3/25 (Mon) Response to Packet Tampering Attempts Notice

Hunters Association
|
Mar 25, 2024, 11:57
|
980

 

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you!

 

We thank all the Hunters who are passionately playing Solo Leveling:Arise.

 

Solo Leveling:Arise is continuously monitoring and managing the game to create a fair gaming environment and ensure a pleasant and convenient gaming experience for our Hunters.

 

Since the launch of our service last week, there have been attempts at packet tampering aimed at Solo Leveling:Arise.

 

The system automatically detects packet tampering attempts, and if detected, game access will be restricted.

 

You may experience disadvantages when using your account due to packet tampering attempts. Please note this to avoid any disadvantages in using your valuable account.

 

To create a fair gaming environment, we will take firm action against the use of unauthorized programs and data manipulation.

 

We will always try our best to ensure a pleasant adventure for our Hunters.

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Note: New Hunter Arrival & Gameplay Update

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: New Hunter Arrival & Gameplay Update

Hunters Association
|
Apr 15, 2024, 10:00
|
29,908

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

We would like to express our sincere gratitude to all the Hunters

who are accompanying us on our journey in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

We are aware of your keen interest in gameplay

and all the other upcoming updates soon to come.

 

Today, the Solo Leveling:ARISE team will review the past month of Early Access

and share some insights into the gameplay that will be unveiled in the near future.

 

First, let’s take a look at the upcoming update scheduled for April.

 

 

[New Hunter Arrival]

 

“Silver Mane Baek Yoonho” will join the Gate raid. 

 

 

[Tearing down enemies mercilessly with claws equipped on both hands.]

A close-ranged fighter specialized in dealing massive damage to a single enemy.

 

Initially, the team deliberated very carefully

on presenting "Baek Yoonho" in both beast and human form.

 

After careful consideration of each form's skills and position,

we concluded that only by separating the hunter would we be able to properly 

present the unique battle style for each hunter.

 

We're delighted to announce that "Silver Mane Baek Yoonho" will join the Gate raid,

bringing even more thrilling action to the game.

 

[Maintaining Vibrant Gameplay]

 

Over the past month, we have identified several issues

and are in the process of resolving them one by one.

For example, we reduced the combat difficulty of Chapter 8-5 on April 11th.

 

More details will be revealed in the upcoming update notices,

In today's Developer Note, we would like to focus on two major changes in the game.

 

[Enhancing Enjoyment in Battle Experience]

1. The difficulty of the Power of Destruction will be reduced.

2. The Hunter formation will be improved to automatically select the Hunter with higher combat power, after comparing the Hunter you own and the Hunter that is provided in the Sub Story.

3. The skill effects of some Hunters will be improved.

4. The achievement conditions for certain battle missions will be relieved.

 

[Removing Obstacles Hindering Hunter's Sprint]

1. Fixed issues where the game would freeze upon clearing certain contents, during loading, or in the middle of gameplay.

2. Fixed issues where tutorials wouldn't progress properly, causing the game to be unplayable.

 

We value your feedback, and the Solo Leveling:ARISE team will continue to grow with your valuable opinions.

 

[Faction of the Shield]

 

Defense measures against the use of illegal programs and malicious behavior will be further strengthened.

 

Our team is committed to creating a fair gaming environment

by continuously monitoring and tracking illegal programs.

Through thorough analysis, we're investigating and taking action against malicious behavior.

 

We will continue to strive to strengthen and enhance our defenses

against illegal programs and malicious activities.

 

[Upcoming Journey]

 

We are focusing on a major update scheduled for May.

 

Our focus lies in improving the game by closely monitoring aspects related to combat experience,

resource acquisition and consumption, and balance.

 

Our team is actively preparing the following:

 

- Considering a reduction in the Gold cost for Artifact replacement.
- Adding additional sources for acquiring Artifact Enhancement Chips to allow players more frequent experiences with Artifact Enhancement.
- Improving the reward acquisition method for the Power of Destruction system.
- Adding Kargalgan's story after Chapter 15.
- Developing various challenge contents to provide diverse combat experiences.
- Improving the method of Selling/Salvaging All Weapons and Artifacts.
- Adding new stories to the Hunter Archive.

 

Solo Leveling:ARISE will continue to develop through the diverse feedback from hunters,

and your opinions play a significant role in its development.

 

 

The team is dedicated to delivering a unique experience to our Hunters through astonishing action, beyond the original story that enthralled the world.

 

Get ready for Solo Leveling:ARISE, where you'll encounter a fresh kind of excitement and ignite your thirst for challenges.

 

This concludes our Developer Note for today, and we'll return with more updates in the next one. Stay tuned!

 

Thank you.

* For products with a specified "Daily Purchase Limit," the purchase count resets every day at 00:00 (UTC+0).

 

 

📌 System Improvements

1. The Check-In interface will be improved.

2. The background color of the Story Mode will change according to the selected difficulty.

3. The displayed list on the left of the Fuse menu will be improved.

4. When playing Hunter modes on mobile devices, the location for certain interfaces of the type B controller will be improved.

5. The display method of the Activity Funds will be improved.

6. Effects will be added when forming Shadows and Hunters in the Form Team screen.

7. The amount of possessing Gold will be displayed within the Artifact enhancement pop-up.

8. When obtaining new Runes, visual effects will be added based on the grade of the obtained Runes.

9. A rolling banner will be added in the Lobby.

10. The sorting filter for the Tournament achievement reward list in the Points Event will be improved.

11. A recommended package popup feature will be added upon meeting specific conditions

12. The display method of guidance messages when the story view is set to OFF will be improved.

13. A red dot will be displayed when there is an opened Dossier.

14. The message display period when unlocking content will be extended.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

1. Fixed the issue where the Exchange Shop tab remained selected even after visiting other shop tabs.

2. Fixed the issue where the color of certain Hunters’ QTE skill effects was displayed differently in certain circumstances.

3. Fixed the issue where the coupon images were not displayed in the webshop.

4. Fixed the issue where some of the description text was incorrectly displayed for the R-Rank [Knight's Sword] Advancement Tier 3 application effect.

5. Fixed the issue where the [Obtain Lee Bora] achievement was not properly completed after obtaining the Hunter through the [Total Purchases] reward in the [Bonus] tab of the Shop.

- Hunters experiencing this issue will have it resolved upon logging in after this update.

6. Fixed the issue where the camera position remained fixed when conversing with lobby NPCs under specific circumstances.

7. Fixed the issue where the sound of specific NPCs remained constant regardless of distance.

8. Modified the cooldown reset effect of The Commander's Touch skill to be applied properly.

9. Fixed the issue where the effects of Min Byung-gu Advancement Tier 5 were only applied to Min Byung-gu himself, ensuring they are now applied to the hunter with the highest combat power as intended.

10. Fixed the issue where certain characters in Hunter Archive were displayed smaller than others.

11. Modified Hwang Dongsoo’s Basic Skill [Urge to Kill] so that the attribute [Impulsive Revenge] is maintained when hitting the enemy.

12. Fixed the issue where the Shadow growth value was applied to the maximum on the Shadow Info in some Rank Details.

13. Fixed the issue where the red dot and reward claim button were active, even though there were no rewards available in the Power of Destruction.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Note: The Winds of Change [Updated 4/26 (Fri) 11:00 (UTC+0)]

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: The Winds of Change [Updated 4/26 (Fri) 11:00 (UTC+0)]

Hunters Association
|
Apr 26, 2024, 10:00
|
21,676

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

Since the start of our Early Access last month, our team has been running towards an even more significant mission, the Grand Update.

 

In this developer note, we would like to share some finalized matters after consideration for improvement and provide a sneak peek at some of the upcoming updates.

 

 

[ARISE: Feedback]

 

During the Early Access period, many hunters provided diverse and fantastic feedback on maximizing the fun of various combat styles.

 

We have promptly addressed feedback that could be quickly implemented through development, while improvements for other feedback are still in progress.

 

- The Gold cost for Artifact replacement will be reduced based on the Enhancement Tier.

- Gold Repeat Rewards for Gate missions will be increased.

- Considering lowering the difficulty of accomplishing certain events

 

Reflecting the feedback from many hunters, we have decreased the Artifact removal cost and increased the sources of Gold acquisition.

 

Through this measure, we hope hunters can combine various Artifact stats and experience diverse action gameplay.

(Thank you to all the hunters who provided feedback!)

 

[Faction of the Shield Skill Level Up]

 

We have activated the Faction of the Shield since the start of Early Access last month.

 

Furthermore, we have leveled up the Faction of the Shield to investigate malicious activities, impose sanctions, and take measures to delete the rankings of detected fraudulent registrations.

 

In the future, we will continue strengthening the Faction of the Shield and strive to create a fair gaming environment.

(Fraudulent registrations will not be able to escape the scrutiny of the Hunter Association's Surveillance Team)

 

[The Winds of Change]

 

First of all, thank you again for enjoying Solo Leveling:ARISE during the Early Access period.

 

Now, we will introduce the completed development of the major updates mentioned in the previous developer note, as well as the various contents that our team will introduce in the future.
(As a developer, it's always fun and happy to present new updates.)

 

“Diversity”

 

Our team hoped that hunters would enjoy diverse gameplay through various combinations.

 

Sometimes through combinations of Artifacts, sometimes through Runes and Blessing Stones, or even combinations of different Skills and Weapons.

 

However, after analyzing the diverse play patterns of hunters during the past period, we found that various combinations were not being used as intended, and we are currently working on finding the causes and making improvements.

 

We would like to thank the hunters who have helped improve the completeness of this project. 
Based on feedback from hunters, the following balance adjustments will be made to improve completeness.

Sung Jinwoo Exclusive Weapon
- [Demon King's Longsword] is a powerful, yet hard to obtain S-Rank item in the original story, but its power does not seem to be activated properly in-game. Therefore, the damage will be adjusted upward based on its Advancement Tier.
- The Critical Hit Rate of [Orc's Broadsword] will be adjusted upwards based on its Advancement Tier.
- The Damage of [Rock Golem Hammer] will be adjusted upwards based on its Advancement Tier.
- The Shield and Damage of [Knight Killer] will be adjusted upwards based on its Advancement Tier.
- The Damage of [West Wind] will be reduced, and only 1 stack is possible per skill.
- When the first target of [West Wind] is hit with a Critical Hit, the cooldown decreases.

 

Hunter Stats [Updated 4/26 (Fri) 11:00 (UTC+0)] 
- Will fix the issue where only two Phantom Foxes were summoned in certain circumstances upon reaching Advancement Tier 1 with Lee Bora. 
- Will fix the issue where Woo Jinchul's Super Armor was not applied in certain circumstances.
- WIll increase the damage of Han Song-Yi's Retrieve skill.
- Will fix the issue where mana consumption increased abnormally upon reaching Advancement Tier 1 with Song Chiyul. 

* Some text has been clarified to avoid confusion.

 

Certain Stats [Updated 4/26 (Fri) 11:00 (UTC+0)] 
- Will fix the issue where the Critical Damage stat dealt to Magic Beasts was applied less than intended.
We sincerely apologize to our Hunters for the inconvenience caused by the issue. 

* Some text has been clarified to avoid confusion.

 

We would like to extend our gratitude to the Hunters who have contributed to improving the completeness of Solo Leveling:Arise. Now, we would like to proceed with sharing the upcoming update details.

 

 

Sung Jinwoo has overcome numerous hardships and trials against adversaries like Arachnid, Hwang Dongsuk, Kang Taeshik, and Igris.

 

In the upcoming update, the addition of a new story will introduce the appearance of Almighty Shaman Kargalgan and unexpected twists and turns in the adventure.

 

If you haven't equipped artifacts suitable for hunters yet, the new content may demand extreme control and strategy.

 

After reading this, you now have a choice to make.

Focusing on farming artifacts or training your control skills?

(Unless you have high-end gear from head to toe like Yoo Jinho.)

 

[Hunters' Runway]

 

Our team hoped that battles with various hunters would offer a different kind of excitement from Sung Jinwoo's battles.

 

Fortunately, it seems that hunters are enjoying quite interesting battles through various combinations.

 

In particular, we were pleased to know that we could provide different combat gameplay experiences by observing hunters challenging dungeons like The Gatekeeper of Hell, Cerberus, and The Runaway Giant Arachnid with different combinations.

 

To provide another layer of enjoyment in hunter combination battles, we are preparing a system with various costumes for hunters actively participating in raids and making the dungeon feel like a runway. We appreciate your anticipation.

 

[Next Step!]

 

 

While Sung Jinwoo experienced a Job Change to The Monarch of Shadows only once in the original work, our team wanted to express that Sung Jinwoo is continuously growing.

 

Through the Change Job system, feedback on growth is provided through milestones to expand the combat experience.

 

With the upcoming update, Sung Jinwoo will be able to achieve a Job Change beyond The Monarch of Shadows, and hunters will be able to experience more diverse skills along with a unique costume based on the new Changed Job.

 

[Fragments of Their Stories]

 

In addition to the stories of Kang Taeshik, who causes mysterious accidents, and B-Rank healer Lee Joohee, who is afraid of Magic Beasts, new hunters' stories await you.

 

Please look forward to what secret stories the new hunters will tell.

 

[Power of Destruction]

 

The boss of Power of Destruction uses various Lethal Moves depending on their phase transition.

Sometimes, he raises his right hand and strikes hard, and sometimes sweeps the floor, going berserk.

 

The key to Power of Destruction is to repeatedly enjoy the pleasure of intuitive numerical growth through the cycle of growth → numerical verification → reward acquisition → growth.

 

However, we have determined that improvements to the current mechanism are necessary to provide the above-mentioned enjoyment, and we are considering various improvements.

 

More details will be revealed in the upcoming Update Details notice.

 

[No Secrets - New Hunter Arrival]

 

"Cha Hae-In" will join the Gate raid.

 

 

[Vice Guild Master of the Hunters Guild ]

As Korea's ninth S-Rank hunter, she attracts public attention with her beautiful appearance and outstanding skills.

 

However, we had some concerns about Cha Hae-In's exposure in various communities and the trend predicting her as the next Rate Up hunter.

 

As well as when and how to introduce Cha Hae-In and in what form.

(Hunters' prediction skills are indeed remarkable.)

 

As many hunters have eagerly awaited Cha Hae-In's arrival, we are pleased to announce in this developer note that Cha Hae-In will join the Gate raid.

 

 

Our team is focusing on the upcoming grand update.

Through this update, we aim to excite the world and deliver amazing action never seen before.

 

We appreciate your continued interest and participation in Solo Leveling:ARISE as we embark on this new journey.

As a token of appreciation, CM Iron has prepared a gift for our Hunters, so check out the link below!

[Grand Update Celebration Countdown Check-In Event]

 

This concludes our Developer Note for today, and we'll return with more news in the next one. Stay tuned!

 

Thank you.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

 - Improved some descriptions for Shadow Soldiers.

 - Added Reputation rewards for certain chapters in the Story.

 - Improved type classification in the Artifact menu and added a list extension feature.

 - Improved some interfaces within the Crafting menu.

 - Improved some interfaces within the Battlefield of Trials Floor selection screen.

 - Added explanatory text to the Critical Hit Damage (?) button in the Stat Details pop-up.

 - Added Immunity to continuous damage for bosses in Power of Destruction.

 - Improved the description text for the [Sunder] Rune skill.

 - Added a feature to claim rewards upon initial game download and log in.

* After claiming the rewards, the reward icon may still appear upon logging in from another device, but the reward can only be claimed once per account.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the issue where pressing the SKIP button repeatedly during the SSR animation in the Draw results screen resulted in incorrect sound output.

- Fixed the issue where the UI sound was interrupted during skill preview.

- Fixed the issue where the background music continued after exiting the game.

- Fixed the issue where the screen was displayed abnormally after starting Battlefield of Time with the Auto-Battle feature on.

- Fixed the issue where a red dot was displayed even though there were no items to claim in the mail in certain situations.

- Fixed the issue where being in an Invincible state through buffs caused stagger when attacked with Super Armor.

- Fixed the intermittent issue where Hunter skills could not be used during battles with The Gatekeeper of Hell, Cerberus.

- Fixed the issue where certain Side Stories were not displayed.

- Fixed the issue where Support Hunters were summoned when some Red Gate bosses appeared.

- Fixed the issue where the description text of some Artifact stats was not properly displayed the same as the unit.

* Please note that the description text displayed on the Artifact info has been modified, and the applied effects will not be affected.

- Fixed the issue where Camera Settings were not applied normally when setting keys in Netmarble Launcher (PC).

- Fixed the results screen to be properly displayed during continuous growth.

- Fixed the issue where critical damage dealt to magic beasts was applied less than intended.

- Fixed the issue where some Defense Penetration values ​​were not applied properly.

- Fixed the issue where the attack speed of Lethargy debuff used by some monsters was incorrectly applied to characters.

- Fixed the abnormal camera display when playing Dungeon Break.

- Fixed the Special Commissions count to be checked in Gates, Instance Dungeon, and Encore Missions.

- Fixed the issue where battles did not proceed normally in certain circumstances when playing Power of Destruction.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Note: A Thank You Letter from the <Solo Leveling:ARISE> Team

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: A Thank You Letter from the <Solo Leveling:ARISE> Team

Hunters Association
|
May 10, 2024, 10:03
|
565,675

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

Today, instead of a dry developer note, we would like to express our heartfelt gratitude to the hunters who have shown us unwavering support.

 

Since the grand launch, many of you have been enjoying various touching scenes from the original story by playing as the main character [Sung Jinwoo] or [Hunters].

 

Our team had one goal in mind when developing this project.

 

It was to present not only the experience of the original work, which can only be felt in Solo Leveling:ARISE, but also various fun elements, such as the original Hunters and the Army of Shadows.

 

Perhaps that's why we can't forget the thrill of the first encounter with Igris presented in the game.

 

 

Our team has always dreamed and hoped for this moment...

 

to show our Hunters the moment of the main character, Sung Jinwoo, growing into The Monarch of Shadows,

and the stylish actions using various weapons and runes!

 

Now, A new world of action begins.

 

As a new world begins, our team is reviewing the valuable feedback from our hunters.

 

We promise to do our best to repay your support and provide an enjoyable action experience. We also commit to continuous communication with our hunters.

 

We will also do our best to resolve any issues that are currently occurring as quickly as possible to avoid any inconvenience.

 

For example, there may be game crashes due to black screens or multiple executions.

If you encounter the issue of multiple executions, no need to worry about whether someone else has secretly logged into my account.

A temporary solution is available by restarting the PC, and we will try to fix the root cause as soon as possible. 😥

 

Additionally, we are preparing a variety of content as well as stories.

For example, we are working on the "Guild System," which is an important worldview in the original work.

 

Perhaps in the next developer's note, we can provide more detailed information.

 

Please look forward to the new journey in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

We will continue to excite our hunters and present enjoyable action.

 

We'll return with more news in the next one.

 

We have prepared a token of appreciation for our hunters, so please make sure to check your mailbox.

Perhaps there may be some good news every Friday.

👉 [Go to the <Solo Leveling:ARISE> Grand Launch Appreciation Gift Notice]

 

 

(S'up Sung! Check the Mailbox in the Lobby. It's on the right side of the Missions!

Still don't know? Ugh, No wonder they call you The Weakest Hunter of All Mankind...

Don't forget! 💌)

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

Thank you to all the hunters who enjoy playing Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

As previously announced in the global launch notice, automated ranking exclusion processing continues by introducing real-time AI (Faction of the Shield) with advanced detection to prevent unauthorized program users from registering fraudulent records.

 

If detected by the anti-cheat system, your ranking may be excluded, and fraudulent game data may be subject to deletion.

 

Furthermore, the anti-cheat system "Faction of the Shield" in Solo Leveling:ARISE will continuously upgrade through AI-based learning to enhance detection sensitivity against cheating.

 

In cases of manipulation detection in ranking records, initial restrictions on ranking-related content will be implemented, and game usage itself may be restricted.

 

We kindly ask for your attention to prevent any disruption to your valuable account and gameplay due to small temptations.

We will continue to strengthen the Shield faction and strive to create a fair gaming environment.

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

If you have any concerns or issues regarding the detection, please contact our Customer Support.

name.en: Developer Note: Cold-Blooded Ice Queen Coming! [Updated 5/22 (Wed) 02:37 (UTC+0)]

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Cold-Blooded Ice Queen Coming! [Updated 5/22 (Wed) 02:37 (UTC+0)]

Hunters Association
|
May 21, 2024, 09:00
|
205,408

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

It has already been two weeks since we started this journey with our hunters.

Today, we are here to express our gratitude and introduce some new content we are currently preparing.

Now let's take a look at the prepared content one by one!

 

 

1. New Content - Battlefield of Chaos

First, we would like to introduce the "Battlefield of Chaos," a new content that will bring new excitement to our hunters.

 

The Battlefield of Chaos is a defense-type dungeon in which hunters must defeat randomly appearing bosses consecutively. This will be a difficult content where hunters who are farming Tier 10 Encore Missions or Instance Dungeon can challenge.

 

We expect that Battlefield of Chaos will offer a differentiated battle experience, unlike any existing content, for hunters who have grown to a certain level. Dominate the Battlefield of Chaos and seize the strength of the powerful Gems!

 

 

2. New Content - Gem

We have put a lot of thought into presenting the Battlefield of Chaos and offering appealing rewards to hunters. We felt that simple rewards such as Gold and EXP would not be enough to provide sufficient motivation to challenge the new content.

 

After careful consideration, we are revealing "Gem" as a new reward and content for our hunters.

 

Obtain various Gems while playing the Battlefield of Chaos and freely set the obtained Gems to the newly added Gem system slot. Equip Gems and unlock the next levels of Gems to power up Sung Jinwoo, the other Hunters, and even the Shadows to fight against the massive chaos.

 

 

3. New Character - Alicia Blanche

Solo Leveling original character Alicia Blanche, whom many hunters may have already met at the Hunters Association lobby, is finally joining the hunters.

 

While Sung Jinwoo is known as the weakest hunter of all mankind, a story will unfold in France about Alicia Blanche, who strives to uncover the truth and face an unknown enemy. Experience the story of a beautiful water elemental hunter who blossoms ice flowers with powerful freezing magic.

 

 

 

These are the crucial aspects we plan to reveal by the end of May. We will also introduce various content that we are preparing with time to ensure its completeness and quality for future releases.

 

4. Guild

Even when playing the same game, the experience and immersion can be significantly different depending on the bond. We are well aware of this difference, so our target for the first grand update was "development of a Guild system." As the Guild is considered important in the original story, we thought that the Guild system our hunters encounter in the game must also be special.

 

To achieve this, hunters who are joining a Guild will be able to bond with each other and grow together, receiving various benefits based on their progress. Additionally, our goal is to enable the creation of unique Guilds through various themes and interactions. We will try our best to provide a Guild system our hunters can be satisfied with.

 

5. Workshop of Brilliant Light

We are preparing a new content called "Workshop of Brilliant Light (working title)" to offer hunters another engaging gameplay experience. Workshop of Brilliant Light is a challenge-type content where various bosses appear. You will encounter powerful bosses but will be able to weaken them through various methods and use these methods to gain advantages in the battle.

 

We hope that the test video we've prepared will excite hunters about the new challenge content, "Workshop of Brilliant Light."

 

 

6. Improvement in Balance and Details

Currently, as we move through early access and the official launch, we are disappointed to see that some hunters are not as favored as our development team intended. The development team has been continuously considering this issue and determined that providing the joy of diverse gameplay is crucial. Therefore, a performance adjustment will take place as below based on current usage and the performance balance result.

 

The following hunters and weapons are also scheduled to be buffed compared to their current status. [Updated 5/22 (Wed) 02:37 (UTC+0)]

 - SSR Min Byung-Gu, SSR  Seo Jiwoo, SSR Emma Laurent, SSR Cha Hae-In, SSR  Choi Jong-In

 - SR Park Beom-Shik, SR Song Chiyul, SR Jo Kyuhwan

 - SSR Vulcan's Rage, R Lycan Slayer

More details will be provided in a future Update Details notice.

 

As for SSR weapons, which require a lot of time and effort to power up, they are not easy to use for hunters who prefer a relatively lighter gaming experience. To address this, we are preparing features such as evolving SR Sung Jinwoo weapons into higher-grade weapons and crafting SR hunter-exclusive weapons. We will try to be as careful and discreet as we can, as this will change the composition of the game that has already been launched. We hope that our sincere wish for many hunters to enjoy the game even more can be effectively conveyed.

 

7. Conclusion

The Battlefield of Chaos, Gem, and new hunter Alicia Blanche are in the final stage of preparation and will be revealed to our hunters soon. We will also try hard to release the Guild system and Workshop of Brilliant Light as soon as possible.

 

As it’s in the early stages of service, we are receiving countless feedback on improvements and bug reports from our hunters. We greatly appreciate the feedback and deeply apologize for not being able to resolve the issues promptly. Especially for issues regarding hacking or abuse of the program, we will take measures firmly based on our principles. We will strive to resolve bugs as fast as we can and provide a more enjoyable gameplay experience.

 

Thanks to the love sent from our hunters Solo Leveling:ARISE has reached 20 million downloads. We will never forget that all of this is thanks to the overwhelming love and support from our hunters. We have prepared a small check-in event for hunters to enjoy until the new update is released.

Log in every day to receive rewards and enjoy the game.

 

👉 [20 Million Downloads Celebration! 10-Day Check-In Event]

 

This concludes our Developer Note for today, and we'll return with more news in the next one. Stay tuned!

 

Thank you.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

- [Battlefield of Chaos], where you can defeat randomly appearing bosses consecutively, will be added.

- There are a total of five battlefields, and different battlefields are opened daily.

- Each battlefield consists of several tiers, and you can challenge the higher tiers after clearing the lower tiers.

- The conditions for forming a team and the recommended attributes differ based on the type and tier of the battlefield.

* The Battlefield of Chaos is unlocked after clearing [Chapter 15]

* The Battlefield of Chaos has a limited number of times you can claim rewards daily.

you will not receive rewards even if you clear the battlefield.

* Some products may have a weekly purchase limit and may be available again after the weekly reset.

* Depending on the type of product, either Gold, Essence Stones, or direct payment may be required, so please check the details in the game.

 

📌 Common Notes for All Packages

- All of the packages and content can be sold again in the future.

- The sales period may be subject to change in certain circumstances and we will notify you of the changes through a notice.

- The packages can be purchased for a limited time during the sales period.

- The purchasing methods differ based on the type of package. Please check the details in the game.

- Available purchases for the packages with [Monthly purchase limit] will be reset every first day of the month at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- Available purchases for the packages with [Weekly purchase limit] will be reset every Monday at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- Available purchases for the packages with [Daily purchase limit] will be reset every day at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- Decreased the difficulty of Extreme Evasion.

- Improved to ensure that usage of Sung Jinwoo and Hunters’ skills is not disrupted in certain circumstances when playing Story content.

- Added a pop up where you can select the gamepad control type in the game title screen.

* You can also select the control type in the Options within the game title screen.

- Deleted certain effects and skills that black Sung Jinwoo uses in the Sung Jinwoo job change quest.

- Improved certain monsters’ attack methods and effects appearing in Side Chapters of certain Stories.

- Improved to properly apply the display resolution of the Netmarble Launcher (PC).

- Improved Caution description of Special Summons.

- Improved to be able to claim all the event mission rewards at once that could be achieved without limits.

- Improved Hunters’ skill use sequences more smoothly in Auto mode.

- Details regarding the Burn effect will be added to the Encore Missions The Gatekeeper of Hell, Cerberus info.

* The effect was already being applied before and only the details will be added.

 “When the debuff has stacked a certain number of times, it deals significant damage to the entire party.”

- Improved display conditions for the in-game red dot.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the issue where the tutorial could not proceed in certain circumstances.

- Fixed the issue where a security error occurred when attempting to log in under unstable network conditions.

- Fixed the issue where hunters were unable to attach images when using Customer Support on iOS devices.

- Improved some description text.

- Fixed abnormal display issues in certain interfaces.

- Fixed the intermittent issue where test text was displayed on the Options screen.

- Fixed certain descriptions in the Battlefield of Trials.

- Fixed the Artifact lock feature to apply normally.

- Fixed the intermittent issue where QTE skills could not be used during Basic/Core Attacks with gun-type weapons.

- Fixed the issue where the Cha Hae-In Hunter Preview was unable to proceed in certain circumstances.

- Fixed the intermittent issue where certain Chapters were unable to proceed.

- Fixed the issue where Anna Ruiz's skills would not activate properly in certain circumstances.

- Fixed the issue where Sung Jin-Woo's Job Change Quest did not proceed properly in certain circumstances.

- Fixed the issue where the animation screen was displayed abnormally when obtaining Choi Jong-In through a draw.

- Fixed the intermittent issue where some weapon skills were not activated properly.

- Fixed the issue where some Hunters' Support Skills did not activate properly in certain circumstances.

- Fixed the issue where the Lycan Slayer hit less than intended when using.

- Fixed the issue where the [Red Mane Lycan] didn’t appear in some cases when changing bosses during Instance Dungeon Steel-fanged Lycan content.

- Fixed the issue where certain effects of Yoo Jinho advancement tier 5 were not applied normally.

- Fixed the issue where certain effects of the Blessing Stones were not applied normally.

- Fixed the issue where the name of the rank, [Heroic] has been displayed inconsistently in certain circumstances. 
* Please note that the phrase [Heroic] will be used for the rank after the update.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you!

 

Solo Leveling:ARISE strives to create a fair gaming environment to ensure our hunters can always enjoy smooth and uninterrupted gameplay.

 

Our detection system, Faction of the Shield, is actively monitoring for abnormal activities such as intentional disruption of operations, abuse, and the use of unauthorized programs. If detected, these activities will result in the deletion of rankings.

 

Please refer to this to avoid any actions that may cause your valuable account to face penalties.

* Upon being detected, your ranking will not be registered and will not be able to receive related rewards.

 

 

We will continue to strengthen the Shield faction and strive to create a fair gaming environment.

 

Thank you.

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

A server patch is scheduled for 5/29 (Wed).

 

The connection may be unstable while the patch is in progress,

so please be sure to play the game after the patch is complete.

 

Please see below for more details.

 

 

📌 Patch Schedule

- 5/29 (Wed) 10:40 (UTC+0) [Completed]

 

📌 Patch Details

- Fixed an issue where the Total Purchases rewards in the Bonus tab of the Shop were not being received properly.

 

📌 Confirmed Details

- Subject: Hunters who claimed the [Bonus Shop Total Purchases] rewards before the 5/29 (Wed) update.

- Issue: When reaching the Total Purchases milestones in the Bonus Shop, the [Total Purchases Rewards] are displayed as if they have already been claimed. 

 

[Example]

If you have claimed until the third reward of the Total Purchases before the 5/29 (Wed) update, you will be able to claim starting from the fourth reward of the [Bonus Shop Total Purchases] after the update.

 

📌 Planned Measure

For hunters who were not able to claim the Total Purchases rewards due to the issue above, the rewards are scheduled to be sent to your mailbox sequentially as soon as possible.

* The reward distribution date will be announced in a future notice.

 

[Added on 5/29 (Wed) 12:40 (UTC+0)]

 

The issue has been resolved on 5/29 (Wed) 12:40 (UTC+0).
* The rewards can be claimed upon reconnecting to the game after the issue normalization period.

 

For hunters who did not receive the [Bonus Shop Total Purchases] rewards, 

we will distribute them via in-game mail at a later date, 

and we will provide further information on the distribution schedule.

 

[Added on 5/31 (Fri) 08:56 (UTC+0)]
The unreceived rewards have been distributed to hunters through mail who were unable to receive rewards for the Bonus Shop Total Purchases after the 5/29 (Wed) update.
* The rewards will be stored for 365 days in the mailbox. Please claim the rewards before the expiration date.
* The rewards are being distributed sequentially. We will try our best to distribute the rewards as soon as possible to hunters who have not yet received the rewards.

 

[Added on 6/5 (Wed) 08:40 (UTC+0)]
The second distribution for the unreceived [Bonus Shop Total Purchases] rewards has been completed.
* The rewards will be stored for 365 days in the mailbox. Please claim the rewards before the expiration date.
* The rewards are being distributed sequentially. We will try our best to distribute the rewards as soon as possible to hunters who have not yet received the rewards.

 

[Added on 6/12 (Wed) 09:25 (UTC+0)]
The third distribution for the unreceived [Bonus Shop Total Purchases] rewards has been completed.
* The rewards will be stored for 365 days in the mailbox. Please claim the rewards before the expiration date.
* The rewards are being distributed sequentially. We will try our best to distribute the rewards as soon as possible to hunters who have not yet received the rewards.

 

[Added on 6/19 (Wed) 06:28 (UTC+0)]
All unreceived [Bonus Shop Total Purchases] rewards have been distributed.
* The rewards will be stored for 365 days in the mailbox. Please claim the rewards before the expiration date.

 

📌 Notes

* Please note that you may experience disconnections during the patch process.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Notice from the Hunters Association [Updated 6/4 (Tue) 11:07 (UTC+0)]

Hunters Association
|
Jun 3, 2024, 12:57
|
22,343

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

Our team introduced the first update since our global launch last month, and we are now gearing up for an even more significant mission: the major update in June.

 

In this developer note, we would like to talk about the improvements we have been considering, the confirmed updates, and the feedback hunters have shared with us through the community.

 

 

[Battle Experience]

 

Recently, as various tests and strategies regarding hunters and weapons have been conducted, discrepancies have occurred between what is stated in the in-game tooltips and what is actually applied in the game.

We sincerely apologize for the confusion.

 

Contrary to our intention, we have also received feedback in various communities regarding interruptions in battle experience. We will inform you of the resolution of the issue.

 

Min Byung-Gu

- The power gauge recovery value in Min Byung-Gu's Divine Punishment skill description will be changed from 5% to 50%, and will be reflected as 50% recovery for the entire team rather than individual recovery.

(The description will be modified to match the current 50% application.)

- Min Byung-Gu's Advancement Tier 1 description will be changed from "Light Attribute" to "the entire team."

(It is currently being applied to the entire team, and the description will be modified accordingly.)

 

Seo Jiwoo

- Seo Jiwoo's Advancement Tier 5 effect, Critical Hit Rate, was being applied at 32%. However, there was an issue where the combined total was not fully reflected when it was added to other Critical Hit Rate effects, which will be fixed.

(Please note that the final applied value may change due to monster level-based Critical Hit resistance.)

 

- The effect of Seo Jiwoo's Advancement Tier 4 (increasing Max HP by 15% of Critical Hit Damage) is currently being applied by converting the percent increase in Critical Hit Damage from Artifact Set effects to HP. The description will be modified to make this clear.

(Please note that the percent increases in critical damage from Artifact set effects, team buffs, exclusive weapon effects, etc., will be applied. However, numerical values such as stats from Artifact stats will not be converted to HP.)

* We have checked the opinions of many hunters after posting the Developer Note.
After thorough internal discussion, we have decided to buff the Seo Jiwoo’s Advancement Tier 4 effect, increases the user’s Max HP by an amount equal to 15% of Critical Hit damage, by not only applying Artifact Set Effects, team buffs, and exclusive weapon effect, but also the Artifact option effects and Gems to the critical hit damage. 

We will do our best to ensure that the value of hunters efforts and dedication is preserved in the future.

* The details above have been complemented to prevent any misunderstanding. 

[Revised 6/4 (Tue) 11:07 (UTC+0)]

 

Sung Jinwoo’s Exclusive Weapon & Skill Rune

- An issue where Knight Killer's Telekinesis skill is not correctly applying up to 10 stacks as intended will be fixed to ensure that it properly stacks up to 10.

- An issue where the Demonic Plum Flower Sword's Amplifying Draw fails to trigger the final hit in certain situations after activation will be fixed.

- An issue where the Amplifying Draw does not refresh when the Full Bloom skill is activated after a specific awakening of the Demonic Plum Flower Sword will be fixed.

- An issue where Sung Jinwoo's damage abnormally increases when using the Death's Dance: Wildfire Skill Rune will be fixed to ensure that the damage increase applies normally when attacking with the weakness attribute of the Rune Skill.

 

Dungeon Issues

- An intermittent issue in Chapter 17 where the HP of High Orcs does not decrease below a certain level as intended will be fixed.

- An issue where Arachne repeats certain actions in specific situations will be fixed.

- Certain dungeon monsters have a Freeze resistance effect, where they become immune to Freeze for a certain period. The resistance effect is applied differently depending on the boss monster's attributes. For example, bosses like Power of Destruction Ennio may be immune to effects like Bleed. We have identified that there is insufficient explanation regarding this mechanic, so we plan to enhance the descriptions of status effect resistance and immunity in the dungeon entrance screen to provide clearer information.

 

Min Byung-Gu, Seo Jiwoo, and Sung Jinwoo Skill Rune related adjustments mentioned above will be implemented as soon as possible and will be announced through a separate notice.

 

Any other inconveniences or bugs you may be experiencing will be addressed and resolved in the next update.

 

We would like to express our gratitude to all the hunters who have contributed to improving the quality of Solo Leveling:ARISE.

As a token of our appreciation, we have prepared a special gift for you. Please refer to the notice below for more information.

 

👉[<Solo Leveling:ARISE> Developer's Gift Notice]

 

 

[Hunter Origin]

 

Our team aimed to expand the Solo Leveling universe by incorporating original hunters into the game.

To achieve this, their stories needed to be seamlessly integrated into the game.

 

There are still numerous untold stories within the game, particularly those surrounding the mysterious original hunters. Among them, we are eager to uncover the secrets of Alicia Blanche, the Guild Master of Justitia.

 

Alicia Blanche, who recently joined Gate Raid, harbors a dark past.

She lost everything in an accident during a raid she attended with her father and swore vengeance.

 

[Alicia Blanche - Excerpt from The Last Raid of the Astraea Guild (That Day)]

 

 

Why Nina's grandmother treated her coldly and what happened that day...

 

These questions will soon be revealed in the upcoming Alicia Blanche episode, so please look forward to it.

 

[Growth Experience]

 

Over the past month, we have observed the artifacts of our hunters and come to two conclusions. Hunters either sell artifacts with specific stats to earn Gold or keep some enhanced artifacts as they are.

 

We hoped that our hunters would enjoy various combat experiences by switching and enhancing multiple artifacts.

 

One obstacle preventing you from fully enjoying these combat experiences is the limited supply of [Artifact Enhancement Chips]. To improve this, we are preparing an event where you can use artifacts with non-utilized stats from the enhancement process to obtain items necessary for growth.

 

(We will provide further details separately.)

 

 

[Faction of the Shield Skill Level Up]

 

Defense measures against unauthorized program usage and malicious activities are becoming more robust. Our team is committed to creating a fair gaming environment by continuously monitoring and tracking unauthorized programs and removing offenders from the rankings.

 

Starting with the June update, we would like to inform you in advance that repeated detection of malicious activities involving unauthorized programs may result in a ban from the game.

 

Additionally, those who create or distribute unauthorized programs, not just those who use them, may face further actions beyond game sanctions.

(Cheaters cannot escape the vigilance of the Hunters Association Surveillance Team.)

 

 

Solo Leveling:ARISE continues to evolve thanks to the ongoing interest and diverse feedback from our hunters.

 

Hunters, we sincerely thank you for always being there with us.

 

We look forward to meeting you again soon.

 

Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Notice from the <Solo Leveling:ARISE> Team

Hunters Association
|
Jun 5, 2024, 12:48
|
17,914

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

We have reviewed various opinions in the community regarding the performance of specific hunters and events.

 

Firstly, we sincerely apologize for any inconvenience caused by several issues. We truly appreciate the valuable feedback from our hunters.

 

We would like to explain the issues that have drawn attention and discussion among our hunters.

 

[Issues Regarding Hunter Performance]

 

Hunters and their skills interact in various ways.

 

During battles, various situations unfold rapidly in real-time, sometimes resulting in outcomes different from what our hunters expect. This has caused significant confusion during the normalization process.

 

We have confirmed that our verification was insufficient during the process of integrating various logic and interactions, and we sincerely apologize for this once again.

 

We will strive to minimize errors to ensure that everything functions as our hunters expect.

 

Additionally, we would address the issue when Min Byung-Gu uses his ultimate skill, "Heavenly Blessing," while in a "Disguise" status, the increased critical damage effect applied to the team is not being applied to Seo Ji-Woo.

 

The effect works by increasing a portion of the critical damage under various conditions. It operates by calculating the increase and then applying it accordingly.

 

However, the calculated value did not operate as expected due to a separate real-time logic applied during these battle situations.

 

This issue requires a revision of the applied logic and program code, and due to the need for thorough verification, it will take some time to fix. We will try to have it properly fixed in the upcoming build update.

 

[Regarding Feedback]

 

We have received many criticisms regarding the slow response from our development team.

 

We continuously monitor our hunters' opinions to ensure that we do not overlook them. However, in our efforts to find the best resolution solutions, we may not have responded as quickly as we desired.

 

In response, our team will strive to increase our speed in addressing hunter feedback. Additionally, if there are cases where responses to reviews take longer, we will notify you in advance through a notice.

 

We remain committed to actively improving any shortcomings to provide our hunters with the best possible experience.

 

If you encounter any incorrect actions during gameplay or areas that require improvement, we would appreciate it if you could report them through the Bug Report board or by contacting our Customer Support via 1:1 inquiry.

 

[Scheduled Improvements]

 

Among the numerous feedbacks from our hunters, we have plans to address the areas that require improvement as follows. The items listed below are scheduled for improvement in the short term, aiming for the next update on 6/19.

 

- To make it easier for hunters to utilize Gate Rescan, we plan to change the Rescan cost from Essence Stones to a small amount of Gold.

We've noticed that many hunters don't use all their Gate Keys, which are essential for obtaining items for growth. We believe that part of it is caused by not being able to find the Gate of the desired rank. To address this, we would like to change the Gate Rescan cost to a small amount of Gold, making it easier for hunters to find Gates of their desired rank without burden.

 

- We are also preparing to increase the amount of Free Special Sweep provided in Daily Growth Support as a next update goal.

 

- Multiplay will be supported in the [Battlefield of Chaos]. Content will continue to be added to the [Battlefield of Chaos], and we aim to improve the quick multiplay process or sweep existing content accordingly.

 

- We are preparing improvements to allow more diverse skills to be utilized by adjusting the balance of Sung Jinwoo's skills.

As hunters grow and acquire various Runes, more hunters are combining different skills. However, there is a tendency for certain skills to be favored over others. To address this, our team will enhance the balance of specific skills, allowing hunters to utilize a more diverse combination of skills and Runes.

 

- We plan to change the Gold used for unequipping Artifacts so that no cost will be incurred up to Tier 15. We consider Tier 15 the benchmark for testing various sets to see if ideal stats are granted. Therefore, we aim to make it more convenient for hunters to frequently test Artifacts up to this stage.

 

[Conclusion]

 

Our ultimate goal is to provide services that deliver an enjoyable experience for our hunters.

 

If there have been any occasions where we have not met your expectations, we sincerely apologize and promise to deliver better services in the future.

 

What gives us the most strength is seeing our hunters enjoy Solo Leveling:ARISE by actively sharing thoughts and strategies about the game.

 

Instead of worrying about bugs, we hope to see more vibrant discussions filled with strategies. We will listen to the voices of our hunters to make Solo Leveling:Arise a game that can be enjoyed for a long time.

 

To better listen to our hunters' voices, we will gather your opinions and improvement suggestions through a survey that will be conducted until next week.

 

We have prepared the gifts below to express our commitment to providing better service in the future.

Please continue to enjoy your battle.

 

📌 Developer Note Reward

- The Developer Note Reward will be sent to all the hunters with Lv. 10 or higher when logging into the game.

* Please restart the game if the reward is not sent to your mailbox.

 

Thank you.

 

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

name.en: Developer Note: Finally, to Demons' Castle!

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Finally, to Demons' Castle!

Hunters Association
|
Jun 12, 2024, 10:49
|
50,321

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

Today, we would like to share the upcoming updated content, improvements,

and future plans with our hunters.

 

 

[Workshop of Brilliant Light: Demons' Castle Lower Floors]

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

 

Workshop of Brilliant Light is a challenge-type content where various bosses appear.

You will encounter powerful bosses, but you can weaken them through various methods and use these methods to gain advantages in the battle.

(Excerpt from a previous Developer Note)

 

Hunters, get ready to face the Ruler of the Lower Floors of the Demons' Castle, Vulcan, who mercilessly punished numerous intruders with a large blunt weapon made from a branch of the World Tree at the Workshop of Brilliant Light: Demons' Castle Lower Floors.

 

Vulcan, whose immense size matches his greed, awaits intruders at Demons' Castle.

To tackle the fire attribute Vulcan, you will need to prepare skills and Hunters associated with the water attribute.

 

Hunters who have conquered Demons' Castle Lower Floors at Workshop of Brilliant Light will have the opportunity to obtain higher-level Artifacts.

These Artifacts will be granted with innovative set effects different from before.

 

Our team hopes that obtaining these higher-level Artifacts will help you power up your Sung Jinwoo and Hunters, making it more enjoyable to tackle previously difficult challenges such as Reverse Mode and Battlefield of Trials.

 

Hunters who have received the Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitation!

It’s time to become even stronger.

 

"On the stage prepared for the Day of Reckoning, how will you proceed?"

 

 

[Growth Experience]

 

In a previous Developer Note, our team mentioned we were preparing an event to assist with Artifact growth.

 

This event is scheduled to take place after the June update. During the event period, salvaging Artifacts will receive Fragments Imbued with Mana Power based on the enhancement tier (1-20) and the equipment rarity.

 

The Artifact Salvage Event can be accessed through the [Event] tab.

 

Fragments Imbued with Mana Power can be exchanged for various growth materials, including Artifact Enhancement Chips. Additionally, Lv. 73 Artifacts obtainable from the Workshop of Brilliant Light can also be acquired through exchange, so please look forward to it.

 

 

[New Hunter Will Join the Gate Raid]

 

 

 

The American hunter "Bella Fisher," who went to China to find her biological parents, also known as the Aquamarine Ripples "Meilin Fisher," will join the Gate raid.

 

[Future Improvements]

 

In addition to the already announced support for Multiplay in Battlefield of Chaos and the removal of Artifact unequipping costs up to +15 enhancements in the June update, we are also preparing various other improvements.

 

● According to Sung Jinwoo's achievement level, rewards will be added to obtain Heroic Blessing Stones, Heroic Runes, and more.
● In the Bonds system, rewards will be improved so that upon pressing the reward button, you can claim all available rewards at once.
● The poison and skill frequency of the Battlefield of Trials Floor 35 Boss, Camula, will be adjusted downwards.

- We noticed that many hunters were struggling with the skill frequency of the Battlefield of Trials Floor 35 Boss, Camula, despite attempting strategies such as using Break or utilizing Hunters like Lee Bora and Park Heejin with Purify. Therefore, we have decided to decrease the difficulty.

● Issues where attacks targeted the wrong enemies or empty spaces after Shadow Step will be fixed.
● The Artifact filter, previously consisting of only one effect, will now be subdivided into Main Effects, Sub Effects, and Excluded Effects, allowing for more detailed filtering. This enables the display or exclusion of the desired effects only.
● Related information will be displayed in the boss information for monsters with Freeze resistance.

 

Furthermore, our team listens closely to the feedback from our hunters and continuously strives to provide the best possible experience.

 

We have also created a platform for hunters to share their feedback in order to offer a better service.

We kindly ask for your active participation so that we can actively improve any shortcomings

 

A survey will be conducted separately soon.

 

 

[Battlefield of Time: Season 2 Balance Adjustment Announcement]

 

Our team has been contemplating as the Battlefield of Time season progresses.

 

Firstly, we have noticed that more hunters were unable to claim the achievement rewards in the Battlefield of Time than we anticipated.

 

Of course, there are also hunters who enjoy the content with various strategies.

 

As Battlefield of Time provides rewards such as Rune Fragments, Shadow Energy, and Essence Stones, we aim to provide additional buffs for those who exceed a certain amount of time to ensure that effort is rewarded with results.

 

The second concern is the tendency of strategies favoring specific weapons.

 

It's a situation where strategies are often repeated until a specific skill achieves maximum damage, or where clearing with just one well-timed attack.

 

Our team believes that providing enjoyment through diverse gameplay experiences is essential. Therefore, we aim to adjust the balance of the appearing monsters to encourage the use of various weapons in Season 2.

 

More detailed information on the adjustments will be revealed at a later date.

 

 

[Grand Summer Festival]

 

Summer is right around the corner.

In celebration of this, our team is preparing a “Grand Summer Festival”.

 

We are working on various content such as limited stories, event bosses, and mini-games that can only be experienced during the Grand Summer Festival. Through these, we aim to provide you with new and exciting experiences.

 

We are releasing an image under development first and kindly ask for your anticipation.

 

 

Our development team will continue to communicate with hunters through CM Notes and Developer Notes.

 

We strive to create a community where players can enjoy the game, share strategies, provide constructive criticism, and offer suggestions for improvement.

 

📌Developer Note Gift

Redeem Code	Redeem Code Reward
SOLODEVNOTE	Essence Stones x 1,000
Lucky Skill Rune Chest x 5

* Each redeem code can only be used once per account.

* The redeem code can be used until 6/18 14:59 (UTC+0) and cannot be used after the period.

* Rewards will be immediately distributed upon redeeming the code.

 

Hunters, we kindly ask for your continued interest and support for Solo Leveling:ARISE as we embark on this new journey together.

 

This concludes our Developer Note for today, and we'll return with more news in the next one. Stay tuned!

 

Thank you.

 

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

 Greetings Hunters,

Solo Leveling is loved by many hunters all over the world!

 

In the first game, Solo Leveling:ARISE, the special stories of hunters, Hunter Origin, will begin.

 

Hunter Origin is an original story exclusive to Solo Leveling:ARISE, not seen in the original work.

It has been created under the supervision of the original author to provide diverse stories and fun within the Solo Leveling universe.

 

In the future, whenever a new Hunter joins the game,

hunters from the original work will be provided with behind-the-scenes stories unique to Solo Leveling:ARISE.

Hunter Origin begins now, and the first episode features the beloved "Alicia Blanche."

Stay tuned for more episodes of Hunter Origin, and we appreciate your continued interest and support.

 

Thank you.

📢 6/19 (Wed) Update Details

 

 

📌 New SSR Hunter & Hunter Exclusive Weapon Added

- An SSR Water Attribute Healer [Meilin Fisher] and her exclusive weapon [Hook, Line, and Sinker] will be added.

- The new Hunter's profile icon, Dossier, and Codex will also be added.

- This Hunter can be obtained through Rate Up Draw, and you can experience the power of this Hunter in advance through Hunter Preview.

📌 New Costumes Added

- New costumes for certain Hunters will be added.

- Costumes can be purchased in the shop.

* Costumes can be equipped by entering through the hanger-shaped button on the Sung Jinwoo and Hunters information screen.

- A new shadow, “Tusk”, will be added.

Tusk

* For more detailed information, please check [Quick Menu > Army of Shadows] in the game.

 

📌 New Content “Workshop of Brilliant Light” Added

- “Workshop of Brilliant Light” is the content where you defeat numerous monsters and bosses.

- It consists of main stages and sub-stages, and the first challenge attempt is free.

- Depending on the stage, you can proceed in Player Mode or Hunter Mode.

- Select the desired difficulty and start your challenge by pressing "Start Raid." The Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitations can be used to enter the stage selection screen.

* No “Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitation” will be consumed on the first attempt for each difficulty.

* This content is unlocked upon clearing [Hard] Chapter 10 of the main Story and can be entered through [Compass > Workshop of Brilliant Light].

* You can challenge if you meet the Battle Tier achievement conditions. Clearing a lower difficulty will allow you to challenge a higher difficulty.

* Workshop of Brilliant Light is held at one-week intervals and is reset once every Wednesday at 00:00 (UTC+0).

Additionally, the Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitations will be charged to its maximum quantity upon weekly reset.

 

[Blessing of Brilliant Light]

- In sub-stages, upon clearing designated waves, the "Blessing of Brilliant Light" buff option will appear, and you can select one of them to receive the buff effect.

* There are multiple waves where you can choose the buff, and all selected buffs will remain active until the end of the battle.

* The Blessing of Brilliant Light buff effects apply to all dungeons within the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

* You can proceed to the next main stage even without clearing the sub-stages.

 

[Rewards]

📌 Sung Jinwoo Level Achievement Reward Added

- Rewards based on Sung Jinwoo's level of achievement will be added.

* The reward page can be accessed via the [Sung Jinwoo] icon located on the right side of the Sung Jinwoo information within the Quick Menu.

* Level achievement requirements and reward information can be checked in-game.

- Participate in the Rate Up Draw event for the new hunter, [Meilin Fisher].

* Rate Up Draw Hunters may be added to the Custom Draw list in the future.

- An event will be held where you can receive various rewards by rolling the dice obtained through missions.

 

📌 A Cute Cat Summoner Has Appeared! Meilin Fisher’s Growth Tournament

- Compete in our Growth Tournament to claim various rewards as you level up your Hunters and accumulate points.

 

📌 6/19 (Wed) Points Event

- Complete designated missions in various points event categories to earn points

and obtain rewards based on the accumulated points.

 

📌 Challenge! Workshop of Brilliant Light Clear Event

- If you enter the Workshop of Brilliant Light during the event period and clear the corresponding mission stage for the first time during the event period, you will receive the rewards twice in total. Once during the event period and once after the event ends.

 

📌 May's Salvage Project! Artifact Salvage Event

 - An Artifact Salvage Event will be held where you can exchange various items using materials obtained from salvaging enhanced Artifacts.

 

* Please refer to separate notices for detailed information about each event.

- Fixed the issue where the boss was not being targeted in Power of Destruction in certain circumstances.

- Corrected the stacking count application for Knight Killer [Telekinesis].

- Fixed the issue where when Min Byung-Gu uses his ultimate skill, "Heavenly Blessing," in the "Disguise" state, the increased critical damage effect applied to the team was not being applied to Seo Ji-Woo's 4th advancement effect, HP conversion.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters
