text_en:
Notices

Notice on the 6/13 Survey

Hunters Association
|
Jun 20, 2024, 11:28
|
8,371

 

 

Greetings Hunters,
The Hunters Association has a notice for you!

 

We would like to provide an update on the survey conducted on 6/13 (Thu). Despite the short period, we received an overwhelming 25,000 responses, thanks to the enthusiastic participation of many players. We deeply appreciate your affection for our game. However, due to the sheer volume of responses, the collection and analysis process is taking longer than expected. 

 

Today, we would like to give an initial update based on the players' main inquiries and feedback. We will continue to analyze the responses and incorporate them into the game. If there are any new updates or content that need further improvement, we will prepare additional notices.

 

Here are the rankings from the first and second surveys regarding the content and growth elements that hunters felt needed the most improvement.
 

Top 3 Content
in Need of Improvement	1. Story	2. Gates	3. Power of Destruction
Top 3 Growth Elements
in Need of Improvement	1. Sung Jinwoo	2. Army of Shadows	3. Artifact

We will consider these insights and strive to implement improvements as quickly as possible so that hunters can experience them firsthand.

Next, we will address the most frequently asked questions from the individual surveys and provide details on the improvements we are currently working on.
 

1. Story

In the story-related survey, we received numerous comments regarding the high combat power required and the difficulty of certain story stages.

Many hunters have pointed out the excessive difficulty, leading to prolonged stagnation in specific areas, and challenges in securing trophies from already cleared dungeons, often requiring specific hunters or limiting the number of hits taken.

We plan to adjust the required combat power, difficulty of stage mechanics, and stats of monsters and bosses.

Our goal is to ensure that new hunters can progress smoothly through the first 15 chapters, and to adjust the overly challenging difficulty beyond Chapter 15, allowing for a more enjoyable story experience.

However, achieving the desired balance will require extensive internal testing and further adjustments after implementation. We will announce the proposed changes and apply them to the game accordingly.

We also plan to make detailed adjustments to the trophy acquisition goals, such as clearing with a specific attribute hit, forming teams with two or more attribute hunters, using extreme evasion 3 times, being hit less than 15 times, and clearing without falling below 30% HP.

Our aim is to provide satisfaction of achievement, and detailed adjustments may include changing to other tasks or changing the number of tasks. We will inform you of the confirmed adjustments through future notices.
 

 

2. Gates

 

Following the 6/12 patch, where we adjusted the difficulty and the number of Special Sweeps, we have received positive feedback regarding the direction of these changes. However, there have been continued requests for improved play convenience and increased rewards.

 

We intend to proceed cautiously with additional improvements to the overall Gate content, taking sufficient time for careful consideration. However, we aim to adjust the scale of early-stage storylines and the extent of lower-tier Activity Funds to help new hunters adapt more comfortably to the game. Additionally, we plan to enhance the reward balance for Gates below Lv. 20. Moving forward, we will continue to promptly incorporate any necessary improvements to the Gate content as needed.

 

 

3. Instance Dungeon & Encore Missions

 

We have received similar feedback regarding difficulty and rewards for both contents.

In terms of difficulty, there were opinions that hoped to make Legendary Artifact farming more enjoyable even if it meant lowering the difficulty in the early stages for beginners and raising the difficulty to increase the probability in the latter stages.

Additionally, in terms of rewards, many players have expressed dissatisfaction with the probability of obtaining certain Artifacts and granting specific stats.

There have also been suggestions for improving convenience, such as skipping repetitive boss appearances and increasing the max multiplier.

Improving satisfaction with drop rates in Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions is currently on hold. Given the recent update introducing new high-level Artifacts, we prefer to monitor the situation further. Our goal is to provide enjoyable content that allows for diverse strategies and enjoyable Hunter formations. Therefore, we aim to focus on planning directions that enhance the utility of additional Artifacts you possess.

It may be difficult to proceed with skipping boss appearances. We are considering prioritizing adjustments in the "Power of Destruction" to ensure that any skips do not disrupt the cinematic experience. While impressive, repeated viewing of these scenes may diminish their impact, so we aim to explore options to minimize such occurrences by expanding the multiplayer play, potentially doubling the current scale. We will provide further updates once these plans are finalized. Thank you for your understanding and patience.

 

 

4. Battlefield of Trials

Many of you have pointed out dissatisfaction with the high difficulty in later stages and the relatively low rewards compared to the level of challenge after clearing.

As of the June 19th update, we have lowered the difficulty of Player Floor 35. In addition, we have created an environment where obtaining high-level Artifacts is more achievable. Therefore, we plan to monitor the situation without further adjustments to difficulty for now. Of course, this decision is not final, and we will periodically review whether updates are needed at each update cycle.

 

 

5. Battlefield of Time

Many hunters who participated in the survey perceived the content as challenging and rewarding, having already experienced growth to the extreme. As a result, they provided a lot of feedback regarding enjoyment and convenience. Specifically, they highlighted the need for more diverse gameplay, expressing concerns about situations where specific Weapons or Artifacts are forced and the excessive influence of luck based on Critical Hits.

Furthermore, they pointed out issues with specific rules, such as gameplay gaps due to Calculation Periods and record settings that seemed unreasonable due to the motion that continues after the boss kill.

Season 2 has now begun. We plan to continuously review and reflect interesting improvements to Battlefield of Time. As part of this effort, a patch was made through the update on 6/19 to apply Fighting Spirit buffs to Sung Jinwoo and Hunters, as well as adjust the monster stats. We hope you are satisfied with these updates and look forward to what's ahead.

Furthermore, we are considering reducing Practice Periods to minimize gameplay gaps. Since Season 2 has already started, implementing this change may take some time. We will notify you in advance once the schedule is confirmed.

It seems technically challenging to adjust the record calculations due to the post-boss-kill animations shared across different content environments. As such, we aim to maintain the current situation. With the Battlefield of Time Fighting Spirit buff update on 6/19, we anticipate overall clear times to decrease, making it easier to achieve confirmed rewards. Therefore, we kindly ask for your understanding and apologize for any inconvenience this may cause regarding this matter.

 

 

6. Battlefield of Chaos

It's been about three weeks since the update, and we've received a lot of feedback regarding the difficulty due to high-difficulty settings and low Gem drop rates.

In particular, it seems there are concerns about the difficulty after Chapter 7, where Rank 3 Gems appear, and the perceived unfairness of the drop rates for Rank 3 Gems. Additionally, since it's a dungeon based on attributes, there have been comments that setting up Hunters according to attributes for smooth clearing is not easy under the current circumstances.

Through the recent update, we introduced Multiplay and the availability to purchase keys in Battlefield of Chaos, which we believe has slightly improved acquisition rates and player progression. To further enhance this experience, we are preparing to introduce a "Mileage System" where players can periodically earn additional Gems based on their gameplay frequency. We are aware of the challenges posed by the extended playtime, high difficulty, and the demand for various Hunters, which can create burdens. Rest assured, our development team acknowledges these issues thoroughly, and we are committed to continuing improvements to provide a better gameplay experience in the future.
 

 

7. Power of Destruction

As you know, it is challenging and powerful content along with Battlefield of Time, and you have given us a lot of feedback on fun and convenience as well.

 Many of you mentioned that the gameplay feels repetitive due to the same bosses and patterns. You also expressed concerns about fatigue from ranking calculations and the perceived unfairness of Tier 3 rewards being concentrated among top players. 

Furthermore, since there are Artifacts specialized for Power of Destruction gameplay, there are many requests for improvements in convenience aspects such as replacement costs and preset provisions.

 

Compared to other content that needs immediate improvement, we do not consider this to need immediate improvement. We will try to share a specific way to develop it into more exciting content. 

We are more focused on improving the difficulties that our hunters are currently facing. We are striving to find a way to reduce the excessive battle time and consider preparing for the rapid application of the preset feature that many hunters recommend in advance. 

 

 

8. Sung Jinwoo 

Many of you have mentioned that Sung Jinwoo is not as powerful as expected. However, considering the current stage of the story, many of you also have high expectations for his future development. Additionally, there has been feedback that certain skills and stats are exceedingly superior, leading to a forced reliance on them. Many of you have also pointed out that the acquisition of certain Runes, Blessing Stones, and Mana Power Extract is excessively difficult.

Sung Jinwoo will gradually become stronger in accordance with the progression of the story. However, due to the nature of our game, whether Sung Jinwoo will reach the level of strength portrayed in the original work, especially to the extent of overwhelming other hunters, is an area that requires careful consideration. Despite this, we acknowledge that the current implementation of Sung Jinwoo may not be satisfying enough due to the difficulty our hunters are experiencing across various content. Therefore, we are planning to continuously balance his abilities to ensure a more satisfying experience for our hunters. 

We have already planned to rebalance Sung Jinwoo's skills. If our testing confirms that we can meet our hunters' expectations, we expect to introduce these changes in the next update. We will provide more detailed information on this later.

Regarding the shortage of Runes, Blessing Stones, and Mana Power Extracts, we will continue to provide some support through various events while also considering regular support options.

 

 

9. Hunters 

The most frequently mentioned issue is the preference for certain hunters. Additionally, there has been significant feedback regarding the strongly balanced design and enforcement of advancement tier 5 for newly released hunters, as well as the excessive scarcity of specific upgrade materials for growth.

We are reviewing the possibility of rebalancing Sung Jinwoo's skills and those of other hunters. If possible, we aim to implement these changes in the next update. We will provide detailed information on these changes as soon as they are ready.

Regarding the shortage of Mana Power Elixir II, we plan to monitor the situation further. With the reduced gate Rescan costs and difficulty adjustments, it should become easier to gain rewards from Red Gates. For now, we will observe how you manage to obtain these resources. We will try to support the supply through events as well as Mana Power Extract.

 

 

10. Artifacts

Many of you have expressed significant fatigue regarding the acquisition and growth of Artifacts. Additionally, concerns about the costs of enhancement and replacement, as well as the lack of convenience features like presets, have been noted.

Regarding Artifacts, we will continue to review areas where adjustments can be made to balance and enhance gameplay enjoyment. Some improvements have already been made in terms of visibility to players and usability aspects. Moving forward, we will also work on solutions to improve the costs incurred and the supply of related growth materials.

 

 

11. Army of Shadows 

We have confirmed that many hunters struggle with an insufficient supply of materials. Moreover, there were opinions that after gathering insufficient materials with hard work, the summoning period of Shadows was too short and had weak performances. It was hard for our hunters to feel the power of the Shadows in the original work.

After the 6/19 update, hunters extracting and using “Tusk” are increasing. We expect an increase in gameplay related to the Gates system improvements and the Reverse Mode difficulty, so for now we plan to consider expanding the source of Shadow Traces afterwards. Before that, we are planning to apply these two factors first. Increase the duration of the Shadows for better performance on battlefields, and adjust Shades consumption or the total amount of Shades to increase the usage frequency of the Shadows.

 

 

12. Expectations on content and opinions our hunters wish to share with the Development Team. 

The most shared opinion was to improve current content and ensure the stability of the game's operation. We have confirmed that hunters are eager to play in a stable gaming environment and want to avoid excessive fatigue so that many hunters can enjoy the game.

Please come and check as we will inform you of the details on the upcoming content through the [Developer Note] soon. We have prepared content that many hunters were waiting for, so we expect huge anticipation from our hunters. 

Through this survey, we received many words of encouragement as well as a lot of constructive criticism. We take all these valuable opinions as expressions of your love for the game. We will do our best to meet your expectations by preparing thoroughly and creating an enjoyable gaming environment for you.

 

 

PS. 

We apologize for the dissatisfaction regarding the initial release of the Workshop of Brilliant Light. Additionally, we are thoroughly investigating the difficulties and issues our hunters are currently facing and will strive to provide a more enjoyable gaming environment.

We would like to thank all the hunters for their participation once again and have prepared gifts below. We hope this will support your adventure, help your research on new Artifacts, and ultimately provide an enjoyable gameplay environment for the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

 

📌 Survey Result Reward

📌 Notes

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Second Half of 2024 Road Map

Hunters Association
|
Jun 21, 2024, 09:00
|
102,507

 

 

 Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

Before we share details about upcoming events and updates our team is preparing, we would like to discuss improvements planned for the recently introduced Workshop of Brilliant Light.

 

[Workshop of Brilliant Light Improvements]

 

Thankfully, we are receiving helpful comments from our hunters regarding the Workshop of Brilliant Light after the update. We would like to share our planned improvements on the mostly gathered opinions on “Difficulty” and “Rewards”.

 

Workshop of Brilliant Light Difficulty

 

Despite preparing powered-up Artifacts and Hunters, many hunters have mentioned that the content was extremely difficult.

 

Therefore, we plan to improve the performance of Blessings obtainable from [Burning Overpass] and [Burning Square] and increase the appearance rate of legendary-grade Blessings to be more effective when tackling bosses on higher floors.

 

Workshop of Brilliant Light Rewards

 

Unlike the Encore Missions and Instance Dungeon content, our hunters are able to participate daily, the Workshop of Brilliant Light can be participated in twice a week.

 

We have confirmed feedback regarding the insufficient number of rewards needed to grow Sung Jinwoo and other Hunters compared to the high difficulty of battle balance requirements.

 

In response, we will significantly adjust the rewards for strategies by increasing Artifact rewards to Easy mode standards and adjusting Normal mode to drop Artifacts up to the highest Legendary grade on all floors.

 

The Workshop of Brilliant Light is a weekly content renewed every Wednesday.

We will apply the improvements with a detailed notice on the upcoming renewal date, 6/26 (Wed).

 

 

[50th Day Event Spoiler]

 

It has been almost 50 days since our global launch on May 8th. 🎉

 

Looking back on the past 50 days, it may have been a short time, but it has been filled with both joy and disappointments alongside our hunters.

 

We are excited to unveil a sneak peek of the Seo Jiwoo costume, which recently topped our popularity polls in a survey. You can obtain the Seo Jiwoo costume through a check-in event, please stay tuned for various other events we have prepared for the upcoming 50-day event.

 

 

 

[Hunter Archive Revamp]

 

Hunter Archive is a feature where you can enjoy the original stories of Hunters using keys.

However, the keys are no longer useful once you have played through all the stories.

 

That's why we would like to revamp Hunter Archive.

 

We are preparing to expand the stories to provide additional content about the Hunters.

For hunters with an original webtoon, “Hunter: Origin,” this will be indicated in the Hunter Archive.

 

We will also add special stages where you can farm resources.

More detailed information will be provided in future update notices.

 

 

[Introduction of Mileage System for Battlefield of Chaos]

 

Our game features several daily content activities, such as Encore Missions, Instance Dungeon, and Power of Destruction.

 

Recently, we've added a new daily farming content: Battlefield of Chaos.

 

Since its update, we've received numerous suggestions for improvement.

 

In response, we implemented the Multiplay system in a previous update as an initial improvement.

However, we have noticed that Battlefield of Chaos still needs appeal compared to other daily content.

 

To address this, we plan to introduce a system where additional rewards can be obtained based on the number of plays through the first update of July.

 

We sincerely thank all the hunters who provided improvement suggestions during this time.

 

 

[Battlefield of Trials Challenge Mode]

 

One of the main drawbacks of the Challenge Mode in Battlefield of Trials and other content is the difficulty or level barriers that can make progression challenging.

 

We are developing seasonal content to provide a sense of accomplishment with rewards for each stage. Please look forward to this upcoming feature.

 

 

[Grand Summer Festival]

 

In a previous developer note, we mentioned the “Grand Summer Festival.”

We would like to disclose more information about the content and events that you can enjoy exclusively during the “Grand Summer Festival.'”

 

[Beach]

 

 

The sweltering heat and scorching sun have driven the Hunters’ 2nd Raid Team to take their first vacation at the beach. What delightful experiences await them on their summer vacation?

 

Meanwhile, Alicia and Emma, escaping the heat on a French beach, stumble upon a mysterious glass bottle. What could be inside? Stay tuned to find out their story.

 

The "Grand Summer Festival" will feature an event story along with various content, promising to bring refreshing joy to all hunters. Please look forward to it!

 

 

Next, we have updates on new Shadows.

 

[New Shadow: Cerbie]

 

 

In the June update, we introduced the shadow Tusk.

 

This character was extracted as a shadow from "Almighty Shaman, Kargalgan," who clashed with Sung Jinwoo in Chapter 18 and was named Tusk.

 

Tusk is a shadow that increases the entire team's [Core Attack] skill damage.

 

Cerbie, scheduled to be updated, is a new shadow that did not appear in the original work.

It is similar to Baruka, whom we can meet in the game, but Sung Jinwoo failed to extract in the original story.

 

Like other Shadows, Cerbie will progressively upgrade its appearance as it grows.

 

For those who have enjoyed performing dazzling combo plays with original Hunters not seen in the original work, we hope you will also enjoy summoning original shadows and leading the battlefield as the Monarch of Shadows.

 

Although still in the development stage, we plan to introduce Kaisellin (Kaisel), ridden by "the Monarch of White Flames, Baran," as a shadow in a future update.

 

 

 

[Upcoming Special Summons Improvements]

 

We are planning to improve the results of Special Summons.

 

We have received feedback that the monthly opportunities provided by Special Summons can sometimes result in unfavorable experiences for hunters.

 

We empathize with your concerns, and we will add newly joined Hunters from Gate Raid and Sung Jinwoo's Weapons since the global launch to the Special Summons list. Furthermore, we aim to improve the system so that hunters can secure two or more SSR rewards based on the Special Summon results.

 

We will strive to present it to hunters through the first update in July.

 

 

[Second Half of 2024 Roadmap]

 

Our team has been diligently working to bring you exciting content following the Guild content and Grand Summer Festival in our July update.

 

As the Grand Summer Festival comes to an end, you can look forward to the "Global Launch 100th Day Update" and the "ARISE Festival."

 

In the September update, prepare for the arrival of "Baran, the Demon King".

 

 

Additionally, we are preparing the debut of Original Hunters, which many of you have been eagerly anticipating.

 

How would you feel about the appearance of Japan's S-rank Hunter Goto Ryuji, who joined the Jeju Island Raid, or South Korea's Hunter Association Leader, Go Gunhee?

 

Other Hunters who topped the popularity polls in the survey are also under development.

 

Furthermore, we are planning seasonal events throughout the year to ensure you have a thrilling action-packed experience. In December, we are particularly excited about the update featuring Jeju Island and the appearance of Shadow Beru.

 

[Second Half of 2024 Roadmap]

 

 

 

Although it has been only a few days after presenting the June update to our hunters, our team will continuously strive to provide an enjoyable experience that exceeds the original story.

 

We will address details on the Guild content that we are currently developing in the next Developer Note.

 

📌 Developer Note Gift

* The redeem code can be used until 6/25 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0) and will not be able to be used after the expiration date.

* The gifts will be sent immediately upon using the redeem code.

 

Thank you for being with us at all times.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

name.en: Notice on Blessing Effects Application in the Workshop of Brilliant Light

text_en:
Notices

Notice on Blessing Effects Application in the Workshop of Brilliant Light

Hunters Association
|
Jun 25, 2024, 08:54
|
6,114

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you!

 

We have reviewed the inquiries related to the Blessing effects obtained from the Workshop of Brilliant Light 

and would like to provide an update through this notice.

 

We have received feedback from hunters that the Blessing effects appearing in the Workshop of Brilliant Light

 sub-stages may not be applied correctly.

 

Although these updates were thoroughly tested beforehand, we conducted a meticulous re-examination given the number of inquiries. We have confirmed that the Blessing effects are being applied correctly.

 

Additionally, please refer to the detailed application rules below:

 

- Blessings with the same stats are combined and applied regardless of their grade.

- Damage is calculated considering the monster's stats, such as Defense.

- For Blessings that reduce the boss's HP, the total HP of the boss will be reduced, but the boss's HP bar will be displayed as a fixed value.

Ex) If a boss with 100 HP bars has its HP reduced by 5%, the total HP is recalculated to 95%, which is then displayed as 100 HP bars.

 

We hope the details above resolve the confusion, and we will continue to do our best to ensure a smooth gaming environment in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

Developer Notes

Developer Note: Guild Summoning

Hunters Association
|
Jun 26, 2024, 10:14
|
58,107

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

First of all, we would like to express our gratitude to all the hunters for their valuable feedback. Thanks to your input, Solo Leveling:ARISE has been able to improve and grow through communication over the past 50 days.

 

We sincerely thank all the hunters who have contributed to enhancing the game's quality.

 

[50th Day Celebration Surprise Gift]

Redeem Code	Redeem Code Reward
50DAYTHX	Essence Stones x 500
[Treasure Hunt] Event Ticket x 5　

 

Our team has prepared a surprise gift as a token of our appreciation. We hope you will enjoy it and look forward to continuing our communication.

 

Today, we would like to provide a preview of the "Guild" system and various improvements mentioned in the previous Developer Note.

 

 

[Guild]

 

 

(Excerpt from Hidden Chapter: Guild)
 

As repeatedly emphasized in previous Developer Notes, our team places great importance on the "Guild" system.

 

We have dedicated significant time to preparing the "Guild" system to ensure it becomes a special feature for all hunters. Finally, it will be introduced through an update at the end of July.

 

We would like to take this opportunity to express our gratitude to all hunters for their patience.

 

Guild creation and joining will be possible across all servers, and Guild Names cannot be duplicated.

This means that it is crucial to create a unique Guild Name, like the White Tiger Guild in the original work.

 

Upon creating or joining a guild, you can access the Guild Lobby. The Guild Lobby can be customized with various themes, allowing you to develop a unique and special guild.

 

You can grow by completing missions together with your guild members, and there will be a Guild-exclusive exchange shop and ranking system.

 

We are also preparing to introduce a Guild Boss system in a future update, where multiple hunters can team up to tackle giant monsters.

 

As many of you eagerly anticipate this, we are excited to share a sneak peek of the upcoming guild raid content featuring a battle scene between Fachtna and Sung Jinwoo.

 

[Fachtna's Final Battle Scene]

 

 

[Sung Jinwoo and Hunters Balance Adjustments]

 

We adjusted the balance for Sung Jinwoo's weapon and some Hunters in the May update.

 

However, despite these adjustments, we acknowledge that some Hunters are still not favored.

Some Runes are of little use despite being of Legendary grade.

 

Our team plans to adjust the balance of certain Hunters and Runes in the July update.

 

Hunters currently under discussion for potential buffs include Choi Jong-In, Lim Tae-Gyu, Hwang Dongsoo, Woo Jinchul, Baek Yoonho, Emma Laurent, and Silver Mane Baek Yoonho.

 

Next, we would like to discuss the direction of improvements for Runes.

Currently, there are 44 types of Runes, but only part of them are used in specific content.

To increase the variety of Rune usage, we are considering enhancing the balance of the following Runes.

 

Skill

Rune Skill

Vital Strike

Internal Wound

 

 

Dagger Toss

Bombardment

 

 

Mutilate

Phantom

Strike

Flame Slash

Sequent Explosions

In addition to balance adjustments, our team has been extensively discussing the direction for utilizing Hunters with various attributes based on your feedback.

 

We appreciate your valuable opinions. Once we have determined the direction, we will provide further updates.

 

 

[Improvement Plan for Duplicate Legendary Runes and Blessing Stones]

 

Many of you have pointed out the issue of having no use for duplicate Legendary Runes and Blessing Stones, which were hard to obtain.

 

To address this, we are preparing a feature that will allow you to convert duplicate Legendary Runes or Blessing Stones into a random chest by consuming 1,000 Essence Stones. This update is planned for July.

 

If you need a quick response, please contact Customer Support with the required currency, and we will assist you with the exchange.

 

 

[Improvement Discussion on Summoning Limit of Army of Shadows]

 

 

The system was initially designed to reflect the mechanism from the original work, where Sung Jinwoo consumes mana to summon the Army of Shadows.

However, we recognize that this may impact the fun of the game. Therefore, we are currently considering improvements to this system.

 

 

[Hunter Costume Dye System]

 

 

In the world of ARISE, each Hunter possesses their own tastes and fashion styles.

 

For example, Alicia usually sports shimmering blonde hair but occasionally switches to a pink hue for a change of pace. There are also days when she wants to express her passion with a fiery shirt, reminiscent of blazing flames, despite using the Freeze skill.

 

Our team is preparing a "Hunter Costume Dye System" that will allow you to express the personalities of various Hunters.

 

With the Hunter Costume Dye System, we look forward to seeing the creation of many wonderful styles for your Hunters.

 

 

[Faction of the Shield Skill Level Up]

 

Our team is taking continuous defensive measures against using unauthorized programs and malicious activities.

 

As previously stated in a Developer Note, the ongoing detection of such activities following the June update will lead to access restrictions.

We also want to remind you that fraudulent registrations are being monitored in real-time by the Faction of the Shield, leading to rank deletions and game suspensions.

 

We remain dedicated to ensuring that all hunters enjoy a refreshing gaming experience, even in the summer heat.

 

 

[Official Livestream]

 

We have received feedback from the community regarding official livestreams and communication. Although we currently communicate through Developer Notes and our global YouTube channel, we believe additional livestreams are necessary for more honest and direct communication. We plan to proceed with this once preparations are complete.

 

 

This concludes our Developer Note for today.

Thank you for your continued support.

 

Stay tuned for more updates in the next one.

 

Thank you.

 

* The redeem code can only be used once per account, and rewards will be sent immediately upon use.
* The redeem code can be used until 7/3 (Wed) 14:59 (UTC+0) and will not be able to be used after the expiration date.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

- 50th Day Appreciation Celebration Coin x 10

We sincerely apologize for the issue regarding the event that we have prepared for our hunters to enjoy.

We will strive to provide an enjoyable gaming environment.

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Note: A Preview of Changes

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: A Preview of Changes

Hunters Association
|
Jul 5, 2024, 01:00
|
67,721

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

Many of the updates announced in the previous Developer Note will finally be introduced next week.

 

Let's preview the key points our hunters should prepare for in advance.

 

 

[A Different Fusion System]

 

Our team has been continuously working on reducing the difficulty of in-game content.

However, beyond simply lowering difficulty, we have also considered ways to provide enjoyable action control while ensuring easy gameplay.

 

In our game, in addition to Weapons and Artifacts, which are referred to as equipment, various elements such as Runes, Blessing Stones, and Gems contribute to the fun of growth and action.

However, we felt that it was challenging to derive enjoyment from acquiring and using high-grade Runes and Blessing stones through Fusion.

 

Through this update, we aim to increase the success rates of Fusion. The exact numbers will be provided in an update notice.

 

How about saving your Runes, Blessing Stones, and Gems of each rank in anticipation of the upcoming improved Fusion system?

 

Following the update, we will provide chests where you can select Heroic Blessing Stones and Runes, allowing you to experience the joy of combinations or choices.

 

 

[Hunter Archive Upgraded with Secret Library]

 

We’ve heard your concerns about the accumulating Hunter Archive Keys after completing all the Archives. Simply stopping the accumulation of keys once all Archives are completed didn't seem to be the best solution. Additionally, we wanted to address the issue of waiting several days to view a single Hunter's story.

 

Now, in Hunter Archive, you can enjoy any Hunter's entire story with just one key.

The remaining keys provided daily can be used to play a specific Hunter’s "Secret Library," where you can obtain various rewards, including Hunter costumes.

 

<Park Heejin Hunter Costume>

 

 

Immerse yourself in the stories of the Hunters you encounter in Solo Leveling:ARISE, and discover costumes with new colors and abundant rewards in the Secret Library.

 

 

[Hunters Association Welcomes More Than Just Sung Jinwoo]

 

Many of you have requested the feature to control your favorite Hunter in the Association's lobby.

 

In response to this feedback, we have prepared a system that allows you to control your favorite Hunter and interact with the characters in the lobby.

 

 

 

[More Improvements]

 

Even good things can become monotonous. You can now skip the Power of Destruction opening and meet Ennio faster.

 

The Max Multiplier for Encore Missions and Instance Dungeon will be doubled. For hunters without the Daily Growth Support benefits, it will increase up to four times, improving gameplay for a more enjoyable and convenient experience.

 

 

[Good to Know in Advance]

 

We know that many hunters like to prepare for new events in advance. Therefore, here's a brief overview of the Points Event starting with the 7/10 (Wed) update.

 

A growth event for the new Hunter Yoo Soohyun and a "Weapon Growth Event" are scheduled.

Hunters aiming for event rewards and rank rewards should take note and manage their weapon growth speed accordingly.

 

The Guaranteed SSR feature for Special Summons will be implemented starting on 7/16 (Tue). If 2 SSRs do not appear within a certain number of Special Summons, the rate of 2 SSRs appearing will increase, and by the 10th summon, 2 SSRs will be guaranteed to appear on the Special Summons. We hope this makes your choices more enjoyable.

 

Please mark 7/16 (Tue) on your calendar and plan your use and purchase of Special Summons Tickets accordingly.

 

 

[Conclusion]

 

Your encouragement and thoughtful advice mean a lot to us.

Today, we have also prepared a thank-you gift to express our gratitude.

 

 

[Update Celebration Surprise Gift]

Redeem Code	Redeem Code Reward
0705DEVNOTEGIFT	Essence Stones x 500
[Treasure Hunt] Event Ticket x 5
0705N	A 30% Webshop Discount Coupon

* This redeem code can be used until 7/8 (Mon) 03:00 (UTC+0) and will not be usable after the expiration date.

* The rewards will be sent immediately upon use.

* This redeem code can only be used once per account.

* This redeem code is non-transferable and may restrict service usage in monetary transactions.

* Please note that it is difficult to provide assistance for rewards that have expired due to mailbox expiration.

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

 

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you!

 

Solo Leveling:ARISE continues to implement defense measures against the use of unauthorized programs and malicious activities.

 

Our detection system, Faction of the Shield, is actively monitoring, and actions are being taken upon detection.

 

Detection of abnormal play will continue in the future, so please refer to this to avoid any actions that may cause your valuable account to face penalties.

 

 

📌 6/19 (Wed) - 7/7 (Sun) Real-time Detected Player

- First Offense: 817 Players (30-Day Ranking Deletion)

- Second Offense: 1,155 Players (365-Day Ranking Deletion)

- Third Offense: 2,732 Players (30-Day Access Restriction)

 

* Upon being detected, your ranking will not be registered, and you will not be able to receive related rewards.

* If a hunter becomes subject for the third offense during the second offense period, both access restriction and ranking deletion will be applied. [Added 10/15 (Tue) 08:06 (UTC+0)]

 

 

Solo Leveling:ARISE will continue to strive to create a fair gaming environment for all hunters.

 

Thank you.

- SSR Sung Jinwoo Weapons Skadi and Moonshadow will also be added to the Special Summons lineup.

- A support system for acquiring SSRs, which accumulates based on the number of Special Summons, will be added.

- Depending on the accumulated support count, there is an increased chance of two or more SSRs appearing in Special Summons results.

* Starting from the 5th Special Summons, the probability of 2 or more SSRs appearing will increase.

* Upon the appearance of two or more SSRs, the acquisition support count will reset.

* SSR acquisition support applies only to ongoing Special Summons, and the accumulated count will reset when the next Special Summons starts.

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

Hunters Association

23,679

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

We would like to briefly summarize the contents of the Developer Note broadcast held on 7/9 (Tue).

For more detailed information, please check the video through the link below.

 

[7/9 (Tue) Developer Note Broadcast Video]

* This is a summary of the broadcast aired in Korea on the evening of 7/9 (Tue).

Please note that some of the features mentioned for future implementation during the broadcast have already been implemented in the 7/10 (Wed) update.

 

Additionally, some redeem codes were revealed during the broadcast for all the hunters who have shown great interest and support for Solo Leveling:ARISE. Please make sure to use them and claim your rewards before the expiration date.

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During broadcast]

Redeem Code

7/15 (Mon) 14:59 (UTC+0)

📢 7/9 (Tue) Developer Note Broadcast Summary

 

📌 Balance Adjustments

 

1. Workshop of Brilliant Light Difficulty Reduced (00:03:51)

- We have received feedback that some hunters find Workshop of Brilliant Light challenging, so we will make improvements to help more hunters clear this content.

 

2. Sung Jinwoo Skill Performance Improvements (00:06:22)

- We plan to improve the skills that are not currently being used.

We are committed to supporting diverse gameplay styles by encouraging the use of various skills, ensuring an enjoyable experience for all hunters.

 

3. Hunter Balance Adjustments (00:08:57)

- We will continue to make improvements to the Hunters that are not currently being used.

Specifically, we will enhance the performance of Hunters who are underperforming in Team Fight content like Power of Destruction. Moving forward, we will focus on balance adjustments through buffs rather than nerfs.

 

📌 Upcoming Updates

 

1. Guild Content Update (00:14:36)

We will introduce both cooperative and competitive guild content. Although we initially planned to release this update in July, we have postponed it to mid-August to provide a more stable and improved experience. We appreciate your understanding.

 

2. Artifact Sources Added (00:17:55)

We will be adding Lv.70 and Lv.75 equipment to the Instance Dungeon and Encore Mission. These new equipment will share set effects with existing sets such as Dragon Knight and Black Lion.

 

As we introduce new content and Artifacts, we aim to maintain the value of previously used Artifacts and ensure they are not easily discarded.

 

Furthermore, new Artifacts with unique set effects will also be introduced.

 

3. Level Expansion and New Job Change

Sung Jinwoo’s max level will be increased by 5 levels every 6 weeks. A new job change for Sung Jinwoo will also be added. This job change will come with new skills and an impressive new costume. Please look forward to it!

 

📌 Q&A

 

Q: Cha Hae-In felt powerful initially, but now she seems less effective. Why is that?

A: Since Cha Hae-In is not used much in the Workshop of Brilliant Light, it seems that she doesn't have a place to shine.

We plan to develop content in which Cha Hae-In can play a significant role. Additionally, we are committed to updating the game to ensure that various Hunters are used effectively in different content.

 

Q: Is it normal that West Wind clears everything in the Battlefield of Time? It makes the game less enjoyable. Why is this being left unaddressed?

A: The completion rate during Season 1 of Battlefield of Time was low. Therefore, the goal for Season 2 was to increase the completion rate for lower-level hunters. We have currently achieved a 90% completion rate.

Starting from Season 3, we will adjust the balance based on Season 2, allowing hunters to achieve the fastest records by playing with recommended attributes. This will prevent only West Wind from being used among Sung Jinwoo's weapons and will highlight the additional damage dealt to weaknesses, diversifying the weapons used for each boss.

 

Q: Why is there such a lack of content and nothing to do?

A: Players are clearing content faster than we anticipated.

The development team is aware of this issue that players feel there is a lack of content. We are actively working on creating various new events and fun content that you can participate in even after completing the main content. We will continue to add more content to keep the game enjoyable.

 

Q: Why are you releasing only certain attributes consecutively?

A: Currently, the boss of the Workshop of Brilliant Light, Vulcan, has a water attribute weakness. We planned this so players can clear Vulcan more easily.

The new content added with updates and releases will be focused on Workshop of Brilliant Light. We understand that some players have been focusing on growing specific attribute Hunters to match the updates.

We assure you that we will continue to develop other content where you can utilize the Hunters you have worked hard to grow, ensuring that your time and effort are not wasted.

 

Q: Why is the story update so slow?

A: We recognize that the story is crucial to our game. Understanding the high expectations of many hunters, we are dedicated to enhancing the quality of our story content, which requires considerable development time.

However, to ensure that hunters are not left waiting indefinitely for new story updates, we also plan to introduce original stories created specifically for the game. We appreciate your patience and hope for your continued anticipation.

 

Q: Why is Sung Jinwoo so weak? Sung Jinwoo is weaker than Hunters, which makes it awkward and less fun.

A: We are aware that Sung Jinwoo may feel relatively weak due to our focus on balancing improvements primarily for Hunters.

We are currently planning to strengthen Sung Jinwoo through new skills, new job changes, and adjustments to less popular Runes and Blessing Stones. Please look forward to meeting a more powerful Sung Jinwoo in the future.

 

Q. There's a feeling that there aren't many fun contents other than Workshop of Brilliant Light. Why are Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitations given out in such small quantities?

A. As difficult as Workshop of Brilliant Light is, it was designed to balance the gameplay stress and farming speed among all hunters so that the gap between hunters does not widen too much.

However, we are considering ways to provide opportunities for top hunters to obtain Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitations through events or additional purchase options.

 

Q: Why did you include the seemingly useless "Healing Given Increase" in Artifact stats when it is so difficult to match the Artifacts from the beginning?

A: We believe that offering a variety of options will make designing Hunters with diverse mechanics fun. We anticipate releasing Hunters in the future, in which Healing Given will play a crucial role, so please look forward to it.

 

Q: What is the overall balance criteria? It seems that there's not much for paying users to do, and it's difficult for mid-to-low spenders.

A: Due to the nature of action RPGs, balancing can be challenging. Nevertheless, we strive to achieve a balance where both non-paying and moderate-spending hunters can enjoy and clear content satisfactorily. Our development team continuously monitors hunter progression and adjusts aspects such as high failure rates in stages to maintain this balance. Furthermore, we aim to introduce content that allows all hunters to compete and grow, ensuring everyone can enjoy the game.

 

Q. There are so many voices from hunters, but why are responses and improvements so slow?

A: We are reviewing the feedback left on the community.

However, implementing all suggestions immediately into the servers or integrating every opinion into the game is challenging.

Please understand that it takes time to create content that aligns with our development direction and receives approval from business departments.

We appreciate your patience and are committed to incorporating valuable feedback to introduce content that meets your expectations.

 

 

In the future, we will strive to provide a more enjoyable and satisfying service.

We kindly ask for your continued interest and support in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: One Step Further

Hunters Association
|
Jul 19, 2024, 07:19
|
240,461

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

First of all, we would like to extend our sincere gratitude to all the hunters for your valuable feedback.

 

Our team serves Solo Leveling: ARISE in 176 countries, and we carefully review your opinions through various channels.

 

While managing service across multiple countries can present communication challenges, please be assured that we are committed to doing our best.

 

Today, we are excited to share some upcoming improvements with you, including details about the Summer Vacation event.

 

 

[Summer Vacation]

 

As briefly mentioned in a previous Developer Note, the "Summer Vacation" event is finally arriving for all hunters.

 

Embark on a unique adventure with the Hunters Guild Strike Squad during their summer vacation. Experience heartwarming stories triggered by anonymous letters found in glass bottles, and dive into the excitement of various festivals and mini-games that you won’t want to miss!

 

Join us for a special experience that can only be enjoyed here this summer.

 

 

Hunters!

 

Are you ready to enjoy the variety of events we've prepared for you?

First, we are excited to give you a sneak peek at Sung Jinwoo on his summer vacation.

 

 

Next, let's discuss the growth and farming of Artifacts.

 

[Normalization of Growth Experience]

 

To improve the joy of farming and growing Artifacts, we plan to make the previously introduced Artifact salvage event into a permanent feature in this update.

 

With these improvements, you will be able to sell or salvage unused Artifacts to earn Gold and obtain Artifact Enhancement Chip I and II.

 

Additionally, to address some shortcomings observed during the previous event, we will make it available to salvage Artifacts that have not been enhanced. This will allow you to obtain Artifact Enhancement Chip I.

 

For Artifacts enhanced to Lv. 15 or higher, you will be able to obtain both Artifact Enhancement Chip I and II. Please look forward to these upcoming changes.

 

 

[One Step Further]

 

We believe Artifact farming is one of the core enjoyable elements of our game.

 

Since the addition of Lv. 73 and 78 Artifacts, many hunters have been challenging the Workshop of Brilliant Light, yet only a few have successfully cleared Demons' Castle 50F.

 

While we have slightly reduced the difficulty, facing the Avaricious Vulcan with Lv. 55 equipment remains difficult.

 

With this update, new Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions will be added, where you can farm new Artifacts at Lv. 70 and Lv. 75.

 

We will also be introducing Artifacts that share effects with sets such as Black Lion, Dragon Knight, and etc at Lv. 50 and Lv. 55. We hope these new Artifacts will enhance your enjoyment of challenging high-difficulty content such as the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

 

Additionally, in this update, we will introduce the [Demons' Castle Lower Floors - Hard] difficulty in the Workshop of Brilliant Light to find out who will be "the heir of the most glorious brilliance."

 

The [Demons' Castle Lower Floors - Hard] difficulty will cater to hunters who crave more brutal battles, providing a significant challenge. In return, very special rewards await those who succeed.

 

After the update, if over 3,000 hunters manage to defeat Vulcan on the Hard difficulty, an event will be scheduled to distribute a celebration reward to all hunters across the server, so please look forward to it.

 

Of course, the 3,000 hunters who contribute to the reward will receive a "Special Honor Reward."

 

Hunters, our team's goal regarding Artifact farming is to obtain Artifacts from the Workshop of Brilliant Light that possess the best set effects and stats.

 

Therefore, even with the new features for Workshops of Brilliant Light added in the future, we will do our best to ensure that the value of existing Artifacts is not compromised.

 

Please get ready and enjoy the fun of Artifact farming.

 

 

[Experience Optimization]

 

Our team is continuously working to optimize the gaming experience for all hunters.

We will discuss the confirmed or under-review improvements that hunters mentioned through the community.

 

● The crafting of Mana Power Elixir II with Mana Power Elixir I is preparing to be added.

● The difficulty of Chapter 17 and 18 in the Main Story (Normal) will be slightly reduced.

● Multiplay support will be introduced to the Secret Library.

● The Attack/Defense/HP stats of Shadows will be increased, and the remaining time of Commanders will be extended.

● The effects of some Blessing Stones (Rare/Heroic/Legendary) will be increased.

 

 

 

● We are considering new weekly content that involves using various Hunters.

- We are also exploring new elements leading to further growth within this content.

 

● We are considering increasing the rewards for those who obtain Hunters that have already completed all Dimensional Advancements.

- If the reward increase is implemented, it will be applied retroactively to those who have previously completed all Dimensional Advancements. Therefore, please feel free to continue your draws without any concerns.

 

 

The much-awaited “Sung Jinwoo Level Expansion,” along with the new “Three-Headed Shadow” and “New Hunter with a Fresh Story,” will be covered in our upcoming Developer Livestream. Stay tuned as we continue the discussion and reveal more details that we couldn't cover in the Developer Note.

 

Preview: Her Appearance

 

 

 

 

We will be greeting you soon through the Livestream scheduled for 7/29 (Mon).

 

Thank you.

📌 Common Notes for All Packages

- The sales period may be subject to change in certain circumstances and we will notify you of the changes through a notice.

- The packages can be purchased for a limited time during the sales period.

- Fixed an issue where the game would freeze at the end of Power of Destruction battles.

- Fixed an issue where Yoo Jinho would use Yoo Soohyun's skills in Reverse Chapter 12, "Another Raid."

- Fixed an issue where pressing the ESC button in the Workshop of Brilliant Light's Blessing Selection screen would cause the game to freeze.

- Fixed an issue where the purchase price was displayed as the full amount of Diamonds without applying the discount when using a Diamond Discount Coupon.

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

Developer Notes

7/29 (Mon) Developer Note Livestream Video Summary

Hunters Association
|
Aug 1, 2024, 06:00
|
15,743

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

We would like to briefly summarize the contents of the Developer Note broadcast held on 7/29 (Mon).

For more detailed information, please check the video through the link below.

 

[7/29 (Mon) Developer Note Livestream Video]

* This is a summary of the livestream aired in Korea on the evening of 7/29 (Mon).

 

Additionally, some redeem codes were revealed during the livestream for all the hunters who have shown great interest and support for Solo Leveling:ARISE. Please make sure to use them and claim your rewards before the expiration date.

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

Code

Reward

Expiration Date (UTC+0)

SLALIVESTREAM

Custom Draw Ticket x 10

Until 2024/8/4 (Sun) 14:59

JULYUPDATELIVE

Essence Stones x 1,000

SEEYOUSOON

Custom Draw Ticket x 10

SURPRISEGIFT

Essence Stones x 1,000

 

[One More Surprise Redeem Code!]

- To celebrate the summer event we have prepared an additional surprise redeem code.

Code

Reward

Expiration Date (UTC+0)

SLASUMMEREVENT

Custom Draw Ticket x 10

Until 2024/8/31 (Sat) 14:59

 

 

 

📢 7/29 (Mon) Developer Note Livestream Video Summary

 

📌 Introduction on New Hunter and Summer Events

 

1. New Hunter: Amamiya Mirei (12:32)

- She is a Solo Leveling:ARISE original SSR-Rank Wind attribute dealer who is a high school girl swordsman.

- When using ultimate skill, Oni Kuroha's soul takes over and her skill performances become more powerful.

- When using basic attacks skill cooldown decreases, hence being able to use various skills consecutively.

- Please look forward to seeing the exclusive weapon "Bunny Bunbun" and new costumes that align with the summer vacation that are scheduled to be added.

 

2. First Summer Event: Summer Vacation (16:58)

- Summer Vacation theme original stories and 2 mini games will proceed.

- 2 Sung Jinwoo exclusive weapons (Secured Marlin Surfboard / Juicy Grilled Skewer) are obtainable through the event and you can experience funny weapon performances that align with the summer event theme.

* The Juicy Grilled Skewer is scheduled to be added through the update in August.

- You can check newly added Sung Jinwoo, Cha Hae-In, and Lee Bora summer costumes through the events.

 

 

📌 Content Update and Scheduled Improvements

 

1. Scheduled to be Updated 1: Costume Dye System (24:29)

- A dyeing feature where you can dye your costumes in various colors will be added.

Dyeing feature requires Dye exclusive currencies and the currencies are obtainable through various sources such as events.

- The dyeing feature will be first applied to certain hunters’ costumes such as Cha Hae-In, Alicia, and Amamiya Mirei. Please stay tuned since more dyeable costumes will be added in the future.

 

2. Scheduled to be Updated 2: New Shadow “Cerbie” (26:11)

- “Cerbie” is a new original shadow also mentioned in the previous Developer Note that is not included in the original story.

- It grants an effect that increases a team's critical damage which is also an excellent effect compared to the previously added “Tusk,” so please look forward to it.

 

3. Scheduled to be Updated 3: Workshop of Brilliant Light Adjustment (27:30)

- Along with the addition of new stages in the Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions, new Hard Mode will be added to the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

- Given the challenging difficulty of the content, we plan to provide definite rewards, such as guaranteed acquisition of Legendary Artifacts and offering selection chests that contain Legendary Artifacts.

- For hunters who are struggling with the Workshop of Brilliant Light, we are also planning to additionally lower the difficulty of Easy Mode. Use the Lv. 70 or 75 Artifacts obtainable in the new stages of Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions to challenge the Workshop of Brilliant Light more easily.

 

4. Scheduled to be Updates 4: Sung Jinwoo Maximun Level Expansion (32:46)

- Sung Jinwoo’s achievable maximum level will be expanded to 85 and the hunter maximum level and Gates difficulty will increase accordingly.

- For hunters who have reached Reputation Lv. 80 before, we are considering increasing the rewards based on the Reputation Level.

 

 

📌 Q&A

 

Q. Yoo Soohyun hunter’s performances seem to be lower than expected. Doesn’t she need additional buffs? (00:37:05)

A. According to the statistics, she is still the top-class hunter among the fire attribute hunters.

 

However, based on the opinions that she is a bit disappointing compared to Alicia added before, we will discuss internally to identify any areas that can be improved and ensure that adjustments are made at an appropriate time.

 

We are especially internally aware of the need in application of granting Super Armor when using Yoo Soohyun’s Hell Fire skill.

 

We will try to include this into Hunter Balance Adjustments of this update.

 

Q. A lot of Gold is required for enhancing and exchanging Artifacts but the sources are too limited. (00:40:12)

A. We are currently gradually increasing the sources of in-game currencies. However, we are aware of the stress our hunters are facing when exchanging equipment such as Artifacts.

 

We are considering supporting the equipment exchange to lower the stress by providing Artifact exchange free periods through events for our hunters to concentrate on gameplay and Artifact organizing. We will keep improving by monitoring the inconveniences that may occur during the procedure.

 

Q. How will you solve the certain less preferred Artifact options? (00:44:31)

A. We are aware of the less preferred and abandoned options from hunters. We will consider providing a solution for this.

 

Q. It would be great to add a damage meter element (dummy) in the game. (00:46:25)

A. The performance of hunters varies based on the elements or stats of bosses, so it may not be able to test the hunters’ performances just by making a dummy. We will take this into consideration as many hunters are wanting the feature.

 

Q. How about reducing the frequency of livestream to once in three weeks for more communication? (00:48:35)

A. As this is our first livestream, we are still inexperienced in some areas. However, we aim to formalize it into a three-week cycle to communicate with you, hunters, more frequently.

 

Q. How about reducing the update frequency? (00:49:50)

A. Although it is hard for more frequent updates due to changes in specifics and global one-build multi-language translation, we will do our best to introduce new content as soon as possible.

 

Q. We would like to see more diverse boss monsters, backgrounds, or gimmicks. (00:50:35)

A. As battle with new boss monsters is the main content of action games, through this update, we have prepared new bosses for the Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions and other challenging content, so please look forward to the update.

 

Q. Please improve the challenge type content such as Battlefield of Trials.(00:51:57)

A. We have added a new challenge type content such as Battlefield of Trials Challenge through the 7/10 (Wed) update. Since we were considering the balance of all the hunters, we have confirmed opinions from high-level hunters that the content felt too easy.

 

To amend this, we are planning to modify the content to reset in a 3-week cycle to make it a more challenging content.

 

Q. The hunters that appeared in the anime and webtoon such as Choi Jong-In and Baek Yoonho seem much weaker compared to the performances of in-game original hunters. (00:53:10)

A. We are aware of the weak performances of hunters that appeared in the anime and webtoon and are planning for improvements.

 

Choi Jong-In and Woo Jinchul will receive buffs through this update and we will also buff Baek Yoonho as soon as possible.

 

Since there are aspects that cannot be resolved by simply increasing the numbers, we will take the time to continuously enhance various characters, including the anime and webtoon characters.

 

Q. Why are only the original hunters being added not the hunters from the anime and webtoon? (00:55:45)

A. As the game is being developed based on the original IP with a completed story, we are sequentially releasing updates by incorporating original hunters and anime and webtoon hunters.

 

As “Yoo Soohyun” was updated previously, the original hunter will be updated this time and Go Gunhee will be updated next time. We kindly ask for your understanding as we proceed with these updates sequentially.

 

Q. Sung Jinwoo’s performances are quite disappointing compared to other hunters. Please improve this. (00:57:27)

A. We are currently developing additional elements to improve the performance of Sung Jinwoo, as his current performance is lower compared to other hunters.

 

We are currently developing internal features such as expanding the Blessing Stone slots to enhance Sung Jinwoo's performance, and these will be added in future updates.

 

Q. Adjustments are required for the issue where only damage option related Blessing Stones are used. (00:59:31)

A. Additional balance adjustments are scheduled for both 7/31 (Wed) and 8/21 (Wed) updates.

 

We will prepare to incorporate a variety of options for the Blessing Stones to be utilized with new bosses that are added in the future.

 

Q. How about improving the benefits of Monthly Bundles? (01:01:19)

A. We can increase the benefits, but we need to consider how to extend these enhanced benefits to existing subscribers as well. We will carefully explore various approaches to ensure this can be implemented effectively.

 

Q. Can’t you expand the Mining Team Level or increase available counts for Gates Special Sweeps? (01:03:12)

A. We will check the feasibility of expanding the Gate Special Sweep count to 10 times and proceed accordingly. The expansion of the Mining Team level will be considered for future implementation.

 

Q. The rewards for the Special Commissions are too low compared to the effort. (01:04:59)

A. As for Special Commissions, this was planned as collection type content where hunters can claim rewards slowly. As there are hunters trying effortlessly to claim the rewards, we will discuss the issue internally for improvements.

 

Q. It would be nice to add additional auto features for specific actions such as casting ultimate skills or tagging when in Auto Battle mode. (01:06:23)

A. As the AI for Auto Battle is currently being continuously improved and applied, we will also check related features and continuously add and improve them.

 

Q. When will you update the Story content? (01:09:23)

A. Through this update, exclusive story chapters related to the guild content are scheduled to be added.

Additionally, through further updates, we will add stories related to the top floors of the Demon’s Castle, so please look forward to it.

 

Q. When will you update Sung Jinwoo's new job change? (01:23:25)

A. This is scheduled for 8/21 (Wed) and we are planning on adding new costumes and skills with it.

 

Q. Please improve the rewards for the duplicately obtained hunters that have already reached Dimensional Advancement Tier 5. (01:24:04)

A.We are currently discussing increasing the reward levels for this aspect. For those who obtained the hunters before this change, we will retroactively provide the adjusted rewards.
 

Q. The Blessing Stone’s “Boss Slayer” penalty seems too harsh compared to its performance. (01:24:58)

A. As for issues that occur in interaction with other effects, we will try to buff the effect or adjust the balance.

 

Q. Please increase the supply of Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitation. (01:26:03)

A. Through this update, we are adding not only new stages for the Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions but also a new Artifact farming content through Workshop of Brilliant Light Hard Mode.

 

We will gradually improve this while hunters enjoy the newly added content.

 

Q. Please increase the supply of Mark of Time used for Armory growth. (01:27:30)

A. First, we will update the system to allow the acquisition of Mana Power Elixir II and III through Elixir Crafting, encouraging you to progress in character growth. Additionally, we will continue to increase the supply sources for growth materials, including Mark of Time.

 

Q. Other than the Custom Draw Rate Up List, please add an exclusion list. (01:28:19)

A. It doesn’t seem impossible to add to the system, but this may not be able to be applied in the game since this requires careful consideration of various factors.

 

Q. Please improve the part that only the Demonic Plum Flower Sword is used among Sung Jinwoo weapons. (01:29:38)

A. We regularly adjust the content balance in the game, but please understand that these changes are implemented sequentially. We will work on adjusting the balance of other weapons to ensure they have similar usability to the Demonic Plum Sword.

 

Q. Increase the Power of Destruction rank rewards. (01:30:37)

A. We are currently adjusting the reward levels for the Power of Destruction. Considering that some hunters may feel burdened by the gameplay, we will also prepare for functional improvements accordingly.

 

Q. The hard reset period of Artifacts is too short. (01:32:21)

A. The development team is aware that the shorter hard reset cycle for Artifacts due to new content can be burdensome. We are currently reviewing refinement systems, such as upgrading Artifact grades while retaining their auxiliary options, to allow for longer use.

 

We will strive to ensure that the enjoyment of Artifact farming is not quickly diminished by frequent hard resets.

 

📌 Waiting for the Guild

1. Guild System Introduction (1:11:34)

- Maximum of 50 hunters can form the guild together regardless of the server.

- Through the guild system, you can enjoy a guild raid content where 9 hunters along with Sung Jinwoo can participate.

- A guild content related Solo Leveling:ARISE original story will be added as a hidden chapter through this update.

 

2. Guild Name Pre-Claiming (1:13:28)

- To prepare for the addition of the guild system, a pre-claiming of guild names will take place starting from this week (early August).

- Each guild name must be unique across all servers, and you cannot create a guild name identical to those in the original "Solo Leveling" work. Thank you for your understanding.

 

 

📌 Creating Hunters Together

1. Hunter Costume Design Contest Announcement (1:15:09)

- Other than the costumes designed by the development team, a costume design contest event is planned where hunters can apply creative designs of costumes in the game.

 

2. Go Gunhee will appear in the Lobby (1:15:09)

- As newly added hunters were first shown in the Hunters Association Lobby, you will be able to meet Go Gunhee that will be added in the future update in the Lobby after the 7/31 (Wed) update.

 

 

In the future, we will strive to provide a more enjoyable and satisfying service.

We kindly ask for your continued interest and support in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

Hunters Association

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you!

 

A patch & recommended build update is scheduled for 8/1 (Thu) to ensure a pleasant gaming environment.

 

You can proceed with the recommended build update through the market you are currently using, and you will be able to play the game normally with the improvement applied upon logging into the game after the patch is complete.

 

Please see below for more details.

 

 

📌 Patch Schedule

- 8/1 (Thu) 10:15 (UTC+0) [Completed]

 

📌 Patch Details

- Fixed the issue where the Multiplay for Battlefield of Chaos was not reflected properly in the Challenges.

- Fixed the issue where mail was sent to hunters even though there were no unclaimed rewards related to the Summer Vacation mini game record.

- Fixed the issue where the maximum number of uses for the skill “The Dancer” is reduced after Cha Hae-In balance adjustment. 

- Fixed the issue where an error pop-up was displayed in certain circumstances when completing Battlefield of Trials battle missions.

- Fixed an issue where a recommended element for the boss monster was not displayed in the Form Team screen of [Summer Vacation] - [Summer Crush] Chapter 1.

- Fixed the issue where certain event stories are not able to proceed when an NPC dies.

- Fixed the issue where the stage was immediately cleared when Amamiya Mirei uses her ultimate skill after entering stage for certain bosses.

- Fixed the issue where the story special guide chapter 5 was not opened in certain circumstances.

 

📌 Recommended Build Update Details

 - Fixed the issue where the notification markers for tracking attacks displayed on the ground appear earlier than the actual activation.

8/13 (Tue) Developer Note Livestream Video Summary

Hunters Association
|
Aug 21, 2024, 09:00
|
10,066

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

We would like to briefly summarize the contents of the Developer Note broadcast held on 8/13 (Tue).

For more detailed information, please check the video through the link below.

 

[8/13 (Tue) Developer Note Livestream Video]

* This is a summary of the livestream aired in Korea on the evening of 8/13 (Tue).

 

Additionally, some redeem codes were revealed during the livestream for all the hunters who have shown great interest and support for Solo Leveling:ARISE. Please make sure to use them and claim your rewards before the expiration date.

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

Reward
