Mana-imbued Fabric x1,000

SEEUAGAIN

Custom Draw Ticket x10

 

 

📢 8/13 (Tue) Developer Note Livestream Video Summary

 

📌 Q&A

 

Q. How is the Guild System being created? (00:21:51)

A. Menus such as missions, guild bosses, guild exchange shop, and mini games are included in the guild lobby and we are additionally preparing for rankings and guild battles.

We are planning to add Sung Jinwoo exclusive weapons in the guild exchange shop for hunters to obtain.

We are also preparing guild content. A powerful exclusive weapon will be able to be purchased through the guild content so we recommend collecting the guild coins.

 

Q. Can’t you expand the maximum level sooner? When will the Sung Jinwoo New Job Change be added? (00:23:55)

A. We are planning to expand the maximum level to 90 and this is targeted to be updated until mid September.

We are preparing this Job Change costume theme as god of death, offering a different look from the previous costumes and a skill named “Sonic Stream” will be added. 4 Runes for all elements related to the skill will also be added obviously.

 

Q. Are there any plans to remove the cost for swapping Artifacts? (00:26:21)

A. To ease the inconvenience of hunters, we are planning for a free Artifact swapping event based on the update cycle. We are planning to hold a free Artifact Swapping event twice every week regularly.

Continuous swapping can be inconvenient, especially when trying to match and rotate a full 3-piece set. However, it doesn't align with the game's intended purpose. Instead, we believe there is ample enjoyment in strategically setting up Artifacts that suit our hunters on a regular basis. We encourage you to strategically swap Artifacts during the event periods.

 

Q. Please adjust the penalty for Legendary Blessing Stones. (00:28:27)

A. As for 3 Legendary Blessing Stones, the “Boss Slayer,” “Double-edged Sword,” and “Mana Rampage,” that have increased penalties, we have adjusted the penalties to the same level as Heroic Blessing Stones.

 

Q. Please add a damage meter dummy feature. (00:29:50)

A. A damage meter dummy is currently being planned and developed. However, this may take more time than our hunters expect.

We are planning to first display Sung Jinwoo and Hunters’ damage on the guild boss result screen.

Starting from the guild content, we are planning to display the damage of hunters and effects of Sung Jinwoo for our hunters to see for themselves.

 

Q. Is the Reputation level up reward getting buffed or not? (00:31:02)

A. This will be buffed and is scheduled for an update in August. We plan to increase the number of Rate Up Draw Tickets to two and add rewards such as Gems, Time Marks, and Gold at every 5-level increment starting from Reputation Level 25. If you have achieved any Reputation Levels before these rewards are upgraded, rest assured that we will retroactively apply these updates to the levels you previously reached.

 

Q. The rewards for Power of Destruction are too small compared to its play time. (00:32:41)

A. The rewards will be adjusted and we are aiming for a renewal of the content. We will reveal the details to our hunters as soon as possible after increasing the rewards and content renewal.

We are preparing more honorable rewards specifically for veteran players and high-power hunters. We are considering rewards that would allow you to showcase the fact that you're dealing more damage.

 

📌 Real-time Communication

 

Q. Opinions regarding the nerfed effects without any prior notification. (00:34:20)

A. We would like to first apologize for the falsely applied data. Since this is a human-operated task, errors in data handling can occur. As mentioned in the notice, data that was still in QA was accidentally uploaded. After identifying the issue, we rolled back the changes as quickly as possible via a patch. We do not perform stealth patches without informing users when making balance changes. We sincerely apologize for the issue once again.

 

Q. Opinions regarding insufficient Mark of Times. (00:36:00)

A. We are continuously expanding the sources for the item, and even in the events. We are also considering long-term content and are internally reviewing the possibility of making materials for crafting and the armory available through crafting.

 

Q. Opinions regarding unavailable selling of enhanced Artifacts in bulk. (00:36:39)

A. This is clearly a bug. We will fix this issue in the next update.

 

Q. Opinions regarding the Healing Given Increase effect (00:36:58)

A. We have decided to change the Healing Given Increase stat into a different stat. We will inform you of the decided stats through a notice in the future. We are planning to exclude the Healing Given Increase effect from secondary stats that can be farmed in the future.

 

Q. Opinions regarding the rewards when acquiring duplicate hunters after reaching maximum advancement tier.  (00:38:23)

A. As mentioned in the previous livestream, we plan to revamp the system so that when you obtain a duplicate weapon after reaching the maximum advancement tier, you will receive rewards equivalent to dismantling the weapon.

 

Q. Opinions on difficulties regarding advancing Sung Jinwoo weapons.(00:39:36)

A. We are preparing a draw where hunters can obtain Sung Jinwoo weapons. We are thinking of the guild content as the main source so we assume that hunters will be able to obtain Sung Jinwoo weapons more easily while enjoying the guild content.

 

Q. Opinions regarding increase in achievement rewards. (00:40:51)

A. Achievements and missions will continue to be added as part of events in the future. We will also expand achievements along with the addition and expansion of new content.

 

Q. Opinions regarding adjusting the number of Keys in the Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions result screen. (00:41:12)

A. This is scheduled to be improved during the September update.

 

Q. Opinions regarding optimization on mobile devices. (00:41:40)

A. We are continuously working on optimization, but since we are creating high-quality assets, the process involves repeated cycles of optimization followed by adding new assets. However, we are committed to ongoing optimization to ensure compatibility across various devices.

 

Q. Opinions regarding the slow dice speed in the Special Dice Event. (00:43:04)

A. The dice speed will be increased as soon as possible.

 

Q. Opinions regarding massive amount of Gold required when fusing Gems. (00:43:32)

A. We are conducting events where hunters can continuously obtain an appropriate amount of Gold.

We believe that by consistently participating in events, you should be able to acquire enough Gold.

 

Q. Suggestions on exchanging Tier 4 Gems. (00:44:14)

A. It seems that some form of exchange or refusion system might be necessary. Many hunters have submitted feedback on this issue, and the director has mentioned that they will "look into it."

 

Q. Suggestion on expanding the source of acquiring Gold. (00:45:24)

A. We will discuss a hot time event with the development team where hunters can acquire Gold. We have also increased the amount of Gold that can be obtained through the upcoming 100th Day Celebration events.

 

Q. Insufficient Mana Power Extract issue (00:46:04)

A. We are currently discussing the regular source of the item. You will also be able claim the items through the 100th Day Celebration Events, and we are also considering expanding new sources through guild content.

 

Q. Expanded content for unused hunters. (00:47:08)

A. The development team’s wish is to make hunters grow and use various hunters.

We plan to enable hunters used in instance dungeons or closed dungeons to play more active roles. Additionally, we're working on content, such as guild battles, where you'll need to combine various hunters to win. To minimize the number of unused hunters, we will continue to implement balance patches and add new single content.

 

Q. A feature to skip appearing and clearing cutscenes for bosses. (00:48:16)

A. We will enable the skip option for cutscenes that can be skipped.

 

Q. Inconvenience regarding the guild activity. (00:49:02)

A. We are preparing to take the game in a direction that focuses on light, single-player gameplay. We've also been discussing the issue of gameplay burden internally, so there's no need to worry.

 

Q. Increase in Activity Funds reward (00:50:11)

A. We will discuss this internally for the possibility of making even a small adjustment.

 

Q. Complaints about the difficulty of Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions. (01:02:18)

A. It seems that there is a significant disparity in the balance experience between highly progressed users and less progressed users. Therefore, we are planning to create a balance stage that can cover from low to high difficulty levels.

As part of the September update, we are planning to renew the patterns of Instance Dungeons. We aim to adjust the content balance so that it can be enjoyed by both beginners and top-tier players. Additionally, for high difficulty levels, we plan to provide separate rewards that are close to honor rewards.

 

 

Q. Suggestions on removing the level limit for the Story content. (01:05:06)

A. In practice, it seems necessary to have certain story limitations or power hurdles to facilitate learning during the early stages of the game. However, there are concerns that imposing level restrictions on hunters who have surpassed a certain point might be burdensome. Therefore, we plan to gradually remove level restrictions that were in place for the later stages of the game.

 

Q. Opinions regarding the calculation period of Battlefield of Time. (01:06:12)

A. We are planning to improve this by reducing the calculation period in September.

 

 

📌 100th Day Event

 

1. 100th Day Celebration Check-In Event reward (00:53:32)

- The biggest reward for the check-in event will be 50 tickets and you can also claim hunter Go Gunhee as the 14th day reward. Total of 100 tickets will be obtainable through other events.

 

2. 100th Day Event Celebration boss and event reward (00:53:32)

- You can obtain newly added costumes for “Han Se-Mi,” “Emma Laurent,” and “Alicia Blanche.”

- We have also prepared the event weapon “Juicy Grilled Skewer” and event boss “Sand Stone Guardian.”

- We have eased the difficulty of this content so enjoy the content and claim the event rewards.

 

 

📌 Upcoming Updates

 

1. September Story Update: Baran, the Demon King (00:55:35)

- We are preparing an original webtoon and anime story update. The story scheduled to be updated in September is related to the higher floors of the Demons’ Castle and we are designing the battle to offer a fresh experience, different from the existing strategies, so that players can enjoy a new level of satisfaction.

- We are developing to offer three kinds of battle experience using daggers, long swords, and wind. You can expect to encounter strategies that you’ve never experienced before.

 

2. New Hunter: Han Se-Mi (00:59:17)

- A new Wind attribute hunter will be added.

- She possesses healing buffs, shield skills, and skills that remove area effects such as traps in the ground.

 

3. New Hunter: Go Gunhee (01:00:11)

- A new Light attribute hunter will be added.

- We are designing the hunter to deal with enemies with shield effects based on the defense, and the hunter also possesses skills such as Break and Airborne.

- You can meet him on 8/28 (Wed), the 2nd week reward distribution date of the 100th Day Celebration Check-In Event.

 

 

In the future, we will strive to provide a more enjoyable and satisfying service.

We kindly ask for your continued interest and support in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

- Fixed the issue where Legendary Artifacts were unable to be sold in bulk.

- Fixed the issue where the Phantom Foxes summoned by Lee Bora attacks while moving when playing Battlefield of Times Hobgoblin Leader.

- Fixed the issue where a red dot alarm is displayed even if there are no claimable rewards are missions to complete when entering Hunter Pass tab.

- Fixed the issue where the “Back” button does not function after entering the Secret Library in the Hunter Archive in certain circumstances.

- Fixed the intermittent issue where Essence Stones are not immediately distributed after completing Hunter Archive stories.

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

name.en: Developer Note: The Emergence of Monarch of White Flames [Updated 8/30 (Fri) 10:51 (UTC+0)]

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: The Emergence of Monarch of White Flames [Updated 8/30 (Fri) 10:51 (UTC+0)]

Hunters Association
|
Aug 29, 2024, 07:30
|
74,401

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

First of all, we would like to express our gratitude to the hunters for enjoying Solo Leveling:ARISE.

The team will always try hard for our hunters to always enjoy entertaining actions.

 

Today, we will address details on the improvements mentioned in the previous livestream, including upcoming updates.

 

 

[New Battle Experience]

 

As mentioned in the previous livestream, the changes for “Healing Given Increase” have been determined.

 

Unlike brief notifications in the livestream, there were countless discussions in the development team.

 

As Artifact farming is one of the core content in the game, this affects hunters’ playing experiences such as battle balances and overall entertainment in the game.

 

After long consideration our team has decided to change the “Healing Given Increase” effect into “Mana Recovery Increase.”

 

This decision was made to address feedback regarding the inability to fully enjoy a variety of actions during combat due to a lack of mana.

 

However, please note that since there are hunters using the “Healing Given Increase” effect as a main option, the details will be maintained and only the sub option of the “Healing Given Increase” will be changed.

 

The detailed balance will be announced through a notice in the future.

 

As for the update which contains new battle experience that many hunters await, it is targeted for October.

 

Although it may take some time, we plan to proceed carefully to verify various aspects of balance and assess the impact on Sung Jinwoo and the other hunters.

 

We want to inform you that our team’s approach to balance is focused on “buffing.”

 

Hunters who are evaluated as underperforming or not receiving enough attention, will be continuously adjusted for balance improvements. We will always strive to ensure that you can experience a more diverse range of combat scenarios through these ongoing adjustments.

 

Additionally, many hunters are mentioning and evaluating that the Sung Jinwoo’s new Job Change Monarch of Shadow Soul Shepherd “Sonic Stream” skill’s performance is way better than the previous skills.

 

This balance has been designed to perform with high efficiency in specific situations.

 

However, our development team values the use of Sung Jinwoo’s various Skills and Runes depending on the stage or content. Therefore, we plan to make adjustments to enhance skills and runes that are currently underutilized in the near future.

 

We hope you enjoy the diverse and engaging gameplay.

 

[Sense of Belonging]

 

 

After the last update, many hunters have been enjoying the guild system in various ways, such as creating guilds, becoming guild masters, joining guilds, and becoming a guild member.

 

However, during the joining and leaving the guild, a penalty system, developed to prevent abuse, was activated and was deemed as inconvenient by certain hunters.

The corresponding system is scheduled to be improved so we carefully ask for your patience.

 

Except for the issue above, the details below will also be added or improved.

 

- Guild Skill will be added.
- When challenging the Guild Boss, additional attempts will be added after registering for 2 times.
- A feature to search for other guilds will be added.
- The buff display in the exchange shop will be improved.
- The display of Guild Master and Vice Guild Master will be improved.
- The Guild creation interface will be improved.
- Guild notice will be amended and lobby display will be improved.

 

A “Guild Rank” system where hunters can strengthen the unity in the Guild is also under development so please look forward to it.

 

[Crafting]

 

[Truth: Demon Knight's Spear]

 

Through the previous Developer Note in May, we have mentioned an upgrade feature where hunters can upgrade certain Sung Jinwoo SR-Rank weapons to a higher rank.

 

After such information was made public, many hunters have expressed significant concerns.

 

The concerns involved cases where hunters already salvaged SR-Rank equipment and SR-Rank weapons might disrupt the balance of SSR-Rank weapons.

 

The team have collected the hunters' opinions and have currently developed and applied the SSR-Rank weapon crafting through the guild system.

 

The Solo Leveling:ARISE will strive to improve through the precious feedback from our hunters.

 

[Faction of the Shield Skill Level Up]

 

The team is continuously upgrading the detecting system and firmly taking measures related to the usage of unauthorized programs or abuse.

 

We would like to inform you that currently, those who have engaged in fraudulent registration are being monitored in real time and are subject to ranking removal and game access suspension for up to 365 days.

(Those who have engaged in fraudulent registration are not able to reclaim their account.)

 

[Upcoming Improvements]

 

Before addressing the details,

We apologize for the inconvenience due to several issues and unstable service

 

We agree with the opinion that improvements are needed for artifacts with attributes as their main option.

However, after internal discussion, it will take some time since this requires overall amendments, including complex battle calculation logics.

 

We ask for your understanding, Hunters.

 

We will continue addressing the improvements scheduled for the next update.

 

- The Bonds level will be expanded to Lv. 90.
- The maximum level will be expanded to Lv. 90.
- To allow hunters to earn additional rewards at higher scores, the rewards for "Power of Destruction" will be expanded based on achievement scores.
- Starting from Battlefield of Time Season 4, the challenge bosses will be increased from 4 to 5 and will proceed for 6 weeks, divided accordingly.
- To more promptly distribute the rewards after playing the Battlefield of Time, the settlement time will be shortened.
- The segment rewards for the Battle Missions will be expanded.
- The Gates difficulty and missions will be expanded.
- For a more sensitive control of usage of the ultimate skill in Power of Destruction or Guild Boss content, a new feature where hunters can manually control it in Team Fight mode will be added.
- The Hunters Association Support Chest obtainable through the Daily Essence Stone Support will be converted into a better chest item.

[Added 8/30 (Fri) 10:51 (UTC+0)]
* Please note that the newly acquired chests will be changed and the content of the previously obtained chests will be maintained.

 

Although it hasn’t been improved in this update,

We are also exploring ways to utilize unused Tier 4 Gems so we ask for your understanding and patience in this matter.

 

The team will always listen carefully to the feedback of our hunters.

 

[Conclusion]

 

[Battle Scene of Sung Jinwoo vs Baran]

 

Dear Hunters,

The September update is also a crucial update for the development team.

 

We are trying hard to present a more complete story of Sung Jinwoo who will finally face Baran.

 

Please wait for the day to face the demon king, Baran.

 

One more thing, the long-awaited “him” is preparing to visit the hunters before the public release of the Jeju Island raid.

 

At this point, perhaps it's time to give you a sneak peek of him. 

“He has red eyes and blond hair.”

 

“One of the last survivors of the past “Dragon Kamish Raid” in the United States,

named as “National Level” hunter after the incident and the true king of the Scavenger Guild”

 

Any topics we didn't cover in this developers note will be continued in the upcoming "Developer Livestream." We appreciate your anticipation and support.

name.en: Developer Note: Regarding the Upcoming Update and Recent Feedback

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Regarding the Upcoming Update and Recent Feedback

Hunters Association
|
Sep 11, 2024, 08:00
|
17,966

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Development Team.

 

Today, we are here with a Developer Note to share our thoughts and discuss with our hunters regarding the details announced through the previous livestream that was broadcasted on 9/9 (Mon).

 

About Concept of Hunters and Double Rate Up

 

We've seen many comments from hunters regarding the character design, concept, and performance that you expect from the game. Especially around the time of the livestream, your feedback made us realize that our preparations were insufficient, and it gave us a lot to think about.

We believed that hunters with a fresh concept would help refresh the game's atmosphere, but the result did not align with the expectations of our hunters. For the characters that will be introduced in the future, we will carefully prepare them to not only fit the theme of Solo Leveling but also meet the standards of satisfaction that our hunters expect.

 

We've also heard feedback from our hunters that the opening timing of the announced rate up feels too close.

Charlotte and Harper are twin sisters, deeply connected within the story. They share a common experience and work through the same events together, which is why we wanted to present their intertwined stories to you. This led to the decision to release both characters within a short timeframe.

 

Through the Rate Up Draw, Harper’s rate up will start on 9/12 (Thu) and last for four weeks and Charlotte’s rate up will start on 9/19 (Thu) and last for three weeks. We had thoroughly discussed the double rate up in advance, and since we expected that it might feel burdensome, we extended the rate up period compared to previous rate ups. Additionally, we planned to distribute Rate Up Draw Tickets through events, hoping this would help ease the burden for our Hunters.

 

However, we still completely understand the remaining burden of our hunters due to the double rate up. Therefore, we will be distributing Essence Stones in the check-in event that will be starting from 9/19 (Thu) to alleviate the burden.

 

About Forced Rate Up

 

Other than the characters’ design of the upcoming rate up, we assume that our huntres are also anxious of the forced draw. We do not aim to force the use of new hunters exclusively in top-tier content. Therefore, we will structure the content in a way that allows the use of various hunters by introducing additional attribute weaknesses and thoroughly testing the internal balance of top-tier content. As fellow players, we also do not welcome situations where only specific hunters are mandatory. Rest assured, you don't need to worry that you won't be able to play content without the rate up characters.

 

About Skill Rune Balance

 

Our guiding principle in managing the game is to avoid nerfing the balance that hunters are currently experiencing. We believe that hunters have noticed our commitment to this principle through previous buffs, including those to characters like Seo Jiwoo. Nerfing characters would turn the satisfaction you’ve experienced into disappointment, which is why we aim to maintain this operational philosophy moving forward.

 

As for Sonic Stream-Magnifying Slashes, however, we had to go through a lot of consideration and discussion because too much damage was dealt upon activation under certain circumstances.

 

After careful discussion, we have concluded to buff other Runes to the equivalent level of the current Magnifying Slashes for other Runes to also be selected by our hunters.

 

We have previously revealed the details regarding the buffs and have prepared balance adjustment measures to increase the type of buff receiving Runes and buffing them to the equivalent level of the current Magnifying Slashes performance through the 9/12 (Thu) update.

Developer Notes

9/9 (Mon) Developer Note Livestream Video Summary

Hunters Association
|
Sep 11, 2024, 08:00
|
4,524

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

We would like to briefly summarize the contents of the Developer Note broadcast held on 9/9 (Mon).

For more detailed information, please check the video through the link below.

 

👉 [9/9 (Mon) Developer Note Livestream Video]

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

Lucky Skill Rune Chest Vol.2 x2

0912BARANISCOMING

Essence Stones x2,500

 

 

📢 9/9 (Mon) Developer Note Livestream Video Summary

 

📌 Q&A

 

Q. Aren’t the newly added skill runes unusually strong? (00:21:40)

A. First of all, we apologize for the confusion regarding skill rune balance. Our plan was to enhance Sung Jinwoo’s performance through skill balancing, but there were unintended bugs, and it was confirmed that they dealt more damage than expected. However, considering the impact on gameplay, we decided to keep them as they are, as they seemed effective in terms of fun. We plan to gradually adjust the skill runes by increasing their balance.

 

Q. When and how will the Healing Given option change? (00:24:53)

A. For the Healing Given, the Main Effects will remain the same, while the secondary option will be changed to Mana Recovery Rate. As a part of the September update, the recovery rate stat will be maintained since there are cases where it is being utilized.

 

Q. Sung Jinwoo is too weak. Isn’t he weaker than the hunters? (00:26:08)

A. In the original work, Sung Jinwoo is a character who becomes stronger starting from the Demon’s Castle and Jeju Island Raid episodes. The development team is also considering additional growth for Sung Jinwoo in various ways, aiming for the Jeju Island Raid Update. We are preparing new features such as Sung Jinwoo’s QTE Rune Skill, Ultimate Skill, and new Job Changes. We appreciate your continued interest and support.

 

Q. In team fights, hunters waste their Ultimate Skills too often, which is very inconvenient.   (00:27:41)

A. The AI for Hunters is continuously being improved. For guild fights and team fights, we are working on making it possible to use them manually for Sung Jinwoo’s team only.

 

Q. The ranking calculation time for the Battlefield of Time seems too long, and the break time also seems too lengthy. (00:28:58)

A. We are working on improvements related to this issue in the upcoming 2.0 update. We will provide detailed information about these changes at the scheduled update time.

 

Q. When will the rewards for the 400 million or more rank in the Power of Destruction be renewed? (00:29:23)

A. The renewal is scheduled for the September update. The reward score range will be extended to 1 billion, and additional reward lists for tier 2 and 3 Chests will be included. You will have a good chance of obtaining Custom Draw Tickets from these chests, and similar to the guild raid, a result damage meter will also be applied, so we appreciate your anticipation.

 

📌 Real-time Communication

 

Q.  When will the issue of having a red dot even though there aren’t any additional rewards to obtain be fixed? (00:31:07)

A. This issue requires a build update to fix, which has made it challenging for a quick solution. It is expected to be addressed in the upcoming update.

 

Q. Tell us more about the Double Rate Up. (00:31:46)

A. In order to strategize for the Workshop of Brilliant Light, a completion of an attribute deck is required. For this deck completion, it's anticipated that Hunter supplies will be necessary, so we're preparing for a double rate up format.

 

Q. Please explain Bracelets’ Elemental Weakness not being applied correctly. (00:32:55)

A. We apologize for the inconvenience. This issue is scheduled to be fixed in the September update.

 

Q. The rewards for acquiring Hunters with advancement tier 10 or higher seem to need improvement. (00:33:31)

A. We are preparing to improve the rewards for acquiring Hunters who have completed 10 advancements, aiming for an update in October. We will provide detailed information through an update notice.

 

Q. The difficulty of the Battlefield of Trials Challenge has become too high. (00:34:31)

A. We have noticed that many Hunters are finding the Trials of the Battlefield Challenge particularly difficult after stage 11. We plan to adjust the balancing of this challenge in the upcoming update.

 

Q. I want to see the guild rankings. (00:35:07)

A. We are currently discussing internally about preparing the guild rankings for the October update. If there are no issues, it is scheduled to be updated in October.

 

Q. It seems like some hunters are getting leaked early. (00:35:31)

A. Sometimes, Hunters who are not yet released may appear in the lobby due to art assets. However, as the specs are not finalized internally, you don’t have to assume that these details will be as shown.

 

Q. Please update the rate up and special summons lists. (00:36:15)

A. We will ensure that the special summons list is updated based on a specific cycle. Since advance notices are required, please check for updates through our update announcements.

 

Q. It’s too difficult to obtain Artifacts with the desired effects. (00:37:30)

A. We are preparing an event related to Artifact effects. We will provide more details in the upcoming update.

 

Q. When will the Blessing Stone slot expansion be available? (00:38:30)

A.  The planning for the slot expansion has been reviewed, but it has not yet been confirmed for an update. We will provide detailed information once the decision is made.

 

Q. Are there any plans to add PvP content? (00:39:10)

A. There are no plans to add PvP content this year. Although we know there are hunters who enjoy PvP, we will focus on single-player content for the remainder of the year.

 

Q. Is there a solution for overheating issues? (00:40:10)

A. We have optimized guild boss content, but high-quality and flashy effects can lead to higher heat generation. Lowering the graphic settings might help control the heat.

 

Q. Manhwa original hunters, especially Choi Jong-In and Baek Yunho, are too weak. (00:41:00)

A. We continuously review and improve all hunters, including manhwa original ones. We have been buffing underperforming Hunters and will continue to monitor and adjust to meet your balance expectations.

 

Q. The rewards for subscription are too low. (00:43:50)

A. We have discussed and decided to increase the rewards for subscription. Details will be provided in an update notice.

 

Q. Please implement a guild chat system. (00:44:30)

A. Guild chat systems are often misused, so we currently do not plan to implement an internal chat system for guilds.

 

Q. Please release a Sung Jinwoo costume. (00:45:13)

A. We are currently working on a Sung Jinwoo costume. Additional chroma versions are also planned, so please stay tuned for updates.

 

📌 Upcoming Updates

 

1. Solo Leveling:ARISE 2.0 Update (00:46:50)

- One of the most exciting episodes from the original game, the Upper Floors of the Demon Castle, is being updated. This update will include new story chapters, level expansions, and a renewal of, Encore Missions and Instance Dungeon. Additionally, there will be updates to the Proof of the Strong, a renewal for the Battlefield of Time, as well as new hunters and shadows.

 

2. Update Celebration Event - Autumn Season Event (01:01:12)

- To celebrate the update, we are preparing an event with various rewards including Rate Up Draw Ticket x50, Gold  x1,000,000 and items related to the new hunters. We hope you look forward to and participate in this event.

 

3. Artifact Crafting Event (01:02:12)

- Since it can be challenging to obtain desired effects for artifacts through farming alone, we are preparing an Artifact Crafting Event. This event will allow you to choose and craft artifacts with the effects you want. Take advantage of this opportunity to craft the artifacts you desire by participating in the event.

 

 

We will continue to strive to provide even more enjoyable and satisfying services for our hunters.

Please continue to show the same level of interest and affection for Solo Leveling:ARISE

 

Thank you.

- When selecting Legendary Skill Rune/Blessing Stone in the inventory, you will be moved to crafting item instead of Skill Rune/Blessing Stone fusion item where you can refine Legendary Skill Rune/Blessing Stone.

- You will be able to check the details of the Guild buffs purchased in Guild Exchange Shop in the lobby screen.

- In Team Fight mode, you will be able to manually control the use of each hunter’s Ultimate Skill.

* If the hunters’ Ultimate Skill gauge is charged the portrait will flash and you can tap the designated number of the corresponding hunter to activate the skill.

* Please check the settings for the supporting hunters’ Ultimate Skill activation in the game through [Options] > [Controls].

- Fixed the missing notification of “Berserk” related description in the Workshop of Brilliant Light daily boss “Avaricious Vulcan” monster passive.

(Uses Berserk to increase Attack →  Uses Berserk to increase Attack and Defense)

- Improved to check the enemy boss’s HP bar when Emma Laurent Ultimate Skill “Burning Pride” is hit.

- Improved the notification of Hunters Association Premium Subscription benefits and pre-notification before the expiration of the subscription period.

- Improved certain skill tooltips by removing the probability-related text for effects that have a 100% activation rate.

- When proceeding with the Special Summons draw and opening all the slots, the Special Summon confirmation period will be extended from 2 days originally to the end of the draw period.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the issue where the red dot was displayed after completing the Guild contents and missions.

- Fixed the issue where the Bracelet Artifact’s elemental damage (%) effect was not applied normally.

- Fixed the issue where the effect of Lee Bora hunter’s exclusive weapon “Solid Logic”  was not activating normally during Guild Boss content.

- Fixed the issue where the critical hit rate and increase in critical damage effects were not normally applied for certain hunters in the Guild Boss content.

- Fixed the issue where the exclusive weapon for the required hunter in the Hidden Chapter 2 Side Story was incorrectly applied.

- Fixed the issue where certain font tagging features were available when editing profile or Guild introduction. 

- Fixed the issue where Go Gunhee’s motion was incorrectly applied when tagging out.

- Fixed the issue where the Hidden Chapter was not displayed normally in the profile or the quick menu’s Story progression.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you!

 

First of all, we would like to apologize for the issues that occurred after the 9/12 (Thu) update.

The whole development team is currently striving to find the root cause of the issue as soon as possible.

However, the fix for this issue is taking longer than anticipated as it involves not only applying a correction but also conducting thorough testing.

 

Especially for the issue where a black screen is displayed during the gameplay, you have to redownload the entire game data to resolve the issue.

We understand the inconvenience of our hunters and are taking measures so that the issue can be resolved by just downloading additional data.

 

Please understand that the searching and applying for that solution is taking some time.

 

For hunters who wish to enjoy the game sooner, please redownload the game data in a wifi environment.

 

We also have promised a check-in event that contains Essence Stones through the Developer Livestream.

We have decided to reinforce the rewards and distribute them to hunters as soon as possible.

 

Please refer to the following check-in event notice scheduled to begin today.

 

👉 [Go See Check-In Event]

 

Once again, we apologize for providing an unpleasant gaming environment.

 

Thank you.

Developer Notes

Developer Note: Upcoming Changes [Updated 10/4 (Fri) 06:00 (UTC+0)]

Hunters Association

81,027

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

First of all, we would like to apologize to all hunters who have experienced inconveniences due to various issues that happened after the last update.

 

Solo Leveling:ARISE is growing thanks to all of the precious feedback from our fellow hunters, and will continue to strive to provide you with a fun and pleasant environment.

 

Today, we are here with a developer note to share some news about the upcoming updates before our official livestream at the end of October.

 

 

[Workshop of Brilliant Light: Demons' Castle Upper Floors]

 

Following the Story of Baran, Monarch of White Flames in the last Update,

Workshop of Brilliant Light: Demons' Castle Upper Floors Baran Raid will be added to the game.

 

First, Baran will begin with the difficulty of somewhere between Vulcan easy and normal.

If you manage to clear the Baran raid immediately after the update, you'll be in the top 10% of hunters worldwide.

 

Secondly, there is no mandatory requirement to have specific hunter skills in order to defeat Baran.

When challenging Vulcan, we are aware that hunters with shield removal such as Hwang Dongsoo or Meilin Fisher took a spot in your formation. Instead, how about challenging Baran with a more diverse group of hunters?

 

Lastly, Baran has weaknesses against Dark Element and Wind Element.

Just like Vulcan, Baran also has a standard amount of Break Gauge.

Utilizing this will help you in challenging Baran.

 

To assist with defeating Vulcan, we plan to extend Charlotte’s rate up period for a week.

We ask for your anticipation for the upcoming Baran Raid.

 

[A New Growth System! The Power of Core]

 

As announced in the previous official livestream, along with the renewal of Encore Missions and Instance Dungeon, we are planning to introduce the new Core System and a renewal for the Workshop of Brilliant Light so that cores could be obtained as a reward.

 

A core is another growth element for Sung Jinwoo and other hunters,

equipping a core that matches the passive will offer special effects and stats.

 

A total of 3 cores can be equipped, and each of them offer specialized effects such as Attack / Defense / Support. 

 

We share with you the image of the upcoming Core System, and will be putting in our utmost effort to finalize everything before we meet with you.

 

[The Ultimate Hunter and The Glamorous Model! And The Demon King’s Longsword]

 

During the last official livestream, our team mentioned that we will continuously monitor and adjust hunters who are less equipped.

 

In this balance adjustment, Fire Element hunters from the manhwa and the Demon King’s Longsword will be adjusted since they have received the most feedback from our fellow hunters.

[Upcoming Changes]

The upcoming update has various changes prepared for you.

We are also preparing to improve certain aspects that may have caused inconvenience for our hunters.

 

● Cha Hae-In / Alicia Blanche / Meilin Fisher / Yoo Soohyun / Amamiya Mirei / Han Se-Mi will be added to the Rate Up Draw.
● Meilin Fisher / Yoo Soohyun / Amamiya Mirei / Han Se-Mi / Go Gunhee will be added to the Special Summons after the reset on 10/16. Additionally, you can also obtain Sung Jinwoo Weapon Phoenix Soul and Zeke's Fragment.
● The amount of Platinum Commemorative Coin obtained when obtaining additional hunters who have completed Transcendence Advancement, will be increased as 15 → 240.

● A New Blessing Stone slot will be added on 10/31 (Thu).
As the attacks of existing magic beasts have become more powerful, the surviving environment of hunters has become more harsh. To solve the issue, we are planning to add a separate slot regardless of the remaining slots for equipping Blessing Stones that can provide assistance in survival.

All Blessing Stones could be equipped in the previous 4 slots, but only Blessing Stones related to survival can be equipped in the new slot.

 

Other than the details above, the team is currently focusing on the precious feedback from our hunters.

 

For example, we have confirmed feedback regarding the increase in mana consumption when leveling up.

We are currently reviewing to improve the less importance of level up due to increase in mana consumption when leveling up.

 

We will strive to provide a better gaming environment as possible.

 

The team is preparing for more various details in October in addition to the updates scheduled for 10/10 (Thu).

 

[Judge of Death]

 

We have revealed this image through the previous second half roadmap of the year before.

The monster that you could sometimes see on the loading screen is approaching close to you step by step. By the time its true form is revealed, a new job change for Sung Jinwoo will likely be added.

 

An upcoming season event <Horror Festival> and new Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions bosses are also scheduled for that period!

📌 New Workshop of Brilliant Light Dungeon - Addition of Demon’s Castle Upper Floors and Improvements

 

▶ Addition of new dungeon “Demon’s Castle Upper Floors”

- The “Workshop of Brilliant Light - Demon’s Castle Upper Floors” will be added where hunters can challenge the king of demons, Monarch of White Flames, Baran.

The “Demon’s Castle Upper Floors” will be unlocked after clearing “Demons' Castle Lower Floors - Easy.”

* The Demon’s Castle Upper Floors will be available for challenge after reaching Battle Tier 3022.

* The normal difficulty of the Demon’s Castle Upper Floors will be unlocked after clearing easy mode.

 

- The Demon’s Castle Upper Floors consists of main and sub stages and you can enter the stage selection screen by consuming the Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitation when selecting difficulty.

* For the initial challenge for each difficulty, “Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitations” will not be consumed.

* The Workshop of Brilliant Light proceeds in a weekly cycle and resets once every Thursday at 00:00 (UTC+0).

Additionally, the Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitation recharges to its maximum amount at the reset period.

- The stages consist of player and hunter modes, and this can be checked through marked icons for each stage.

 

- In the main stages of the Demon’s Castle Upper Floors, Solidified Stones that are required for enhancing the new equipment “Core” will be obtainable.

In the sub stages, you can clear the stages more easily with the Blessing of Brilliant Light Effect similar to the Demon’s Castle Lower Floors.

* The reward items (Powder of Blessing, Advanced Mana Crystal, Artifact Enhancement Chip II, Weapon Enhancement Gear II etc.) obtainable from the Demon’s Castle Lower Floors can also be obtained in the Demon’s Castle Upper Floors.

* The detailed information on the obtainable rewards can be checked in the game.

📌 New Equipment “Core”

- A “Core” equipment that enables Sung Jinwoo and hunters to obtain additional stats and special effects will be added along with the Core Codex and related Achievements.

- Solidified Stone I / II / III used for enhancing Cores and crafting related to the Solidified Stone will be added.

- Cores can be obtained from Workshop of Brilliant Light - Demon’s Castle Upper/Lower Floors and each hunter can equip 3 types of Cores (Mind / Body / Spirit).

- Each Core possess options and passives as below.

Category

Description

Option

- Similar to Artifacts, the Core provides stats for the equipping hunters.

- 2 types of bonus stats are provided for Cores of each part. First option is granted with Attack/Defense/HP(Additional Stats or %) based on the Core parts and the other option is granted randomly.

- Option bonuses can be enhanced by leveling up or enhancing Cores.

You can level up Cores up to Lv. 10 by using other Cores as material.

- After reaching the maximum level, you can randomly enhance options by using Solidified Stones that match the rarity of the Core.

- You can only enhance options until 100% of enhancement.

Passive

- A passive is a special effect that activates when a hunter with a specific attribute or Sung Jinwoo equips the Core.

- The passive varies based on the items and the activation conditions are granted randomly. You are not able to change or enhance the passive.

- If the hunter is equipping Cores with identical passive in different parts, the effect will be stacked.

* The detailed information on options and passives can be checked in the game.

Developer Notes

10/29 (Tue) Developer Note Livestream Video Summary

Hunters Association
|
Oct 30, 2024, 10:08
|
10,207

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

We would like to briefly summarize the contents of the Developer Livestream held on 10/29 (Tue).

For more detailed information, please check the video through the link below.

 

👉 [10/29 (Tue) Developer Livestream Video]

* To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

Code

Reward

Expiration Date (UTC+0)

HALFYEARANNIV

Essence Stones x1,000

2024/11/5 (Tue) 14:59

THXHUNTERS

Light Festival Lucky Box x10

FESTIVALPUMPKIN

Mana Power Extract x2

Heroic Skill Rune Chest Vol. 2 x1

BIZSURPRISE

Weapon Custom Draw Ticket x10

 

 

📢 10/29 (Tue) Developer Note Livestream Video Summary

 

📌 Q&A

 

Q. Sung Jinwoo's QTE skill is weaker than his basic attacks, leading to it being unused. (00:35:10)

A. This was mentioned in the last livestream, and the development team is aware of it. We are currently working on buffing the specs of the QTE skill and implementing rune application features to enable more strategic skill usage.

 

Q. Will the option reroll feature for Tier 4 Gem be added? When will the team remove the Gem Healing Given Increase and Healing Received Increase option? (00:35:50)

A. We are currently preparing Tier 5 Gems and you will be able to meet them soon.

We recommend using the Tier 4 Gems with Healing Given Increase and Healing Received Increase options for fusing Tier 5 Gems, and the mentioned options will not be added to the Tier 5 Gems.

 

Q. The daily routine of Encore Missions and Instance Dungeon seems too difficult. (00:37:33)

A. We are planning to lower the burden of daily routines for our hunters.

The recommended combat power will be around 500,000 and the keys will be stored for three days to lower the burden.

However, to ensure the fun of challenge, the Proof of the Strong difficulty will remain the same.

 

Q. Sung Jinwoo’s Ultimate Skill animation is too long. Can’t we just skip it? (00:38:15)

A. We are currently not planning on creating a feature that can skip Sung Jinwoo’s Ultimate Skill animation.

However, we are preparing a new Sung Jinwoo Ultimate Skill and this will be introduced around December with a shorter activation period.

 

Q. Gates are too boring. Can’t you decrease the number of Gates? (00:38:52)

A. For Gates content, we are planning to reduce the counts and increase the rewards per Gate to lower the burden of our hunters.

 

Q. Images of higher tier runes are spreading through communities. Are they actually being released? (00:39:25)

A. During the development process, we consider various potential future updates. The images that were unpacked and shared are actually test data included during development.

   

However, not all of this data will necessarily be implemented in the actual game, and currently, there are no confirmed plans to introduce higher-tier runes. One thing we can confirm is that there are no plans to add new runes within this year.

 

Even if higher-tier runes are introduced in the future, we are in the initial stages of discussing a system that would allow players to earn runes based on gameplay rather than through the current random acquisition method.

 

Q. The current location of the Guild button seems inconvenient. (00:41:12)

A. We apologize for the inconvenience caused by this change. We plan to move the Guild button back to its original position. Additionally, the bug that prevented the red dot notification from appearing will be fixed in the upcoming update.

 

📌 Real-Time Q&A

 

Q. When will Thomas Andre join the game? (00:42:13)

A. We understand that many of you are eagerly awaiting Thomas Andre. To meet your expectations, we have expedited the development timeline, and you can expect to see Thomas Andre around the November update.

 

Additionally, starting with this update, you’ll be able to see Thomas Andre in the lobby. The development team has put a lot of effort into crafting him to match his nation level power status, so please look forward to it.

 

Q. When will the game be optimized? (00:43:32)

A. The development team is working on optimizations with each update. Some optimizations are planned for this update as well, and a separate team will be formed to focus more intensively on optimization. We aim to provide noticeable improvements by the November update.

 

While the progress may seem slower than users expect, we are committed to consistently working on enhancements and will show you the results of our efforts.

 

Q. When will Kaisel be added? (00:44:27)

A. Kaisel will be added soon. We will inform you through the Update Details notice.

 

Q. How about creating a preset feature? (00:44:39)

A. In the last update, we expanded preset slots for Sung Jinwoo. The development team is currently conducting extensive research to find a more optimized approach. Please wait a little longer, and we will present a good solution soon.

 

Q. Are there plans to create PvP content? (00:45:01)

A. As mentioned in the previous livestream, there are currently no short-term plans for PvP development. However, we acknowledge that many hunters enjoy and desire competitive content, so discussions with the business unit regarding the addition of such content may be necessary.

 

Q. When will you add Guild Ranking? (00:45:31)

A. The development team is currently working on contributions related to Guild ranking calculation.

We aim to avoid immediately introducing a competitive structure as soon as Guild content is released. Instead, we plan to add competitive content once the Guilds are activated and reach a certain stage.

 

Q. Will the star shaped Gems be updated? (00:46:17)

A. As mentioned above, it is a test data. There are no additional plans.

 

Q. Are there plans for the Artifact Crafting Event? (00:46:29)

A. We recognize that the Artifact Crafting Event is very useful for the hunters. We plan to hold it again soon and will provide an announcement with more details shortly.

 

Q. Can you differentiate the icons for the damage-reduction skills (such as Shadow Step and Mutilate - Strike) (00:46:51)

A. I think that's a great suggestion. I will pass it on to the planning team so it can be updated.

 

Q. Even after completing Guild missions, there are too few Guild tokens to receive buffs! (00:47:45)

A. An update related to Guild contributions is in preparation, and we are considering ways to adjust the amount of tokens received based on Guild contributions. While I can’t confirm anything right now, we will review the data and discuss it to find the best possible solutions.

 

Q. Please create a Guild chat feature! (00:48:18)

A. Currently, there are no plans to add Guild chat. If we do implement something, it will likely be limited to simple emoticons or greetings for basic communication. We do not have any plans for real-time chat.

 

Q. The cast for rerolling Blessing Stones is too expensive (00:48:58)

A. We are aware that there are mixed opinions about the reroll costs, and it's currently a hot topic in the community.

For those who have already obtained items through challenging rates, drastically lowering the acquisition difficulty could lead to disparities. At the same time, we've noted that many feel the costs are too high and are requesting a reduction.

 

However, as I mentioned earlier, there won't be any additional high-grade runes for the time being, and since hunters are currently using existing runes, it's better to approach the situation cautiously rather than making hasty decisions for the sake of the livestream atmosphere. We will carefully consider various methods, and if we find a feasible solution, we will share it with you.

 

Q. Is there no update planned for original male characters? (00:50:26)

A. Thomas Andre is scheduled for an update, and I understand the kind of vibe you’re looking for. Given the serious and cool combat-based atmosphere of "Solo Leveling," which has a dedicated fandom, we will strive to create characters that can embody these elements.

 

Q. I heard that Tie 5 Gems are coming out, but I’m worried since I’m already short on Tier 4 Gems. (00:51:00)

A. The reason we're not saying we'll drastically lower the acquisition costs for items like Gems or Blessing Stones is that we're gradually increasing the rewards for Blessings Stones, Skill Runes, and Gems. Similarly, when the Tier 5 Gems are released, we're considering measures to replenish Tier 4 Gems through events and other means.

 

Q. As the number of Artifacts increases, it becomes challenging to collect them. (00:51:57)

A. As mentioned earlier, the Crafting Event is planned, and we are also monitoring the acquisition rates.

 

Q. The Demonic Plum Flower Sword’s performance is too powerful. (00:52:12)

A. There are currently no plans to nerf the performance of existing skills. However, we plan to buff other skills to align them with the top-tier runes and achieve balance. We will gradually raise the specs of the underperforming runes to make adjustments.

 

📌 Upcoming Updates

 

1. Sung Jinwoo Maximum Level Expansion (00:53:58)

- The maximum level for Sung Jinwoo and hunters will be expanded. The addition of Gate difficulties 39 and 40, along with a difficulty patch, will be implemented, making it easier for hunters to enjoy the game.

 

2. New Sung Jinwoo Job Change: Titan of Twilight (00:54:28)

- New Sung Jinwoo Job Change and new Skill Dagger Rush will be added. The new skill, "Dagger Rush," is designed with an out boxing style, making it easier to land hits compared to other skills. Additionally, many hunters have requested an expansion of the Blessing Stones, and we’re happy to announce that this will be implemented. The slots for Blessing Stones will be increased from the original 4 to a total of 6, with 2 new slots being added. These will be unlocked with the new class introduced at the end of the year. Previously, many hunters focused solely on attack-oriented Blessing Stones. The expanded Blessing Stones will now include options for survival-oriented stones, allowing for a more balanced approach. This expansion will be implemented alongside a balance patch, so make sure to take advantage of the new defensive options.

 

3. Story Expansion: Deimos (00:58:47)

- There have been hints about Deimos in the stories of new hunters, such as the Hunter Origin webtoon. The previously laid breadcrumbs will be tied into the storyline, so we appreciate your anticipation and interest in this development.

 

4. New Shadow: Kaisel (1:00:08)

- The long-awaited Kaisel, which Sung Jinwoo rode while soaring through the skies in the original work, is finally making its appearance. We've put in a lot of effort to stay true to the original portrayal, especially since Kaisel is such an impressive Shadow. When summoned, Kaisel will enhance ultimate damage and provide movement buffs that align with its concept.

 

5. New Growth Element: Remnant Power (1:01:17)

- The Remnant Power is a new growth element and skill being introduced in this update. The concept revolves around borrowing the strength of the Monarchs. In the story of Solo Leveling, Sung Jinwoo saves a world in crisis from these Monarchs. With this in mind, we've designed the concept around defeating the Monarchs to gather their power for growth. You can expect to feel Sung Jinwoo becoming even stronger than before!

 

6. Battlefield of Chaos Tier 15 and Tier 5 Gem (1:03:10)

- The Battlefield of Chaos will be expanded to Tier 15, allowing you to earn higher rewards than before. However, We understand there may be concerns about increased difficulty with this expansion. Rest assured, the Tier 15 will be designed to match the difficulty of the existing Tier 12. We encourage you to take on the challenge of the Battlefield of Chaos and collect plenty of high tier Gems!

 

7. New Workshop of Brilliant Light: Baran Hard (1:04:35)

- The previously held Mission! Recruiting Hunters to Defeat the Workshop of Brilliant Light Vulcan (Hard Mode) will return in a Baran version. Many hunters have strived to clear the mission through the Vulcan event, and we believe this provided an enjoyable experience for hunters. While it may seem geared toward top hunters, there will also be overall rewards prepared for all participants. Given your growth since the last event, we expect the difficulty won't be too challenging this time around. The playtime will be relatively short, so we encourage everyone to take on the challenge.

* The segment showing IN 1,000 / IN 3,000 during the livestream was presented as an illustrative example to help with understanding. Detailed information about the event will be provided in a future announcement.

 

8. New Hunter - Isla Wright (1:06:59)

- A new dark attribute support, Isla Wright, is set to be added to complete the dark attribute deck. - Gather materials from the Workshop of Brilliant Light to enhance the Remnant Power through level-up.

Increase combat power and acquire passive points that can be used to enhance Remnant Power skills through level-up.

📌 Blessing Stone Type Segmentation Based on Types and New Type Exclusive Slot

- The Blessing Stones will be separated into Supplement/Survival types based on their effects.

- The existing Blessing Stone slot will be converted to a slot where an Supplement-type Blessing Stone can be equipped, and an additional slot will be added for equipping a Survival-type Blessing Stone.

- When advancing to the new Job Change “The Monarch of Shadows Titan of Twilight,” an additional slot for equipping a Survival-type Blessing Stone will be unlocked, allowing for a total of four Supplement slots and two Survival slots.

With the segmentation of Blessing Stone types and the addition of type-specific slots, all Blessing Stones equipped before the update will be unequipped and stored in the inventory. The system will reset to include the default Daily Quest Completion Blessing Stone equipped upon account creation.

Please take a moment after the maintenance to check and re-equip your previously used Blessing Stones. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation.

📌 Common Notes for All Packages

- All of the packages and content can be sold again in the future.

- The sales period may be subject to change in certain circumstances and we will notify you of the changes through a notice.

- The packages can be purchased for a limited time during the sales period.

- The purchasing methods differ based on the type of package. Please check the details in the game.

- Available purchases for the packages with [Monthly purchase limit] will be reset every first day of the month at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- Available purchases for the packages with [Weekly purchase limit] will be reset every Monday at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- Available purchases for the packages with [Daily purchase limit] will be reset every day at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- For pass-type packages, Pass EXP, and mission completion information will be applied differently based on each package.

- The unclaimed pass tier achievement rewards will be sent to your mailbox at the end of the pass period.

 

 

📌 Other Improvements

- The remaining time on the Blessing selection screen displayed during the Workshop of Brilliant Light sub-stages will be improved.

- The Hunters Association Lobby and Guild Lobby interiors will be updated with a Pumpkin Festival event theme.

- When ongoing events (such as the Growth Tournament) have related packages available, hunters will be able to the event shop directly from the Rate Up Draw screen.

- Tooltip descriptions regarding option enhancements will be added to the Core Inventory.

- An auto-equip button will be added to the Core management screen for hunters and Sung Jinwoo.

* When used, this feature will automatically equip Cores that meet the conditions for activating passive effects.

- After clearing the Workshop of Brilliant Light, the Core’s level, passive details, and option enhancement will be displayed when a Core is acquired.

- The maximum storage limit for Instance Dungeon, Encore Missions, and the Battlefield of Chaos keys will increase.

* The daily recharge amount for each key remains the same; keys will recharge at the daily reset if the total doesn't exceed the maximum storage limit. However, if the daily recharge amount exceeds the storage limit, only up to the maximum storage amount will be recharged.

* The daily recharge and maximum storage limits vary based on the Reputation level.

- Gina’s  skill priority during auro-battle mode will be adjusted.

- Adjust Shadow Visibility will be added to [Options] > [Graphics] menu.

- When attempting to enter Job Change in Sung Jinwoo's Job Change menu without meeting the requirements, a message indicating the required conditions will be displayed.

- Removed incorrectly added effect notifications in certain stages of Workshop of Brilliant Light on Easy and Normal difficulty.

- Fixed the issue where incorrect chapter and mission information was displayed on the pause screen in Chapters 19 and 20 of the story.

- Fixed the issue where the icon of basic skill critical damage increase effect among the Core passives was displayed incorrectly.

- Fixed the issue where Achievements were not cleared collectively when completing multiple high levels of Proof of the Strong at once in Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions.

* For hunters who have experienced the issue above, please clear the corresponding stage again after the update to normally clear the stage and acquire rewards.

- Fixed the issue in the Upper Floors of Workshop of Brilliant Light where Extreme Evasion did not activate normally when the boss is applied with the break effect or defeated shortly after Baran (longsword mode) uses a specific pattern in the 100th floor stage.

- Fixed the missing Ultimate Skill dialogue for Gina.

- Fixed the issue in Hunter Mode where the QTE button appeared slowly after some hunters using a core skill.

- Fixed the issue where the set Proof of the Storing level was not applied correctly when attempting the 21st level by tapping the next level button after clearing the 20th level in Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions.

- Fixed the missing elemental weakness settings for monsters in Cha Hae-In’s Secret Library stage.

- Fixed the missing change in rankings animation when registering records in Power of Destruction.

- Fixed the issue where the Demon King's Daggers would sometimes not hit at close range.

- Fixed the issue where the effect and the second hit range of Sung Jinwoo's Vacuum Wave didn't match.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

📌 Thank you speech for winning the Grand Prize

 

■ Thank you for the support! Game Awards Grand Prize Winner Celebration SSR Jinwoo Weapon Selection Ticket and Legendary Blessing Stone distribution!

- In celebration of Solo Leveling:Arise being selected for the Grand Prize, appreciation rewards are being distributed.

Starting from November 13, alongside previously distributed gifts, hunters at level 30 or higher will receive 20 Rate Up Draw Tickets and 20 Custom Draw Tickets. Hunters at level 50 or higher will also be rewarded with 30 Custom Draw Tickets and a Legendary Blessing Stone Selection Chest.

 

In particular, since the Legendary Blessing Stone is provided as a selection chest rather than a random reward, hunters who were disappointed by not obtaining their desired Legendary Blessing Stone are highly encouraged to claim this reward. The newly added level-based rewards will be distributed starting 11/21 (Thu) and can be claimed until 2025/1/31 (Fri).

 

📌 Q&A

 

Q. Delayed gameplay in mobile devices are still ongoing. When will this issue be resolved?

- As mentioned, we have formed a TF team in the development department, and visible results will come in this update. We have optimized resources that consume memory and have also worked on improving heat dissipation. We will continue making improvements so that you can enjoy the game in a more comfortable environment.

 

Q. It’s inconvenient that the debuff skill for reducing defense and the Shadow Step effect are hard to distinguish.

- By default, defense-reducing skills are classified under the same category, and when used simultaneously, only the skill with the higher defense reduction value will apply. Therefore, you don't need to stress too much about which defense reduction is being applied. However, for effects that apply separately, like Choi Jong-In’s defense reduction, we will further look into it and provide further clarification.

 

Q. Daily works are being eased continuously, however there are no changes in “Mission,” which is inconvenient.

- Daily works and missions will be eased through the 11/28 (Thu) update.

 

Q. It is too hard to get Lv. 78 Artifacts.

- We also had an internal meeting. Previously, it was only available from the Workshop of Brilliant Light, making targeted farming possible, but now that it's mixed with other Artifacts, there have been complaints about the inconvenience. While the overall supply amount has increased according to the data, we understand that it may still feel insufficient. Therefore, we are running a guaranteed crafting event and will also be holding additional events where you can obtain these Artifacts.

 

Q. Are there any plans to apply Proof of the Strong to the Workshop of Brilliant Light content?

- The Workshop of Brilliant Light itself is set to a very high difficulty, but it seems that some hunters who have already cleared it are seeking even higher challenges. The development team is working on this, and we plan to add challenging conditions for the hard difficulty, allowing hunters to earn honor rewards.

 

Q. It would be great if there were Rage rewards for Guild Boss at level 15 or higher.

- Initially, achieving level 14 rage was enough to secure the top rankings, but over time, hunters have discovered specialized setups for Guild Boss battles, such as hunter combinations and Skill Rune configurations. It's truly impressive, and we are currently preparing an expansion to accommodate this.

 

📌 Real-Time Q&A

 

Q. Please apply Multiplay for the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

- We will align the issue in an aspect of easing the daily work.

 

Q. Is the reroll feature still difficult to apply?

- As mentioned last time, rerolling is not something that can be easily decided. Instead, we are considering increasing the chances of obtaining Legendary items, which would raise the overall supply rate.

 

Q. The Mini Game Guild mission is too hard to clear.

- Both small and large Guilds are facing difficulty achieving this, as it ultimately depends on the participation of individuals. While it was originally a mission added for a bit of fun, we will work on improving it by lowering the difficulty.

 

Q. Leveling up each individual hunter is too inconvenient.

- We will prioritize developing a feature that allows you to level up all hunters at once.

 

Q. It is too difficult to upgrade Shadows.

- As the story progression rewards have been increased, the supply of Shadow growth rewards has also been boosted. This should be helpful.

 

Q. It would be great if there was an Artifact recommendation feature.

- Recently, a new employee who hasn't played SLA joined, and we had them test the game. They had difficulty understanding the Artifacts in particular. We are preparing a feature to make Artifacts easier to comprehend. This will include providing recommended sets and offering a guide for the hunters' skill sequences.

 

Q. Are there any roadmaps after December?

- We had a discussion about the 2025 plans. Once the information is organized, we will provide an official update. Since the roadmap must be strictly followed, I will ensure that we can share it during the next or the following livestream after further discussion.

 

Q. Are there any plans to enforce newbie/come back benefits?

- We are providing rewards such as growth materials and Draw Tickets to help hunters nurture more hunters. In addition, we are working on long-term updates like easing daily work, and I would say that now is a great time for hunters to return.

 

Q. Please make a hunter costume only package.

- Currently, hunter costumes are sold in package form, and many hunters feel that the price is burdensome. Therefore, we are preparing to offer some costumes with discounted prices in the near future.

 

Q. Are there plans to renew Shadows? We don’t want to see Beru keep dying.

- As mentioned in the previous livestream, we are preparing a direction that will allow for even stronger growth than before..

 

Q. Are there plans for collaboration?

- We are discussing in various methods and will deliver it to you if there are confirmations.

 

📌 Scheduled Updates

 

■ SLA Roguelike arrives! Simulation Gate System

- To assist with hunter growth, the Hunters Association introduces the Simulation Gate. This is a "roguelike" content where hunters experience various combat and non-combat environments, testing their strength and progressing in the Hunter Mode. We've made many preparations to ensure a continuous gameplay experience, with support for continuation and rewards along the way.

 

The combat concept involves storing the hunters' abilities in memory and having them engage in virtual battles. Various combat scenarios will be offered, including encounters with two hunters appearing as enemies at the same time. If you've ever wondered what it would be like to face off against the hunters you've fought alongside, the Simulation Gate will provide an answer. The final boss will be Sung Jinwoo, offering a unique battle experience compared to traditional large boss fights.

 

In the non-combat event stages that appear throughout, you can recover lost health, revive fallen hunters, or even change your team composition. Additionally, you can acquire exclusive buffs that make your hunters stronger, and you will also be able to enhance these buffs.

 

In addition, the Simulation Gate features an exclusive mastery system called Effect Amplification. By unlocking nodes, you can receive additional effects during your simulation gameplay.

 

■ Additional Artifact Stats! New Growth System: Enchantment

- In addition to Artifacts, a new "Enchantment" system will allow you to further increase your stats. Since it can add stats separately from the existing options, the combat power provided by Artifacts will increase even more. It can raise your team’s combat power by around 100,000, which will be a great help for hunters tackling high-difficulty content.

 

SLA requires some gold for all enhancement methods, and the same applies to Enchantment. However, an update increasing overall gold rewards will help alleviate this.

 

There are no paid elements for Enchantment, and the materials needed for it can be obtained by playing the previously revealed Simulation Gate content. Additionally, it is designed to allow anyone who plays steadily to reach the maximum level.

 

■ A phrase that decorates me - Title Update

- There are hunters who demonstrate amazing gameplay, such as quickly conquering content that seems impossibly difficult. To reward such hunters, a Title system will be introduced. This Title will be displayed on the Guild or Ranking screens, allowing hunters to showcase their achievements and appeal to other hunters.

 

■ Proof of achieving great achievements! Challenge Medals

- For hunters who achieve extremely high-difficulty accomplishments, a space to showcase their achievements, called "Challenge Medals," will be added. Upon achieving these achievements, you will earn emblems, and by selecting and displaying up to three emblems in the showcase, you can show them off to others. The Challenge Medals will be updated in mid-December.

 

■ Luxis & Twin Headed Ogre - 2 New Bosses (Encore Missions, Instance Dungeon)

- Two new bosses will be added. As with the existing bosses, the Proof of the Strong challenge will also be prepared, allowing players to enjoy the thrill.

 

■ Power of Destruction Weekly Content Renewal

- The long-awaited update to make Power of Destruction a weekly content is being implemented this time. Since Power of Destruction has provided substantial rewards, the rewards will be adjusted accordingly to ensure hunters do not lose out even with the shift from daily to weekly content.

 

■ 15 times to 10 times! Clearing Gates Adjustment

- The daily Gate play limit will be reduced from 15 to 10, with increased rewards. Naturally, the mission requirements for Gate plays will also be adjusted. Additionally, the difficulty of S-rank Gates, which many hunters found challenging, will be eased.

 

■ Now actively usable? Sung Jinwoo QTE Usability Renewal

- The usability of Sung Jinwoo’s QTE skill will be renewed. In particular, for the core QTE skill Shadow Step, players previously needed specific techniques to force its use during situations like Break or Power of Destruction. To address this inconvenience, the activation conditions will be made easier. It can now be triggered through actions such as breaking an enemy, summoning Shadows, or specific battle patterns like clashing with Baran. There’s no longer a need to wait to use Shadow Step right before a groggy state.

 

The usability of Death and Collapse will also be improved. Previously, bosses could not be affected by status effects like Knock Down or Airborne, making it impossible to use QTE skills. Now, even if the actual status effect does not occur, QTE skills can be used upon hitting an enemy with a skill that carries such effects.

 

Additionally, new runes will be added for Death and Collapse, which were previously underutilized due to their weaker performance. These runes will offer various effects such as Freeze, Break, and damage amplification, expanding combat variations using QTEs. This change will significantly enhance the value of skills that can activate Death or Collapse.

 

■ 5 Reward Items Upon Clearing Story Content! Growth Difficulty Improvement

- With the introduction of various new systems, the growth difficulty will also be further improved. Story chapter clear rewards will increase from the current 2 items to 5, and this adjustment will be retroactively applied to hunters who have already cleared chapters.

 

New rewards will be added to the Battle Mission stages. Depending on the number of Trophies collected in Normal, Hard, and Reverse Modes, various rewards will be provided. Alongside general items like Shadow-related rewards, Essence Stones, and Draw Tickets, hunters will also have the chance to obtain Legendary Runes as Reverse Battle Mission rewards. This update will offer more opportunities to acquire runes, including those for newly added QTE skills.

 

Additionally, with the significant reduction in story difficulty in this update, hunters can enjoy a smoother progression and claim all the clear rewards along the way.

 

■ Finally Arrived! New Hunter Thomas Andre

- The powerful National-Level Hunter, Thomas Andre, finally makes his debut! Thomas is designed to unleash explosive damage, seamlessly switching between his transformed and human forms when using his ultimate ability. During this process, skill cooldowns are reset, allowing for continuous bursts of power. Additionally, his abilities reflect those from the original work, including a unique barrier, enabling him to excel in modes like Power of Destruction or Guild Boss battles with even greater performance."

 

■ Deals Powerful Damage Through Charging! New Sung Jinwoo Weapon “Demonic Club”

- A new weapon, the Demonic Club, is being added! With sleek and swift combat motions, it delivers a satisfying impact. The Demonic Club will be available starting 12/5 (Thu).

 

■ Revive Ruined Artifacts! Enhancement Reset Event

- An enhancement reset event is being held, allowing you to reset already enhanced artifacts while keeping the types of options, and then attempt the enhancement process again. If the base options were good but additional stats were concentrated on unwanted attributes during the enhancement process, this event will give you the opportunity to reset and retry enhancing the artifact.

 

■ Did you think it was over? More Legendary Rune and SSR Sung Jinwoo Weapon! - Winter Event

- Additional rewards will be offered through the Winter Events. Starting from 11/28 (Thu), events such as the check-in event and dice event will provide SSR Sung Jinwoo Weapon Chest and Heroic Blessing Stone. From 12/5 (Thu), the Winter Treasure Hunt event will begin, where you can obtain Legendary Rune.

 

This is part of a policy to ease the game's difficulty and enhance the enjoyment of clearing various content, so there’s no need to worry about the release of higher-tier items.

 

 

Thank you.

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you!

Please see below for more details about the update.
