* Click on each item to navigate to the corresponding content.

 

 

📢 11/28 (Thu) Update Details

 

 

📌 New Reverse Story Chapter & Story Content Improvement

 

▶ New Reverse Story Chapter

- The Hidden Chapter 3/4, added through the 10/31 (Thu) update, will be added to the Reverse Mode.

* You can enjoy Solo Leveling:ARISE original story in the Hidden Chapter.

* Clear achievement rewards and battle mission achievement rewards exist for each chapter.

However, only achievement rewards are provided for chapters that only consist of “Story.”

 

▶ Story Hard/Reverse Difficulty Adjustment

- The difficulty of certain stages in Story Hard/Reverse modes will decrease.

Please see the [11/28 (Thu) In-Game Balance Adjustment Notice] notice for more details.

 

▶ Certain Story Mission Achievement Condition Adjustment

- In the Story content, the Battle Mission conditions for certain stages, such as "equip certain Hunters, equip certain Shadows, or defeat the boss with a specific attribute hunter," will be adjusted.

 

▶ Story Chapter Clear Reward Adjustment (All Difficulties)

- The number of Custom Draw Tickets provided after clearing each Chapter will increase from 2 to 5.

* The Battle Mission all clear rewards will remain as 2 Custom Draw Tickets, same as before.

* For Hunters who have cleared chapters and obtained rewards before the above improvements are applied, the additional quantity of Custom Draw Tickets will be sent to your mailbox after the maintenance.

 

▶ Addition of Battle Mission Achievement Reward

- A feature will be added that allows you to receive additional rewards based on the cumulative completion count of Battle Missions for each difficulty level in Story Mode: Normal, Hard, and Reverse.

- Battle Mission achievement rewards can be checked and claimed from the Chapter selection screen for each difficulty in the Story menu.

 

📌 New Content - Simulation Gate (Beta Season)

- This is a roguelike content where you select your own path and effectively utilize various environments and buffs that appear in each stage to clear them.

* Simulation Gate will unlock after clearing Story Normal Chapter 20.

 

▶ How to Enter

- You can enter the content by tapping “Simulation Gate” on the Lobby screen or quick menu.

- You can enter the Simulation Gate by spending an entry code, and 2 entry codes recharge weekly.

* If you do not have an entry code, you can access the test mode. However, in test mode, only a small number of Memory Chips will be rewarded, with no additional rewards provided.

- You can choose a difficulty level of up to 15 stages to challenge, and the higher the stage, the greater the rewards upon clearing.

* When attempting the Simulation Gate for the first time, you can select a difficulty level of up to stage 5.

* When challenging a stage, you can skip lower stages and attempt a higher difficulty level directly.

If you skip lower stages and clear a higher stage, all challenges from the skipped lower stages will be considered completed.

 

▶ Algorithm of the Week & Effect Amplification

- In the Simulation Gate, special rules set as the "Algorithm of the Week" are applied each season, enhancing the monsters within the Gate.

- In Effect Amplification, amplification effects are activated to strengthen hunters progressing through the Simulation Gate.

A certain amount of memory chips is required to activate each amplification effect, and the previous amplification effect must be activated in order to unlock the next stage’s amplification effect.

* Please note that the activated amplification effect cannot be reset.

 

▶ Simulation Gate Process

- The Simulation Gate progresses through a series of stages, consisting of a total of 11 stages.

* It is only available in Hunter Mode, excluding Sung Jinwoo, and the powers of Shadows and Remnant Power cannot be used.

- Depending on your progress, the types of the next stages will be divided, and you can choose the area to proceed with.

Each area consists of Normal Battle, Enhanced Battle, Episodes, System Maintenance, and Special Battle, with the following characteristics.

Category

Description

Normal Battle

- This area is the same as the typical Gate structure, where you engage in battle with monsters that appear within a time limit.

- In stages where you engage in battle, you can choose "Memory Code" as a reward, which grants buffs to the hunter upon defeating enemies.

- Memory Codes provide powerful effects based on specific attributes or conditions. By strategically selecting them according to your team composition, you can clear stages more easily.

Enhanced Battle

- Similar to Normal Battle, you engage in battles with monsters, but in this area, enhanced monsters or boss monsters will appear.

Special Battle

- This area involves simulated battles using the data of a specified hunter, and it appears at fixed stages (Stage 4, Stage 8, Stage 11).

* The corresponding stage is a “Time Attack” mode, and the time flows even when pausing the game. Please refer to the above details when playing the content. [Added 12/9 (Wed) 06:17 (UTC+0)]

Episode

- This area features various events or mini games without battle, where you can receive rewards or penalties.

System Maintenance

- Similar to Episodes, this area has no battle. It is a zone where you can use the Simulation Coins earned from previous stages to perform maintenance and prepare for the next challenges.

- In the management section, you can acquire data fragments with buff effects or enhance the blessing effects of Memory Codes.

- In Data Recovery, you can resurrect hunters who were killed during the progression of previous stages.

- In Data Formation, you can change the hunters or shadows you have organized upon entry.

Please note that hunters who have died during the stage progression cannot be changed unless they are resurrected.

- Upon clearing each stage, you will receive Simulation Coins and Entity's Treasure Chest rewards. Additionally, objects that restore the hunter's hp and mana may appear.

 

▶ Simulation Gate Completion & Reward

- Once all stages are completed, the simulation will be finished, and rewards will be given along with a calculation screen.

The rewards include Enchantment materials or Dimensional Recording Devices used in the Simulation Shop. Additionally, the amount of acquired Memory Chips used for Effect Amplification, increases based on the difficulty level of the Simulation completion.

- In test mode, where entry codes are not used, no rewards are given except for a small amount of Memory Chips.

- If your organized team is wiped out or if you wish to abandon the Simulation midway, you can exit and settle the Simulation by pressing the end simulation button on the simulation map screen.

* If you exit without progressing the Simulation, you will not receive any rewards, but the used entry code will be returned to you.

 

▶ Simulation Mission

- The Simulation Gate offers separate weekly missions. By completing the given missions, you can earn points and receive rewards based on the mission points.

 

▶ Simulation Record

- In the Simulation Records section, you can check the details of the Episodes, Collections, and Memory Codes obtained during the Simulation.

* The Simulation Gate is currently in its beta season, and records will be accessible starting from the regular season.

📌 Common Notes for All Packages

- All of the packages and content can be sold again in the future.

- The sales period may be subject to change in certain circumstances and we will notify you of the changes through a notice.

- The packages can be purchased for a limited time during the sales period.

- The purchasing methods differ based on the type of package. Please check the details in the game.

- Available purchases for the packages with [Monthly purchase limit] will be reset every first day of the month at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- Available purchases for the packages with [Weekly purchase limit] will be reset every Monday at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- Available purchases for the packages with [Daily purchase limit] will be reset every day at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- For pass-type packages, Pass EXP, and mission completion information will be applied differently based on each package.

- The unclaimed pass tier achievement rewards will be sent to your mailbox at the end of the pass period.

 

 

📌 Other Improvements

- The initial unlock condition for Workshop of Brilliant Light content will change to “Clear Story Normal Chapter 18 [To the Demons' Castle Again].”

* Hunters who have already unlocked the Workshop of Brilliant Light can access the content without any additional conditions.

- Decreased the entry level limit for certain stages in the Story Normal Chapter 18.

- Added “Crafting” item in the Solidified Stone II / III items’ source.

- The “Shard of Baran” item will be adjusted to no longer be purchasable.

- The stages where Checkmate Kysa and Fores appear as bosses will have the description "Immune to Shield Removal Effects" added.

- Adjusted certain Battle Missions in the Battlefield of Trials Hunter Mode Floor 53. (Clear within 60 seconds → Clear within 90 seconds)

- A recommended formation button will be added for certain stages, allowing hunters to set up recommended hunters based on usage rates for each content before entering.

- A “Battle Options” feature will be added to the stage result screen.

Settings below are available in the Battle Options.

1. In content where Multiplay is available, you can adjust the Multiplay when proceeding to the next stage or retrying from the stage result screen.

2. On the stage result screen, you can choose whether to start from the team formation screen when proceeding to the next stage or retrying.

- In the PC version client, when the game is inactive due to another window being open, gamepad controls and vibrations will no longer apply.

- A Remnant Power Skill auto use setting will be added to the [Options] → [Controls].

- Hunters will be able to view point bonuses and other details in the Secret Library tab even without completing all Hunter Archive missions.

* Secret Library stages will remain accessible only after completing all Hunter Archive missions, as before.

- An icon will be added on the Draw screen, allowing hunters to move directly to the Hunter Archive of the rate up draw hunter.

- On the Custom Draw and Weapon Custom Draw screen, the Rate Up List will now display whether the featured hunters or weapons are owned, not owned, or advanced.

- The Challenges mission clear conditions below will be improved.

Acquire Core with certain rank → Acquire Core with certain rank or higher

Acquire/equip Gem with certain rank → Acquire/equip Gem with certain rank or higher

- Starter /Intermediate / Advanced Hunter Pass reset period will be adjusted to align with other content reset periods (00:00 (UTC+0)).

- The priority of certain skills for Iron Shadow will be adjusted.

- Changed Isla Wright’s recommended stat type (Damage reduction → Damage increase)

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the issue where the set Remnant Power is not being prevented on the Hunter Archive team formation screen.

- Fixed the issue where the recently acquired Blessing Stone seems to be used as material when continuously attempting Fusion after acquiring a new Blessing Stone in Fusion.

- Fixed the issue where the Proof of the Strong is applied differently in the Encore Missions in certain circumstances.

- Fixed the issue where, when using Sung Jinwoo weapon “Spooky Pumpkin,” the advancement tier 5 effer (activate Core Attack) is not activated normally while using [Peek-a-boom] skill with another weapon equipped.

- Fixed the issue where, when using Rune Skills that activates certain QTE skills, the activated QTE skills can be used continuously.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

2,812

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Faction of the Shield team.

 

First, we would like to sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused to all hunters due to the recent issue.

 

We will provide an explanation regarding the occurrence related to the Faction of the Shield.

 

The Faction of the Shield, the abnormal gameplay detection system of Solo Leveling: ARISE, detects unauthorized gameplay in real-time using various methods and is undergoing continuous refinement and enhancement.

 

In the case of hunters detected in Guild content, this issue occurred as the Faction of the Shield is being further developed. During this process, discrepancies arose between the system’s predictions, based on learned records of guild bosses with complex attack patterns, and the actual measured results.

 

The score for hunters who have experienced the issue has currently been restored.
If there are additional inquiries regarding the issue, please contact our customer support. 

 

We deeply apologize once again to all hunters who experienced inconvenience due to this issue. Moving forward, we will continue to improve Faction of the Shield to ensure such problems do not reoccur in the future.

 

We remain committed to providing a fair and enjoyable gaming environment for everyone.

 

Thank you.

📌 Common Notes for All Packages

- All of the packages and content can be sold again in the future.

- The sales period may be subject to change in certain circumstances and we will notify you of the changes through a notice.

- The packages can be purchased for a limited time during the sales period.

- The purchasing methods differ based on the type of package. Please check the details in the game.

- Available purchases for the packages with [Monthly purchase limit] will be reset every first day of the month at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- Available purchases for the packages with [Weekly purchase limit] will be reset every Monday at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- Available purchases for the packages with [Daily purchase limit] will be reset every day at 00:00 (UTC+0).

- For pass-type packages, Pass EXP, and mission completion information will be applied differently based on each package.

- The unclaimed pass tier achievement rewards will be sent to your mailbox at the end of the pass period.

 

 

📌 Other Improvements

- New title screen and App icon.

- New event themes will be applied to the Hunters Association lobby and Guild lobby.

- When proceeding with the update, an update summary pop-up will be displayed at the first log in.

- A "Combat Guide" feature will be added, providing tips on how to utilize each Hunter and recommended development methods.

You can access it by clicking the icon at the top right of the skill tab on the hunter management screen.

- In the Battlefield of Time, monster patterns will be adjusted to make them approach hunters more frequently.

- Workshop of Brilliant Light - In the "Demons' Castle Entrance" stage of the Demons' Castle Lower Floors, a guidance message will be added when the Cerberus uses certain patterns.

- Workshop of Brilliant Light - In the "Demons' Castle Spire" stage of the Demons' Castle Upper Floors, the introduction cutscene for "Baran, the Monarch of White Flames" will be improved to allow skipping.

- The timing of the tutorial sequence for the Simulation Gate will be adjusted to trigger upon the hunter's first entry into the content.

- A craft all feature will be added, allowing hunters to immediately craft missing materials directly from the screen when upgrading Skills, Hunters, Shadows, or enhancing the Armory.

* A popup will only appear if there are materials available for crafting and it will not appear if the required materials are insufficient.

- Improved the [Augment] effect's description of Sung Jinwoo Skill Rune “Surprise Attack” (QTE Skill Collapse exclusive Skill Rune).

The [Break] state removes this effect.

Increases attack 10/15/20%

Duration: 20 second(s)

- Improvements will be made so that when a QTE skill is active, other QTE skills that are on cooldown and meet activation conditions will not be displayed.

- The skill animation speed and enemy targeting performance of Sung Jinwoo's weapon, “Divine Quarterstaff,” will be improved.

- If some of Sung Jinwoo's weapons have [Airborne] or [Knockdown] effects on normal attacks, the skill description in the weapon section will be improved to display these effects.

- On the weapon management screen, Sung Jinwoo weapon type will be displayed (Sword / Daggers / Polearm / Scythe / Firearm / Bow / Catalyst).

- The icon image for in-game event items will be changed, and it will be added to the top menu in the lobby.

- The entry level restrictions for certain stages in Story Hard difficulty will be adjusted to match the monster levels.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the issue where [Code] could be refreshed when force closing Simulation Gate stage 1.

- Fixed the issue where a team with Shadows included is displayed when changing party in the Simulation Gate entry formation screen.

- Fixed the issue where Shadows are summoned when clearing the first stage after entering the Simulation Gate.

- Fixed the missing cooldown description in the Simulation Gate Code effect Overclock - [Reset].

* The corresponding detail has been excluded from the update. We apologize for the confusion. [Revised 12/19 (Thu) 05:08 (UTC+0)]

- Fixed the display of damage values for certain Code effects related to additional attacks in the Simulation Gate. [Added 12/19 (Thu) 05:08 (UTC+0)]

- Fixed the issue where an error occurs and crashes when using the Code refresh feature while playing Simulation Gate Episode area.

- Fixed the issue where the displayed actual time and recorded time are shown different in Battlefield of Time and Battlefield of Time Challenge,

- Fixed the inaccurate targeting of SSR Divine Quarterstaff advancement tier 3 effect, “when hit during charging.”

- Fixed the issue where additional monsters appear after the clearing animation, if you clear stages in certain cases in Story Hidden Chapter 4 certain stages.

- Fixed the issue where Sung Jinwoo’s Skill Rune “Surge” (QTE Skill Collapse exclusive Skill Rune) was activated at a location where it cannot hit enemies.

- Fixed the issue where, during the animation of Sung Jinwoo's Skill Rune "Thunderstorm" (QTE skill for Collapse), his gaze would intermittently look in awkward directions.

- Fixed the issue where the "Activate" button was displayed in the benefits list when selecting the Activity Funds pop-up in the Hunters Association lobby, while the Monthly Bundles Daily Growth Support was already activated.

- Fixed the issue where Sung Jinwoo’s buff effects are removed when canceling  “Divine Quarterstaff” charging weapon skill by dashing.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

📢 12/18 (Wed) Developer Livestream Video Summary

* Please note that the content below is excerpted and translated from the inven article "Jeju Island Raid & 2025 Roadmap and Abundant Rewards! - Solo Leveling Developer Livestream" that summarized the 12/18 (Wed) Developer Liverstream.

[View Original Text]

 

👉 [12/18 (Wed) Developer Livestream Video]

* To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

Code

Reward

Advanced Mana Crystal x150

EVERYDAYSLV

WELCOME2025

Black Friday Lucky Box x5

 

 

📌 Q&A

 

Q. New/Returning hunters seem to be having a hard time catching up.

- During the November update period, many hunters returned to or newly discovered Solo Leveling:Arise. Moving forward, we aim to make the game more accessible for newcomers. In line with this goal, we plan to introduce special missions for new hunters.

Through these special missions, new hunters will be able to obtain SSR Cha Hae-In and her exclusive weapon simply by playing the game. Additionally, through supporting draws, hunters who complete 20 draws will be able to select and guarantee one SSR Hunter of their choice. Of course, existing hunters will also have the opportunity to participate once.

 

Q. When will Sung Jinwoo’s Ultimate Skill with short casting time be released?

- We will reveal it through a video with tomorrow’s update.

 

Q. It is positive that the game is becoming easier but wish there was content for high-level hunters.

- Until now, updates have primarily focused on new and returning hunters. Of course, we greatly value our dedicated high-level hunters who continue to support the game. As revealed in the update roadmap, we are also preparing exciting content specifically for our advanced hunters to enjoy

 

Q. The Artifact Modification Event was so inconvenient.

- It is true that there were inconveniences, such as having to repeatedly equip and unequip items and needing to complete enhancement up to +20 before resetting. We are fully aware that these aspects caused discomfort in the hunters' experience. We will address the identified issues and make improvements to ensure a smoother experience in the next event.

 

Q.  Wish we could fuse unused Tier 5 Gems.

- It seems that discussions about Tier 5 Gems are starting to surface. However, apart from the high-level hunters, the supply rate of Tier 5 Gems is still insufficient. While it’s not an urgent issue, we do agree on the need for improvement. We’ll make sure to share our direction on this matter in the next livestream.

 

Q. It would like to see Cooperation Content & Guild Competition added to the game.

- 2024 has been a year focused on enhancing the fun of single-player experiences. For 2025, we believe it’s time to introduce collaborative content. However, this won’t be implemented immediately; instead, we are gathering ideas from various angles and developing prototypes. Please refer to the roadmap for more detailed information.

 

Q. It has become too much of a burden to play mini games for Guild Coins.

- We will discuss adjustments to mini game balance and the resource requirements for Guild Buffs to make essential purchases more accessible. Regarding Guild Coins, there have been ongoing discussions, as they were designed with relatively high investment costs to encourage participation in cooperative content. However, given the significant feedback, we will consider making changes.

 

Q. Why isn’t Goto Ryuji added through the December Update?

- We conducted a survey among users to determine the most desired hunter, and Thomas Andre received the highest preference. As a result, he was prioritized for release, which delayed Goto Ryuji's turn. After Thomas Andre's release, he has firmly established himself as an essential character. Considering the character's high importance, we are also exploring the possibility of extending his rate up period to support new and returning hunters.

 

📌 Real-Time Q&A

 

Q. Adjustments for Tier 5 Gem’s random option values are necessary.

- There has been some discussion about the stats of Tier 5 Gems being too close to those of Tier 4 Gems when the minimum values are assigned. We understand the concern that the minimum values are too low. While it’s difficult to promise an immediate update, we will review the possibility of making adjustments.

 

Q. Please apply multiplay to Workshop of Brilliant Light and Simulation Gate content.

- The multiplay will be applied to the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

 

Q. We wish there were more sources to claim Simulation Gate Entry Codes.

- As this is new content, many hunters feel the opportunities to play are too limited. Given the nature of the Simulation Gate, where the gameplay experience can vary significantly depending on the Code, we've received numerous requests for more chances to play. We will discuss the possibility of increasing the number of attempts.

 

Q. Guild Boss and Power of Destruction rankings for team fight setups have not been widely shared yet.

- We don’t consider this to be too difficult. We will discuss whether this can be implemented as a feature by reviewing the most used deck list or recommended list.

 

Q. Can’t wait to see Beru’s appearance and performance.

- Please check the update for today.

 

Q. There is a higher tier of Shadows in the manhwa. Will this be implemented to the game?

- In the manhwa, Beru appears as “General” tier and this will be applied to the game through this update.

 

Q. Hunter Upgrade materials are too hard to get such as Advanced Mana Crystal.

- Additionally, there have been many discussions about Gold acquisition. We are aware of the shortage of resources and plan to continue expanding ways to obtain them through events and login rewards. Due to the impact of the Artifact Modification Event, Advanced Mana Crystals, which previously showed surplus in our data, have now become significantly scarce. To address this, we will ensure that Advanced Mana Crystals are also distributed through upcoming events.

 

Q. The Battlefield of Time seems to lack distinctiveness.

- Battles ending in just 10 seconds after starting indicate that the element of luck has become overly influential. As hunters have grown stronger, we will review whether adjustments to the content's balance are necessary to provide a more consistent and satisfying experience.

 

Q. Are there any plans for a Costume discount event?

- As mentioned in the previous livestream, some costumes will now be available at a lower price and purchasable with diamonds. Please check the detailed list after tomorrow's update. Diamond discount coupons can also be applied to these purchases.

 

Q. Could you please clarify the reason for the ongoing bans?

- It would be best to explain the situation clearly. The Faction of the Shield program has been detecting unusual gameplay, and in the past, there were numerous instances of abnormal play, such as client manipulation or unauthorized programs leading to excessively high records. When the service was first launched, issues related to cheating were significant, but these have decreased as the Faction of the Shield has been continuously updated.

 

However, it's clear that strengthening such defense systems can result in unfair bans for some, while weakening them can lead to inadequate responses to cheating or abuse. In fact, during the recent attempt to increase precision by checking certain areas, a large number of bans occurred over a four-hour period. A notice was immediately issued, and recovery was carried out.

 

We understand this may be inconvenient, but we ask for your understanding, as programs like the Faction of the Shield need continuous updates and improvements in order to provide a cleaner environment for others. Once again, we sincerely apologize to those who were affected unjustly.

 

Q. Share with us some information on the Guild contribution abusing issue.

- It has been identified that hunters could increase their contribution points by rejoining a Guild, and a patch has been implemented to address this issue. Now, hunters must wait a certain amount of time after joining a Guild before they can accumulate contribution points.

 

Q. Make subscriptions purchasable also on the PC.

- The subscription service with regular payments has a slightly different system, so it is taking some time, but it is currently being prepared. We definitely want to provide it to you, so we would appreciate it if you could wait a little longer.

 

Q. Regarding the lags and optimization for mobile devices.

- 매As I have mentioned, optimization updates will be carried out in both this update and the one in January. Since a dedicated TF team is already in operation, we will ensure that we can show you improvements.

 

Q. The number of shadows has increased, but is there any plan to provide additional features for arranging them?

- In the case of shadows, there are relatively no issues on PC, but there are optimization-related concerns in mobile environments. Once optimization progresses further, the feature to expand Shadow arrangement may also be considered.

 

Q. When a new Story is added, shouldn't the Challenges also increase?

- We will make sure to add them in line with the timing. Since Challenges serve as a driving force for enjoying the game by fulfilling a kind of desire, We will continue to update them regularly.

 

📌 Upcoming Updates

 

■ Ant King is Coming! Jeju Island Story Update
The moment has finally come to introduce the Jeju Island update. While we've already shown some great aspects before, this time we've poured all our resources into delivering the best possible direction. You'll experience a level of quality so overwhelming it could be considered a highlight. The difficulty of the Normal mode has been significantly eased through revisions, so I hope you'll play it and experience it firsthand.

In the final battle against the Ant King in the Jeju Island raid, you'll find the action to be bold and frenzied, perfectly capturing the feeling of "this is exactly how the battle with the Ant King should be" from the original webtoon.

 

▲ Jeju Island Raid Story Update has finally arrived!

■ Defeat the Ant King and Reach Sung Jinwoo Lv. 100! Unlock New Job Change “Master of the Abyss”

Sung Jinwoo's maximum level has been expanded from 95 to 100. In the original manhwa, Sung Jinwoo reaches level 100 after defeating the Ant King, and we've timed this update as a tribute to that moment. Achieving level 100 will unlock expanded activity support rewards, new Gate difficulty levels, and expanded Bond rewards.

 

By clearing the Story, Hunters can unlock the new Job Change "Master of the Abyss." The requirements for this Job Change are relatively easy to achieve, with a combat power of 150,000, clearing the Jeju Island story, and passing the Battlefield of Trials Floor 40. The Job Change dungeon is designed to be fun, with a battle between the Army of Shadows and its own kind. Hunters will also receive the costume worn during the battle with the Ant King, a new Ultimate Skill, and an expanded Blessing Stone slot as part of the reward.

 

The new Ultimate Skill is named "King's Domain." We’ve designed its animation to be both concise and powerful, resolving the issue of the previous ultimate skill "Truth: Mutilate" being too long to use in time attack, making it visually stunning and strong.

 

 ▲ Maximum Sung Jinwoo level expanded to 100 along with additional benefits

 

▲ A new Ultimate Skill “King’s Domain” with short casting time is added.

 

■ Offers Increase in Attack and Critical Damage effect, New Shadow “Beru”

The long-awaited new Shadow, "Beru," finally makes its debut. Just like in the original work, it is expected to become one of the most beloved Shadows by the hunters.

 

Beru provides a team attack power and critical damage boost when placed in the leader slot. In alignment with the storyline where the Ant King absorbs Min Byung-gu's power, Beru's summoning will trigger abilities related to healing. Since no other Shadow has healing-related skills, it will carve out a unique position for itself.

 

At the same time, the Shadow promotion system has been expanded to include the "General" rank. With the introduction of Beru, the first General rank Shadow from the original work, existing Shadows can now be promoted to enhance their powers and acquire new skills. To make it easier to grow your Shadows, we will also be offering rewards through events.

 

 ▲ Beru is expected to be preferred by numerous hunters due to its increase in Attack and Critical Damage effect.

 

▲ New “General” rank will be added to all the existing Shadows along with Beru.

 

■ Satisfy your competitive spirit and desire for honor! Challenge Medals

The Challenge Medals system, which allows you to fill the sense of pride in achieving milestones, will be implemented in this update. You can display and show off your trophies and seals.

 

▲ Boost your achievements through the Challenges Medal content.

 

■ Five new Blessing Stones have been added! Will they become the new meta for setups?

Five new Blessing Stones have been added: Intuit, Desire, Mana Powered Shield, Solidify, and Aggressive Defense.

 

Intuit increases attack power based on intelligence, while Desire boosts attack power when mana is below 60%. In the past, an "All Intelligence" build was popular for cooldown reduction, but due to the significant damage reduction, it became obsolete, and the "All Strength" build has since remained dominant. To add more variety to setups, these new Blessing Stones have been introduced. While they offer new options, it’s important to note that "All Intelligence" is not necessarily the best choice, and there will be an optimal balance point, adding a layer of strategy and experimentation.

 

Mana Powered Shield absorbs damage by consuming mana, Solidify reduces damage taken by 1% every 6 seconds, and Aggressive Defense generates a shield on landing a normal attack. Mana Powered Shield not only enhances survivability but also increases mana consumption, synergizing with the new Blessing Stone "Desire." Aggressive Defense, with its continuous shield generation, can also complement other items that rely on shield mechanics, providing potential synergies with increased firepower. These additions are expected to attract significant attention and become impactful in different builds.

 

▲ New Blessing Stones with a variety of effects have been added, allowing for the consideration of different stat setups.

 

■ New Hunter Shimizu Akari Released! Thomas Andre Specialized Light Attribute Support

In this update, the new hunter Shimizu Akari, a powerful supporter who wields a large axe and was originally part of the Japanese team in the original work will join. Shimizu Akari continues to strengthen the light attribute, providing a damage increase effect to light attribute hunters, boosting firepower with tailored debuffs for enemies, and offering shields to synergize with Thomas Andre.

While Min Byung-Gu, as a light attribute, holds a strong position as an all-around supporter usable in any deck, Shimizu Akari is specifically designed as light attribute supporter, particularly enhancing the performance of Thomas Andre.

 

▲ Light attribute new hunter Shimizu Akari is specialized in supporting Thomas Andre.

 

■ Clear Workshop of Brilliant Light at once? Provides Rate Up Draw Ticket through Hunter Preview and other content added

Improvements to existing content are also being made. In the Hunter Preview, rewards have been upgraded, and the currency rewards previously given have been increased. Additionally, Rate Up Draw Tickets will be provided to make it easier to draw hunters.

In repetitive content such as Encore Missions, Instance Dungeons, and the Battlefield of Chaos, the formation used to clear the stage will now be automatically saved. This addresses the inconvenience of having a different formation load each time, which we have been aware of for some time. The scale of the fix was larger than expected, but it has finally been completed in this update.

For the Workshop of Brilliant Light, which has been a high-difficulty weekly content with considerable fatigue, a multiplay system has been applied. Going forward, hunters can use up to 3 tickets at once to play. Additionally, a new "Proof of the Strong" system has been added to the Workshop of Brilliant Light, offering honor rewards such as titles and frames.

 

 ▲ In the Hunter Preview, rewards and convenience have been enhanced, including the addition of tickets.

 

▲ In the Workshop of Brilliant Light, the new multiplier system allows players to set up to 3 times, reducing the stress of repetitive tasks.

 

■ SSR Hunter+Weapon & Costume, and a powerful event weapon! Holiday Party Event

The Holiday Party event will be held with a Holiday theme. In the event dungeon, the Gift Bomb Hobgoblin will appear, spreading presents and offering Essence Stones and Boss Challenge Keys.

 

Additionally, this event will feature the new SSR weapon for Sung Jinwoo, "Gold-tailed Fox." Unlike previous SSR event weapons, the Gold-tailed Fox is focused on performance, making it a viable primary weapon. Since it can be obtained through the event, it is highly recommended to collect it. The weapon has a Light attribute and can be combined with various other weapons, including the Guild Weapon "Truth: Demon Knight's Spear" and the recently released Divine Quarterstaff.

The Holiday Party event will be held with a Holiday theme. In the event dungeon, the Gift Bomb Hobgoblin will appear, spreading presents and offering Essence Stones and Boss Challenge Keys.

 

Additionally, this event will feature the new SSR weapon for Sung Jinwoo, "Gold-tailed Fox." Unlike previous event SSR weapons, the Gold-tailed Fox is focused on performance, making it a viable primary weapon. Since it can be obtained through the event, it is highly recommended to collect it. The weapon has a Light attribute and can be combined with various other weapons, including the Guild Weapon "Truth: Demon Knight's Spear" and the recently released Divine Quarterstaff.

 

Other mini-games, such as card matching, will also be available, offering rewards like Alicia Blanche's chroma costume, SSR Hunter and Hunter weapon selection options, and more. During the event period, Mirei and Shimizu Akari's Holiday costumes will also be on sale.

 

 ▲ A Holiday Party Event is scheduled to prepare for the year-end season.

 

 ▲ The Light attribute weapon "Gold-tailed Fox" is an event weapon, but it has been uniquely designed to hold value as a primary weapon.

 

▲ Obtain Essence Stones and growth materials through various mini games!

 

▲ New Alicia Costume and SSR Hunter and Weapon selection tickets will be obtainable.

 

▲ Mirei and Akari’s special costume will be purchasable.

 

■ Endless Abundant Update! 2025 First Half Roadmap
In January, Deimos will be released in the Workshop of Brilliant Light. Additionally, Esil Radiru, a Demon character who is not a Hunter in the original work, will be introduced as a Hunter. This character is imagined as part of an "if" story, exploring what it would be like if Esil Radiru were a Hunter. With the original author's approval, this character is highly anticipated, and we plan to explore more "if" storylines in the future.

From January to March, content related to the Jeju Island Raid will be featured. We are preparing cooperative content where hunters can reenact the battle with the Ant King, offering the fun of collaborating in raids. In February, a new Guild Boss, Queen Ant, will be released, marking the start of the regular season for the Simulation Gate. In March, the hidden story "Monarch of Transfiguration Yogumunt" will be introduced, alongside the highly anticipated new Hunter, Goto Ryuji.

Starting in April, new story content will be available, including the Busan Knight Raid and School Raid content(working title). In June, a storyline related to the system's designer will unfold, filled with impactful scenes that will rival those of the Jeju Island Raid.

As for the Championship, we are discussing ways to allow mobile players to participate as well. The goal is to move away from offline qualifiers, such as visiting PC cafes, and enable players to participate on their own devices, allowing them to compete in the environment where they normally play the game.

Additionally, we will be offering the 2024 Korea Game Awards reward costume, featuring a glamorous gold trim design, which can be obtained in tomorrow's update.

 

▲ The year 2025 will also be filled with new enemies and various content.

 

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Note: Train to Become a Formidable Combatant

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Train to Become a Formidable Combatant

Hunters Association
|
Jan 10, 2025, 05:00
|
22,023

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

It’s been a while since we've reached out through a Developer’s Note.

 

As the New Year begins, we wish all our hunters happiness and good health.

 

We, the Solo Leveling:ARISE team will do our best to provide a wide variety of exciting experiences this year as well.

 

Through this Developer Note, we will address some of the preparing features before the livestream scheduled for 1/14 (Tue).

 

 

[Train to Become a Formidable Combatant]

 

Has anyone noticed the newly located Sung Jinwoo icon at the left of the lobby screen after the last update?

 

As mentioned in the December livestream, “Train to Become a Formidable Combatant” is a new hunter mission where hunters can clear various missions and claim rewards sequentially, tier after tier.

 

You will be able to claim an Artifact Set or Fixed Support Draw Ticket, and even Sung Jinwoo’s SSR weapon based on your progression.

 

Not only these but also “Battlefield Dancer Cha Hae-In,” “Aquamarine Ripples Meilin,” and 50 Custom Draw Tickets will be provided for hunters who have cleared the final tier, so please look forward to it.

 

(Rest assured since hunters currently enjoying the game will also be able to claim them!)

 

[Growing Hunters]

 

Firstly, we express our gratitude to hunters who are reporting in-game errors and required improvements.

The team is dedicated to fixing issues and to continuously improve.

 

Here are the scheduled fixes and improvements for the January update.

 

- Hunter bulk level up feature will be added.
- The maximum available counts will increase from 10 to 20 per Fusion.
- Kang Taeshik’s Ultimate Skill Cooldown and Attack will be adjusted in the Simulation Gate.
- When the Collapse - Surprise Attack Rune’s “Resonance” effect is activated, other debuffs applied to enemies will not be removed.
- The purchase limit in the exchange shop will reset through the 1/16 (Thu) update.
* For hunters who still have remaining exchange counts, hurry up!
- The issue where the Palace Guard Set 4 Effect (grants buff when applied with Shield) was not triggered in certain cases will be resolved.
- The issue where Thomas Andre’s Ultimate Skill cooldown was not applied normally.
* As for the issue above, we are planning to sustain the current status since resolving it may result in providing a different battle experience. The details and background of the issue will be addressed through the official livestream.

 

Other fixes and improvements will also be implemented so please look forward to it!

 

[Alliance & Yogumunt]

 

Do you remember the cooperation event and new story “Monarch of Transfiguration Yogumunt” mentioned with the roadmap in the previous livestream?

 

Through this update, a cooperation event where hunters have to gather their strength and fight against the Ant King will be revealed.

 

And when the end of the event approaches, the Monarch of Transfiguration Yogumunt will show itself out of the silence.

 

On a late one night,

 

“Why not focus on the hypothesis you’ve been trying to avoid?”

As soon as Alicia finished speaking, Sung Jinwoo woke up from his sleep.

Thinking back to the conversation with Alicia, who for some reason popped out from his dream, he reminded himself of the Deimos Raid.

 

There were more than a few peculiarities.

 

The beast seemed confused by the command to kill mankind as though it was considering itself a human.

The “Enemy in Black Form” that resembled an adult man, and the word “Failure.”

 

At that very moment, Sung Jinwoo sensed the Shadow that he placed on Alicia was under attack and immediately uses the “Shadow Exchange.”

 

 

 

Another story of Sung Jinwoo and Justitia members.

The Ice Witch Alicia seems to be confused with the sudden incident she is facing...

 

[Hidden Story - Excerpt from Yogumunt]

 

While you are starting to enjoy a bit of this story, the SLC(Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship) will be slowly approaching our hunters.

 

[Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship 2025]

 

In November and October 2024, an offline Championship was held in Korea.

 

Various highlight plays were created thanks to the amazing plays of hunters who have participated in the SLC (Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship).

 

In the Solo Leveling:ARISE offline Championship, there is a special [Picks & Bans] rule.

It’s a system where hunters can ban Sung Jinwoo weapons and make it impossible to use for both the hunter and the opponent.

 

The [Picks & Bans] system can be seen in the SLC 2025 teaser video released a few days ago.

In the The Gatekeeper of Hell, Cerberus stage, it was impressive to watch banning the opponent’s most preferred weapon [Vulcan’s Rage] and eventually leading the team to win the match.

 

The preliminary stages of SLC 2025 will be conducted online and the final stages afterwards are scheduled offline. The stage for you to perform amazing and wise plays is prepared and we are waiting for your enthusiastic participation.

 

We will be waiting for the birth of a new National Level hunter.

[Go See Picks & Bans System]

 

[Developer Livestream Pre-Notification]

 

Through this Developer Livestream, various content are in preparation including the aforementioned “Train to Become a Formidable Combatant.”

 

A cooperation event will be revealed for the first time through the livestream so don’t hesitate to watch our broadcast.

We will be looking forward to meeting our hunters in the upcoming Developer Livestream.

 

 

Dear hunter, we are always grateful for your companionship throughout our journey.

We have prepared a small gift so don’t forget to check your mailbox.

 

☞ [Go See Solo Leveling:ARISE Team’s Gift]

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

📢 1/14 (Tue) Developer Livestream Video Summary

* Please note that the content below is excerpted and translated from the inven article "New Workshop of Brilliant Light and the Debut of Esil Radiru as a hunter! SLA Developer Livestream" that summarized the 1/14 (Tue) Developer Liverstream.

[View Original Text]

 

👉 [1/14 (Tue) Developer Livestream Video]

* To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

📌 Q&A

 

Q. When will the Mana Powered Shield be released?

- The release has been slightly delayed due to technical issues. The current bugs have all been fixed. However, the Mana Powered Shield alone is difficult to perform optimally when updated separately, so it will be added alongside the next Blessing Stones update.

 

Q. When will you apply the Bulk/Multiple Level up feature?

- This has been a long-standing question, and I apologize for not addressing it sooner. Although delayed, it is scheduled to be implemented in the January update. You will be able to grow your desired hunters simultaneously. In addition to leveling up all hunters at once, you will, of course, also have the option to select multiple hunters of your choice to grow.

 

Q. Thomas Andre’s Ultimate Skill tends to activate too soon in certain cases.

- It is true that there are cases where the skill is used faster than the cooldown time. This occurs due to an internal bug where the cooldown is not applied on every second ultimate usage. However, fixing this bug would result in a nerf to the character’s stats, and since it aligns well with Thomas Andre's explosive damage-dealing concept, the decision has been made to maintain it as is.

 

Q. When the Palace Guard set shield is activated, the damage increase effect is not being applied.

- We should begin by offering an apology for this as well. There have been many metas revolving around shields, leading to numerous attempts to utilize the Palace Guard set. However, it was discovered that the Palace Guard set effect intermittently or continuously fails to activate properly. This bug is scheduled to be fixed in the January update.

 

Q. It is inconvenient that the maximum Fusion attempts are limited to 10 times.

- We have confirmed the trends and it will increase to a maximum of 20 times in this update.

 

Q. When will the Special Summons hunter list be renewed?

- The Special Summons list expands approximately every three months, and quite some time has passed since the last expansion, leading to some dissatisfaction. With this update, the list will be expanded, allowing you to experience greater benefits than before.

 

Q. The Monthly Bundles become unattractive after the end of discount benefits.

- We completely agree. Missing a payment by a day or two and seeing the price revert to the original can make purchasing hesitant, and this approach seems less than ideal. We aim to discuss lowering the base price of subscription packages to match the discounted price by around February. Additionally, as the subscription packages were created and maintained since their initial launch, their rewards have become somewhat unsatisfactory. We will work on enhancing the rewards alongside the price adjustment.

 

Q. Most of the growth for Artifacts, Runes, and Blessing Stones are complete and it is starting to get boring.

- We have confirmed the trends regarding not having things left to do and we agree with that. In the second half of last year, we focused our update on newbies and returning hunters. Implementing upward growth updates simultaneously has been avoided, as it tends to widen the gap rather than narrowing it.

 

Recent data shows that new and returning players have largely caught up in terms of growth, with essential Runes, Blessing Stones, and Artifact farming progressing steadily. As a result, we believe it is now the right time to introduce ways to further advance growth, and we plan to proceed with a content update to support this.

 

The core of an RPG lies in character growth through farming. However, many hunters have already completed farming endgame items from content like Encore Missions and Instance Dungeon. To address this, we are researching new farming content. Additionally, to support latecomers, we will continue to reduce the gap by easing the difficulty of existing farming elements.

 

📌 Real-Time Q&A

 

Q. The game crashes too often.

- It has been confirmed that crashing issues related to memory still persist on iPhones. While we have addressed frequent loading issues in environments such as the shop in this update, further improvements are necessary. We will continue to work on optimization, and we kindly ask for your patience and understanding as we make these adjustments.

 

Q. The Bonds red dot bug is concerning.

- The Bonds red dot bug has been identified, and we are currently working on a fix. However, it wasn't fully resolved in this update. We will make every effort to resolve it as quickly as possible.

 

Q. Please update the Developer Note more frequently.

- We’ve seen a lot of discussions about this in the community. One notable post mentioned, "Since the update cycle is about a month, it would be nice to share update directions along the way, so we can have some time to build anticipation."

 

Recently, especially with the development of livestreams, we've focused on revealing updates during the streams, which has caused some neglect of the Developer Notes and other forms of communication. Moving forward, we will share information through various methods, such as images and text, to help build anticipation for upcoming updates and livestreams.

 

Q. Are there any plans on updating the Armory?

- We are aware that some players have completed the Armory growth. We will consider the appropriate timing and proceed with an update to expand the slots.

 

Q. Is the feature to manage subscriptions on PC clients currently under development?

- As mentioned in the last livestream, development has already begun, and after the February update, you will be able to manage subscriptions on PC.

 

Q. There are complaints regarding [Tier 5] Gems.

- We are aware that the performance of the [Tier 5] Gems seems somewhat lacking compared to the difficulty of obtaining them. We will discuss potential solutions, such as increasing the Gem specs or expanding the Gem slots. Additionally, we are not currently considering gems beyond tier 5l.

 

Q. I have already reached the maximum Battle Tier. When will this be expanded?

- The maximum tier will be expanded in the January update.

 

Q. Are you planning on bringing back the original Shadow Step in Power of Destruction?

- This aspect tends to vary based on individual hunter preferences. Some hunters prefer the current method, where Shadow Step can be used easily and the challenges are completed with ease, while others long for the old approach, where they can challenge the highest levels through more control and skill.

 

Currently, high-level hunters are able to achieve top rewards even with auto-play, and for the Power of Destruction, we are preparing to develop the next difficulty level. We are considering various directions, such as new difficulty levels, new types, and new bosses, and once the direction is solidified, we will share the details.

 

In a similar context, in the Battlefield of Time, high-ranking hunters are also recording extremely fast clear times. We will discuss updates for this as well.

 

Q. Possessing a maximum of 4,000 Artifacts seems insufficient now.

- There are performance-related issues with the number of Artifacts that can be held, so blindly expanding it is not feasible. We will check the maximum expansion limit and let you know once we have a clearer understanding.

 

Q. Story Hard Mode is too easy to clear.

- While we will keep the normal difficulty relatively easy, we will adjust the difficulty in hard mode to provide a more satisfying challenge for hunters.

 

Q. Will it be available to see the ranking system in Workshop of Brilliant Light or Guild Boss?

- The development is now complete, and we will be able to introduce it soon. Since the update direction has been set to boost challenge-oriented content and new growth and farming elements, we plan to reflect rankings in various high-level contents, such as the Proof of the Strong and other challenging content, to enhance the thrill of competition.

 

Q. The Blessing Stone and Skill Rune rerolls are too expensive.

- For those who have acquired most of the Blessing Stones and Skill Runes, there is an increasing difficulty in obtaining the desired items due to the remaining few slots. We are currently reviewing various solutions, such as implementing a sort of pity system or introducing entirely new methods. As we continue to discuss the best approach, we kindly ask for your patience.

 

📌 Upcoming Updates

 

■ The approach needs to focus on pattern! Workshop of Brilliant Light: Deimos.

 

Deimos, whose appearance was revealed through the Story, will appear as a boss in the new Workshop of Brilliant Light. Of course, in the new Workshop of Brilliant Light, you'll encounter a more varied version of Deimos.

 

The new Workshop of Brilliant Light will be updated to require a broader range of strategies. The previous version of the Workshop of Brilliant Light had a structure where, once you formed a core party, you could proceed with it throughout, which eventually led to repetitive gameplay and the eventual use of multiplay.

 

However, in the Deimos battle, it will align with the original concept of the Workshop of Brilliant Light, offering an experience where strategy and control come into play. You'll enjoy the fun of identifying the key points needed for your strategy and crafting combinations to clear each floor and dungeon. The action and patterns are designed to be engaging, and we've added puzzle elements to enhance the strategic aspects, moving away from simply "deal and forget" gameplay.

 

In the Deimos battle, the boss absorbs the power of darkness, making it strong against wind attributes but weak against light and fire attributes. It is recommended to use this weakness in your strategy during the battle.

 

▲ The design requires "strategy" rather than the original "deal and overpower" approach.

 

With the addition of the new Workshop, new Core rewards will be added accordingly, which are essential to the Workshop's design. The newly added Cores include those with Attack and those related to MP.

 

Additionally, the Core break feature will be introduced. Once the enhancement level of a Core reaches 100%, it can be enhanced using special materials, extending the maximum Core level to 15.

 

▲ Along with the Cores equipped with new effects, the Core break feature will be introduced.

 

■ All Hunters unite! Jeju Island Alliance Raid.

 

The Jeju Island story, which was updated in December, features a collaboration between Korean and Japanese hunters as they work together to conquer Jeju Island. This event content, the Jeju Island Alliance Raid, provides a way for hunters to indirectly experience this story.

 

In this dungeon, hunters playing SLA will team up to conquer dungeons and achieve their goals. The event begins with battling the Army of Ants in January, securing the path to the Queen Ant. In February, hunters will fight the Queen Ant, and in March, the grand finale, the Beru Raid, will take place. The Queen Ant will be provided in a Guild Boss format, and since the battle with Beru holds special significance in the original, there are ongoing discussions about the best way to present it, so look forward to it.

 

The Jeju Island Alliance Raid will offer rewards such as Hunter Exclusive Weapon Design, hunters, and Weapon Selection Tickets for Sung Jinwoo, as well as high-tier items like Mana Power Extract.

 

▲ The "Jeju Island Alliance Raid" will allow hunters to indirectly experience the hunters' collaborative operation.

 

■ If she were a hunter... New hunter Esil Radiru

 

The character who proudly took first place in the upcoming hunter vote, Esil Radiru, will make her debut as a new hunter. Although it's impossible for a demon like Esil Radiru to become a hunter in the original world setting, through a special "IF" storyline, we were able to introduce hunter Esil Radiru with the approval of the IP holder and original creators. Additionally, Esil Radiru’s story is quite engaging, and a webtoon will also be provided.

 

Returning to the game, Esil Radiru is a fire attribute Breaker who possesses a skill that can instantly eliminate a certain amount of Break Gauge. Furthermore, within the Workshop of Brilliant Light, she has the ability to increase the Break efficiency for the entire team. This will be especially useful in situations where a small amount of Break Gauge remains, and hunters are anxiously waiting for the skill cooldown to end.

 

In addition to her Break performance, Esil Radiru also has a buff effect that increases dealing ability, allowing her to perform both as a Breaker and a Buffer, which will make her a popular character performance-wise.

 

▲ Esil Radiru, who won first place in the upcoming hunter vote, will appear as a hunter in the IF universe.

 

▲ A Breaker and Buffer with powerful Break performance and a party-wide buff.

 

■ Sung Jinwoo’s New Fire Attribute Weapon, Fan of the Fire Demon

 

A new type of weapon, the Fan of the Fire Demon, with effects similar to Moonshadow, will be released on January 23. In addition to increasing fire damage, it also has an effect that slows down enemy movement, allowing for good synergy with existing fire attribute weapons.

 

Along with this, there will be an improvement in the weapon draw BM system. Starting with the Fan of the Fire Demon, the system will be enhanced to allow players to definitively obtain the weapon they want. As new hunters and weapons are continually released, this improvement aims to address the difficulty of obtaining desired items and ease the concern of hesitating to use newly released high-performance weapons due to lower breakthrough levels compared to existing ones.

 

▲ The Fan of the Fire Demon, offering both a slow effect and increased damage like Moonshadow, is here! Plus, the BM system becomes much more user-friendly.

 

■ Enjoying Story with hunters, new Reverse Story Chapter 21-23

 

New Reverse chapters that can be played with hunters will be added.

It may be a bit challenging, but you'll be able to experience the unique flavor of hunter battle.

 

▲ New Reverse Story chapters will open.

 

■ Detailed inconvenience issues are being improved! Further enhancements are underway.

 

The level-up guide will be improved to be more visually appealing. Many new and returning users have had difficulty understanding where and how to earn experience and resources during the progression process. To address this, the guidance has been enhanced.

 

Hunter exclusive weapon crafting will also see improvements in visibility and convenience. The crafting window for hunter exclusive weapons has been a scrolling format, and similar-looking weapons often lead to accidental crafting. Now, a direct shortcut button for weapon crafting will be added in each hunter's menu, ensuring that hunters can craft the desired weapon with certainty.

 

Regarding Gate sweep, an update will be carried out in February. Previously, the sweep required consuming a certain amount of "sweep points" for Sung Jinwoo or the hunter, which was somewhat unintuitive. This system will be replaced by a more straightforward concept, where the process is now based on the number of attempts.

 

▲ Improvements in convenience will be made, including the level-up guide, hunter exclusive weapon crafting, and Gate Sweep.

 

■ New Guild Achievement System

 

A Guild Achievement system will be added, allowing guild members to participate with a sense of purpose and goals. While the Guild system still has some areas that feel a bit bland, we will gradually add more content to enhance it.

 

▲ A Guild Achievement system where Guild members can work together to accomplish goals.

 

■ Free distribution during the 1st anniversary event! The winning piece of the Pixiv contest will be revealed.

 

The winning designs from the Sung Jinwoo and Hunter design contest on Pixiv have been selected. The skin featuring Sung Jinwoo in a noble appearance and Alicia in a blue dress have both been chosen. These costumes will be distributed for free to all hunters during the 1st anniversary event.

 

▲ The contest costumes will be crafted with attention to detail and will be distributed for free during the 1st anniversary event.

 

■ Events for newcomers! Train to Become a Formidable Combatant

 

A new event called "Train to Become a Formidable Combatant" is being held to help new hunters catch up with existing ones and enjoy the game together. By completing various missions, hunters can earn growth resources and will receive guaranteed rewards such as Cha Hae-In, Meilin Fisher, their exclusive weapons, and 50 Custom Draw Tickets, among other generous rewards.

 

Additionally, hunters can acquire Sung Jinwoo’s new SSR weapon, Truth: Kasaka's Venom Fang. Kasaka's Venom Fang, one of Sung Jinwoo's signature weapons from the original story, is being upgraded to "Truth" this time. This water attribute weapon will be particularly useful for new hunters, as the lower levels of Workshop of Brilliant Light (Demons' Castle Lower Floors) feature a water attribute weakness.

 

Of course, the event rewards are also available to existing hunters, and there are plans to provide a way to obtain event exclusive weapons like Gold-tailed Fox for those who may have missed them during the previous event. Please look forward to it!

 

▲ To help new hunters settle in and grow, the "Train to Become a Formidable Combatant" event will be held.

 

▲ The reward weapon, Truth: Kasaka's Venom Fang, is a water attribute weapon, making it ideal for tackling the Demons' Castle Lower Floors in the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

 

■ Snow Flower Events

 

In celebration of the Year of the Azure Serpent, the Snow Flower Events will offer SSR hunter event weapons as rewards. Additionally, various rewards such as Blessing Stones Premium Chests, Weapon Custom Draw Tickets, Gold, and Essence Stones will be available.

 

At the same time, the convenience of some events, including the Dice Event, will be improved, allowing hunters to collect rewards all at once and enjoy the event more comfortably.

 

▲ In the seasonal Snow Flower Events, a variety of rewards will be offered, and the convenience of participating in the event will also be improved.

 

■ The stage is expanding Globally, Global SLC 2025

 

In 2025, the SLC will be held globally. Hunters who achieve over 1,000 points in the 7th season of Battlefield of Time will have the opportunity to participate in the online qualifiers. The selected elite hunters will then compete in the main event held in Korea.

 

While the previous tournament was limited to domestic participants, many overseas hunters expressed their desire to join, so this year, the competition has been expanded globally. We look forward to seeing powerful hunters from all over the world showcase their skills. Additionally, all expenses, including travel, accommodation, and meals, will be fully covered by the company, so you can participate without any concerns.

 

▲ The SLC will now be held globally, expanding beyond domestic competition to include hunters from around the world.

 

📌 Resolution of Solo Leveling:ARISE for 2025

 

Jin Sung Gun, Head of Development)

Thank you so much for the past year of 2024.

Thanks to all of you, we were able to achieve the result of winning the Korea Game Awards, and we have been able to create and service the game in a fun way. In order to repay your support, we will continue to work even harder. In particular, we will address feedback such as "there’s nothing to do" and "lack of fun in farming," and make improvements so that you can experience new excitement.

 

Lee Da Haeng, Head of Business Division)

I am truly grateful for the past year. It seems like we are welcoming a great year thanks to the hunters.

This year, we will make sure you experience new excitement and even more enjoyable growth.

Additionally, we will continue to share updates and upcoming plans through Developer Notes, and if you have any feedback, please leave it in the community.

We will continue to communicate and engage while reviewing everything. I look forward to your continued support this year.

 

 

Thank you.

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you!

 

Here are the details scheduled to be added and changed through the update on 1/16 (Thu).

 

Please see below for more details about the update.

📢 1/16 (Thu) Update Details

 

 

📌 Reverse Story New Chapter

- Chapters 21-23 added through the 12/19 (Thu) update will also be added to the Reverse Mode.

* Clear and Battle Missions rewards will be granted for each chapter.

However, only Clear rewards will be provided when clearing chapters that only consist of “Story.”

 

📌 Workshop of Brilliant Light New Dungeon & Improvements

▶ New Dungeon “Spire of Transfiguration”

- A new “Workshop of Brilliant Light - Spire of Transfiguration” (Easy/Normal) where hunters can challenge the Judge of Death, Deimos.

The “Spire of Transfiguration” will unlock after clearing “Demon’s Castle Upper Floors - Normal.”

* Reach Battle Tier 31 to challenge the Spire of Transfiguration.

* Clear Spire of Transfiguration Easy to unlock Normal mode.

* The Spire of Transfiguration boss will be added to the Special Commission list.

 

- The Spire of Transfiguration consists of main and sub stages and you can enter the stage selection screen by consuming the Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitation when selecting difficulty.

* For the initial challenge for each difficulty, “Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitations” will not be consumed.

* The Workshop of Brilliant Light proceeds in a weekly cycle and resets once every Thursday at 00:00 (UTC+0).

Additionally, the Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitation recharges to its maximum amount at the reset period.

- The stages consist of player and hunter modes, and this can be checked through marked icons for each stage.

 

- In the Workshop of Brilliant Light main stages, you can acquire Cores and materials for enhancing Cores such as Solidified Stones.

You will be able to clear the stages more easily by acquiring Blessing of Brilliant Light effects through the sub stages.

* Please check the details regarding the obtainable rewards in-game.

 

▶ Other Workshop of Brilliant Light Improvements

- As the new Workshop of Brilliant Light is added, new entering dungeon selection screens (Monarch of White Flames/the Commander of Transfiguration) will be added.

- On the Blessings selection screen in the sub stages, a feature to reset the Blessings list will be added.

The cost for the initial reset is free and Gold x100,000 is required for additional Blessings list reset (total up to 2 times available).

* Blessings reset counts will reset every time when you acquire Blessings after 1/3/5 waves.

 

📌 New Cores

- New Core equipment obtainable from the Workshop of Brilliant - Spire of Transfiguration will be added.

* The options for the new Cores are similar to the original Cores.

The effect only activates only once per battle.

 

📌 New Growth Element - Core Limit Break

- A new “Core Limit Break” feature will be added where hunters can enhance Cores that have reached the maximum level.

- Only Cores that have reached 100% enhancement with Lv. 10 can be selected for limit break.

A “Condensed Energy” material item is required for Core limit break and the corresponding item can be acquired as rewards when clearing Workshop of Brilliant Light - Spire of Transfiguration.

- When proceeding with the Core limit break, the maximum level and Core option maximum value will increase accordingly.

* After the Core limit break, level up your Cores by using other Cores or Core Aether and enhance options by using Solidified Stones.

* The Core Passive will not be changed when proceeding with the limit break.

 

📌 Global Cooperation Event - Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Skirmish

The first stage of the cooperative raid event where all the hunters have to gather strength, “Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Skirmish” will be revealed.

 

▶ Event Summary

- The Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Skirmish consists of 4 operations in total. Clear the given stages at each operation phase, achieve progress, and conquer the e challenge.
 

▶ Operations Participation

- In order to participate in each operation, “Operation Plans” are required and the corresponding item can be obtained by clearing daily Alliance Raid missions.

- Each operation stage consists of 8 levels and higher levels will open based on the operation progress. Additionally, higher grade rewards will be given when challenging higher level operations.

- When clearing an operation, it will be reflected in the corresponding operation’s progress.

When reaching 100% of operation progress, the next operation will unlock and you will be able to challenge a new dungeon.

* The operation progress is renewed every hour by calculating the hunters’ participation and Cooperative Support record based on the entire server.

 

▶ Cooperative Support

- In addition to participating in operations using Operation Plans, you can also increase operation progress and claim rewards through Cooperative Support.

- Battle Support Supplies are required for Cooperative Support and the supplies can be acquired by clearing Alliance Raid missions.

 

▶ Reward

- Obtain “Jeju Island Contribution Points” and “Jeju Island Raid Coins” by clearing operations and through Cooperative Support.

- Gather Jeju Island Raid Contribution Points and claim level rewards in the “Raid Contribution Challenge.”

The Jeju Island Raid Coins can be exchanged for various items in the exchange shop.

- In addition to the progression of each operation, you can check the entire Alliance Raid's progress on the event page and also claim rewards based on the progress.

 

Please see the event notice below for more details on how to participate and event period.

[Global Cooperation Event - Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Skirmish]

 

We hope to see enthusiastic participation from our hunters to reach 100% progression of the entire Alliance Raid.
