text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: WANTED

Hunters Association
|
Jan 23, 2025, 10:00
|
63,897

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

Our team has received various feedback regarding [communication] through different communities.

 

As mentioned in the last official Livestream, we will do our best to communicate with and greet our hunters more frequently in the future.

 

Our sincere gratitude goes out to all the hunters who always provide us with valuable feedback.

 

 

 

[Arise]

 

[Excerpt from Yogumunt]

 

 

‘Shadows will demonstrate even more powerful combat capabilities.’

 

Our team is always carefully listening to the valuable feedback from our hunters.

 

Among the various suggestions, many of you expressed a desire for the Shadows to take a more active role in combat.

 

In response to this feedback, we’re planning to introduce a system that will allow Shadows to be armed once they reach a certain rank, enabling them to be more active during combat.

 

By activating the newly added Shadow Armament System, you can obtain powerful buff effects that will aid you in battle, allowing you to experience more diverse combat than ever before

 

This new growth feature will be unveiled sequentially through updates in February and March, and we look forward to your continued anticipation and support.

 

 

 

In the March update, the Ice Witch Beste, whom you encountered in the Instance Dungeon, will join the Shadows as a new addition.

 

 

[WANTED]

 

‘Who will be the first to conquer the spire?’

 

 

The hunters' challenge of defeating Vulcan and Baran on Hard difficulty in a race to be the first has truly been an amazing journey for us to witness.

 

In particular, the first person to defeat Vulcan did so just 13 minutes after the event began.

 

To continue this thrilling journey, our team is preparing a new event where you’ll be tasked with defeating Commander of Transfiguration Deimos (Hard).

 

The awe-inspiring might of Commander Deimos will stand firmly in your way at the Abyssal Execution Scaffold.

 

Special rewards will be given to the hunters who make their mark in history as the heroes who quell his fury, so we hope many of you will rise to the challenge.

 

[Blade Guild]

 

‘She’ has black and dark hair, red eyes, and purple lips.

With pure passion and innate competitiveness, ‘she’ grew into a strong hunter faster than anyone else.

 

Rather than concealing the marks left from her battles, she proudly displays them, treating them as her own personal symbol.

 

After 'she' joins you in the Gate raid,

'he,' who belongs to the same guild, will soon come to find you.

 

Please look forward to seeing ‘him’ as he unsheathes his red blade bravely, without a moment's hesitation in the face of the enemy.

 

 

[The Next]

 

We would like to address the feedback you have shared through official livestreams and various other channels.

 

We hope this helps answer our hunters' questions.

 

Q. After advancing to the Shadow General rank, the effects of the original skills are not applying.

Please make the Iron’s Defense Decrease skill be used as a priority.

 

As of the 1/16 update, we fixed the issue where Cerbie’s Combustion Skill was not being applied upon promotion.

In the February update, we’ll make improvements so that Iron’s Defense Decrease skill is prioritized.

Q. There’s no reward history for Simulation Gate, and the UI is inconvenient.

We will be improving features, such as Algorithm of the Week and the Skip UI, in the February update.

We will also prepare to add a reward history feature in the March update.

 

Q. The boss on the 50th floor is too strong.

We’re preparing to expand the maximum floor of the Battlefield of Trials.

Before this expansion, the boss for the 50th floor, Wolf Shepherd Roke, will be weakened due to the high failure rate on that floor.

 

Q. There is a sense of boredom from only attacking the same boss (Guild Boss, Power of Destruction, etc.).

As mentioned in the Developer livestream, the Guild Boss Fachtna will temporarily go into hiding, and the Queen Ant will appear as both a Guild Boss and a cooperative event boss. This update is planned for February.

We will also improve the Guild Join List rules so that hunters who are not currently in a guild can participate more smoothly in this event.

 

Q. If I’ve fully enhanced Baran’s passive through Remnant Power, where do I use the remaining Shards of Baran?

We are preparing a way for you to use them when passives for other Monarchs become available in the future.

More details will be discussed during our livestream.

 

Q. Please make the monthly subscription discount permanent.

A permanent discount will be applied in the February update.

 

Q. Please add more bosses to Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions.

We’re preparing to add new bosses in the March update.

We’ll share more details in our livestream.

 

Q. When is Sung Jinwoo’s new job change coming out?

We are preparing to introduce a new job change with the March update.

We’ll share more details in our livestream.

 

 

[AI is not perfect.

However, we will continue to strive to make the learning more complete.]

 

First, we would like to address and sincerely apologize for the issue related to the incorrect sanctions that occurred today from 17:18 to approximately 19:55 (UTC+0).

 

The issue occurred because the Faction of the Shield team was preparing for the upcoming SLC tournament, during which a stronger level of detection was applied than usual.

 

While carrying out this learning process, some hunters were incorrectly detected, resulting in many hunters experiencing inconvenience.

As soon as we identified the issue, we took additional measures to restore the situation for those who experienced inconvenience.

 

Our team will do its best to establish preventive measures to ensure that hunters do not experience similar issues again.

 

[Welcoming Spring]

 

Near the end of the February Valentine event, which will soon be presented to the hunters, the warm sunlight of spring will begin to arrive.

 

One day, Bora, Se-Mi, and Jiwoo gathered at the cafe in front of the Hunters Guild.

While being cautious of their surroundings, they began to devise a secret plan.

The goal of their mission is to take Gina, who is indifferent to spring, on a spring outing!

 

“Let’s plant spring in Gina’s heart!”

 

A warm spring breeze arrives, filling our hearts with anticipation.

 

[Memorial]

 

There are countless worlds in the time where the rulers spun using 'The Cup of Reincarnation.'

 

In the worlds that have passed, there are hunters similar to those of today, though with subtle differences.

 

The hunters who thrived in those forgotten worlds will remain in someone's records and be remembered forever.

 

The first Memorial Hunter to visit the hunters will be from the Valkyrie Guild.

 

“She has a cold and blunt personality, and changes in her facial expressions are also few.”

 

(Some words may be changed upon official release as this content is still under development.

 

[Montage Video]

 

Our team is continuously expanding the world of Solo Leveling:ARISE.

Do you remember the OST that was introduced in the last official forum post?

 

Word on the street is that two new OSTs will soon be revealed to the hunters.

 

Before that, here's a short montage video capturing the moment when Sung Jinwoo first faced the gate. 

Turn up the volume for a moment and experience that intense beginning once again.

 

 

 

[Momentum]

 

Our team is currently facing an important dilemma.

 

The dilemma arises from the issue of some hunters, whose growth has been somewhat completed, experiencing a loss of motivation in the game.

 

Due to our focus on new and returning hunters as their numbers increased, we may have overlooked motivating our existing hunters.

 

We fully understand the concerns regarding the lack of motivation to continue playing the game. In response, our team is currently preparing to reintroduce the enjoyment of farming, along with various other content.

 

Hunters, please wait a moment.

 

As you enjoy your time in various stories, such as the Deimos Wanted Event and SLC 2025, you will soon find yourself experiencing this new content!

 

 

[Developer Livestream Pre-Notification]

 

The Developer Livestream scheduled for February will be an opportunity to provide more detailed information about the upcoming update.

 

We look forward to seeing our hunters at the upcoming Developer Livestream.

 

 

📌Developer Note Gift

 Redeem Code

Redeem Code Reward

Weapon Custom Draw Ticket x10

Weapon Enhacement GearⅢ x20

Precision Design x2

* This redeem code can only be used once per account.

* This redeem code can be used until 1/27 (Mon) 14:59 (UTC+0) and will not be usable after the expiration date.

* The rewards will be sent immediately upon use.

 

Thank you for being with us at all times.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

👉 [2/11 (Tue) Developer Livestream Video]

* To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

📌 Q&A

Q. When will it be possible to purchase the Subscription on PC?

- As mentioned in the previous livestream, we are preparing features related to Subscription.

Since many hunters play the game on PC, we are working to make Subscriptions available directly on PC.

We also previously discussed enhancements to the benefits of the subscription plan, which will be explained in detail in the improvements section.

 

Q. The early stages of Reverse Mode and Workshop of Brilliant Light (Easy) are too difficult.

- We have identified that some early bosses in Reverse Mode and Workshop of Brilliant Light (Easy) create hurdles for beginner hunters, so we have adjusted the balance accordingly.

Additionally, some floors in the Battlefield of Trials have shown similar trends, and improvements will be included in this update as well. We will continue to monitor the difficulty and make further updates if necessary.

 

Q. We heard that the Gate Sweep system will be changed. How will it be modified?

- Previously, sweeping consumed a set amount of points, which many found confusing.

To simplify the system, it will be changed to a usage-based deduction method, where the number of sweeps will now be reduced based on attempts. The number of available sweeps will vary depending on the hunter’s rank and advancement tier. In short, 1 point will be deducted per sweep attempt.

 

Q. You mentioned improving the appeal of Monthly Bundles plans. How exactly will they change?

- As mentioned in the previous livestream, we have recognized your valuable feedback regarding the appeal of the Monthly Bundles plans. In response, we have actively reflected your opinions and enhanced the rewards for both the Monthly Bundles and Subscription across the board.

For detailed improvements, please refer to the update notice.

 

Q. When will the Artifact Crafting Event be held again?

- The Artifact Crafting Event is scheduled to begin on 2/27 (Thu).

* We apologize for the lack of clarity regarding the schedule during the livestream. This is the corrected information.

It seems that many hunters have been looking forward to this event since the last livestream. We hope this allows you to craft the Artifacts you desire.

 

📌 Real-Time Q&A

Q. Will the Bonds red dot bug finally be fixed in this update?

- First, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. This issue will be fixed in this update, so please check and confirm.

 

Q. The amount of new content being released feels insufficient.

- We recognize the feedback that there is not enough content and that there isn’t much to do.

While we have been focusing on updates for new and returning players, we acknowledge that this may have left some gaps.

We apologize for this and will continue to provide ongoing updates along with additional rewards.

 

Q. It would be great to have online co-op or PvP content added.

- The recently introduced Jeju Island Alliance Raid was designed as an asynchronous co-op feature.

While we cannot share details at this moment, our development team is actively working on various new types of content.

The prototype development has already been completed.

 

Solo Leveling:ARISE focuses on providing a deep single-player experience, and as such, we currently have a flexible approach to developing multiplayer content. However, we do understand the concerns of top-level players who feel there isn't enough to do. To address this, we will gradually introduce new content to alleviate this sense of frustration.

 

In the Jeju Island Alliance Raid in February, it will feature the Queen Ant, and in March, we will focus on Beru. For the Beru raid, we are preparing it in a way that enhances the cooperative elements of the gameplay.

 

Q. How long do we have to farm the same Artifact? The fun of farming seems to be diminishing.

- We have had numerous internal meetings to explore various directions for expanding Artifact levels. We have now settled on the initial plan.

The update will introduce new, higher-tier Artifacts, while ensuring that existing Artifacts are not discarded.

 

This change will involve adjusting the acquisition of lower-level Artifacts to make it easier, among other adjustments.

For detailed information, please refer to the update notice.

 

Q. We hope the Shadows can be further enhanced.

- This is included in the upcoming update, where the Shadow Armaments system will be introduced.

 

Q. It seems like the usefulness of Thomas Andre has dropped significantly.

- As we introduce new hunters, we focus on creating content where they can shine, which has caused Thomas' usage to decline. However, we are preparing to ensure that existing hunters, including Thomas, are not left behind, with new content such as the Queen Ant Boss content and updates to Power of Destruction.

 

For characters that fall behind in usability, we have always taken the approach of providing buffs or introducing suitable content to maintain their value. We have never nerfed a character. This situation is no different, and we will continue to provide opportunities for characters to thrive. For example, while Yoo Soohyun initially received mixed feedback, she has recently become much more powerful, and we will continue to offer content that allows characters to perform well over time.

 

Q. Are there any upcoming updates related to Gems?

- We are currently planning improvements to Gems, and they are already included in our roadmap. We will provide further details at the appropriate time.

 

Q. How will the Jeju Island Alliance Raid event be concluded?

- The finale of the Jeju Island Alliance Raid will feature a battle against Ant King, Beru. It will be a slightly different type of content, and internal testing is currently underway, so we hope you look forward to it.

 

Q. The Jeju Island Alliance Raid felt too anticlimactic.

- For the story content, unlike Workshop of Brilliant Light and Guild Raids, we believe it’s important to make it accessible for everyone, rather than dragging it out with overly challenging content. While difficult content can keep players engaged for a while, it is not always the best approach..

 

We will continue to add original story elements while providing content that is enjoyable and quick to experience. The focus will not be on extending content by making it more difficult, but on providing enjoyable, well-paced updates.

 

As for updates for top-level players, we have focused on new and returning players until the end of last year, but from February onwards, we will target top-level players for updates through the first half of the year and towards the end of the year. We are preparing content that will be enjoyable.

 

Q. The update intervals feel too long.

- During the previous 3-week update cycle, we faced issues with incomplete content and bugs. To reduce bugs and improve content quality, we have now moved to a 4-week update interval.

 

Q. What is the direction of future content updates?

- We will ensure that the story and basic growth are balanced, while staying on track with the publicly announced roadmap.

We will ensure that the story and basic growth are balanced, while staying on track with the publicly announced roadmap.

For challenging content such as Battlefield of Trials, Power of Destruction, and Guild Boss content, we are planning to provide additional rewards for top-level players who exceed certain standards. We are also considering adding new difficulty levels, such as "Very Hard."

 

Q. I would like to see a multiplier feature in the Simulation Gates.

- We will forward this suggestion to the development team for consideration.

 

Q. In the Workshop of Brilliant Light, sometimes the materials for Limit Breaking Cores do not drop, and the rewards are inconsistent.

- We will make adjustments to the rewards in the Workshop of Brilliant Light. We will ensure that, at each stage of play, players receive a consistent minimum reward.

 

Q. Additional growth elements, such as the Armory expansion?

- We have a plan for updates regarding high-level growth, but it cannot be implemented all at once. It will be rolled out gradually, so we hope you enjoy the content as it releases.

 

Regarding the expansion of the maximum weapon levels, we have received a lot of feedback on extending Sung Jinwoo level as well, and it follows the same reasoning. While increasing levels can significantly boost combat power without the need for additional content, the level expansion is integrated with the story and other content.

 

Continuously expanding the maximum levels can create a significant gap between beginner and top-level players, which leads to difficulty spikes and can reduce the enjoyment of the game. We are carefully monitoring this and adjusting the speed of progress. Instead of simply expanding levels, we are introducing new growth methods, like Shadow Armaments, to enhance the fun of gameplay. We ask for your understanding as we move forward with these changes.

 

Q. Q. Are there any plans for improvements to the Simulation Gate?

- The Simulation Gate is scheduled to officially open as content in March. We have been receiving various feedback on this and are considering adjustments.

In addition to basic difficulty adjustments, we are reviewing adding enhancements to the Code balance within the Simulation Gate, improving the farming experience, and implementing a multiplier play feature to increase the convenience of gameplay.

 

📌 Upcoming February Update &  Improvements

 

■ Workshop of Brilliant Light Deimos Hard Mode Update

 

A new Deimos Hard Mode will be released in the Workshop of Brilliant Light. With new patterns that differ from the existing ones, hunters will experience a fresh sense of challenge and enjoyment in strategizing.

 

A [Wanted] event will also take place. This time, it will be divided into two tiers groups 3,000 and 6,000 hunters. The first 3,000 and 6,000 hunters to clear the mode will receive limited edition rewards, and once the first 3,000 clear the stage, rewards will be distributed to all hunters.

 

In previous events, the Vulcan raid saw its first clear in 13 minutes, and Baran was cleared in 15 minutes by the first hunter. Similarly, the Deimos raid is expected to have its first clear relatively quickly. Given that it only took less than a week for all hunters to complete the Baran wanted event, the number of first-come participants is expected to be manageable.

 

▲ With the release of Deimos Hard Mode, an early bird clear event will be held.

 

■ More Powerful Army of Shadows! Shadow Armaments System

 

The Shadow Armament system will be unlocked once the Shadow reaches the General rank, allowing hunters to equip Shadow weapons. Equipping these weapons will increase combat power and unlock new Shadow skills and effects.

 

In the original work, Sung Jinwoo gives weapons to the Shadow, but in the game, if weapons are directly given to the Shadow, the pool of weapons that Sung Jinwoo can use would be reduced. Therefore, for gameplay purposes, the Shadow will be using different weapons.

 

It is important to note that Shadow weapons will not be part of a gacha system. Instead, hunters will obtain Shadow items during gameplay, which can be fused to create and upgrade the weapons.

 

Additionally, Shadow skill level ups will be added in the next update. To avoid overwhelming hunters with too much growth at once, this will be provided gradually.

 

▲ A “Shadow Armament” system where hunters can equip weapons to Shadows when reaching General rank.

 

■ Strong Japanese S-Rank Hunter, Tawata Kanae Released

 

Tawata Kanae, an S-rank hunter from the Japanese Blade Guild who appeared in the original work, will be introduced as a fire attribute Assassin. Tawata Kanae’s fighting style involves dual swords and wire action, providing a highly dynamic and instant-action combat experience that makes her easy to use. Her unique characteristic is that she becomes stronger as either she or her allies defeat regular monsters or successfully apply break effects, making her especially powerful in environments where such conditions are met.

 

In contrast to Yoo Soohyun, Tawata Kanae excels in long-term battles, where she can build up buffs by continuously defeating enemies or performing breaks, increasing her firepower over time. Yoo Soohyun, on the other hand, is better suited for high-defense environments, where her strength lies in penetrating enemy defenses.

 

Additionally, Tawata Kanae’s E-skill is enhanced during Q or Core Attacks, making her damage output vary significantly depending on the skill sequence. This gives her a high degree of player control, requiring skillful manipulation to maximize her potential. Unlike other fire attribute characters, Tawata Kanae stands out with her fast, exhilarating action, providing a distinct and exciting playstyle.

 

▲ Tawata Kanae becomes stronger every time monsters are defeated or the break effect is applied,

 

▲ The characteristic is the sustained increase in firepower, which leads to a high peak damage, and the ability to perform exciting, dynamic actions.

 

■ Jeju Island Alliance Raid - Final Update

 

The Skirmish event is followed by the final week of the Jeju Island Alliance Raid. In the final battle, hunters will face the Queen Ant in a Guild Boss content format. The main rewards include Special Player's Weapon Design that can be used to craft Sung Jinwoo's weapons, Heroic Skill Runes, Blessing Stones, and titles.

 

Additionally, the Coin Exchange Shop, which opened during the Skirmish period, will be extended. If there are items that you were unable to exchange previously, you will be able to exchange them again by participating in the new event. This event is part of a long-term series, so we hope you enjoy it.

 

Furthermore, since the Queen Ant battle is in a Guild Boss content, joining a Guild is mandatory to participate in the event. While you can engage in some other missions, the main event is the Guild Boss content, so we encourage everyone to join a Guild and participate. There are enjoyable points like the accumulation of Rage points and other Guild-exclusive content, which is why the Queen Ant content takes this form.

 

Before encouraging the joining of a Guild, we recognized that the Guild system itself needed improvements, and as such, updates are being made in this regard. Now, only active Guilds will appear in the Guild list, and Guild Contribution Points can also be viewed, making it easier to find a new Guild.

 

▲ After the end of Skirmish, the Jeju Island Alliance Raid will rush into its final phase.

 

■ New Guild Boss - Queen Ant

 

The Queen Ant is characterized by summoning an Army of Ants to protect herself during the battle. Each time a subordinate Ant is defeated, the damage the Queen Ant takes increases, making it advantageous to quickly eliminate the subordinate Ants in order to build up the Rage counts more efficiently.

Therefore, in the Queen Ant battle, while 1v1 damage is important, it is also crucial to combine hunters and skills that can deal with multiple enemies at once.

 

The newly introduced hunter, Tawata Kanae, is specialized for such group battles, and hunters like Emma Laurent, who are frequently used in time attacks, will also perform excellently. Previous boss battles were mainly focused on 1v1 duels, making it hard for hunters who shine in group battles to stand out. This Queen Ant battle presents a great opportunity for such hunters to shine.

 

▲ The Queen Ant that summons multiple subordinates has arrived as a new Guild Boss.

 

■ Implementation of Additional Growth Content, Starting From March Rune & Blessing Stone!

 

An update in March will allow further growth of Skill Runes and Blessing Stones. Previously, Legendary Runes were obtained through Fusion, but the newly added Rune rank will be obtained by enhancing existing Legendary Runes. More detailed information will be shared through a Developer Note.

 

Regarding Artifacts, plans are underway to expand levels and add more features. In addition to adding higher-tier Artifacts, a system is being developed where existing Artifacts can be refined to increase their levels. The goal is to make it easier for hunters to acquire higher-tier Artifacts. This allows hunters to farm new Artifacts or refine their existing ones with good stats to obtain even higher-tier Artifacts.

 

As for higher-tier Artifacts, the update will include a rework of Encore Missions and Instance Dungeon, with new difficulty levels and adjustments to the "Proof of the Strong" difficulty. This is a significant update, which is planned for April, and ongoing information will be shared through a Developer Note.

 

▲ Skill Runes and Blessing Stones will be available for additional growth in Match and Artifact Improvements will be applied during April.

 

■ Valentine’s Day Event

 

In celebration of Valentine's Day, various events and rewards will be offered. Along with the usual Profile Frames and Backgrounds, a costume for Woo Jinchul will be added. Additionally, there will be tickets for use in the Rune, Blessing Stone, and Artifact crafting events.

 

A new Hunter Upgrade Reset Ticket will also be introduced. This ticket allows hunters to receive back the Elixirs used for hunter upgrades, rather than returning all the resources spent on overall character development. For hunters who have been short on Elixirs due to limited playtime, this will help them improve and use their desired hunters more effectively.

 

▲ Claim various currencies, Profile, Artifact Crafting Tickets, and Hunter Upgrade Reset Tickets through the Valentine’s Event.

 

▲ Craft Artifacts with options you prefer and reclaim Elixirs from unprefered hunters.

 

■ Maximum Weapon Level Expansion Lv. 120! Additional Improvements

 

The maximum weapon level will be expanded, allowing upgrades up to Lv. 120, which will raise your base combat power. A convenience update will also be implemented, where a guide will appear when pausing the game. On the pause screen, you can check key character gimmicks, recommended skill sequences, and current skill progress.

 

The unlocking conditions for Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions will be eased. Previously, you needed to clear all levels from stage 1 to stage 20 to unlock new dungeons, but now your highest completed stage will be automatically applied. Additionally, when you obtain trophies in higher stages, lower stages will automatically be marked as cleared. Once you get 3 trophies in stage 20, you no longer need to farm trophies in the lower stages.

 

Monthly Bundles and Subscription packages will see price discounts and increased rewards. With a subscription, your maximum Artifact storage will be expanded to 1,000, and the maximum key capacity will be doubled.

 

Moreover, an update is being prepared where you can once again obtain weapons previously provided as event rewards, including Gold-tailed Fox. More details will be shared in the next livestream.

 

▲ Maximum weapon level will increase to 120 and a guide will be displayed when pausing during battle.

 

▲ The unlock condition for Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions will be eased and the trophies will be obtained when clearing high-tier dungeons.

 

▲ The price for Monthly Bundles will decrease and rewards will be adjusted.

 

📌 Closing Comments

 

Lee Da Haeng, Business Division Director)

I was quite nervous throughout this livestream. In January, we shared our vision and put in a lot of effort to prepare, but there were still many areas where we fell short. However, we truly appreciate those who have supported us and said they would wait.

 

Previously, we committed to ensuring that new and returning players could settle into the game smoothly, and we have successfully achieved that. Now, our next mission is to create an enjoyable environment for our existing players, and we are determined to accomplish it.

Once the updates roll out as planned, we are confident that you will truly enjoy the farming experience. Please wait just a little longer, and we promise to deliver great results.

 

Jin Sung Gun, Head of Development)

We have been closely reviewing the feedback from high-ranking players. Many of you have voiced opinions regarding additional growth opportunities, ranking-related features, and competition in the Rage system. Internally, we are actively working on these aspects.

 

Although the Jeju Island Raid was an event and is not included in this discussion, we plan to introduce a Rage Competition System for Guild Boss content in the future. Similarly, for Power of Destruction, we are considering adjustments to the ranking system to create a more competitive environment for top players. Additionally, the development of Armory expansion has already been completed, and we are currently discussing its release schedule.

 

At present, there is a lack of dedicated spaces for top-level players to showcase their strength. To address this, we are exploring ways to enhance ranking competition and implement cooperative features that allow players to assist others. However, these changes require time, and we ask for your patience as we continue development and roll out updates.

 

We acknowledge both the constructive criticism and diverse opinions from our community. While it is challenging to create updates that satisfy all players, we will continue refining our approach to align with our development philosophy and direction, incorporating your feedback step by step.

 

 

Thank you.

📌 Global Cooperation Event - Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Final

The “Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Skirmish” has been successfully conquered thanks to the cooperation of our hunters. Now, get ready for a new step, “Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Final.”

 

▶ Event Summary

- The Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Final consists of 3 operations, Point A/B Decoy Operation and the main operation which is “Fina: Queen Ant.” Clear the stages for each operation and achieve progress.
 

▶ Operation Progress

- Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Final consists of three operations that proceed simultaneously, and hunters can freely participate in any operation after the event begins.

- To join the Point A/B Decoy Operation during the Final event, you will need an "Operation Plans II" entry ticket, which can be obtained daily from the Jeju Island Alliance Raid missions.

- 포The Point A/B Decoy Operation stages are divided into eight difficulty levels, with higher difficulties unlocking as the operation progresses. Higher difficulty levels provide increased progress and contribution point rewards.

- The main operation, "Final: Queen Ant," is conducted in a Guild Boss format, where hunters form a team with Sung Jinwoo and nine hunters to take on the Queen Ant raid.

The contribution points and progress for Final: Queen Ant are calculated based on the number of times the Queen Ant enters a Rage state.

* To participate in the Final: Queen Ant stage, you must be a member of a Guild.

* After the maintenance, the existing Guild Boss, "Fachtna," will be replaced with Queen Ant, allowing hunters to challenge her.

The Queen Ant Raid follows the same system as the previous Guild Boss content, with hunters able to challenge the boss up to twice per week and register their records.

- Successfully completing an operation will contribute to the progress of the corresponding operation stage.

* Operation progress is calculated based on the participation and Cooperative Support of all hunters across the entire server and is updated every hour.

* Please note that the Final: Queen Ant progress will only be properly reflected once both weekly Guild Boss attempts have been completed and registered.

 

▶ Cooperative Support

- In addition to participating in operations using Operational Plans, you can increase the operation progress and earn rewards through Cooperative Support.

- The Cooperative Support requires Battle Support Supplies II and the item can be obtained at a certain rate through the World Drop event after clearing Gates, Instance Dungeon, and Encore Missions.

 

▶ Reward

- Obtain “Jeju Island Contribution Points” and “Jeju Island Raid Coins” by clearing operations and through Cooperative Support.

- Gather Jeju Island Raid Contribution Points and claim level rewards in the “Raid Contribution Challenge.”

The Jeju Island Raid Coins can be exchanged for various items in the exchange shop.

* The exchange count limit and exchange shop item list will remain the same after the update.

- In addition to the progression of each operation, you can check the entire Alliance Raid's progress on the event page and also claim rewards based on the progress.

 

Please see the event notice below for more details on how to participate and event period.

[Global Cooperation Event - Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Final]

 

We expect enthusiastic participation from all our hunters to successfully complete the mission by defeating the Ants and the Queen Ant that have evaded Jeju Island!

 

📌 New Shadow Growth System - Shadow Armaments

- A new feature “Shadow Armaments” will be added to apply additional stats and special skills to Shadows.

- Activating Shadow Armament increases Attack, Precision, and Army Combat Power, while also granting additional special attack skills and armament effects unique to the Shadow Armament, beyond existing skills.

- Each Shadow can activate and evolve its unique Shadow Armament using the new materials "Shadow Echoes" and "Abyssal Crystal".

* The Shadow Armaments will only be activated to Shadows with “General” rank or higher.

* The Shadow Echo can be obtained through crafting, while Abyssal Crystals can be acquired from the Battlefield of Time Exchange Shop and Power of Destruction reward chests.

- A new Artifact Slot System will be added, allowing Sung Jinwoo and hunters to switch Artifact setups based on the content they engage in.

Each hunter will have a total of four slots, two Armor slots and two Accessory slots, which can be used to swap equipped Artifacts.

- During combat, the effects of the selected slot’s Artifacts will be applied. Unlike the original Artifact equip/unequip feature, switching slots will not consume Gold.

📌 Other Improvements

- Some monster stats in the Hunter Preview Stage will be adjusted.

- The debuff effects of the boss "Wolf Shepherd Roke" in Battlefield of Trial Floor 50 will be reduced.

- The stats of the boss monster in Reverse Story Chapter 1, "E-Rank Hunter" stage will be lowered.

- A hunter strategy guide section will be added to the pause menu during combat.

- The location of the "skill guide" button in the Hunters section will be adjusted.

- In the Proof of the Strong menu, completion marks will be added for stages below the one you have achieved.

- Preset formations will now be usable in the Power of Destruction.

* However, when loading a preset that includes a hunter from a different team, that hunter will be excluded from the formation.

- The skill effect of Arch Lich, the boss of The Hazy Tomb of the Dead in Spire of Transfiguration, will be modified.

- The Weekly Algorithm UI in Simulation Gate will be improved.

- The stage selection and skip UI in Simulation Gate will be improved.

- Inactive Guilds will no longer appear in the Guild join list.

- The mission descriptions for certain "Train to Become a Formidable Combatant" quests will be improved.

- Changed rewards and eased certain mission clear conditions in the Train to Become a Formidable Combatant. [Added 2/13 (Thu) 03:25 (UTC+0)]
* The mission conditions for 3-3 and 3-15 will be eased and 3-3 mission rewards will change from Artifact Enhancement Chip I x100 to Hunter Archive Key x2.

- The display conditions for the "Train to Become a Formidable Combatant" mission notice at the top of the lobby will be adjusted.

- When purchasing costume packages in the shop, a feature displaying you already own the costume will appear if you already have the corresponding costume.

- A shortcut button for crafting will be added to the weapon info screen in the Weapons and Codex menu for craftable weapons.

- The difficulty of some stages in the Workshop of Brilliant Light – Demons' Castle Lower Floors, easy difficulty (Demons' Castle Entrance, Demons' Castle 25F) will be reduced.

- Removed the daily accumulated purchase counts limit in the Bonus Shop. 

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the issue where boss monsters in the Workshop of Brilliant Light were intermittently not counted for Special Commissions upon being defeated.

- Fixed the issue with Battle Mission rankings.

* Hunters whose rankings changed after the 1/23 Faction of the Shield update will have their rankings adjusted based on the previous rankings data before the issue occurred.

- Fixed the issue where only 1 Hunter Exclusive Weapon Design was obtained when salvaging the Fan of the Fire Demon.

* Hunters who salvaged the weapon before the update will receive the missing Hunter Exclusive Weapon Design via mail.

- Fixed the issue with the "Train to Become a Formidable Combatant" mission "Reach a certain level for Cha Hae-In", which required an additional level-up to complete.

- Fixed the issue where some items in the Special Shop caused the top item categories tab to not appear intermittently.

- Fixed the issue where a red dot appeared on the Bonds tab even when there were no available rewards.

- Fixed the issue where Shadows from existing presets would summon upon entering the Simulation Gate.

- Fixed the issue where incorrect text appeared in Options - Controls - Battle Mode.

- Fixed the issue where QTE skills would not activate after using Gina's Ultimate Skill.

- Fixed the issue where characters occasionally went outside the map during certain stages in the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

- Fixed the issue where the Blessing Stones "Desire" Hero/Rare grade were incorrectly displayed when the language was set to English.

- Fixed the issue where after clearing certain stages in the Simulation Gate, upon re-entering, hunters would enter outside the designated area and be unable to proceed to the next stage.

- Fixed the issue where clearing "Special Battle" stages in the Simulation Gate, except for the final stage, was not counted for the "Clear Special Battle" weekly mission.

- Fixed the issue where the Core "Limbs of the Watcher (Sung Jinwoo)" had incorrect activation conditions.

- Fixed the issue where Chapter 33 of the Challenges would intermittently not progress correctly.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: ReAwakening

Hunters Association
|
Feb 21, 2025, 09:00
|
46,581

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

Today, we will be addressing the March update details that our Hunters are waiting for and sharing news regarding the updates scheduled for further in the future.

 

 

 

🎉 Thank you for leading the way in conquering Gates for 300 days! 🎉

 

Hunters, do you remember the first day to enter the Gates?

Thank you for always being with us at the Hunters Association!

 

It has already been 300 days since Hunters began leveling up, clearing Gates one by one.

 

Why not place your hand on the Mana Meter now?

You might receive a surprising result, perhaps even the birth of a National-Level Hunter! 😁

 

Just as you have grown beyond expectations, the Solo Leveling:ARISE project team continues to level up endlessly to bring you even more dynamic action.

 

We would like to take this moment to express our gratitude to all Hunters who have shared their valuable feedback, enabling us to keep improving.

 

As we approach the first anniversary of Solo Leveling:ARISE and SLC 2025, please look forward to what's to come. We will continue striving to provide even better service!

 

[300th Day Celebration Developer Note Surprise Gift]

Redeem Code

Reward

SLVDEVNOTE300

- Essence Stones x3,000

- Custom Draw Ticket x10

- Skill Rune Premium Chest Vol. 4 x3

 

[ReAwakening]

 

Through past official livestreams and various channels, we have heard the concerns from Hunters regarding the lack of challenge content after reaching a certain level of growth.

 

In March and April, we are focusing on improving the challenge content and introducing new growth elements that many of you have requested. We would like to take this opportunity to share the upcoming plans with you, one by one.

 

Updates Scheduled for March

- The maximum level for Sung Jinwoo will be expanded from Lv. 100 to Lv. 105.
*  New Sung Jinwoo Job Change will be added.
*  Sung Jinwoo level achievement rewards will be added.
- 44 - 45 tier Gates will be added.
- Challenges will be expanded to add chapters until 38.
- Battle tier will be expanded to tier 60.
- Shadow skill level up feature will be added.
- Simulation Gate will be converted into a regular season.
*  The Effect Amplification will reset and used Memory Chips will be returned.
*  After the regular season, the required number of Memory Chips for Effect Amplification will be adjusted.
*  Simulation Gate Codex will be added that consists of Episode / Collection / Code.
*  The time attack in the Special Battle section will be removed.
*  When failing the battle, you will be able to choose whether to retry once or finalize the battle.

*  If you have reached the maximum retry counts, finalization will proceed.

*  When pausing in the battle area, you can select the retry button.
*  Difficulty will be expanded.
- Artifact instance enhancement system will be added.
*  Instant enhancement now allows you to skip enhancement animations and upgrade directly to your target level at once.
*  If required materials are insufficient, the enhancement will stop.
- Workshop of Brilliant Light - Deimos will now feature Proof of the Strong, allowing you to showcase your strength.
- A new growth system will be introduced for Legendary Skill Runes and Blessing Stones.

 

We would like to provide more details on the new growth system for Legendary Skill Runes and Blessing Stones, which many Hunters might be curious about.

 

The official name for this new growth system has not been finalized yet, but internally, we are referring to it as Refinement and Amplification (these names may also be officially adopted).

 

First, Refinement is a system that allows Hunters who own a Legendary Skill Rune or Blessing Stone to consume materials and obtain a higher-grade Skill Rune or Blessing Stone.

It is designed to guarantee the acquisition of a higher-grade item rather than relying on a random system, which we believe will be well received by many Hunters.

 

Skill Runes and Blessing Stones obtained through Refinement can then undergo further growth through the Amplification system.

 

Amplification is a system that allows Hunters to strengthen their higher-grade Skill Runes and Blessing Stones by using duplicate ones, enabling them to achieve even more powerful effects.

 

The Refinement system is scheduled to be added in the March update, while the Amplification system will be introduced in the April update.

 

Additionally, to coincide with the introduction of these features, we plan to hold an event that will increase the overall supply of Rune Fragments and Powder of Blessing, so please look forward to it!

 

Updates Scheduled for April

- The maximum floor of the Battlefield of Trials will be expanded, offering new challenges.
- The Armory will be expanded.
- A Hard difficulty will be added to the Reverse Story.
- A new growth system and Refinement system for Artifacts will be introduced.
- Multiplier play will be added to Simulation Gate.
- The Guild Boss Rage Battle (working title) will begin, allowing you to prove your strength.

 

We have carefully reviewed your valuable feedback regarding Guild contribution through various community channels.

 

First and foremost, we sincerely apologize for the lack of clear guidance on the Guild Rank System.

 

Based on your feedback, we are currently improving the Guild content guide, and we are also working on enhancements to the Guild contribution system.

 

As part of this effort, we plan to introduce the Guild Boss Rage Battle (working title) in the April update.

Rewards will be distributed based on the Rage Count, so please look forward to it!

 

[Fusion System Improvement]

 

The Fusion system for Skill Runes and Blessing Stones was introduced to provide an additional way to utilize duplicate Legendary Skill Runes and Blessing Stones.

 

However, we recognize that the current system requires an excessive amount of Essence Stones to obtain the desired Skill Runes and Blessing Stones. We deeply empathize with the concerns raised by our Hunters regarding this issue.

 

To address this, our team is planning to improve the Fusion system in the March update.

With the improved system, Hunters will be able to directly set their desired outcome, and by meeting specific conditions, they will be able to obtain the exact result they want.

 

For those preparing for Fusion, we recommend taking a brief pause and looking forward to a more efficient Fusion experience after the March update!

 

[Hidden Stage - Yogumunt]

 

 

At that moment, an unexpected sight unfolded before their eyes.

The missing raid members were gathered not far away.

Letting out a sigh of relief at the thought of having one less problem to deal with, Sung Jinwoo approached them to check their condition.

 

But something was off.

The raid members stood motionless, heads bowed, as if their minds were completely absent.

 

Then, all at once,

They clutched their heads, letting out agonized groans of pain.

 

Just like the Mage Magic Beasts he had encountered in the past,

a horrifying transformation began.

 

In mere moments, an unbelievable sight lay before them.

Every single raid member had morphed into creatures tainted with the "Aura of the Beasts".

Their forms were no longer human,

they had become monsters.

 

And then, all of a sudden, the transformed Beasts lost all sense of reason and charged toward Sung Jinwoo and his party.

 

Will they manage to conquer this labyrinth and uncover the hidden truth?

Or is all of this part of someone’s grand design?

 

- Excerpt from Yogmund -

 

[Need a cup of hot black tea?]

 

 

Finally, she will join the Gate Raid through the April update.

Most of the Hunters will already be familiar with her greetings.

 

With her cold and confident charm, she enjoys the thrill of riding a motorbike.

 

Look forward to her upcoming feats!

 

[Ant King: Final Battle]

 

The upcoming Ant King Raid is a team-based battle where three Hunters fight together while sharing HP.

(Why not extend a hand to Guild members who may need your support?)

 

During combat, Hunters can earn additional contribution rewards based on their damage dealt, survival status, and specific actions, in addition to the standard clear rewards.

 

Now, it's time to prepare for the final battle against the Ant King.

 

Until the day we reclaim Jeju Island, we will always stand by and support our Hunters!

 

 

Hunters, that’s all for today’s news.

The Solo Leveling:ARISE team is putting a lot of effort into preparing for our first anniversary, and we ask for your great anticipation.

 

We’ll be sure to greet you through the official livestream and SLC 2025.

Thank you!

 

* The redeem code can only be used once per account and the rewards will be sent immediately upon usage.

* The redeem code can be used until 2/28 (Fri) 14:59 (UTC+0), and will not be able to be used after the designated period.

 

 - Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

text_en:
Notices

Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship 2025 Finals Participation Notice

Hunters Association
|
Mar 10, 2025, 08:00
|
1,051

 

 

Greetings, Hunters

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

After a fierce competition, the Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship 2025 preliminaries. that was held since February, has come to an end!

 

We express our utmost gratitude to all the Hunters who have participated in the Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship 2025 preliminaries.

 

As stated in the Championship rules, all the Hunters participating in the offline championship must submit an English nickname and for those who have no English nickname, must change their nickname into English.

 

As the finals for the Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship 2025 is scheduled to be held offline at the venue, a survey will be conducted to confirm participants' availability for on-site attendance.

 

We will provide access to the survey through forum announcements and in-game notifications.

Please make sure to check and participate in the survey.

 

 

📢 Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship 2025 Finals Participation Notice

 

📌 Championship Participation Schedule for Finalists

Championship Participation Schedule

4/8 (Tue) - 4/12 (Sat)

* For the convenience of the finalists, we can coordinate flight schedules and arrival dates in advance.

* However, as pre-interviews and profile photoshoots are planned for the finalists, we recommend arriving by April 8 (Tue), four days before the competition, to ensure a smooth schedule and proper condition management.

 

📌 Finalists Detailed Schedule

Date

Scheduled Details

4/8 (Tue)

▶ Hunters Arrival & Personal Preparation

4/9 (Wed)

▶ Profile Photoshoots

▶ Pre-interviews

4/10 (Thu)

▶ Hunters OT 

▶ Hunters Personal Preparation

4/11 (Fri)

▶ Hunters Personal Preparation

4/12 (Sat)

Finals

* This schedule serves as a guideline for finalists and may vary based on individually coordinated arrangements.

* All Hunters will be accompanied by a dedicated guide (for interpretation, transportation, etc.) from arrival at the venue or entry into the country until departure (end of the championship).

* A separate practice area can be provided upon request.

 

📌 Finals Tournament Format & Rules

- The details regarding finals tournament format & rules can be seen through the link below.

👉 [Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship 2025 Rules]

 

📌 Survey

📍 Survey Participants

- Top rank Hunters of each league (International / Asia) based on the preliminaries result after the end of the period on 3/10 (Mon) 00:00 (UTC+0).

* Even if you submit your intention of participation through the survey, it does not guarantee final confirmation for the finals. The finalists will be contacted individually in ranking order among those confirmed for on-site attendance.

* Please note that finalists will be determined based on championship rules from those who have confirmed their participation.

* Selected finalists will receive individual notifications via in-game mail, sent to the account information provided in the survey.

* Even if you have received a notification email regarding your participation in the finals, you will be excluded from the list of finalists if any violations of the championship rules, such as proxy play or abusing, are found.

* You can check the top rankings for each league through the link below.

👉 [Preliminaries Ranking]

 

📍 Survey Period

- 3/10 (Mon) 08:00 - 3/12 (Wed) 00:00 (UTC+0)

 

📍 How to Paricipate in the Survey

- Participate in the survey through forum notice / in-game mail.

 

👉 [Participate in the Survey]

 

* The corresponding survey is conducted for top ranking Hunters of Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship 2025 preliminaries. 

* If you do not submit the survey within the designated period, you will be considered as unable to participate in the finals.

* If you have submitted wrong information in the survey, you can participate in the survey again.

* If you have submitted the survey multiple times, the latest survey submitted will be reviewed as your final submission.

* The finals will be held with separately set accounts and if you confirm your on-site participation but fail to attend or leave during the championship, you may face restrictions on future events and tournaments. Please make sure to thoroughly review and understand the championship rules, including the above details.

👉 [Solo Leveling:ARISE 2025 Rules]

* Prizes will be awarded after deductions in accordance with the regulations of each region, and physical prizes will be shipped after the winner covers any applicable taxes.

* In accordance with the championship rules, it is recommended that you change and use an English nickname.

 

 

The journey to the Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship 2025 finals and the final match is almost here!

Make sure to participate on-site and showcase your burning desire to become the strongest Hunter.

 

Thank you.

3/11 (Tue) Developer Livestream Video Summary

Hunters Association
|
Mar 12, 2025, 10:00
|
8,329

 

📢 3/11 (Tue) Developer Livestream Video Summary

* Please note that the content below is excerpted and translated from the inven article "New original story and the arrival of Goto Ryuji! SLA March Developer Livestream" that summarized the 3/11 (Tue) Developer Liverstream.

[View Original Text]

 

👉 [3/11 (Tue) Developer Livestream Video]

* To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

Code

Reward

Expiration Date (UTC+0)

ARISEBESTE

Special Design x2

Weapon Enhancement Gear III x20

Until 2025/3/20 (Thu)

23:59

SHADOWUP77

Traces of Shadow x50

Shadow Energy x1,000

03SPRINGEVENT13

Essence Stones x1,000

Advanced Mana Crystal x100

Gold x500,000

 

 

 

📌 Q&A

 

Q. Are there any planned balance patches for underutilized Runes or Blessing Stones?

- So far, we have focused on balancing content and rewards. However, if Skill Runes are left unattended, it could lead to build stagnation, so we plan to implement improvements. A total of 21 Skill Runes will be buffed in various ways, including increased damage output and reduced mana consumption. Additionally, 10 Blessing Stones will receive performance enhancements. Detailed information will be provided in an upcoming notice.

 

Q. Improvements are required for duplicate Rune/Blessing Stone acquisition.

- There have been many inquiries about the reroll system, and it has been frequently discussed in livestreams. We have put a lot of thought into this. While we cannot retroactively compensate for the stress caused by past rerolls, we have decided to move forward by addressing this issue. The Fusion system will be improved, allowing Hunters to select a desired Rune or Blessing Stone and attempt a transformation. The refinement system will include a 10-attempt pity system, ensuring that if a hunter does not obtain the targeted Rune or Blessing Stone within 10 attempts, they will be guaranteed to receive it.

If Hunters acquire the targeted Rune or Blessing Stone through other means while accumulating pity points, they will not lose their progress. Instead, they can reassign the accumulated points to a different target, reducing the burden on Hunters.

 

Q. There is a severe shortage of Advanced Mana Crystals.

- With higher-tier growth now available, the shortage of Advanced Mana Crystals is indeed an issue.

To address this quickly, we have increased the exchange limit for Advanced Mana Crystals in the shop from 50 to 100.

Additionally, we will expand supply routes, such as event rewards, to further increase availability.

 

Q. We want to obtain Sung Jinwoo’s event weapons from the past.

- Weapons from past events, including Gold-tailed Fox, will be made available again through an upcoming event (Exciting Spring Outing).

 

Q. Too many Artifacts drop from a single source, making it difficult to obtain desired ones.

- We recognize that the current drop system makes it challenging to acquire specific Artifacts.

To improve this, we are considering adjustments in various ways, ensuring a more structured way to obtain desired Artifacts.

Further details will be shared through future notices.

 

📌 Real Time Q&A

 

Q. Any updates regarding Guild Boss?

- We are preparing a system where guilds can compete based on Rage stats.

Please stay tuned, as this feature will be available soon.

 

Q. Are there any plans to increase Critical Hit Rate?

- The maximum Critical Hit Rate that can be set is 50%.

However, there are already various buffs and effects available during combat that allow Hunters to significantly increase their Critical Hit Rate.

There are also strategies that leverage this aspect.

We suggest considering these elements as part of your setup and strategies to maximize your Critical Hit Rate potential.

 

Q. Are there any plans to introduce a Global Ranking System?

- We are aware that many Hunters are interested in a Global Ranking system in addition to the group rankings.

It is currently in development, and you will be able to experience it soon.

 

Q. The red dot notification bug is still occurring.

- We conducted a thorough check with the QA team and held additional meetings to ensure this issue does not persist.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and will work to improve it.

 

Q. Can the number of Simulation Gate tickets be increased?

- There are no immediate plans to increase the ticket limit.

However, with the next update introducing multiplier play, we will adjust the ticket limit accordingly at that time.

 

Q. Can a practice mode be added to Workshop of Brilliant Light without requiring tickets?

- This could be helpful for improving proficiency. We will review the possibility and work on implementing it.

 

Q. The animation effect during consecutive Enchantment feels slow and frustrating.

- The development has been completed, and an update will be implemented to make Enchantment instant.

 

Q. There isn’t much to do with the Gem system.

- We initially focused on improving Blessing Stones and Skill Runes, which led to less immediate attention on the Gem system. However, we recognize that some Hunters have already fully optimized their Gems. We will prepare an update to address this soon.

 

Q. Are there any plans for an Artifact Reset event?

- We will schedule Artifact crafting and reset events periodically at appropriate times.

 

Q. Salvaging Artifacts is inconvenient and cumbersome.

- We previously made improvements, but it seems there are still inconveniences.

We will discuss this internally and determine additional improvement measures.

 

Q. Optimization improvements are needed.

- The development team has been working on memory optimization. However, due to the large scale of this update, critical bugs were discovered during the QA process. We are currently fixing these issues, but unfortunately, we couldn't apply the improvements in this update. We will ensure everything is properly refined and apply the optimizations in the next update.

 

Q. Please fix the Artifact Preset bug.

- There was a bug where the preset would switch inconsistently, applying a different setup instead of the one used to clear a stage. This issue will be fixed in the upcoming update.

 

Q. Please provide an explanation regarding the wrongful bans.

- In the early stages after launch, there were a significant number of Hunters achieving impossibly high records.

To address this, we implemented an automated Faction of the Shield to detect and handle such cases.

As the system continued to learn and improve, some false bans did occur while identifying malicious users.

However, even when abnormal gameplay is detected, we do not immediately enforce penalties. Instead, we send a warning email first.

We understand that receiving such an email may have been upsetting. If a Hunter is found to be innocent, the warning record will be removed.

We ask for your understanding as we continue refining the system.

 

Q. Can the costumes distributed during the event period be obtained again?

- We believe that selling costumes directly after the event period is not the right approach.

Since these costumes were rewards for playing during the event, they should ideally be obtained through the event itself.

However, we will consider ways to allow Hunters to obtain missed rewards through other means.

 

Q. Sung Jinwoo's mouth does not move in the mobile version.

- If the graphic settings are set to “low,” the mouth may not move due to memory optimization.

To resolve this, we recommend increasing the character quality setting, which should fix the issue.

 

Q. There are insufficient Gold and Subscription benefits.

- We are continuously discussing with the business team to expand the rewards for subscriptions.

Additionally, we will provide extra Gold through upcoming events.

 

Q. Are there any plans for collaborations?

- While there are plans for collaborations, it is currently at a stage where we cannot provide details.

Preparations are underway, and we will provide information once it is ready to be publicly announced.

 

📌 March Update & Upcoming Improvements

 

■ New Original Story - Yogumunt

 

A new original story focusing on monarch Yogumunt will be released.

In the original work, Yogumunt is a monarch with exceptional magical abilities, capable of creating Gates, but there are very few combat scenes, and many details were skipped. The development team has expanded this into an original story.

 

The story is highly engaging, revolving around the various secrets tied to Yogumunt.

It also features the generals who serve the monarchs, and hunters will have the chance to encounter the incredibly beautiful vampire Bedelia and the executioner Davorka.

 

Since it’s a story chapter, the difficulty will not be very high, so new and returning Hunters will be able to enjoy it easily.

 

▲ The original story related to monarch, Yogumunt will be updated.

 

 ▲ New commander, vampire Bedelia

 

▲ You will face the executor Davorka. As this will be added to story mode, the difficulty will not be set too high.

 

■ Sung Jinwoo Level 100 → 105 Expansion

 

The maximum level for Sung Jinwoo will be increased from 100 to 105.

At the same time, the Activity Funds reward tier will be expanded, and the Gate difficulty will increase from level 43 to 45.

 

To achieve the new class, "Adversary", Hunters will need to reach a combat power of 200,000, clear the new story, and clear Trial of the Battlefield at Floor 45.

New content will include an expanded Blessing Stones slot, the Mana Powered Shield Blessing Stone, and a new costume. The Job Change battle will be set in a space similar to where the monarchs fought, providing a familiar feeling.

 

  ▲ The maximum level for Sung Jinwoo will be increased from 100 to 105.

 

▲ New Job Change Adversary, Blessing Stone Slot expansion and new Blessing Stone “Mana Powered Shield” will be provided.

 

■ Freeze Support and Defense Penetration Buff! New Shadow: Beste

 

After the Ice Witch Beste was defeated by Sung Jinwoo, she joins the army and becomes a new shadow under the name Beste. As Beste originally specialized in freeze magic, Beste possesses a skill that freezes enemies.

With her leader effect, she provides a Defense Penetration increase, and additionally, her Skills grant Defense Penetration buffs to her teammates.

 

Recently, a lot of research has been done regarding Defense Penetration. While the release of the Queen Ant has somewhat diminished the Defense Penetration trend, it’s still true that high-level boss strategies require around 40% Defense Penetration.

Moreover, the meta tends to cycle, and with the release of bosses with high defense in the future, Beste will retain her unique merit.

 

▲ Beste provides freeze ability along with Defense Penetration effect.

 

■ Shadow Skill Growth System

 

Following the enhancement of Shadow Armaments, the Skill Growth System is now being introduced. In response to feedback regarding the Shadows' performance being too weak, this system allows Hunters to increase the damage of the skills used by Shadows by leveling them up.

 

The materials required for Shadow Skill growth can be obtained through Gate play and are also available in the exchange shop. As with other items, higher-level materials can be crafted, and with skill growth, the performance of the Shadows is expected to be significantly strengthened.

 

▲ The implementation of Shadow Skill growth system, combat ability will increase.

 

■ Feel the Speed with the Wind Attribute Breaker! New Hunter: Goto Ryuji

 

Goto Ryuji, the leader of the Japanese team who appeared in the Jeju Island Raid, is an S-rank Hunter with semi-national power, and he is now released. Goto Ryuji, as a wind-attribute breaker, executes extremely speedy attacks that cover a wide range.

 

He can use his slash technique (Q) up to 6 times consecutively, stacking critical hit or damage buffs, and finishing the cycle with his wide-area attack (E). In addition to his performance as a breaker, he also provides wind-attribute team buffs, making him a potential core member of the wind-attribute party, possibly replacing Woo Jinchul.

 

▲ The new Hunter, Goto Ryuji, is a next-generation Wind Attribute Breaker with team buffs.

 

■ Instance Dungeon & Encore Missions New Boss

 

The Poison-toothed Giant Desert Centipede and Hobgoblin Leader, who appeared in the original work, will join as bosses. The Poison-toothed Giant Desert Centipede can be encountered during Encore Missions, while the Hobgoblin Leader will appear in an Instance Dungeon.

 

▲ The Poison-toothed Giant Desert Centipede and Hobgoblin Leader, which were encountered in the story and events, will join as bosses.

 

■ Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Final Act

 

The final chapter of the Jeju Island Alliance Raid begins. This chapter, depicting the blood battle with the Ant King, takes the concept of multiple Hunters teaming up to the next level by emphasizing real-time collaboration with other Hunters.

 

The battle will proceed with a matchmaking system, where, once partner matching is complete, each Hunter will tackle the Ant King, whose health is shared among the participants. While typical MMORPG party play is challenging to implement in a mobile environment, this feature allows Hunters to see their contributions to the boss's health depletion, adding an extra layer of involvement.

 

The matchmaking will be divided into three groups based on Battle Tiers, allowing Hunters to join forces with higher-powered teammates. As a main reward, a Legendary Skill Rune Random Chest will be provided, along with various other growth resources.

 

 

▲ The final battle with the Ant King, Beru, will be conducted in a matchmaking format, further emphasizing the collaborative aspect of the fight.

 

■ The true test of a master, the Proof of the Strong: Deimos.

 

The "Deimos Proof of the Strong" content is a new addition following the closure of "Baran Proof of the Strong." It targets the top 0.00X% of hunters, offering a real challenge for those at the highest levels.

 

The difficulty ramps up significantly with 10 stages, designed to be accessible at the easier levels but pushing even the most elite players to their limits. It's a system that emphasizes the thrill of challenging the best, and ongoing updates will continue to refine the experience.

 

▲ "Deimos Proof of the Strong" is truly content designed for the "true elites," the ultimate challenge for the top Hunters.

 

■ Transcendence: Guaranteed Growth! Skill Rune / Blessing Stone Growth

 

As previously mentioned, Skill Runes and Blessing Stones can now grow into Transcendent grade. This growth process is done through a method called "Synthesis," and the options will follow the base of the Legendary grade item used, rather than being random.

 

The materials required for Transcendence can be obtained through the Power of Destruction, Guild Exchange Shop, and Simulation Gate. Additionally, excess Legendary Runes obtained from duplicates can be used as materials. If you acquire a Legendary Rune or stone that you didn’t have before, it will feel rewarding, and even if you get one you already had, it can be used as a material for Transcendence.

 

▲ You can grow Skill Rune/Blessing Stone to Transcendent grade through the Synthesis feature.

 

■ Difficulty, Skills, Code – All Improved! Simulation Gate: Regular Season

 

The Simulation Gate exits its beta service and enters the Regular Season. While opinions on the fun of the Simulation Gate were divided, the regular season has been renewed to offer a wider variety of enjoyment.

 

First, a new codex and achievement systems are added, and the difficulty is divided into 30 stages. The previous gap between stages, particularly between stages 15 and 16, was too steep, making it easy to clear the lower levels but impossible to progress to the next. This has been adjusted to offer a smoother progression. With the increase in stages, the difficulty in the new 30 stages will be higher compared to the previous 15.

 

The skill tree for the Simulation Gate has also been improved, and any previously used points will be refunded for reuse. Notably, the time attack feature has been removed, making it easier to play, and save points have been added, allowing you to resume from a specific point. Additionally, after losing, Hunters can now attempt a retry once, reducing stress.

 

In addition, new codes have been added, and code balance adjustments have been made. By stacking high-performance codes effectively, Hunters will be able to clear stages that are higher than their combat power.

 

▲ The Simulation Gate Regular Season is being released after numerous fixes and improvements.

 

■ New Wind Attribute Longsword: Stormbringer will be released (3/27 (Thu))

 

With the release of Goto Ryuji, the Stormbringer, a new weapon of the same attribute, joins the game. This wind-attribute longsword enhances the speed of regular attacks, core attacks, and skills according to Sung Jinwoo's strength stat.

 

Additionally, when the weapon skill hits, it triggers a buff that increases the damage of wind-attribute skills, making it even more powerful when paired with new transcendental skills. This design allows for a much stronger performance when using a wind-attribute deck. In fact, the upcoming battle with the Ant King Beru in this update is structured around the wind-attribute weakness, allowing Hunters to fully utilize the weapon's power.

 

▲ The new weapon, Stormbringer, is designed to strengthen wind-attribute specialized decks.

 

📌 Events & Other Content

 

■ Get the Past Sung Jinwoo Event Weapon Again! Spring Outing Event

In this event, a variety of mini-games will be offered. In the running race, Hunters must dodge enemy traps, break obstacles blocking the path, and use extreme evasion techniques to reach the goal. A new boss with a spring-themed costume will also make an appearance.

 

As part of the spring-themed missions, Hunters can earn a new costume for Jina, along with 100 Custom Draw Tickets, a new icon, and frame through check-in rewards. In the Boss Challenge, a random chest containing the previous Sung Jinwoo event weapons, such as Secured Marlin Surfboard, Juicy Grilled Skewer, Spooky Pumpkin, and Gold-tailed Fox will be available.

Additionally, there will be opportunities to obtain chests where Hunters can choose their desired rewards.

 

 ▲ Spring Outing Event: Offering New Fun with Running Events and Boss Challenges

 

▲ Amazing Rewards: 100 Custom Draw Tickets and Gold-tailed Fox

 

■ SLC 2025 Finals: Solo Leveling Merch, Mini-Games, Cosplay, and Intense Main Competitions!

The SLC 2025 Finals will be held on April 12th at Gwangmyeong Ibex Studio. The event will be broadcast live in Korean, Japanese, and English, and tickets are available for purchase through the ticket link. Limited edition merchandise will be given out at the venue, and participants who join the mini-games in the event zone will receive special gifts.

 

While there won't be a separate developer live stream in April, updates will be provided through the second half of the roadmap revealed at the event, as well as through Developer Note.
* Due to a lack of information about the schedule during the broadcast, we are providing the corrected details.

 

▲ On April 12th, the SLC 2025 Finals will arrive, filled with a wealth of exciting activities!

 

■ April Update Preview

 

A higher-level Artifact will be released, and a new feature allowing Hunters to refine existing Artifacts to upgrade them to higher levels will also be introduced. To obtain these high-level Artifacts, Hunters will need to challenge higher-difficulty Encore Missions and Instance Dungeons, and this expansion of content is being prepared accordingly.

 

In particular, for this high-level Artifact update, previously underused Artifact sets will not be included, and the addition of new set items is also under consideration. Furthermore, the Armory level and pages will be expanded, and as previously mentioned, the Guild Boss Rage Battle will be available in the April update.

 

Additionally, the new hunter, Seorin, who has always welcomed Hunters in the Hunters Association lobby, will be joining as a playable character.

 

 ▲ The expansion of higher-level Artifacts and Artifact refining will be accompanied by the introduction of new challenges in Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions to obtain them.

 

▲ Armory Level/Page will be expanded and Guild Boss Rage Competition will begin.

 

▲ Lobby's very own, the woman in the information desk, Seorin, joins as a new playable Hunter!

 

 

Thank you.

📌 Skill Rune & Blessing Stone New Growth Element: Skill Research - Synthesis Feature

▶ New Transcendent Grade & Synthesis Feature

- A new Transcendent grade will be added to Skill Runes and Blessing Stones, and they can be obtained through Skill Research - Synthesis.

- Skill Rune and Blessing Stone synthesis can be accessed by tapping [Skill Research] from the Quick Menu in the lobby.

 

▶ How to Proceed With Skill Rune & Blessing Stone Synthesis

- Only Legendary grade Skill Runes and Blessing Stones in possession can be synthesized. The synthesis process requires extra Legendary grade Skill Runes/Blessing Stones from your inventory as materials, along with a [Transcendent Stone] for the target of synthesis.

* The extra Legendary grade Skill Runes/Blessing Stones used as materials do not need to be of the same type as the target.

* Rare and Heroic grade Skill Runes and Blessing Stones cannot be used for synthesis.

* The Transcendent Stones required for Synthesis can be obtained through the Battlefield of Time Exchange Shop, Guild Exchange Shop, and Power of Destruction rewards.

 

📌 New Blessing Stone

- New Survival type Blessing Stone [Mana Powered Shield] will be added.

* The new Blessing Stones are available in Rare, Heroic, Legendary, and Transcendent grades.

For more details, please check in-game.

* The new Blessing Stones will be added to the Synthesis lineup, and the acquisition rates of each item will be adjusted.

However, the acquisition rates for each grade (Rare/Heroic/Legendary) will remain the same as before.

* For the Blessing Stone Premium/Lucky Chests, a new version (Vol. 5) will be introduced, including the newly added Blessing Stones.

Blessing Stone Premium/Lucky Chests Vol. 4 will remain available as the previous version, which does not include the newly added Blessing Stone, and can still be used as before.

 

📌 New Shadow Growth Element: Shadow Skill Level Up

- A new Shadow Skill Level Up feature will be added where Hunters can enhance Army of Shadows’ skills.

- In the Shadow management screen, you can level up the skills of each shadow and skill levels increase, the skill damage dealt by the shadow and the combat power of the Army of Shadows will also rise.

- Shadow Skills can be enhanced starting from the Elite grade, with a maximum level of 5 for Elite grade Shadows and 10 for Elite Knight grade Shadows.

- Shadow Skill growth requires a new material, [Shadow Skill Scroll].

* Shadow Skill Scrolls can be obtained through Gates and Crafting.

* For Shadow Skills above level 8, [Mana Power Extract] is required, just like in Sung Jinwoo/Hunter Skill enhancement.

 

📌 Global Cooperation Event - Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Final Act

Hunters who have successfully defeated the Queen Ant, the final trial for the recapture of Jeju Island now awaits you.

The final chapter of the Jeju Island Alliance Raid Event begins, where you will face the Ant King in the ultimate battle.

 

For details on the event schedule and participation, please refer to the event announcement below.

[Global Cooperation Event - Jeju Island Alliance Raid: Final Act]

 

The final battle against the Ant King to reclaim Jeju Island begins! Wishing all Hunters the best of luck in this decisive showdown!
