📌 Skill Rune & Blessing Stone Refinement Feature Improvement

- The existing Legendary grade Skill Rune/Blessing Stone refinement feature will now be available in the Fusion menu.

Additionally, improvements have been made to allow selecting a desired Skill Rune/Blessing Stone as the refinement target.

* Only unowned Skill Runes/Blessing Stones can be set as the Fusion target.

- Upon a Super Success in refinement, the selected Fusion target Skill Rune/Blessing Stone will be obtained. If the selected target is not acquired, loyalty points will be accumulated.

- If the loyalty points reach 10, the next refinement will guarantee the acquisition of the selected Fusion target.

* The loyalty points reset upon a Super Success.

* If the selected Fusion target is obtained through other means, it must be changed before using the refinement feature.

* If all Legendary grade Skill Runes/Blessing Stones are owned, the refinement feature will no longer be available.

However, any remaining loyalty points will be retained and can be used when new Skill Runes/Blessing Stones are added in the future.

 

📌 Simulation Gate Regular Season & Improvements

The Simulation Gate, which was previously available in its Beta version, will be officially opened as a regular season after the maintenance.

With the launch of the regular season, the following adjustments and improvements will be applied.

 

▶ Addition of Higher Difficulties & Combat Power Adjustments for Each Tier

- The original 15 difficulties will be expanded to a maximum of 30 difficulties.

* When challenging a stage, you can skip lower stages and attempt a higher difficulty level directly.

If you clear a higher stage after skipping lower ones, all challenge objectives from the skipped stages will be considered completed.

- With the addition of new difficulty levels, the recommended combat power, monster levels, and base scores for existing stages will be adjusted.

 

▶ Algorithm of the Week Content Adjustment

- The content of the Algorithm of the Week will be adjusted, and in addition to harmful effects, beneficial effects that assist in strategy will also be applied.

The existing harmful effects will also be applied in a new form starting from the regular season.

 

▶ Balance Adjustment

- New Code and protocol effects [multithread] and [upscaling] will be added.

- Certain effects of the original codes and protocols will be adjusted.

- In certain episode stages, the success probability and rewards obtained based on choices will be adjusted.

- New Collection entries will be added, and the applicable classes and effects of existing Collections will be adjusted.

* For detailed information on codes, collections, and episode rewards, please check in-game.

- The default amount of Data Fragments awarded upon entry into the Simulation Gate will increase from 100 to 200.

- The amount of Data Fragments obtained per stage will be fixed at 100.

- The cost of code rerolls will be fixed at 50 Data Fragments, and you can reroll up to 3 times per stage.

- When obtaining duplicate codes or collections at their maximum level, the amount of Data Fragments received will be increased.

- The Data Fragment costs for facilities usage (formation, resurrection) and code enhancement in the System Management will be adjusted.

 

▶ Effect Amplification Tree Renewal & Activation Expansion

- The Effect Amplification Tree will be renewed, and the effect amplification activated during the beta season will be reset.

* The Memory Chips used for activation before the reset will be returned and can be used again.

- The number of active effect amplifications will expand from 81 to 140, allowing you to further enhance Hunter stats during Simulation Gate progression.

The expanded Effect Amplification Tree will feature not only existing effects but also new analytical effects that will assist with strategy and can be activated.

 

▶ New Archive Feature

- With the start of the regular season, the [Archive] where you can view your Simulation Gate records will be opened.

- In the Archive, you can check the episodes, collections, and codes obtained during Simulation Gate progression. For each record you collect, you will receive a Dimensional Discs as a reward.

 

▶ Other Improvements

- The Time Attack mode in special battles will be removed, and time will no longer pass during the pause screen while progressing through battles.

* As a result of the removal of Time Attack mode, related items will be removed from the score settlement screen.

- The Simulation Gate Lobby UI will be renewed to make it easier to check score achievement rewards and weekly Memory Chip acquisition status.

- In the Simulation Map and pause screen, you will now be able to view treasure chest rewards (Enchantment materials) more easily.

- The UI and animations will be improved to make it easier to check the acquisition, loss, grade changes, or protocol activations for codes during stages.

- A retry feature will be added to the pause screen, allowing you to retry the current stage during progress.

* Episodes and System Management zones cannot use the retry feature.

- Improvements will be made so that if you fail the strategy due to death or time over, you can retry the stage.

* Stage retries can be used only once.

- A Blessing Stone Transcendent Stone Selection Chest will be added to the Exchange List in the Simulation Exchange Shop.

 

📌 Other Content Improvement & Changes

▶ Battlefield of Trials Challenge New Season

- A new Battlefield of Time Challenge season will begin until the next update, and new rules will be applied to Player/Hunter modes.

* Please check the details on the challenge rules and rewards in-game.

 

▶ Workshop of Brilliant Light - Proof of the Strong will be added to the Spire of Transfiguration and will be removed from the Demons’ Castle Upper Floors

- The Proof of the Strong will be added to the Spire of Transfiguration Hard, allowing Hunters to challenge higher difficulties.

- The Proof of the Strong is available in Sung Jinwoo/Hunter modes when challenging the Hard Mode [Abyssal Execution Scaffold] stage.

- When clearing the Proof of the Strong applied stage, you can claim [Token of Absolute Strength] that can be used in the Proof of the Strong exchange shop.다.

- As the Proof of the Strong is added to the Spire of Transfiguration, the original Demons’ Castle Upper  Floors Proof of the Strong will be removed.

* The [Gold Medal: Baran] will no longer be able for exchange after the maintenance.

- The maximum Battle Tier will increase from 55 to 60, and rewards are obtainable when reaching each tier.

▶ New Crafting Item

- The [Special Design] will be added to the Weapon Material Exchange Shop list.

* As new items are added to the exchange shop list, the exchange limit in the Guild Exchange Shop will reset.

 

▶ Skill & Skill Rune UI Improvement

- The Skill equip screen for Sung Jinwoo will be improved to make it easier to check the currently equipped Rune type and rarity for each Skill.

- The Skill equip screen will be improved to display the currently applied attributes as icons for easier identification.

- A Break Effect icon will be added to skill effects for better visibility.

- The Skills tab in the Sung Jinwoo management menu will be improved to allow checking the full list of Blessing Stones and their owned/unowned status.

 

▶ Preset Management Feature Improvement

- Sung Jinwoo's existing equipment replacement presets will be integrated into the Player Presets and can be modified from the Preset Management menu.

* The previous Sung Jinwoo equipment preset replacement function will no longer be available. However, it will be applied to Player Presets 1–5 in Preset Management, allowing usage through preset changes.

- The Player/Hunter Mode preset list will be expanded from the existing 10 slots to a maximum of 20.

* The Guild Boss Mode preset will remain unchanged, with a maximum of 10 slots.

* The expanded list can be added by pressing the "+" button.

- A new function will be added to the Preset Management page, allowing Hunters to copy a preset and paste it into another preset.

- The Preset Management page UI will be improved, and a tag-setting feature will be added for each preset.

Hunters can assign tags to presets and use the preset filter before entering a stage to quickly search for the desired preset.

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Dimensional Advancement

Hunters Association
|
Mar 28, 2025, 08:09
|
43,710

 

Greetings Hunters,
This is Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

We are glad to inform you that the team is thoroughly preparing for not only the April update but also SLC and the upcoming anniversary. 

 

This time, the SLC 2025 is scheduled for 4/12 (Sat), replacing the official developer livestream.

 

For this reason, we are giving our Hunters a heads up on the upcoming updates through a developer note.

 

Please see below for more details.

 

 

[Artifact System Extensive Renewal (April Update)]

 

Our team has determined that the long-standing Artifact farming system has reached a point where change is necessary.
 

Many Hunters may have noticed that while Artifact completion has improved, diversity has decreased, leading to a decline in the enjoyment of farming.

 

This shift has naturally resulted in reduced interest in Instant Dungeons and Encore Missions, a concern we take seriously.
 

To restore the excitement of farming and expand strategic choices for Artifacts, we are preparing several improvements for all Hunters.

 

Instance Dungeon & Encore Missions Difficulty Expansion
-    To enhance the sense of growth and make dungeon challenges more engaging, the difficulty levels will be expanded from the current 20 stages to 30 stages.
-    The Proof of the Strong will be available after clearing expanded tier 30 accordingly.

 

Higher Level Artifact and New Artifact
With the expansion of difficulty levels in Instant Dungeon and Encore Missions, higher-level Artifacts will drop in certain higher-stage dungeons.
-    New Artifacts featuring unique set effects will also be introduced.
These Artifacts are expected to bring changes to the established equipment meta, offering Hunters a wider range of strategic choices.

 

Artifact Farming Improvements
-    To accommodate the addition of new Artifacts and adjust farming difficulty, certain Artifacts (Crimson Knight, Dragon Knight, High-ranking Demon, Holy, Skeleton, Behemoth, Red-eyed, Aquamarine) will no longer appear in higher-stage dungeons.

 

Artifact Acquisition Difficulty Improvement
-    Reflecting the feedback from many Hunters who found it difficult to farm specific Artifacts, we will be improving the system to allow direct selection and exchange of desired Artifacts using Proof of the Strong tokens.

 

[New Artifact Reforge System (April Update)]
Our team aims for well-farmed and enhanced Artifacts to be effectively utilized.
At times, a balanced synergy between newly introduced Artifacts and already optimized ones is essential.
To support this, we have developed the Artifact reforging system, allowing you to upgrade existing Artifacts.
Reforged Artifacts will see their performance enhanced to match the level of a new-tier Artifact.

 

The materials required for reforging can be obtained from Instant Dungeon and Encore Missions. 
 

Hunters, the time has come to prepare for the Yogumunt raid.
Only the ones prepared will be able to stop the massive threat in the upcoming battle.

 

[Guild All-Out War: Gathering Each Other's Strength] (Working Title)
With the April update, the previously introduced Guild Boss rage battle will be added as Guild All-Out War.
●    Guild Boss Renewal
○    Strategic Gameplay: Previously, Guild Boss battles involved Sung Jinwoo and nine Hunters, making it difficult to track the battle. The new system will limit teams to six Hunters per lineup, requiring more strategic play. Similar to Power of Destruction, Hunters in the first lineup cannot participate in the second lineup.
○    Attribute Adjustments: Guild Bosses will now have three attribute weaknesses instead of being weak to all attributes.
○    Rage Rewards & Balance Adjustments: The current 15 difficulty tiers have become outdated for stronger Hunters. The update will introduce more segmented difficulty levels, allowing powerful Hunters to earn even greater rewards. Additionally, National-Level Hunters will still be able to contribute beyond the highest reward tier by earning additional Guild Contribution points.
 

●    The new Guild All-Out War (Guild Boss Rage Battle) will allow Guilds to showcase their strength against each other.
○    Five Guilds of the same rank will be matched to compete.
○    The winner is determined by the priority order:  Total Rage generated against the Guild Boss > Total damage dealt to the Boss > Guild member participation rate
We will continue to enhance Guild content based on Hunters' feedback and in-game data to ensure a more engaging experience.

 

[Limit Break: Various Improvements & New Content (April & May Updates)]

 

In this developer note, we can share more details about the topics we briefly mentioned previously.

 

We will introduce the various updates planned for April and May, as well as the new content set to launch in May, one by one.

 

[April Update Details]
●    The maximum floors of Battlefield of Trials will be expanded to Floor 70, allowing Hunters for new challenges.
●    Armory expansion & Reverse Story hard mode will be added.
●    Battle Mission information display feature will be added.
-    From now on, Hunters will be able to locate the insufficient trophies more easily.
●    Water attribute Hunter Seorin will join the Gates raid.

 

[May Update Details (1-Year Anniversary Grand Update)]
●    1-Year Anniversary appreciation will begin.
●    Multiplay will be added for Simulation Gate.
●    New stories (Busan Knights Raid / School Dungeon Break) will be updated.

●    Gem equipping slots will be expanded.
●    The Skill Rune amplification system will be updated.
●    Sung Jinwoo's new Job Change and Yogumunt raid will be added. (The Remnant Power for Yogumunt will also be added.)
●    A memorial hunter will join in the hunter Gates raid.
- This is the story of a Hunter, quietly preserved in the faded records of a forgotten world.
●    A new Shadow will be added.
●    Pixiv Competition winning costume will be distributed.

 

[1-Year Anniversary & Future Plans]
"Solo Leveling:ARISE", which officially launched on May 8, 2024, is now approaching its first anniversary!
We would like to take this opportunity to sincerely thank all the Hunters who have been with us on this journey.

 

Moving forward, we will continue to deliver the best action experience while carefully crafting the beloved story content.

 

We hope you look forward to the next story update, "Sung Jinah Goes to School!"

 

 

This is for today.
As you enjoy the various updates planned for April and May, you will soon encounter new challenge content, including the Power of Destruction World Integrated Ranking and the expansion of Story Very Hard difficulty.

 

We look forward to your continued support and hope to see you soon at SLC 2025!

 

Thank you.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

- A new Reforge system will be added where Hunters can Reforge lower level Artifacts and enhance them to upper level Artifacts.

 

▶ How to Reforge Artifacts

- You can Reforge Artifacts in the Artifact Enhancement category and can Reforge Heroic/Legendary Artifacts with Lv. 70 - 78, regardless of the enhancement tier or Enchantment status.

* Normal/Rare and event Artifacts lower than Lv. 70 cannot be Reforged.

* Each Artifact can be Reforged only once and the enhancement tier and Enchantment status will remain the same as before.

 

- Reforging materials include Reforge Stones that match the rank of the Artifact being Reforged, as well as Gold. Artifacts that have been Reforged will display an extra Reforge icon for easy identification.

* Reforge Stones required for Reforging can be obtained through Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions.

* Artifacts that have been leveled up through Reforging will also be registered in the Codex, allowing you to receive Codex rewards.

 

📌 All-Out Guild War & Guild Boss Progress Adjustment

▶ All-Out Guild War

- Battle against the Guild Boss and compete the score with other Guilds through the All-Out Guild War.

- 5 Guilds will group as one and proceed with the All-Out Guild War. The rank will be determined based on the Guild Boss Rage counts.

- The Guild members who have participated in the Guild War will receive rank rewards and contributions after the end of the season.

* Rank D3 or higher Guilds are qualified for the All-Out Guild War.

* If the number of Rage counts is the same, rankings will be determined based on the total damage dealt to the Guild Boss.

 

▶ Guild Boss Progress Adjustment & Addition of Rage Rewards

- The Guild Boss progress will be adjusted and the number of Hunters that can be formed per challenge will reduce from 9 to 6.

Similar to the Power of Destruction, the Hunters used for the initial challenge will not be able to be formed in the next challenge.

* The formation limit resets every week and after using all the challenge counts, you can freely form all the Hunters in the practice mode.

- The weakness attributes for Guild Boss will reduce to 3 and the weakness attributes will be adjusted every update.

- The maximum rewards based on the Guild Boss Rage counts will be expanded. (Individual Reward: Up to 200 / Guild Cooperation Reward: Up to 4,500).

* As Guild Boss progress is being adjusted, the difficulty and rewards balance based on the number of Rage counts will be adjusted accordingly.

* Please check the details on the adjusted Rage rewards in-game.

 

📌 New SSR Hunter & Exclusive Weapon

- SSR Water attribute [Seorin] and exclusive weapon [Melody of Iron and Blood] will be added.

- This Hunter can be obtained through Rate Up Draw, and you can experience the power of this Hunter in advance through Hunter Preview.

- The exclusive weapon can be obtained through crafting or events.

- The new Hunters’ Profile Icon, Dossier, Codex, Bonds will also be added.

📌 Instance Dungeon & Encore Missions Difficulty Expansion

 

▶ Instance Dungeon & Encore Missions Difficulty Expansion

- Difficulty level for Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions will be expanded to tier 30.

* When clearing the Proof of the Strong content for each content, the next difficulty will open, starting from tier 22.

* When clearing a boss with specific difficulty, other bosses’ difficulty within the identical content will automatically open and become available for challenge.

- When clearing stages higher than tier 21, new Artifacts and Reforge Stones, that can be used to Reforge Artifacts, will be obtainable.

* After tier 21, the original Armors (Crimson Knight, Dragon Knight, High-ranking Demon, Holy) and Accessories (Skeleton, Behemoth, Red Eye, Aquamarine) will no longer be dropped.

- Starting from tier 26, each boss has additional specific rules applied. We recommend reviewing the current rule information before attempting a strategy.

- With the maximum difficulty being expanded, the "Proof of the Strong" feature will now be available after clearing tier 30.

* New Armory slots will open after reaching Battle Tier 45.

 

▶ Workshop of Brilliant Light Difficulty Adjustment & Spire of Transfiguration Proof of the Strong Tier Expansion

- The recommended combat power for all stages and all difficulty levels of the Workshop of Brilliant Light will be lowered, excluding the Demons' Castle Lower Floors on Easy difficulty and the Spire of the Transfiguration on Hard difficulty.

- The Proof of the Strong difficulty in the Spire of the Transfiguration (Hard) will be expanded from the current 10 tiers to 20 tiers, and new penalties will be introduced starting from tier 11.

 

▶ Battlefield of Time Season 9 Balance Adjustment

- The critical hit adjustment system will be applied in Battlefield of Time Season 9.

* If a critical hit does not land, the chance for the next attack to critically hit will significantly increase.

* If your critical hit rate exceeds the limit, the critical hit rate will be slightly reduced.

- Due to the implementation of the critical hit adjustment in Battlefield of Time, monster health will be slightly increased.

* This balance adjustment will take effect starting from Stage 2 of Battlefield of Time Season 9, after the 4/10 (Thu) update.

 

▶ Instance Dungeon/Encore Missions/Workshop of Brilliant Light New Conquest Mission Feature

- A new Conquest Mission feature will be added, allowing Hunters to claim rewards based on their accumulated clear count in Instance Dungeon, Encore Missions, and the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

* Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions share the same Conquest Mission, and rewards may vary depending on your Battle Tier level.

* For the Workshop of Brilliant Light Conquest Mission, stages that provide Blessing Buffs are not counted toward the clear total.

* Conquest Mission clear counts reset every Thursday at 00:00 (UTC+0).

 

▶ Simulation Gate Difficulty Related Adjustment

- The effects of certain Collections will be enhanced.

- The damage of the "Multithread" and "Upscaling" protocols will be increased.

- Rewards obtained from choices in certain Episode stages will be adjusted.

- Recommended combat power for difficulties level 16 and above will be displayed lower than before.

- Monster attack power will be reduced in difficulties level 23 and above.

- A specific pattern of [Data] Kang Taeshik appearing in Special Battle will be removed.

- The charge time of the break pattern used by [Data] Cha Hae-In in Special Battle will be increased.

 

▶ Battle Tier Expansion

- The Battle Tier will be expanded from 60 to 70 and achievement rewards are granted when reaching each tier.

 

▶ Crafting UI Improvement

- The Crafting tab will be reorganized into Event, Growth, and Weapon categories. Within each tab, additional subcategories will be introduced based on item usage, making it easier to locate the items you need to craft.

* In relation to the Crafting tab rework, the existing Fusion options using Powder of Blessing and Rune Fragments to create Blessing Stones and Skill Runes will be temporarily available under the Crafting category. [Added 4/10 (Thu) 06:03 (UTC+0)]

 

▶ Artifact Management Convenience Improvement

- A recommended sorting feature will be added to the Artifact equip screen for each Hunter, allowing Artifacts to be sorted based on the Hunter’s recommended stats.

- On the Hunter’s Artifact Management screen, the display method for the three recommended stats will be updated to show the total summed effects of the equipped Artifacts for each of those stats.

- When equipping or replacing an Artifact, if the selected Artifact has options that match the Hunter’s recommended stats, those options will now be visually highlighted.

- In the Artifact filtering menu, a new setting will allow you to select how many of your chosen sub-options or exclusion options must be included in the search results.

 

▶ In-Game Battle Mission Trophy Display Related Improvement

- A new feature will be added that allows you to view your Battle Mission trophy progress by content type via the magnifying glass icon next to the Battle Mission section in the Profile and Trophy Ranking screens.

- On the pre-entry information screen of stages with Battle Missions, icons will now display the rewards available upon completing each mission.

- The UI on the Story Chapter selection screen will be improved to make it easier to check cumulative Battle Mission rewards.

- The Story Battle Results screen will be updated to show how many more trophies are needed to obtain the next cumulative Battle Mission reward.

- Instance Dungeon, Encore Missions, and Battlefield of Chaos will be improved to allow easier checking of Battle Mission progress by field and stage.

- For stages with Battle Missions, progress and trophy acquisition will now be displayed in the top-left corner during gameplay.

* This feature can be toggled on or off via [Controls] – [Battle Mission Details] in the options menu.

- In Dispatch Mining Team, bulk dispatch will now prioritize older gates first.

- The boss selection screen in Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions will be improved to show recommended attributes for each boss.

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the issue in Chapter 22 Side Story [Operation Commenced] where monsters and NPCs did not appear correctly.

- Fixed the issue in the Battlefield of Time Esil Radiru stage where enemies would occasionally not appear after transitioning to Phase 2.

- Fixed the issue where some monsters in the Battlefield of Time had abnormally low HP.

- Fixed the issue in the Simulation Gate where activating the [Upscaling] protocol (2K/4K/8K) incorrectly reduced Amamiya Mirei’s basic skill cooldown.

- Fixed the issue in the Simulation Gate where the HP increase effects from [Upscaling] and [Multithread] only increased max HP without adjusting current HP.

- Fixed the issue in the Simulation Gate where retrying after a forced exit due to full party wipe would incorrectly restore all Hunters’ HP.

- Fixed the issue where re-entering the Simulation Gate under specific conditions after exiting would trigger an error pop-up and force auto-calculation without retry.

- Fixed the issue where Artifact effects assigned in a preset would not apply correctly in certain situations.

- Fixed the issue where changing Sung Jinwoo's weapon in the stage formation screen would forcibly unequip his QTE Skill Rune.

- Fixed the issue where an error pop-up would appear when changing Hunter Artifact slots via presets.

- Fixed the intermittent issue where a Hunter could not be assigned to the first party slot.

- Fixed the issue where Hunter Pass experience required for leveling after reaching Lv.MAX was incorrectly set to 101.

- Fixed the issue with incorrect achievement conditions for Challenge Medals "Reliable Cooperator."

- Fixed incorrect text in Hunter Previews and skill descriptions.

- Fixed the issue where using the character reset button during certain Hunter Previews would cause input to be disabled or break progression.

- Fixed the issue where the Silent Slash skill of Shadow Blades used an animation different from the skill description.

- Fixed abnormal behavior in the skill preview of the Tusk skill "Claws of the Rampaging Fire Dragon."

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

A recommended update is scheduled for 4/12 (Sat) to fix an in-game error.

 

You can proceed with the recommended update through the market you are currently using.

 

Please see below for more details.

 

 

📌 Update Details

- Fixed the issue where weapon level-up/limit break/advancement stats were not updated in the UI when the Hunter had the weapon equipped, even though the changes were correctly applied.

- Fixed the issue where selecting a specific Shadow on the Army of Shadows screen would sometimes select a different Shadow instead.

- Fixed the issue where selecting an empty slot in the Crafting tab would display the previously selected recipe.

- Fixed the issue where tapping an unrelated icon among the Gate rewards would still show a description related to the Core.

- Fixed the issue on iOS devices where using certain skills would be canceled if Freeze or Stun was applied during the animation.

- Fixed the issue where an error pop-up appeared after tapping an empty slot on the Artifact equip screen and then attempting to enhance an Artifact.

- Fixed the intermittent issue during Artifact Reforge where the expected stat result would be lower than the current stat.

* If Artifact Reforge was performed before this fix and resulted in a stat lower than the original, the stat will now be updated to reflect the correct value.

 

▶ How to Download Recommended Update Data (AOS)

1. Search for “Solo Leveling:ARISE” in the Google Play Store.

2. Proceed with manual update.

 

▶ How to Download Recommended Update Data (PC)

1. Select “Solo Leveling:ARISE” in the Netmarble Launcher.

2. Click the Update button.

 

▶ How to Download Recommended Update Data

1. Search for “Solo Leveling:ARISE” in the App Store.

2. Proceed with manual update.

Developer Note: [D-14] 1st Anniversary

Hunters Association
|
Apr 24, 2025, 08:30
|
57,348

 

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

Today, we will be addressing various news sources before the arrival of the 1-year anniversary since the grand launch.

 

 

[The Conclusion of the SLC 2025]

 

 

Our team poured everything we had into preparing for SLC 2025, sprinting non-stop from the very beginning.

 

We debated endlessly on which boss should headline the championship? How should the leagues be divided?

And above all, how can we present Solo Leveling:ARISE's very first global championship to our Hunters in the best possible way?

 

Every step of the process was filled with constant deliberation and challenges. 😂

 

When the day of the finals finally arrived, seeing you enjoy the event zone at the venue, hearing the stadium erupt in cheers every time a finalist shattered a record, our hearts raced with excitement and emotion.

 

To all the Hunters who tuned in online, to everyone who cheered passionately on-site, and to every single Hunter who continues to enjoy Solo Leveling:ARISE to this very moment!

 

We would like to take this opportunity to thank you, from the bottom of our hearts.

Our team will continue to do our utmost to bring you the best possible service and experiences.

 

In addition, a special title will be awarded through the May update to commemorate the 16 finalists and the tournament winner, a token of our gratitude and a lasting mark of their unforgettable moment.

 

[Message Delivered to the Hunters Association]

 

The heartfelt messages you’ve sent through the suggestion board will be addressed in detail during the upcoming 1-Year Anniversary Official Broadcast.

 

We are always listening to the voices of our Hunters, and we will continue striving to improve Solo Leveling:ARISE based on the valuable feedback you've shared with us.

 

Please look forward to the upcoming 1st Anniversary Broadcast. We can’t wait to share it with you!

 

[Memorial Hunter]

[The commander who leads the warriors to victory - Valkyrie’s vow]

 

Within the cycle of time spun by the Cup of Reincarnation by the rulers, countless worlds exist.

In these past worlds, there are Hunters who resemble the ones we know now, but with slightly different shapes of destiny altered by the flow of time.

 

Hunters, have you met the memorial Hunter Cha Hae-In who is bursting out pure-white aura in the lobby?

 

Cha Hae-In, the pure-white Swordmaster, made her first appearance in the roadmap video revealed at the SLC 2025 event. She is also known for her cold and stoic demeanor.

 

As the master of the Valkyrie Guild and a brilliant commander, the raid she leads is renowned for its exceptional defense, standing firm against even the most formidable foes with minimal damage.

 

When she unleashes her ultimate skill, Sword of Destiny, a radiant blade of pure light takes shape, cleaving through the skies.

Infused with celestial power, a flurry of divine swords rain down, piercing through enemy lines with overwhelming force, leaving nothing untouched in their wake.

 

[Sword of Destiny]

The memorial Hunter, Cha Hae-In, the Pure Sword Princess will join the Gate raids and provide a more diverse frame of action.

 

[Upcoming Details]

 

We take feedback from our Hunters very seriously and are continuously keeping our eyes on the Hunters with low usage in battles.

 

The balance adjustment prepared for this update includes 8 Hunters with Break ability.

We will increase the usability of the corresponding Hunters through this adjustment, allowing all the Hunters to perform in various battles.

We look forward to receiving feedback and continued interest from our Hunters.

 

Here are the upcoming updates we’re excited to share with our Hunters.

 

Upcoming Updates for May

- The 1-Year Anniversary Hunter Grand Festival will begin.
- Sung Jinwoo’s maximum level will expand to Lv. 110.
* The Gate tier will expand.
- Sung Jinwoo’s new Job Change will be added.
- New 9 Blessing Stones will be added.
- The amount of Gold reward for Daily/Weekly Missions will increase and Abyssal Fragment reward will be added to - the weekly missions reward.
- The Break performance for some Breakers will be adjusted.
- The new Workshop of Brilliant Light - Yogumunt will be added and new Remnant Power Yogumunt will be added accordingly.
* Use the Shard of Yogumunt to level up the Remnant Power.
* You will be able to convert the Shard of Yogumunt into Shard of Baran.
- New boss, Ant King, will be added to the Instance Dungeon.
- Multiplay will be added to the Simulation Gate.

 

Upcoming Updates for June

- New Shadow will be added.
* The new Shadow scheduled for May has been changed to be added in June.
- Power of Destruction world integrated ranking will be added.
- Additional Gem slots will be added.
- A New Reverse Story will be added.
- The Battlefield of Chaos floors will be expanded.
- An amplification system will be added.
- The Pixiv competition Alicia costume will be added.

 

[School Dungeon Break Story]

 

While raiding a Gate that had appeared in Busan, Sung Jinwoo sensed a signal from the shadow soldier he had planted in Sung Jinah, realizing that she was in grave danger.

 

However, with the cooldown for “Shadow Exchange” still active, he quickly mounted Kaisel and rushed toward Jinah.

 

Meanwhile, at the school, Groctar, Chief of the Red Blade Tribe, overwhelms the shadow High Orc warriors with his sheer strength. However, the shadows continue to regenerate their shattered bodies, refusing to back down.

 

Faced with a threat to his family, Sung Jinwoo is consumed by fierce rage. This upcoming storyline will highlight his unrelenting wrath as he shows no mercy to those who dare endanger his loved ones.

 

We look forward to your excitement for this powerful new story update!

 

By pre-registering for the upcoming update, you can also receive special pre-registration rewards alongside the 1st Anniversary Event.

 

If you haven’t pre-registered yet,  tap the image of Jinah below to claim your rewards!

 

[1st Anniversary]

 

 

We extend our heartfelt thanks to all the Hunters who have been with us on this journey.

The 1st Anniversary Hunter Festival of Solo Leveling:ARISE is about to begin! 🎉

 

As revealed in the CM Note, the festival will feature special gifts unlike anything seen before, including a Transcendent Blessing Stone Selection Chest.

 

We’re also preparing to bring back various limited-time costumes of Sung Jinwoo and other Hunters that were previously unavailable, so you’ll have another chance to obtain them!

 

We hope you look forward to this grand celebration!

 

[Go See CM Note]

 

 

Dear Hunters, that’s all the news we have for today!

 

But don’t worry, there’s even more exciting and diverse 1st anniversary content coming in the upcoming official livestream, so be sure to tune in and join the celebration!

 

We look forward to greeting you with energy and excitement during the broadcast!

Thank you once again for being with us today and always!

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

📢 5/8 (Thu) Update Details

 

 

📌 Main Story New Chapter

- The alliance raid with the Knights Guild and school break dungeon break related new chapter will be added to the Main Story normal and hard.

* Clear and Battle Missions rewards will be granted for each chapter.

However, only Clear rewards will be provided when clearing chapters that only consist of “Story.”

* As new stories are added, new Battle Mission Achievement Rewards for Normal and Hard mode will be added accordingly.

 

📌 Workshop of Brilliant Light New Dungeon & Improvements

▶ New Dungeon “The Distorted Sanctuary”

- A new “Workshop of Brilliant Light - The Distorted Sanctuary” (easy, normal) will be added where Hunters can challenge Yogumunt, the Monarch of Transfiguration.

The Distorted Sanctuary will unlock after clearing “‘Spire of Transfiguration - Easy.”

* The Distorted Sanctuary can be challenged after reaching Battle Tier 40.

* The normal mode will unlock after clearing easy mode.

* The Distorted Sanctuary boss will be added to the Special Commissions list.

 

Please check the details on the Workshop of Brilliant Light through the guide link below.

[Workshop of Brilliant Light Guide]

* The details on the rewards can be checked in-game.

 

▶Workshop of Brilliant Light Certain Dungeons Difficulty Adjustments

- The stats of enemies appearing in the Demos’ Castle Lower Floors Easy - Spire of Transfiguration Normal will slightly decrease.

- The stats of bosses appearing in the Demos’ Castle Lower Floors Easy - Spire of Transfiguration Normal will slightly decrease.

- The Demons’ Castle Lower Floors’ weakness elements will be adjusted to five elements.

* The weakness elements for normal and hard will remain unchanged.

- The Demons' Castle Spire’s boss “Baran of White Flames” mana burn effect will be nerfed in all Demons Castle Upper Floors’ all difficulties.

- In the Spire of Transfiguration on Easy and Normal difficulties, the damage of some attacks from the Arena of Death stage boss, Deimos, the Judge of Death, has been reduced, and the duration period for his Break pattern has been extended.

- In the Spire of Transfiguration on Easy and Normal difficulties, the duration period for the Break pattern of the Abyssal Execution Scaffold stage boss, Deimos, the Commander of Transfiguration, has been extended, and the defense reduction effect of some of his attacks has been removed.

 

▶ Other Workshop of Brilliant Light Improvements

- As a new Workshop of Brilliant Light dungeon is being added, the dungeon entry selection screen UI will be adjusted partially.

- The Workshop of Brilliant Light conquest mission rewards will be improved to be provided based on each Hunters’ Battle Tier level.

 

📌 New Remnant Power & Improvements

▶ New Remnant Power “Yogumunt”

- A new Remnant Power to utilize the power of The Monarch of Transfiguration, Yogumunt will be added.

Check out the info and enhance the new Remnant Power through the Quick Menu > Remnant Power tab.

* The new Remnant Power will unlock after clearing Workshop of Brilliant Light - The Distorted Sanctuary.

 

Please see the detailed info regarding the Remnant Power through the link below.

[Remnant Power Guide]

 

▶ New Shard Convert Feature

- As new Remnant Power is added, a new Shard convert system will be added where you can convert a certain monarch’s shard into another monarch’s shard.

Shard conversion can be accessed from the Remnant Power level-up screen. It allows you to convert other Monarchs' Shards into the Shard of the Monarch you wish to level up, using a fixed conversion rate.

* Currently, Yogumunt's Shards can be converted into Baran's Shards.

The ability to obtain Yogumunt's Shards through Shard conversion will become available in the June update for Hunters who clear The Distorted Sanctuary (Hard) difficulty.

* Shards cannot be converted for Monarchs whose Shadow Power level has already reached the maximum.

 

📌 New Sung Jinwoo Job Change

- New Sung Jinwoo Job Change [The Monarch of Shadows Dawn Sentinel] will be added.

- With the addition of a new Job Change, a new Blessing Stone/Skill Rune will be added accordingly.

Job Change Condition

- Reach Sung Jinwoo Lv. 100

- Clear Story Chapter 25 [Vengeance]

- Clear Battlefield of Trials Floor 50

- Reach 250,000 Total Power with Sung Jinwoo

- New Blessing Stone [Irresistible Force] (Rare)

- Add Sweep Points

 

📌 Maximum Level & Activity Funds Expansion

- The maximum level for the Player will be expanded, and the maximum level for Hunters will also be expanded accordingly.

- Sung Jinwoo level achievement rewards, maximum tier for Activity Funds, and the highest difficulty for Gates will also be expanded.

- As Hunters’ maximum level is expanded, Hunter level achievement rewards (Lv. 110) in the Bonds category will be added.

📌 New Blessing Stone

- New Enhancement type Blessing Stones [Sandbag], [Crushing Attack], [Irresistible Force], [First Strike Barrage], and [Lightning Speed] will be added.

- New Survival type Blessing Stones [Ravenous Instinct], [Best Defense is a Good Offense!], [Irreversible Road], and [Swift Restoration] will be added.

* As for Special Summons, the Special Summons list that opens after 5/16 (Fri) 00:00 (UTC+0) will be renewed.

 

📌 New Artifact Crafting Feature

- A new feature where Hunters can craft desired Artifacts will be available in the Crafting menu.

Lv. 75 or higher Legendary Artifacts can be crafted through the corresponding feature.

* Event Artifacts and Heroic or lower Artifacts cannot be crafted.

 

▶ Artifact Crafting Method and Crafting Material

- You can craft Artifacts by selecting the desired set type, level, and part, then using the new material, Artifact Fragments.

- To craft a Lv. 100 Artifact, an additional material, the Lv. 100 Artifact Recipes, is required.

* Artifact Fragments can be obtained from Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions at difficulty level 12 or higher.

* The Lv. 100 Artifact Recipes can be acquired as a reward from Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions clear missions for Hunters with Battle Tier 31 or above.

 

▶ Artifact Option Setting

- During Artifact crafting, you can set desired main and sub-options using the option setting feature.

You may specify 1 main option and up to 2 sub-options.

- Setting a main option requires the item Luminous Prism I, while setting sub-options requires Luminous Prism II.

* If you craft an Artifact without setting any options, the options will be assigned randomly.

* Luminous Prism I can be obtained at a low drop rate from Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions of difficulty level 12 or higher, and Luminous Prism II from difficulty level 13 or higher.

 

📌 Guild Boss & All-Out Guild War Improvement

▶ Guild Boss & Recommended Element Change

- The previous Guild Boss, Queen Ant, will be replaced with Fachtna, the King of the Desert.

* The Rage balance will be adjusted based on the renewed Guild Boss system introduced in the April update.

- Recommended elements for Guild Boss battles will now be divided into fixed elements and variable elements.

Fixed elements are permanently assigned to the boss, while variable elements may change each season.

* You can view these elements separately under the "Recommended Elements" section.

 

▶ All-Out Guild War Tier Ranking & UI Improvement

- A new tier rankings section will be added to the All-Out Guild War menu, displaying the top 100 Guilds based on Rage attempts and scores within each tier, including S-Rank tiers (S1–S3) and below, in addition to the existing matching group rankings.

* Please note that no separate rewards are provided for tier rankings.

* You can also view past season tier rankings in the previous rankings tab.

- A magnifying glass icon will be added next to each Guild name in the group and tier rankings screens.

By selecting this icon, you can view details such as the number of Rage attempts, scores, weapon setups, and Hunter compositions used by that Guild's members in Guild Boss battles.

 

▶ Other All-Out Guild War Convenience Improvements

- The contribution reward criteria for All-Out Guild War will be changed from score (damage dealt) to the number of Rage Attempts.

- Cumulative score (damage) rewards will also be replaced with rewards based on cumulative Rage Attempts.

- In the All-Out Guild War main screen, the contribution rewards by Guild ranking list and the group ranking screen will now be displayed separately.

- A challenge button will be added directly to the All-Out Guild War screen, allowing you to engage the Guild Boss without navigating away.

- UI elements displaying Guild Boss scores will now abbreviate values using unit notation when the score exceeds a certain threshold, for improved readability.

- The silhouette of the Boss Battle object in the Guild Lobby will dynamically reflect the currently active Guild Boss.

 

📌 Other Content Improvement & Changes

▶ Battlefield of Trials Challenge New Season

- A new Battlefield of Time Challenge season will begin until the next update, and new rules will be applied to Player/Hunter modes.

* Please check the details on the challenge rules and rewards in-game.

 

▶ New Simulation Gate Multiplay Feature & Improvements

- A Multiplay feature will be added to the Simulation Gate.

All available difficulty levels will support multiplay, with a default 2x option.

Hunters with the Daily Growth Support subscription can use up to 4x Multiplay.

- The Code index within the Simulation Gate Codex will be improved to display the protocol effects for each Code.

- Certain notification pop-ups during test mode will be revised.

- Exchange limits for some items in the Simulation Gate Exchange will be increased, and their exchange costs will be adjusted downward.

- The item [Blessing Stone Transcendent Stone Selection Chest] in the Simulation Gate Exchange will be renamed to [Blessing Stone Transcendent Stone Selection Chest I], and its obtainable lineup will be expanded.

 

▶ Armory Slot Enhancement Tier Expansion & Slot Unlock Conditions Improvements

- The upgradeable tiers for each Armory slot will be expanded to a maximum of 10 tiers.

For upgrades beyond tier 8, the Marks of Time III and the new material Time Crystal will be required.

* Time Crystals can be obtained from the Guild exchange and the Battlefield of Time exchange.

- When unlocking an Armory slot, you will now be able to choose between using the Marks of Time or Essence Stone.

- The Battle Tier achievement requirements for unlocking Armory slots can now be waived using Essence Stones.

* The required amount of Essence Stones for slot unlocking will be displayed alongside the Battle Tier requirements for easy reference.

📢 5/7 (Wed) Developer Livestream Video Summary

* Please note that the content below is excerpted and translated from the inven article "End of Gold shortage! 1st Anniversary Developer Livestream filled with amazing news, including the Cha Hae-In from another universe" that summarized the 5/7 (Wed) Developer Liverstream.

[View Original Text]

 

👉 [5/7 (Wed) Developer Livestream Video]

* To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

📌 Q&A

 

Q. Artifact farming is so exhausting. It's really tough to get the new Artifact with the right options.

A. There has been growing feedback that farming for new Artifacts, such as Chaotic, is extremely difficult. To address this issue, the Artifact Crafting system is scheduled to be updated.

 

Q. It feels a bit discouraging that there are no rewards for All-Out Guild War 4th place or lower.

A. We would like to first apologize for that. As we have been preparing a lot of content for our 1st Anniversary, it hasn’t been included in this update, we will be sure to give it some changes in the next update.

 

Q. The collaboration with (G)I-DLE has been announced. Is the rate up draw applied for all five members?

A. It is correct that all five Hunters are being released. The rate up draw will proceed in two separate phases.

Nonetheless, we expect the acquisition and growth difficulty to remain quite high.

To reduce this difficulty, we’ve prepared a wealth of rewards so Hunters can enjoy both the collaboration and the game itself.

 

To elaborate further, when we released both Charlotte and Harper at the same time, we truly felt just how stressful that could be.

While this collaboration will also feature simultaneous rate up draws, we are preparing countermeasures for the overlapping period

and will do our best to minimize the acquisition difficulty so that Hunters won’t feel overwhelmed.

 

We’ve also received many questions asking, “Why a (G)I-DLE collaboration?”

As you know, Solo Leveling is a global IP.

This year’s SLC 2025 Championship was also held on a global scale, and we wanted the collaboration to reflect that global perspective without leaning in any particular direction.

Since the members of (G)I-DLE are from various countries, we felt they were a perfect fit.

 

Of course, the (G)I-DLE collaboration won’t just be a simple character release.

We’re working to ensure they are naturally integrated into the world of Solo Leveling:ARISE.

Additionally, when the collaboration begins, we’ll also be releasing a Solo Leveling OST performed by (G)I-DLE.

We’re putting in a lot of effort to bring out a wide range of charm, so we hope you’re looking forward to it.

 

Q. I'm running out of Gold. The Artifact Reforge cost is also too expensive.

A. Every time an update is released and new Artifacts are introduced, we’re seeing a significant shortage of Gold.

While we’ve been running events to address this, those are only temporary solutions.

We fully understand that the fundamental issue is the need to increase the overall Gold supply.

Starting with this update, you'll be able to see a noticeable increase in the amount of Gold you can earn.

 

Q. We are experiencing a massive shortage of Magic Enchantment items.

A. We will make additional Enchantment books available through rewards and events.

 

Q. It is too hard to grow Shadows.

A. We’re aware that growing Shadows is currently quite challenging.

We will make sure to increase the amount of Shadow-related resources obtainable from Gates.

 

Q. A preset deleting feature is needed.

A. We will look into it.

 

Q. Sorting Artifacts is too difficult right now.

A. We are working on improving the filter system and adding a feature that allows you to sell Artifacts in bulk.

Some of these features will be implemented right away, and we will continue to update quality-of-life functions moving forward.

 

Q. Are there other ways to obtain Workshop of Brilliant Light in3000 costumes?

A. The costumes were a special reward given exclusively to the Hunters who have cleared the mission, and we believe preserving its value is a matter of respect for those Hunters.

We kindly ask for your understanding and look forward to your challenge when a new boss appears in the future.

 

Q. Are you preparing co-op (cooperative play) and PvP content?

A. As for co-op, we first showcased it through the battle with Beru.

We are also continuously testing other co-op content internally.

However, real-time collaboration can be stressful in a mobile environment.

The same goes for PvP. While there are fun aspects, there are also elements that could lead to frustration.

We will listen to your feedback and aim to update the game with more enjoyable content once it’s ready.

 

Q. Increase the farming routes for items such as Truth: Kasaka's Venom Fang.

A. We will continue to provide a route for obtaining weapons through crafting, in addition to the ones available through events.

 

Q. Extend the rate up period for Seorin.

A. If the Seorin rate up period is extended, there is a concern that it might overlap with tomorrow's update.

However, Seorin will eventually be available through the Custom Rate Up Draw, so we recommend utilizing that option.

We will also make sure to provide more opportunities to obtain Custom Draw Tickets.

 

Q. There are leftover Baran Shards. Please make sure they can be used somewhere.

A. We are preparing content that will allow you to process leftover Shards.

 

Q. The difficulty of Deimos is too high.

A. As shown in the data revealed at the start of the livestream, Deimos has particularly low clear rates.

We are planning to lower the difficulty in the future, so please wait a little longer.

 

Q. I’m joining the military soon, is there any way to get the anniversary costume?

A. It’s unfortunate. During the next anniversary event, we plan to run an event where you can obtain costumes released during the past year.

 

Q. The Infamy Artifact is particularly not dropping.

A. The drop rate is set equally.

It likely feels that way because many Hunters are seeking the Infamy Artifact.

We plan to reduce the difficulty of obtaining it through crafting and other methods, so please refer to the upcoming update details.

 

📌 1st Anniversary Update & Improvements

 

■ Busan Raid & School Story Release

A new story is being released with the Busan Raid and the school story of Sung Jinah, the younger sister of Sung Jinwoo.

When Orcs begin to target Sung Jinah, Sung Jinwoo, enraged, no longer hides his power and takes the first steps toward his journey as a full-fledged munchkin.

Once again, we have put a lot of effort into the cutscenes, and we have always strived to meet your expectations with both the story and direction. We hope you are excited for it.

 

By progressing through the new story, Sung Jinwoo’s maximum level will increase from 105 to 110.

As Sung Jinwoo’s level increases, the maximum level for Hunters will also rise. With every 10-level increase, Hunter Bond rewards will be unlocked, allowing you to claim numerous rewards.

Activity Funds and Gate difficulty will also increase.

 

Of course, a new Job Change will be added.

The name of the new Job Change is Dawn Sentinel. The requirements are: combat power of 250,000, Sung Jinwoo level 100 or higher, clearing the new story, and clearing 50 floors of the Battlefield of Trials.

This is the 10th Job Change, and the benefits include the Irresistible Force Blessing Stone and increased sweep points, as well as a combat power boost.

 

▲ The tragic end of those who dared to touch Sung Jinah...

 

▲ With the expansion of Sung Jinwoo's maximum level, new Job Change and Hunter Bond rewards will also be introduced.

 

▲ The name of the new job class is Dawn Sentinel, and it comes with various benefits, including the Irresistible Force Blessing Stone.

 

■ New 9 types of Blessing Stones!

 

A total of nine new Blessing Stones, including Irresistible Force, will be added.

These new stones offer unique and interesting effects.

For example, one stone temporarily reduces your attack power, but then dramatically increases it afterward, creating a penalty during regular mob phases but a major damage boost during boss battles.

There are also stones that increase Break damage or enhance attack power when used in conjunction with Breaks, helping to ease the increased difficulty of Break mechanics.

 

In particular, while active Hunters are generally handling the Break system well, many new Hunters are finding it difficult.

To support smoother gameplay, we will provide the Irresistible Force Blessing Stone, which will help alleviate these challenges.

 

Additionally, new builds such as Lightning Speed, which grants bonuses based on Agility stats,

are expected to open up fresh strategies, even ones that the developers themselves may not have anticipated.

 

▲ New 9 Blessing Stones will be added.

 

■ Artifact Crafting System finally revealed.

 

With the addition of Encore Missions and Instance Dungeon, many new Artifacts have been introduced, which has naturally increased the difficulty of Artifact farming.

To alleviate this, an Artifact Crafting System is being introduced.

 

Artifact Crafting will allow you to choose the main stat and up to two sub-options, and it will be implemented as a permanent feature, not just a limited-time event.

You can expect a significantly improved and more reliable Artifact farming experience compared to before.

 

▲ An Artifact Crafting System to ease the increased difficulty of Artifact farming.

 

▲ You can select a main option and up to two sub-options.

 

■ Workshop of Brilliant Light: Yogumunt Open, starting from Easy & Normal difficulties

 

Following Deimos, the Workshop of Brilliant Light: Yogumunt battle will begin.

At first, the Easy and Normal difficulties will be available, with Hard mode scheduled to be added in June.

 

As the second “Monarch” boss after Baran, Yogumunt will allow you to collect fragments to enhance the Remnant Power.

Unlike the Yogumunt you encountered in the story, this version offers a fully fleshed-out boss experience fitting of the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

 

Additionally, leftover Baran Shards will be exchangeable at a fixed rate through a dedicated system.

However, this system will not be available at Yogumunt’s initial release, but will be introduced with the Hard mode update in June.

 

▲ A new Monarch appears, and naturally, a new Remnant Power will be added as well.

 

■ New Hunter - Pure Sword Princess Cha Hae-In

 

She will be released as a Water attribute Hunter, and it's a deeply nostalgic moment to unveil this refreshed version of Cha Hae-In, especially since it was back in May of last year when she first debuted as the game’s very first rate up character.

 

Cha Hae-In can use her Core Attacks continuously for a limited time after activating her Q skill, as her core gauge won’t deplete during that window.

By using Core Attacks and Active Skills, she accumulates stacks of Will of the Sword.

As this gauge builds, her Defense, Critical Rate, and Critical Damage all increase, resulting in a playstyle where her DPS scales the more she lands her hits.

Additionally, her Ultimate Skill can paralyze enemies, allowing her to deal heavy burst damage over time.

 

▲ A new water attribute memorial hunter Cha Hae-In.

 

▲ A Hunter who specializes in Core Attacks as her primary damage source.

 

■ New Sung Jinwoo Weapon - Winter Fang (Will be released on 5/22)

 

To coincide with the release of a new water attribute Hunter, Sung Jinwoo will also receive a brand-new water attribute weapon called Winter Fang.

It will become available on 5/22 (Thu), two weeks after the first anniversary update.

 

Unlike previous water attribute weapons, which primarily focused on support capabilities, Winter Fang is centered around offensive power.

As its name suggests, it’s themed around a wolf motif, and it synergizes particularly well with the Wolf Assassin rune, making it a strong choice for aggressive builds.

 

Winter Fang allows Sung Jinwoo to teleport to enemies when using skills, delivering swift, targeted attacks.

It also consumes Power Gauge to enable continuous skill use, allowing for high burst potential.

While this mechanic may restrict Ultimate skill usage, the weapon’s evolution stages provide enhancements, such as faster Power Gauge recovery to balance this trade-off.

 

▲ Sung Jinwoo’s new water attirbute weapon, Winter Fang, will be released on 5/22 (Thu), two weeks after the update.

 

■ The Ant King joins the Instance Dungeon as a new boss.

 

Before Beru is reborn as the Shadow, the Ant King will appear as a new boss in the Instance Dungeon.

With the arrival of this new boss, new challenges and rewards, such as Proof of the Strong, will also be added.

 

▲ Before becoming Beru, the Ant King defeated by Sung Jinwoo appears as Ant King.

 

■ I’ll show you the completely transformed me! SSR Breaker Hunter Adjustments

 

The performance of SSR Breaker Hunters will be buffed.

This includes not only early active hunters like Baek Yoonho, Emma Laurent, Lim Tae-Gyu, and Seo Jiwoo, but also later-released and frequently used Hunters like Go Gunhee, Esil Radiru, Harper, and Woo Jinchul.

 

As the game has evolved, enemies' Break Gauges have increased, causing the effectiveness of the existing Breaker Hunters to fall short, especially for new Hunters, who often struggle with utilizing Breaks effectively.

To address this, a complete rebalancing of Breaker Hunters' performance has been implemented, so be sure to make the most of the improvements.

 

▲ Could they become useful again? The buffs for Breakers are now underway.

 

■ Goodbye, Gold Shortage! Additional improvements are on the way.

 

The Gold rewards from Activity Funds will be expanded by 3x, with Gold rewards for daily/weekly missions increased and Abyssal Fragment rewards added.

Additionally, Gold farming will be supported through limited-time events.

 

In the Simulation Gate, multiplay will be introduced, allowing you to earn up to 2x rewards.

However, be cautious, if you fail a challenge, the rewards you lose will also be doubled, so be mindful when attempting high-difficulty challenges.

 

The Guild Boss will see the Queen Ant being replaced, with the new Fachtna season beginning.

Moreover, the Armory will be expanded, allowing you to choose between Essence Stones and Marks of Time when progressing.

Lastly, the Armory level cap will be raised from 7 to 10.

 

▲ The Gold income from Activity Funds and daily missions will increase, allowing you to earn more Gold each day.

 

▲ The Simulation Gate will introduce multiplay, and the Guild Boss will once again feature Fachtna.

 

■ Event & Rewards: Claim Transcendent Blessing Stone!

 

To celebrate the 1st Anniversary, a special check-in event will run from 5/8 (Thu) to 6/3 (Tue).

The main rewards include Transcendent Blessing Stone Selection Chest, 1st Anniversary SSR Hunter Selection Ticket, and 1st Anniversary SSR Hunter Weapon Selection Ticket.

 

Additionally, from 5/8 (thu) to 6/4 (Thu), Hunters will receive 365 Essence Stones daily for a month.

By logging in every day during the event period, you can earn a total of 10,220 Essence Stones.

 

The 1st Anniversary Mission Challenge offers up to 100 Custom Draw Tickets and 1.5 million Gold. The challenge will be set at an easy difficulty, so everyone can participate with ease.

The 1st Anniversary Dice Exploration event will be a light event that allows Hunters to look back at various events from the past year, with rewards including Weapon Selection Tickets and Shadow Keyring items.

 

The Gate Bonus Time Event will be held in two periods: from 5/15 (Thu) to 5/21 (Wed) and from 5/29 (Thu) to 6/5 (Thu).

During these periods, clearing any gate will reward 36,500 Gold and 5 Weapon Enhancement Gear II with no special conditions.

In between these periods, from 5/22 (Thu) to 5/28 (Wed), the Gate EXP Bonus Time event will take place, increasing clear experience by 1.5x.

 

An event to win Sung Jinwoo’s costume, the winning design from the competition, will also be held from 5/26 (Mon) to 6/12 (Thu).

Complete daily missions during this period and earn 50 points to get Sung Jinwoo’s costume for free.

 

The 1st Anniversary Costume Shop will open, allowing you to acquire any costume released over the past year.

Moreover, simply logging in will reward you with Costume Tokens, allowing you to get 1 free costume. If there’s a costume you’ve been wanting from the previous releases, now’s the time to grab it!

 

▲ Incredible rewards! Starting with the Transcendent Blessing Stone from the 1st Anniversary Special Check-In, it's an exciting way to kick off the celebration!

 

▲ After the 5/8 (Thu) update, 365 Essence Stones are claimable daily by logging into the game, 10,220 Essence Stones in total.

 

▲ 100 Custom Draw Tickets and 1,500,000 Gold by clearing simple missions through the Mission Challenge.

 

▲ The Dice Exploration event, which takes a look back at all the events from the past year.

 

▲ From 5/15 (Thu) to 21 (Wed) and 5/29 (Thu) to 6/5 (Thu), every time you clear a Gate, you'll receive Gold and Enhancement Gear II as rewards!

 

▲ The winning costume of Sung Jinwoo will also be released through an event.

 

📌 1st Anniversary Live Wrap-up Thank You Message

 

Lee Da Haeng, Business Division Director: I feel like we’ve been running non-stop for the past year, not even realizing how hard it was thanks to all the love we received.

Beyond just regular updates, we’ve held various events—from community engagements to competitions and offline gatherings.

And now, a year later, I’m truly grateful that players are still saying, “This game is really worth playing.”

We’ll continue doing our best to live up to that love and expectation, and we’ll work hard to make the coming year even better.

 

Jin Sung Gun, Head of Development: The reason Solo Leveling:ARISE was able to keep running for a whole year is largely thanks to all the Hunters here.

I don’t think the game is perfect, many of you have given us tough feedback as well as encouragement.

We’ll keep working hard to show you a better version of ourselves, and strive to become a game worthy of national prestige.

 

Commentator Kim Kyu Hwan: Next time, I’ll make sure to train my physique a bit more. (laughs)

Spending the 1st anniversary with all of you filled me with gratitude, and I really appreciate being invited to such a fun and exciting event we could all enjoy together.

Please continue to look forward to what’s to come.

 

MC Jung In Ho: I often find myself truly grateful to our players.

It’s rare to see people play a game with such genuine affection.

Even when we attend various events, it’s not common to be welcomed so warmly every time.

That’s why everything we do is for all of you.

So please continue to support both the development and business teams, and I hope we can meet again like this one year from now.

 

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Note: New Power and the Upcoming Summer!

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: New Power and the Upcoming Summer!

Hunters Association
|
May 29, 2025, 08:00
|
22,530

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

Are you enjoying the 1st Anniversary Hunter Grand Festival?

 

Today, we will be addressing the details regarding the June update and other updates scheduled for the future.

 

Please see below for more details.

 

 

[Yogumunt (Hard) Clear Time Attack]

 

[Excerpt from Special Rewards]

 

Hunters, your powerful challenge brought down Vulcan, the lord of the Demons' Castle lower floors, in just 13 minutes.

Even the Demon King Baran was forced to his knees in only 15 minutes.

Likewise, Deimos, Commander of Transfiguration, fell in a short time as well.

 

However, at the edge of the abyss, where neither light nor sound can reach, awaits a different kind of foe.

Yogumunt, king of the malevolent spirits and the Monarch of Transfiguration, reigns supreme.

 

He will not allow the challenges from our Hunters easily.

 

Who among the Hunters will rise to the challenge in the illusory afterworld, defeat this mighty sovereign, and etch their name in history as a true hero, claiming the special rewards that await?

 

We look forward to your bold challenge.

 

[Battlefield of Chaos & Gem System Adjustments]

 

We recognize that the Battlefield of Chaos is reaching its limits as a challenging piece of content, and that Gems' growth has largely reached its final stages.

 

To address this, our team is introducing several updates aimed at providing Hunters with new long-term goals. With the upcoming June update, we will expand the maximum floors of the Battlefield of Chaos, introduce a new tier of Gems, and implement an entirely new Gem page system.

 

In the newly added upper floors of the Battlefield of Chaos, Hunters will be able to obtain tiered Gems as well as a brand-new resource tentatively named "Fragments."

These Fragments serve as key upgrade materials that guarantee a 100% success rate when enhancing Gems to the next tier, and they can be farmed directly within the Battlefield of Chaos.

 

Hunters, the time has come to explore deeper, more dynamic combat through a wider range of Gem options.

We hope you look forward to the challenges and rewards that await.

 

[Special Operation List (working title)]

 

Our team has been giving serious thought to the feedback we’ve received regarding progression balance across different content difficulties.

 

In particular, we’ve been closely reviewing ongoing feedback from new and returning Hunters, as well as those whose progression is still in its early stages.

 

We are aware that many Hunters feel a sense of imbalance in rewards, depending on their individual growth stage within the core gameplay loop of Challenge → Reward → Progression.

 

This is largely due to the differences in available options between Hunters with multiple fully developed Hunters and those still in the process of growth.

As a result, we’ve observed that playing with less-developed Hunters often leads to lower rewards and a more limited gameplay experience.

 

To address this and to encourage a more diverse use of Hunters while enhancing the overall enjoyment of challenge and growth, we are preparing a new system that grants temporary enhancement effects (buffs) to specific Hunters in each update.

Please note, however, that this system will not apply to certain content where it may significantly affect core combat experiences.

 

We look forward to your continued interest and excitement for upcoming content.

 

[June & July Update Preview]

 

Hunters, the second summer of Solo Leveling:ARISE has arrived along with the June and July update!

 

First, various changes will be applied with the June update.

     ⦁ The Guild Boss will be converted to Ant Queen.
     ⦁ The Workshop of Brilliant Light weakness will be adjusted.
     ⦁ The Activity Funds Hunter level bonus will be extended.
     ⦁ The battle mission in the Battlefield of Trials floor 64 will be extended from 90 seconds to 100 seconds.
     ⦁ The sale of [Uncontrollable Power Lv.1] in the Guild Buff Exchange will end.

        (Once the sale ends, any already purchased and active buffs will be removed.)

     ⦁ An issue where the camera focus was incorrect at the start of certain story battles will be fixed.
     ⦁ Lennart Niermann joins the Gate Raid.
        - Lennart Niermann is a wind attribute dealer with a defense-based scaling and fires magic bullets imbued with the power of wind.

 

 

Additionally, many Hunters have provided feedback regarding Artifact farming and the focused farming of growth materials.

In response, we plan to implement the following improvements in the June update.

 

[Artifact Farming Improvements]

First, the Artifact crafting system will be improved to encourage more active use.

Artifact Fragments will now drop in greater quantities from Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions.

Additionally, from certain higher stages, Lv. 100 Artifact crafting recipes will drop, enhancing the excitement of high-level Artifact farming.

 

[Balance Adjustment Feedback]

In the previous update, balance adjustments were made for the eight Break Hunters.

We believe many Hunters are now experimenting with diverse strategies in response to the changed combat environment.

In this upcoming update, we will focus on skill balance adjustments for certain Hunters and weapon balance changes for Sung Jinwoo.

 

Our team is always listening to your feedback and working hard to deliver an enjoyable gameplay experience.

 

For Sung Jinwoo’s weapons, we determined that improvements to water attribute weapons are most urgent.

For Sung Jinwoo’s weapons, we determined that improvements to water attribute weapons are most urgent.

This is because, aside from "Thetis' Grimoire," the usage rates of other water-attribute weapons have been notably low,

indicating a high dependency on a single weapon.

 

To broaden the range of weapon choices and add more strategic depth, we plan to adjust the balance of “Skadi” and “True: Kasaka's Venom Fang” so they become more appealing options.

As balance testing is still in progress, we will share the overall direction of these changes rather than specific numbers at this time.

 

[Sung Jinwoo’s Weapon]

Skadi -  Skill damage and effect for certain skills will increase.

Truth: Kasaka’s Venom Fang - [Kasaka's Deadly Poison] effect will be enhanced.

 

[Hunter]

Cha Hae-In, the Pure Sword Princess – The skill [Heavenly Strike] will be enhanced.

The skill coefficients for Charlotte, Harper, Silver Mane Baek Yoonho, Lim Tae-Gyu, and Hwang Dongsoo will be increased.

Han Se-Mi – The performance of the [Natural Unity] buff will be improved.

 

We will share detailed numerical changes in a future update notice.

Our team remains committed to continuous updates, ensuring Hunters can enjoy action-packed gameplay with a wide variety of team compositions.

 

[Growth Materials Acquisition Method Improvements]

Additionally, from certain higher-level Gates onward, you will be able to obtain loot chests that match the concept of each Gate, depending on the type.

For example, clearing a Special Gate will reward you with an additional Gold loot chest.

 

We hope these improvements will support your growth as a Hunter.

Through more efficient farming, we look forward to seeing you become even stronger!

 

Next, let us share details about the July update and the upcoming summer event.

 
     ⦁ The story of Allon, Recluse of the Deep Sea, and the System Architect will be added.
        - An Invitation to the Cartenon Temple!
        - Sung Jinwoo heads once again to the place where it all began, but this time, he is not the same man.
        - And so begins the final trial! What fate awaits Sung Jinwoo?
     ⦁ The Power of Destruction global ranking content will be introduced.
     ⦁ A new Amplification System will be added.
     ⦁ Very Hard difficulty will be added to the new story content.
     ⦁ A new Job Change for Sung Jinwoo will be released.
     ⦁ A new boss will appear in Encore Missions.
     ⦁ Sung Jinwoo's maximum level will be increased.

 

And now, we'd like to share details, through this developer note, about the very first collaboration for “Solo Leveling:ARISE,” which was officially unveiled for the first time at SLC 2025.

 

[Collaboration i-dle]

 

We put a great deal of thought into establishing the concepts for the i-DLE members featured in this collaboration.

 

Much like Yoo Soohyun, who was an ordinary celebrity in the original story but awakened as a Hunter and rose to prominence, we wanted to imagine a narrative in which i-DLE awakens as Hunters within the Solo Leveling:ARISE universe.

We believe this setup could deliver an engaging and unique episode for our Hunters and work extensively to bring it to life.

 

When integrating i-DLE into the world of Solo Leveling:ARISE as Hunters, we aim to highlight each member’s individuality and reflect their unique traits in their combat styles.

After much deliberation, we decided on the following concepts: Miyeon will wield a sword, Minnie a scythe, Soyeon dual handguns, Yuqi gauntlets, and Shuhua an orb.

 

As this marks the first-ever collaboration for Solo Leveling:ARISE, we understand there are high expectations as well as concerns from the community.

As mentioned in the previous developer livestream, we are lowering the acquisition difficulty for these collaboration Hunters.

All five i-DLE members will be available through various in-game events, ensuring that every Hunter has the opportunity to recruit them.

 

We are also preparing special systems to support their growth (advancement), making the process more accessible.

In addition, we have prepared a limited-time story event to celebrate the collaboration, packed with rich content.

 

We are fully committed to delivering a fun and meaningful experience to all Hunters who enjoy Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Please look forward to the thrilling adventures of these collaboration Hunters as they fight alongside the Army of Shadows and conquer the Gates!

 

 

Hunters, that concludes the news we have prepared for today.

 

Exciting adventures and special moments await you.

Are you ready to enjoy a wonderful summer of 2025 with us?

 

We sincerely thank all Hunters for your continued passionate interest and support for Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Fueled by your encouragement, we will keep striving to deliver even better action.

 

The next developer live stream is scheduled for the last week of June, where we will share more in-depth stories that we couldn’t cover this time. Please look forward to it.

 

Until then, have a great time playing.

Thank you.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

📌 Reverse Story New Chapter & Story Certain Stages Adjustment

▶ Reverse Story New Chapter

- The Chapters 24 and 25 added through the 5/8 (Thu) will be added to the Reverse mode normal and hard.

* As new stories are added, new Battle Mission Achievement Rewards for Normal and Hard mode will be added accordingly.

 

▶ Story Normal Mode Certain Stages Recommended Combat Power and Battle Missions Adjustment

- The battle mission, “use Extreme Evasion n times and win,” in Story normal and hard modes will change into “take damage less than n times.”

* Certain stages’ Extreme Evasion related battle missions will remain unchanged.

* The details on adjusted recommended combat power and battle missions can be checked in-game.

 

📌 Workshop of Brilliant Light - The Distorted Sanctuary Hard Mode and Difficulty Adjustment

▶ Workshop of Brilliant Light - The Distorted Sanctuary Hard

- The Distorted Sanctuary on Hard difficulty applies the [high-difficulty battle] settings as of the current update.

* As more Hunters clear the Hard difficulty, the difficulty level may gradually be adjusted.

* Upon clearing the Hard difficulty, the Shards conversion restriction will be lifted, allowing you to convert other Monarchs' Shards into Yogumunt's Shards.

 

A special reward will be given to the first 6,000 Hunters who clear the Distorted Sanctuary on Hard difficulty.

For more details, please refer to the event announcement below.
