📌 Gem Tier Expansion & New Growth Features: Gem Promotion and Gem Refinement

▶ Gem Tier Expansion & New Gem Slot Page

- Gem tiers are now expanded up to Tier 6. Tier 6 Gems can be obtained through the Gem Promotion system.

A new Gem slot page will also be added where you can equip additional Gems.

* The new Gem slot page is unlocked once all Gem slots in the first page are equipped with Tier 4 or higher Gems.

* The new page allows for 20 Gem slots in total, with 4 slots per color.

 

▶ Gem Promotion

- You can promote Gems to Tier 6 by opening the [Gem] menu, tapping the gem icon in the bottom left corner, and selecting the [Promotion] button.

- To promote a gem, you need a Tier 5 Gem with the same option and tier (option value) as the promotion target.

You also need fragments of the same color and another Tier 5 Gem of the same color as materials.

* Color-specific Gem fragments, used as promotion materials, can be obtained from Battlefield of Chaos stages of Tier 16 or higher.

* The secondary Tier 5 Gem used in promotion does not need to have the same option or tier as the main gem.

 

▶ Gem Refinement

- Tier 6 Gems with B-tier or lower options can be refined into A-tier Gems with the same option.

This feature is accessible through the Fusion menu, similar to Skill Rune/Blessing Stone refinement.

* To set or change the refinement target, you must have a Tier 6 Gem with a B-tier or lower option in your inventory.

* Gems currently equipped in any Gem slot page cannot be selected as a refinement target.

- Gem refinement consumes Essence Stones, and if the target Gem is not obtained, mileage will accumulate.

- Once mileage reaches 10, your next refinement will guarantee the acquisition of the set refinement target Gem.

* If you obtain the target gem through a Refinement Success, mileage will be reset.

However, changing the refinement target without achieving refinement success will retain the accumulated mileage.

📌 Artifact Management and Crafting Convenience Improvements

▶ New “Artifact Management” Feature

- A new “Artifact Management” feature will be added to the Artifact menu. You can access the management page by tapping the “Manage” button at the bottom.

* The existing “Salvage” and “Sell” features have been integrated. Now, when salvaging, you can choose your reward, either Gold or Artifact Enhancement Chips.

 

- In the Artifact Management page, in addition to salvaging, you can use “Manage Options”, which include:

Lock All/Unlock All: Select multiple Artifacts using the filter and lock or unlock them in bulk.

Auto Settings: Auto Settings: Set conditions to automatically salvage Artifacts acquired from Gates, Encore Missions, or Instance Dungeons and obtain Gold or Artifact Enhancement Chips accordingly.

 

▶ Improved Auto-Equip for Artifacts

- A “Detailed Settings” feature is added to the Artifact Equip screen for Sung Jinwoo and Hunters.

In this page, you can temporarily equip Artifacts, compare them with currently equipped ones, and preview the resulting stats and combat power changes before finalizing the switch.

* When applying changes, removing Artifacts enhanced to +16 or higher still consumes Gold, as before.

- When using Auto Equip, tapping a changed Artifact slot will now display a popup comparing the previous Artifact and the new one.

A new option is added to exclude slots from Auto Equip by tapping the [-] icon on the upper left of each Artifact slot.

- Improvements to the “Recommended Set Order” logic for Auto Equip:

1. Artifacts will prioritize those matching the recommended set and stats for the Hunter.

2. For Bracelet slots, preference is given to those with matching attributes and main options.

 

▶ Artifact Crafting Improvements
- The crafting result screen will now display the main and sub-options of the crafted Artifact for immediate review.

- From the result screen, you can now lock, enhance, or salvage crafted Artifacts directly.

* However, if the Artifact inventory is full and the crafted Artifact is sent to your mailbox, these functions will not be available.

- From June 26, Season 11 of the Battlefield of Time will begin with a new Critical Hit Rate Adjustment Buff:

* Buffs and balance adjustments for the Battlefield of Time may change each season.

Greetings, Hunters.

This is Jin Seong Gun, the executive producer of Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Today, we’d like to share what Solo Leveling:ARISE (hereafter referred to as ARISE) means to our development team, and explain why we decided to develop the PC/console expansion, Solo Leveling:ARISE OVERDRIVE (hereafter referred to as OVERDRIVE), as a separate build.

 

Our team’s primary goal was for <ARISE> to become a flagship title in the action genre, while also expanding the IP and achieving broad appeal.

Because of this approach, there were some limitations in fully maximizing the precision of action and controls. However, our goal was to create a game where anyone could easily enjoy the thrill of action. We implemented features like auto-battle and multi-play to make combat more accessible, while striving to deliver the best possible action gameplay, anytime, anywhere, across both PC and mobile platforms.

As a result, now one year later, we’ve been able to continue this journey thanks to all the Hunters who resonated with this passion and supported the action gameplay of our title.

 

You may be wondering, then, why we decided to develop the PC/console expansion <OVERDRIVE> as a separate build.

 

<OVERDRIVE> shares the same roots as the original <ARISE>, but it is being developed as a standalone package title to offer an extreme action play experience tailored for PC and console platforms.

It is being built with a focus on deeper, more core gameplay and action mechanics, and we are reinterpreting the combat and progression systems in a way that differs from <ARISE>.

 

For example, auto-battle is not supported, so all battles must be played manually. The combat system includes guard and parry mechanics, encouraging players to engage more directly with moment-to-moment control. Additionally, the title is only available on PC and console in order to support more precise input and control.

 

Because the combat style and the core game systems are fundamentally different, we concluded that developing it as a separate build was the best course of action.

 

We fully understand that some of our current <ARISE> playing Hunters may have concerns that the arrival of <OVERDRIVE> could diminish the value of the game they’ve invested so much passion into, and we completely empathize with those concerns.

 

Therefore, I would like to take this opportunity to emphasize what is most important above all else.

The development of <OVERDRIVE> will never lead to a reduction in development resources or a decline in service quality for the currently serviced <ARISE>.

 

These two games pursue distinct goals.

<OVERDRIVE> focuses on delivering the fun of a “package game” where players can enjoy a short but intense burst of action along with a complete, self-contained story. It is designed to make the most of the PC and console environment, offering enhanced controls and real-time cooperative play. To fully showcase this experience, we’ve structured the game so that Hunters and weapons are not obtained through summoning, but instead through repeated gameplay and accumulated play points. We also aim to implement a streamlined and simplified growth system.

 

On the other hand, <ARISE> will continue, as it has until now, to grow as a “live service game” through ongoing communication and updates with our Hunters.

We will continue to provide fresh content and storylines, rich events, and diverse progression systems.

 

<ARISE> exists thanks to the support of all the Hunters who cherish the game. As a live service title, we place the highest priority on communication with our Hunters and always listen closely to your feedback.

We promise to keep delivering a wide variety of interesting content and the best possible experience with every update, through main story expansions, new Hunters, original episodes, seasonal events, and much more.

 

Thank you.

Developer Notes

6/25 (Wed) Developer Livestream Summary

Hunters Association
|
Jun 27, 2025, 08:00
|
6,070

 

📢 6/25 (Wed) Developer Livestream Summary

* Please note that the content below is excerpted and translated from the inven article "MIYEON and SHUHUA make their appearance first! 6/25 (Wed) Solo Leveling:ARISE Developer Livestream."

[View Original Text]

 

👉[6/25 (Wed) Developer Livestream Summary]

* To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

Redeem Code

Reward

Expiration Date (UTC+0)

THANKFORFEEDBACK

Essence Stones x1,000

Advanced Mana Crystal x300

Goldx 1,000,000

Until 2025/7/9 (Wed) 23:59

JUN3UDCODE

[Tier 5] Gem x2

Gem Fragment Selection Chest x20

JULYUDC0D3

Essence Stones x1,000

Weapon Enhancement Gear III x30

IDLECOLLABEVENT

Custom Draw Ticket x20

Uncommon Skill Rune Chest x3

 

 

📌 Q&A

 

Q. Are Solo Leveling:ARISE and OVERDRIVE separate games?

- Although we released a developer note quickly, OVERDRIVE is indeed a completely separate game. While both are based on the Solo Leveling IP, OVERDRIVE is developed with a focus on action gameplay for platforms like Steam and consoles. On the other hand, ARISE is a more casual mobile-oriented game.

 

Since the development teams are entirely separate, OVERDRIVE will not affect the update schedule or quality of ARISE. Other Solo Leveling-based games are also in development, each with their own project directors and teams, so there’s no need to worry about overlapping resources.

 

Q. Are there any plans to add multiplayer content?

- In the previous Ant King co-op event, only HP was shared. This time, we are focusing more on true cooperative gameplay. Due to limitations of mobile devices, we're currently developing it as a two-player experience.

 

The co-op mode will be introduced as part of the “Architect” storyline update. Once the story update is complete, the multiplayer content will follow. We will keep you updated on the development progress through livestreams.

 

Q. Advanced Mana Crystals are too hard to get.

- We're aware that Advanced Mana Crystals are currently in short supply. Internally, we’re reviewing how to increase rewards, including through events. This time, we’ve increased the daily purchase limit in the shop from 100 to 200.

 

Q. Power of Destruction feels dull compared to other content.

- We’re preparing a Hard Mode. It was originally planned for early July, but due to extended preparations, it will likely be released at the end of July.

 

The most notable change in Hard Mode will be the addition of a World Unified Ranking, allowing top Hunters to compete. Rewards will be revamped accordingly, and honor-based rewards will also be added.

 

As Power of Destruction isn't focused on action gameplay, there are limits to how varied its patterns can be.

 

Q. What’s being done about the Fusion bug?

- After the June update, a bug allowed materials to remain under certain conditions during Fusion requiring three materials. We’ve patched it, but determining total quantities and compensation requires time.

 

Only a small number of Hunters were affected (around 5 for Runes/Blessing Stones and 29 for Gem Fusion), and materials will be retrieved accordingly during an upcoming update.

 

Q. Artifact farming is too difficult.

- We’ve noticed this issue, especially as more Artifact types have been added. Starting with the July update, for four weeks, the drop rate for Burning Series and Chaotic Series Artifacts will increase by 1.5x.

 

If we continue to see demand, especially for DPS gear, we may run focused events for sets like Burning Curse or Chaotic Infamy.

 

Q. Will ARISE also add a training dummy like OVERDRIVE?

- We’re considering adding a meter-based content system similar to Power of Destruction to serve a similar function.

 

Q. When will the Skill Amplification system be released?

- We're preparing for a late July update. We’re monitoring Hunters' progression and will release Skill Amplification at an appropriate time after the new growth content is live.

 

Q. There’s a bug with deck setup in Guild Boss.

- We’ll investigate and resolve it quickly.

 

After this update, Fachtna will return as the Guild Boss, and we have identified several issues related to it. First, there is a problem where the damage from certain skills is too powerful. Since the damage is currently based on maximum HP, Hunters tend to get instantly killed. We are planning to adjust it to be based on current HP instead. Additionally, we will fix issues such as Shadow Step not being applied properly and the so-called “spinning in circles” behavior. If there are any other problems, please let us know, and we will continue to respond accordingly.

 

Regarding the score system, there have been requests to implement a score renewal system. Unlike Power of Destruction, Guild Boss battles immediately apply the total score to the ranking. Because of this system, even if a higher score is achieved through repeated play, it is not reflected. We are currently discussing this and preparing improvements, such as enabling manual score updates.

 

Q. Simulation Gate rewards are too low.

- We agree that the rewards are insufficient. An increase is planned, and we aim to expand Simulation Gate stages along with a story update by the end of July.

 

Q. Gold feels even more scarce after the recent update.

- We’ll explain the gold-related updates in detail in the upcoming update notes.

 

Q. Please allow Guild name changes.

- We’ll improve this alongside the Guild Boss update work.

 

Q. Are there new skills for Sung Jinwoo?

- Yes, new skills for Sung Jinwoo are in development and will be revealed soon. His max level will also be raised with the story update at the end of July.

 

Q. Has the Developer Livestream switched to a bimonthly schedule?

- We’ll definitely hold another stream next month.

 

Q. Sung Jinwoo’s Ultimate Skill feels underwhelming.

- We’re aware that his ultimate skill lacks impact and doesn't have dedicated Runes. We're currently discussing how to improve it with the combat team and will continue refining it.

 

📌 June Update Feedback & July Update Preview & Scheduled Improvements

 

■ Tier 6 Gem and Promotion System
Tier 6 Gems, which can be obtained by upgrading Tier 5 Gems, have been added. While you may currently feel that the required materials are lacking, we will work to provide them consistently through rewards and other means.

■ Yogumunt Workshop of Brilliant Light Hard & Proof of the Strong
The first user to clear Hard Mode Yogumunt did so in just 11 minutes. We sincerely thank you for the strong interest, and as it is being developed as endgame content, we hope you continue to look forward to it.

 

In the upcoming 7/3 (Thu) update, Proof of the Strong will be added, allowing Hunters to challenge an even higher-difficulty version of Yogumunt.

 

As for the first-clear event, it was previously divided into in3,000 and in6,000 rankings, but this time, to provide better feedback and rewards to top-ranking Hunters, we've refined it to in1,000. If Hunters respond positively, we plan to continue using this more segmented approach in the future.

■ Lennart Niermann
First of all, we sincerely apologize. Due to a bug that unintentionally caused the number of hits to increase abnormally, there was an issue where skill damage was reduced. This has now been fixed and is working as intended, so there’s no need to worry.

 

Lennart Niermann is a Wind-element DPS, and we recommend pairing him with Goto Ryuji and Han Se-Mi, as they greatly support his damage cycle, including Ultimate Skill generation. For Guild Boss battles, it’s also effective to include Chae Hae-In in the team to take advantage of his passive that increases damage against enemies who cannot recover HP.

 

For Artifacts, Chaotic Infamy is the most recommended choice.

 

July Update Preview
 

■ Story Expert Mode will be released / Architect scheduled for 7/31 (Thu)
Expert Mode will be added through the 7/3 (Thu) update. For now, it will open up to Chapter 11 only, with the remaining chapters to be released sequentially over time. Expert Mode is a challenging piece of content designed for high-level Hunters, starting at around 1.2 million combat power. Due to its high difficulty, it offers generous rewards, clearing all chapters will grant a total of 35,000 Essence Stones.

 

Additionally, on 7/31 (Thu), the story will expand, and you will finally come face-to-face with the Architect. The dual dungeon storyline is filled with intense and urgent scenes, so we are paying extra attention to its cinematic presentation.

 

▲ Story Expert Mode for top tier Hunters

  

▲ On 7/31 (Thu), a dual dungeon story that include the “Architect” will be released.

 

■ Encore Missions New Boss
A new boss for the Encore Missions will be introduced, featuring two bosses appearing in a single battle. Initially, we considered splitting them into separate dungeons, but ultimately decided that having both appear together would offer a more exciting experience.

The fight begins with Helder, and once his HP drops below a certain threshold, Incaro will be summoned, turning the battle into a 2-on-1. If either boss is defeated first, the remaining boss will gain increased attack and defense, so taking them down simultaneously is the safest strategy.

 

▲ A new boss battle where the fight begins with Helder, and later Incaro joins the fray, turning it into a 2-on-1 encounter.

 

■ Hunter Balance Adjustment & Increased Exchange Limit for Advanced Mana Crystal
As with last month, Hunter balance adjustments will be made again this time. While some Hunters performed well upon their initial release, certain ones have since fallen behind in synergy or overall performance. We will continue to improve these areas on an ongoing basis.

 

In this update, five Hunters will be buffed, including four Light-element Hunters, Thomas Andre, Go Gunhee, Shimizu Akari, and Human-form Baek Yoonho, as well as Alicia Blanche. Since tuning is still in progress, the details of these changes will be shared in the upcoming patch notes.

 

If any Hunters are still underperforming after the patch, we will continue to listen to user feedback and make further adjustments. We’ll also keep monitoring Sung Jinwoo’s weapons and skills to address any areas that may feel lacking.

 

In the Mana Crystal Exchange Shop, the daily exchange limit for Advanced Mana Crystals will be increased from 100 to 200. We’ll continue adjusting the supply based on user feedback.

 

▲ Light-element Hunters and Alicia receive buffs, and the daily exchange limit for Advanced Mana Crystals at the Mana Crystal Exchange Shop will increase.

 

■ Finally! Artifact unequip cost is now free.
It seems we have been struggling to maintain it for too long. We sincerely apologize. From now on, the Artifact unequip cost will be removed regardless of enhancement level.

 

▲ You can now unequip Artifacts for free, regardless of their enhancement level.

 

■ i-dle Collaboration & Events
MIYEON and SHUHUA are joining as Hunters following an Idle collaboration. Since this is the first collaboration, we received a variety of reactions from Hunters. We have put a lot of effort into ensuring that Hunters wouldn’t be disappointed. We decided that characters shouldn’t be difficult to obtain, so simply logging in will grant each Hunter one of the characters.

 

There is only one banner, but it is not a double rate up. Hunters can select which character they want to draw. Even if you get a “pick break” (a pull where you don’t get the desired character), only the collaboration characters appear in this banner. No other Hunters will show up. For example, if you select MIYEON and get a pick break, you will receive SHUHUA instead.

 

Since there were many opinions that this collaboration felt disconnected from the Solo Leveling IP, we put a lot of thought and preparation into integrating it well with the original story. We created a story about how the i-dle characters became Hunters, so please enjoy it. As with other Hunters, this was done with approval from the original creators and Cube, and a webtoon is also planned, so please look forward to it.

 

MIYEON is a Light-element DPS Hunter who uses Defense as a stat and wields a sword as her main weapon. Other sword-wielding Hunters include Chae Hae-In, Kanae, and Mirei, but MIYEON was developed with a distinctive style. Her basic attacks and core skills focus on fast-paced, dynamic action, and her skills involve deploying and detonating constructs. She is designed with stability in mind, so her auto-play performance is good, making her accessible for beginners.

 

SHUHUA is a Water-element DPS Hunter, designed around the concept of a “baby wolf,” a theme popular with fans. Although a mage, she infuses her magic orbs with the soul of a wolf to deliver close-range damage. Her core attacks are key. When using a specific skill, she buffs herself and chains core skills consecutively. She is also easy to use for beginners.

 

The collaboration event is rich with content. As mentioned earlier, you can get the characters for free through the pass, and you can acquire Hunter data via event storylines and daily missions, allowing you to advance them to 1-star for free. Additionally, the check-in rewards grant a shared evolution material so you can evolve one character to 2-star. Of course, various other rewards and currencies are also provided.

 

▲ MIYEON and SHUHUA are joining as first i-dle collaboration.

 

▲ MIYEON is a Light-element defense-scaling DPS who utilizes fast-paced attacks and skills that deploy constructs.

 

▲ SHUHUA is a Water-element melee DPS who showcases an attack style that fits her “baby wolf” concept.

 

▲ Through the pass and mission rewards, you can obtain the characters for free and progress them up to advancement tier 2 for one character and advancement tier 1 for the other.

 

■ New Events such as Mini Games
With many new Hunters being released, we’re placing a strong focus on growth support. In line with the i-dle collaboration, we’ve added a themed mini-game, and revamped previous event formats to better match the collaboration’s style.

 

In the “Play Challenge” event, Hunters can complete designated missions to earn Weapon Custom Draw Tickets as rewards. If all missions are completed, a total of 100 tickets can be obtained. We will continue working to provide even more generous rewards in the future.

 

▲ In addition to new events themed around the i-dle collaboration, a challenge event is also being held where Hunters can earn up to 100 Weapon Custom Draw Tickets.

 

■ Regarding the i-dle Hunters and Future Plans
Not all of the i-dle Hunters will be released in this update. However, when the second phase of the collaboration takes place, the remaining members will also be given out for free, allowing all Hunters to complete the full i-dle lineup. In the next release, three Hunters will be introduced simultaneously, and overall reward quantities will be increased to ensure equal growth opportunities.

 

Since this is an i-dle collaboration, a new song and music video are also planned. The music video will initially feature the i-dle members themselves, then transition into CG, showcasing them as in-game characters in various styles. The song will be released on 7/3 (Thu) alongside the game update, while the music video is expected to take a bit more time.

 

 

▲ All 5 members will gather through the 2nd collaboration.

 

 

 ▲ A music video featuring the i-dle members will be released, with the song being unveiled first on 7/3 (Thu) alongside the game update.

 

📌 Closing Remarks

 

Jaehyun Kim, Head of Planning Department: Following the collaboration, we have various types of content in preparation for each upcoming build. We're working hard to deliver new experiences every month and will continue to share updates through future videos.

 

We’ll do our best to repay the love and support from all our Hunters.

 

Sunggeon Jin, Executive Producer: Not only for this collaboration, but also for the next ARISE update, our development team has been working tirelessly, often late into the night.

We’re doing our best to give back the love you’ve shown us, and we’d be truly grateful for your continued support.

 

 

Thank you.

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: The Architect’s Trial

Hunters Association
|
Jul 16, 2025, 10:15
|
24,798

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

We would like to express our gratitude to all Hunters for enjoying <Solo Leveling:ARISE>.

The team is working tirelessly to deliver an even more enjoyable gaming experience, driven by the passionate support and valuable feedback from all our Hunters.

 

Today, we’d like to share a preview of what’s coming in future updates.

From the end of July through September, we’ll be introducing key content updates, and we hope this brief overview helps address some of your curiosity and anticipation.

 

* Please note that the name of items, packages, and events/content scheduled to be added in the future may be subject to change. (Working Titles)

 

 

[7/31 (Thu) Update Preview]

 

Upon hearing news of a meteor shower, Sung Jinah and her team set off for the seaside.

There, they stumbled upon an unreported Gate…!!!

 

Will Sung Jinah and her team be able to safely deal with the unreported gate and still catch the meteor shower?

 

A new seasonal event [Summer Belongs to Youth] will be held for our Hunters.

Please look forward to it.

 

“Power of Destruction” Hard Mode

A new challenge awaits our even stronger Hunters! The long-awaited Hard Mode of "Power of Destruction" is finally here!

 

The Hard Mode is a prestigious content tier, and it will operate with a unified world ranking system.

Only Hunters who have achieved a certain score or higher in Normal Mode will be able to take on this elite challenge.

 

Among those who prove their strength in Hard Mode, the top-ranking Hunters will receive an exclusive reward, a special weapon costume for Sung Jinwoo, symbolizing true honor.

* A cosmetic system that changes the appearance of Sung Jinwoo’s exclusive weapon or the Hunter's equipped weapon.

 

New Story

[Sung Jinwoo demands to know the Architect’s true identity, but before answering, the Architect proposes one final trial…]

 

This time, we will be presenting four story chapters for our Hunters:

“The One-man Guild,” “Retribution,” “The Source of His Power,” and “The Moment to Decide.”

 

As Sung Jinwoo continues to level up and grow stronger, Woo Jinchul is tasked by Hunters Association President Go Gunhee with verifying whether a solo raid by Jinwoo is truly possible.

 

Don't miss the intense battle against the Architect at the Cartenon Temple, a confrontation you won’t want to miss!

 

The Start of a new Trial, “The Architect’s Trial”

 

We are aware that the Battlefield of Trials Challenge no longer offers the level of difficulty and engagement our Hunters expect.

In response, and alongside the release of new story content, we will be retiring the Battlefield of Trials Challenge and introducing a brand-new challenge mode: The Architect’s Trial.

The Architect’s Trial allows Hunters to push their limits through a Trial Level system, offering greater rewards at higher difficulties. Powerful boss monsters from the story will return in this mode, delivering a fresh strategic experience and a true test of strength.

 

An Endless Research for Growth, “Amplification System”

 

As mentioned before in a previous developer note, a new growth system called the "Amplification System" will be added.

The Amplification System is a new growth element that allows further enhancement of Skill Runes and Blessing Stones.

 

With the introduction of the Amplification System, the overall supply of Transcendent Stones in the contents will be increased.

 

To amplify Skills, you need a Transcendent rank Skill Rune or Blessing Stone and an Amplification Agent.

Amplification can succeed based on a certain rate, and even if it fails, the Transcendent rank Skill Rune or Blessing Stone used as materials will be retained.

Amplification Agent can be obtained from Power of Destruction, Battlefield of Time, and the Guild Exchange Shop.

 

Hunters will be able to enjoy the thrill of surpassing growth limits.

We ask for your great expectations.

 

Diverse Action

 

The direction our team pursues is “diverse action.”

However, it is true that this diversity has recently decreased significantly in Sung Jinwoo mode.

 

Therefore, through this update, our team will introduce the Amplification System and adjust the support skills of various Hunters upward.

Additionally, when the support skills of Hunters are buffed this time, a prefix will be added before the skill name, and balance adjustments are also planned for Sung Jinwoo’s weapons.

 

We are preparing extensively so that Hunters can enjoy diverse action, so please look forward to it.

 

IF. Sung Jinah’s Debut

 

Hunters, have you met Sung Jinah who appeared in the lobby?

Sung Jinah, the second IF Hunter, was first revealed at SLC 2025, and now she is coming to you through this update.

Please look forward to Sung Jinah’s unique Hunter: Origin, and we are excited to announce that Sung Jinah will be joining the Gate Raid!

 

Convenience Improvements and Growth Boosting

 

Our team plans to add various convenience features and mechanisms to help low-level Hunters grow faster through this update, based on the valuable feedback from Hunters.

 

First, the following improvements will be made regarding convenience.

  ⦁ A delete function will be added to presets.
  ⦁ A function to change the order of presets will be added.
  ⦁ The UI will be improved to directly display stat information, allowing clearer understanding of growth differentiation.
  ⦁ Monster statuses such as [Invincible] and [Immortal] will be separately indicated.
  ⦁ Even if you do not log in after the update, you will be able to receive content tickets.
     - However, the maximum amount you can receive cannot be exceeded.
  ⦁ When entering Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions, all difficulty stages will be unlocked.
  ⦁ When Crafting instantly, both the quantity owned and the quantity consumed will be displayed.
  ⦁ Visibility of ranks and grades on the Gem page will be improved, and you will be able to check the upgrade materials you own. A shortcut to the Gem page will be added in the Battlefield of Chaos.
  ⦁ An “Collect All” button will be added for unclaimed story rewards, and grouping (collapse/expand) of episodes and progress display (%) will be improved for better convenience.

 

Mechanisms to support the settlement of new Hunters will be added.

  ⦁ Association missions will be added, providing abundant rewards and experience points for low-level Hunters, and rewards beneficial for Sung Jinwoo and account growth for high-level Hunters.
  ⦁ Level-up convenience will be improved, and the display of stat information for Sung Jinwoo and Hunters will be enhanced for easier viewing.
  ⦁ The tutorial section, which was somewhat lengthy, will be compressed and improved so that new Hunters can adapt to the game more quickly.

 

Please look forward to the upcoming July update.

Next, we will introduce the updates planned for August and September.

 

[August Update]

 

New Monthly Content: "The Watcher's Forbidden Library" (Working title)

We are introducing a new challenge content that reconstructs memorable story episodes into dungeons. This dungeon, which resets every 4 weeks, will be a stage to test your limits through repeated challenges. Prove the true value of your strongly developed Hunters here.

Farm the materials you want! "Shadow Patrol" (Working title)

We plan to provide a system where you can focus on farming desired Shadow growth materials to accelerate the growth of the Army of Shadows.

New collection and growth fun, "Monster Cards" (Working title)

A card collection and growth system using monsters will be added. By collecting cards, you will gain various buff effects, and we are preparing for new strategic enjoyment accordingly.

Additional improvements

Convenience improvements such as adding a Guild record re-registration function.
Improved Bonds rewards with a "Collect All" function to increase convenience.

 

[September Update]

 

Real-Time Co-op PvE: “Architect Showdown” (Working title)

The real-time co-op content that Hunters have been eagerly waiting for is finally coming!

We’re introducing a PvE mode where two Hunters team up to take down a powerful boss.

 

Guild Boss Reimagined: “Colossal Statue” (Working title)

The Guild Boss is being reborn as the overwhelming presence from the original work, the “Colossal Statue.”
Get ready for a brand-new challenge as you face it together with your Guild members.

 

Research Skills Freely: “Training Room” (Working title)

This much-requested feature, also mentioned in our recent livestream, is currently in development. The so-called “dummy” mode, a Training Room where you can freely test skills and builds, will let you push your limits and experiment with new combinations.

(Please note: The content planned for the August/September updates is still under development and may change.)

 

That’s all the news we have for today.

We’re preparing to showcase videos and images of the new content through a Developer Livestream, so stay tuned, Hunters!

 

 

There are two surprise gifts for today’s developer note. A surprise gift code and a check-in event for numerous Hunters to claim rewards.

 

[Developer Note Surprise Gift]

Redeem Code

Reward Info

 

DEVNOTEARCHUPD

Custom Draw Ticket x20

Gold x1,000,000

Low-tier Mana Crystal x1,000

* The redeem code can only be used once per account and the rewards will be sent immediately upon usage.

* This redeem code can be used until 7/30 (Wed) 23:59 (UTC+0) and will not be usable after the expiration date.

 

Click [here] to check out on the check-in event that contains 3,000 Essence Stones.

 

 

Moving forward, our ARISE team will continue to listen closely to our Hunters and do our utmost to deliver the excitement of the original work through engaging and enjoyable gameplay.

Stay tuned for the upcoming updates.

 

Thank you.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

📢 7/31 (Thu) Update Details

 

 

📌 Main Story New Chapter & Improvements

▶ Main Story New Chapter

▶ Story Content Improvements

- Story content UI improvements and quality-of-life updates are being applied.

Please see below for more details.

 1. A new structure called [Act] will be added as a higher-level grouping above chapters, and chapters covering the same storyline will now be grouped under a single Act. You can view the sub-chapters by selecting each Act on the story selection screen.

 2. Chapter completion indicators will be changed to show the number of completed story segments and stages within each chapter.

 3. Normal/Hard/Expert completion indicators will be updated to show the number of completed battle missions per difficulty level.

 4. Even if a chapter contains only story segments, a COMPLETE label will now be displayed when all stories in that chapter are completed.

 5. If there are any unclaimed story rewards (clear rewards, battle mission rewards) on the main story screen, a "Claim Rewards" button will appear at the bottom left, allowing you to collect all available rewards at once.

 6. If there are any uncompleted battle mission trophies in a completed chapter, a "Trophy" button will appear at the bottom left of the main story screen, allowing you to navigate directly to the stage with incomplete battle missions.

 7. When all battle missions in a chapter are completed, the chapter’s battle mission trophy will be highlighted in yellow.

 

📌 New Sung Jinwoo Job Change

- New Sung Jinwoo Job Change [The Monarch of Shadows Code Breaker] will be added.

The Job Change conditions and rewards are as below.

📌 Skill Rune & Blessing Stone New Growth Element: Skill Research - Amplification System

▶ Skill Rune & Blessing Stone Amplification

- Add additional effects to Transcendent Skill Runes and Blessing Stones through the Amplification system.

- You can access the Amplification system through the [Skill Rune Amplification] and [Blessing Stone Amplification] on the [Skill Research] screen.

- When a Skill Rune is amplified, the final damage of the corresponding skill increases.

When a Blessing Stone is amplified, the effects of bonus Attack, bonus Defense, and bonus HP are enhanced.

* The Amplification effect is only applied when equipping the corresponding Skill Rune/Blessing Stone.

* The buff effects (Skill damage increase, Stat increase) increased through Amplification will not be applied in the Battlefield of Time. [Added 7/31 (Thu) 04:24 (UTC+0)]

 

▶ How to Amplify Skill Rune & Blessing Stone

- Transcendent Skill Runes and Blessing Stones currently in possession can be amplified up to Tier 3.

To amplify, you'll need [one identical Transcendent Skill Rune or Blessing Stone] as material.

- When amplifying Skill Runes or Blessing Stones, success is determined by a set Amplification rate for each tier.

Amplification consumes a certain amount of Amplification Agent and Gold. If you use more than the minimum required amount of Agent, your success rate will increase accordingly.

- The amount of extra Agent that can be used, the increase in success rate, and the maximum success rate all vary by Amplification tier.

* Even if amplification fails, the Skill Rune or Blessing Stone used as material will not be consumed. Only Gold and Amplification Agent will be used.

* Amplification Agents can be obtained from Battlefield of Time, Power of Destruction, and the Guild Exchange Shop, among others.

New items in the Guild Exchange Shop will be available after the next shop reset following the update (Monday 00:00 UTC+0).

 

📌 New SKill Rune

- New Skill [Piercing Thrust] and 4 exclusive Skill Runes will be added.

* The new Skill Runes consist of Rare, Heroic, Legendary, and Transcendent rank.

Please refer to the in-game details for more information.

* The new Skill Runes will be added to the Fusion list and the obtain rate for each item will be adjusted accordingly.

However, the obtain rate for each rank (Rare/Heroic/Legendary) will remain the same as before.

* As a new SKill is added, the Skill Rune list for items such as Skill Rune Chest will be updated.

📌 New Content “The Architect’s Test”

▶ The Architect’s Test

- The original Battlefield of Trials Challenge will be renewed as “The Architect’s Test.”

The Architect’s Test content can be played through Content → The Architect’s Test.

 

▶ How to Proceed

- Each season, you can challenge The Architect's Test, which consists of 12 stages.

Unlike the Battlefield of Trials Challenge, each test stage features either Sung Jinwoo Mode or Hunter Mode, depending on the test.

- The Architect's Test features up to 5 test levels based on your Battle Tier.

The higher the test level, the greater the rewards you can earn.

- You can freely adjust the test level. If a stage is too difficult to clear, you may lower the test Level to challenge it at an easier difficulty.

* Note: If you change the test level, you will no longer be able to claim the clear and reward bonuses from levels cleared prior to the change.

- The Architect’s Test, similar to the seasonal rules in the previous Battlefield of Trials Challenge, will apply.

At certain Test Levels, these rules will be more strictly enforced or enhanced.

 

📌 Power of Destruction Upper Difficulty and Improvements

▶ Power of Destruction Upper Difficulty [Eternal Condemnation]

- A new high-level difficulty, [Eternal Condemnation], is being added to Power of Destruction, following the existing Training and Normal modes.

This new difficulty unlocks when you achieve a total score of 35,000,000,000 points or higher in the Normal difficulty [Burning Grudge] stage.

* With the addition of this Hard difficulty, rankings will now apply starting from the Hard mode.

In Normal mode, Hunters will only receive individual challenge rewards.

- In Eternal Condemnation, a new version of Immortal Flame Ennio will appear with new patterns applied.

Additionally, duplicate deployment of Sung Jinwoo’s weapons is now restricted, on top of the existing duplicate Hunter restrictions.

 

▶ Power of Destruction World Ranking & Ranking Reward Adjustment

- In the [Eternal Condemnation] difficulty, a [World Ranking] will be applied, covering all Hunters across Solo Leveling:ARISE.

- Hunters who place high in the World Ranking will receive exclusive titles.

* The world ranking feature will open from 8/14 (Thu) 00:00 (UTC+0).

- With the addition of the World Ranking, the existing Group Ranking and Overall Ranking will be merged into a [Server Ranking].

Hunters who place within the top 100 on the Server Ranking will also receive exclusive titles as rewards.

* Titles awarded from the Power of Destruction World and Server Rankings are time-limited and can only be used for a specific period.

* Server and World Ranking rewards will be distributed after the ranking period ends.

- Due to the ranking system merge, rewards previously available through Group/Overall Rankings will now be obtainable via Individual Challenge Rewards and Server Ranking Rewards.

- As part of this ranking reward adjustment, the reward quantities for the Normal difficulty [Burning Grudge] stage will be increased.

-  The distribution timing of Individual Challenge Rewards will be improved:

You will now immediately receive rewards upon reaching designated records, instead of waiting until the schedule ends.

 

📌 New SSR Hunter & Exclusive Weapon

- A new SSR Wind attribute Hunter [Sung Jinah] and exclusive weapon [Blue Monsoon] will be added.

- The Hunter can be obtained through Rate Up Draw, and you can experience the power of the Hunter in advance through Hunter Preview.

- The exclusive weapon can be obtained through crafting or events.

▶ Instance Dungeon and Encore Missions – Difficulty Adjustments and Improvements

- For difficulty levels 1 through 10 of Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions, the elemental weaknesses of each boss will be changed to include all five elements.

* From level 11 and onward, bosses will retain their original elemental strengths and weaknesses.

- For hunters with a Battle Tier of 30 or below, the reward for clearing Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions will be increased.

* Hunters with Battle Tier 31 or higher will receive the same rewards as before.

Please check in-game for detailed information on the updated rewards.

- The number of Artifact Fragments obtained from difficulty level 12 and above in Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions will be slightly increased.

- When attempting Instance Dungeons or Encore Missions for the first time, all difficulty levels except Challenge mode will now be unlocked and available for challenge.

 

▶ Simulation Gate – Higher Difficulty Levels Added and Balance Adjustments

- The difficulty level, previously capped at Stage 30, will be expanded to Stage 40.

* You can choose to skip lower stages and challenge higher-level stages directly.

If you clear a higher stage without completing the lower ones, the lower-stage challenges will be completed automatically.

- With the addition of new difficulty levels, the recommended combat power and monster levels for existing stages will be adjusted.

- The first stage will be modified to prioritize code selections with specific effects.

- New collectibles with a variety of effects will be added.

 

▶ New High-Grade Enchanting Material and Material Fusion System Added

- A new enchanting material, [First Edition of Magic Crafting II], will be added.

You can obtain the First Edition of Magic Crafting II by progressing through Simulation Gate Stage 26 and above.

- The Fusion Menu will be updated to allow Hunters to combine lower-grade enchanting materials to create higher-grade ones.

The success rate of Fusion varies depending on the grade of the target material.

* Enchanting material Fusion is only available up to [First Edition of Magic Crafting I].

- The "Proof of the Strong" difficulty in The Distorted Sanctuary (Hard Mode) will be expanded from the current 10 stages to 20 stages, and starting from stage 11, new penalties will be added.

- The tier of equipped Gems (Tier 5 and above) will be displayed on each slot in the Gem Equip page.

Additionally, slots with Tier 6 or higher Gems will be visually highlighted for easier identification.

- A shortcut to the Gem Refinement menu will be added to the acquisition info popup for Tier 6 Gem items.

- When upgrading Gems, you will be able to view the option details of the Gems selected as upgrade materials.

- A new Gem-related menu icon will be added to the main screen of Battlefield of Chaos.

- The number of Gem Fragments owned per stage will be displayed in the Battlefield of Chaos.

- A new item, [Skill Runes / Blessing Stones / Gems Refinement Ticket], will be added. These tickets can be used in place of Essence Stones during the Refinement process.

These tickets are divided into two types: general tickets that can be used permanently, and limited-time tickets that are available for a set period. They can be obtained through events or package purchases.

- In both Refinement and Simple Refinement screens, a new toggle button next to the Refinement currency will allow you to choose whether to use Essence Stones or Refinement Tickets.

- If any equipment such as weapons, Artifacts, Skills, Blessing Stones, or Core settings are missing in the formation screen, an exclamation mark icon will be displayed in the corresponding tab for easier identification.

Developer Notes

7/30 (Wed) Developer Livestream Summary

Hunters Association
|
Aug 4, 2025, 09:00
|
3,290

 

📢7/30 (Wed) Developer Livestream Summary

* Please note that the content below is excerpted and translated from the inven article "The Architect’s Debut! Power of Destruction world ranking system, and 7/30 (Thu) Developer Livestream."

 [View Original Text]

* The content written below mainly addresses the Q&A details, excluding the 7/31 (Thu) update related details.

Check out the update details through our official forum.

[Go see Update Details]

 

 * To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

Redeem Code

Reward

Expiration Date (UTC+0)

Golden Mystery Chest x5

HUNTERJINAH

Custom Draw Ticket x10

Weapon Enhancement Gear III x50

UD0FARCHITECT

Gold x3,000,000

[Legendary] Blessing Stone Selection Chest I x1

 

 

📌 Q&A

 

 Q. What is the current status regarding skill-related bugs?

- We're aware that several communities have raised concerns about skill bugs. We are continuously monitoring the situation. Some logic structures affect multiple Hunters, making immediate fixes challenging.

 

Ideally, no issues would occur, but due to the nature of action games, occasional problems may arise. We ask for your understanding and will do our best to resolve them as quickly as possible.

 

Q. Q. Can we have more Preset slots?

- Since Artifact removal became free, more Hunters are actively using presets.

We're preparing improvements such as allowing Preset deletion, adding sorting features, and increasing the number of available slots.

 

Q. Guild Boss “Fachtna” seems to have a problem with targeting.

- We're addressing this issue in the current patch.

Previously, if the target was locked onto the boss’s wings and it moved significantly, the lock would cancel, causing skills to miss. We’ve adjusted the hitbox size to mitigate this problem.

 

Q. Will the Hunter Growth Event return?

- We’ll consider it based on Hunters' demand.

The event allows Hunters to reclaim invested resources through upgrades and skill resets, making it easier to reinvest.

 

Q. Q. When is the second i-dle collaboration?

- The first collab has ended, and there was a necessary cooldown period.

Although we provided free and in-game currency-supported characters, Hunters still felt the burden due to simultaneous releases.

In this update, Sung Jinwoo’s sister, Sung Jinah, will be introduced.

On August 28, the second collaboration will be released, with more well-prepared hunter characters.

 

Regarding feedback about the lack of professional dubbing, we apologize, our staff are not professional voice actors.

For the second collaboration, we're focusing on delivering improved quality, so please stay tuned.

 

Q. Will there be more bikini/swimsuit costumes?

- We’ll aim to release new costumes in line with the season.

 

Q. Q. When will the bug with SHUHUA's skill be fixed?

- As mentioned earlier, we’ve identified the issue.

The fix is scheduled for the 7/31 (Thu) update.

 

Q. Can we get a salvaging feature for Cores and Gems?

- While these items are reusable for growth, we’ll discuss the possibility of adding a salvaging feature with the dev team.

 

Q. What’s the status of adding training dummies?

- The dev team is currently working on this. It’s expected to be included in the next or the following update.

 

Q. The rewards for over-limiting collaboration characters are underwhelming.

- We’ve seen community feedback about Hunters doing 13-limit breaks.

Currently, platinum coins are given, but their usage is unsatisfying.

In the second collaboration, we’re preparing better rewards for Hunters who continue to obtain characters post-max limit.

 

Q. Will the second collaboration also have dual character rate up banners? Dual rate ups feel kind of burdensome.

- It depends on how you interpret the concept of a dual-rate up, but in the recent MIYEON and SHUHUA rate up, we assigned only those two characters to a single banner.

This effectively eliminated the issue of off-banner characters appearing, and we aimed to minimize the burden on Hunters.

In the end, we believe it was a good solution.

 

However, as mentioned in a previous question, we were unable to resolve the issue that arises when Hunters continue to obtain character copies beyond the 10th advancement tier.

That’s why, in the upcoming second collaboration, three characters will appear in a single banner, and we are planning to implement an additional system to resolve that issue.

 

Q. Can new Hunters obtain the older swimsuit costumes?

- We are currently discussing the re-release of previous costumes with our business team.

The goal is to make them available again before the summer ends.

* Some swimsuit costumes will be available through the event below.

[🌟2025 Summer Festival Hosted by the Hunters Association🌟]

 

Q. Q. When will Kamish's Rage be released?

- The Kamish Raid is a major storyline event even in the original work, and our development team also considers it a key content. We're currently developing it as a real-time multiplayer feature. We're putting a lot of thought into this, so that we can present it in a more engaging and substantial form.

 

Q. There's a bug where preset use in Power of Destruction unselects skills.

- We will check once more to see if the bug fix is included in this update. If not, we’ll make sure to apply a fix as soon as possible.

 

Q. Can Baran cores be dropped in Yogumunt content?

- We've seen feedback that Baran cores are preferred in some builds. We will discuss potential improvements with the development team.

 

Q. The Dark attribute seems underpowered. Any plans for improvement?

- We've consistently received feedback on this. Some Hunters have requested Liu Zhigang to be a Dark element, or questioned why Sung Jinah wasn’t Dark.

It’s true that the Dark attribute has a relatively small pool of characters, partly due to the release order. One Dark-attribute Hunter is planned for the August 2nd collaboration, and we’re preparing to expand the Dark lineup quickly in future updates.

 

+ On Real-Time Multiplayer Content

- In the previous update, we introduced real-time multiplayer content, and we’re now working on developing a more advanced version of it.

Development is being expedited, and in the next update, you’ll experience battles featuring two controllable characters simultaneously. We’ll continue to add new content, not just story updates.

 

📌 Closing Remarks

 

Lee Da Haeng Head of the Business Department: Rather than going outside on such hot days, we recommend cooling off in front of the air conditioner and enjoying Solo Leveling:ARISE (laughs).

This time, we’ve prepared a substantial amount of story content and a wide variety of features.

During the collaboration period, there were some limitations in expanding content, but for this update, and the upcoming ones, we’ve prepared a lot, so please look forward to it.

 

We’ve also received many requests to continue communicating through developer notes.

We’ll keep providing information through formats like CM Notes and work hard to maintain communication, so we ask for your continued support.

 

Jin Sung Gun, Executive Producer: Following the collaboration, the development team poured a great deal of effort into this story.

It was a story I personally had high expectations for, and it turned out with great quality.

We hope you enjoy playing it and continue to show your love and support.

 

 

Thank you.

Developer Note: A Path Together

Hunters Association
|
Aug 8, 2025, 09:00
|
21,887

 

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

Today, through this Developer Note, we would like to share detailed updates on the development progress of the content previously mentioned in our last Developer Note and live broadcast. In addition, we will respond to the valuable feedback Hunters have shared with us through the recent survey, one by one.

 

* Please note that the name of items, packages, and events/content scheduled to be added in the future may be subject to change. (Working Titles)

 

 

[The voice of our Hunters lights our path.]

First of all, we sincerely thank all the Hunters who took the time to participate in the recent survey.

Every single piece of feedback you shared was carefully reviewed by our entire team. Through your responses, we were able to better understand which aspects brought you joy and which areas left you wanting more.

That time spent reading your voices was truly invaluable to us.

If you haven’t yet had a chance to check out the survey results, we highly encourage you to take a look and see the picture your voices have painted!

 

[See Last Survey Result]

 

"Solo Leveling:ARISE? is a project we’re building together with our Hunters.

Moving forward, we will continue striving to communicate with you through surveys and various other means.

We kindly ask you to keep shining a light on the path ahead for us. 😁

 

[The Architect Raid]

 

Ever since the “Ant King Alliance Raid” introduced during the Jeju Island event, our development team has been focused on one key question, “How can we make cooperative gameplay truly fun?”

After much deliberation, we found the answer within the valuable feedback you, our Hunters, have shared through various channels, and now, the time has come to reveal the result of that journey.

 

Originally planned for release after September, this new content has been fast-tracked so we could share it with you as soon as possible.

In the upcoming August update, you’ll get to experience an all-new cooperative battle mode where you and your partner take on the battlefield together.

 

“The Architect Raid” builds on the foundation set by the previous Ant King Alliance Raid, where a shared boss HP system was introduced. This time, we’ve gone further, emphasizing tactical cooperation, where partners divide roles, support each other, and work together to overcome a formidable enemy.

To ensure smooth, high-intensity combat even in a mobile environment, we’ve optimized the experience for 2-player co-op through the Sung Jinwoo Mode, increasing both the precision and tension of battle.

 

We also heard your feedback about the fatigue caused by 10 repetitive runs during the previous event. For this update, we’ve restructured the format, removing unnecessary repetition and focusing purely on delivering the thrill of combat itself.

 

We hope you’re as excited as we are for this new dimension of cooperative gameplay in the upcoming update. Stay tuned.

 

[Shadow Vigilantes]

 

 

An unexpected era of chaos where consecutive unexpected incidents occur.

Sung Jinwoo dispatches Shadow Vigilantes around the world and the Shadows prevent chaos by completing various missions on Sung Jinwoo’s order.

 

The new content introduced in this update, Shadow Vigilantes, is built upon one core principle, growth efficiency.

 

Through a variety of missions, you’ll be able to choose the rewards you want and set them as your personal mission objectives.

Following your command, the Shadow Vigilantes will act solely to achieve that goal.

Now is the time for you, Hunter, to make your choice for efficient growth.

 

[i-dle Joining as a complete unit!]

 

 

Hunters, thank you for waiting!

Following MIYEON and SHUHUA, through this update, at last all members of i-dle have become a complete group and join the battlefield of Solo Leveling:ARISE as Hunters.

In the previous Developer Livestream, we gave a small hint about one member’s attribute, and today we will fully unveil it.

We now introduce the new Hunters, each armed with their own individuality, YUQI who uses gauntlets (Fire attribute), SOYEON who uses dual pistols (Wind attribute), and MINNIE who uses a scythe (Dark attribute).

 

Armed with their respective attributes, they will open an entirely new paradigm of battle unlike anything before.

Please look forward to their brilliant activities that will unfold within the world of Solo Leveling:ARISE!

 

[More Changes]

In addition to the matters mentioned above, our team is preparing various other changes to bring greater enjoyment to our Hunters.

 

First, we will deepen the combat experience and add new content for Hunters to enjoy.

New Guild Boss
The “Giant Statue,” which demonstrated overwhelming presence in the story, will appear as a new Guild Boss.
The Guild Boss re-registration feature, originally planned for August, has been changed to the September update.
Content previously planned for September has been adjusted to August, and the content announced in the previous Developer Note as scheduled for August has been changed to September.
Due to the addition of the The Architect Raid and the new Guild Boss, the “Watcher’s Forbidden Library” and “Monster Collection” content mentioned in the last Developer Note as coming in August will be moved to September.
Story Expansion
Chapters 12–15 will be added to Story Mode Expert difficulty.
Chapters 26–29 (Normal/Hard) will be added to Story Mode Reverse difficulty.
Battle Tier Maximum Level Expansion
The Battle Tier maximum level will be expanded to Level 90.
Dark Attribute Hunter Balance Adjustment
After analyzing recent combat data, we determined that Dark attribute Hunters have difficulty gaining an advantage compared to other attributes, so their balance will be adjusted upward.

 

We will also renew convenience features so that Hunters can focus more of their valuable time on combat.

A “Level Up All Skills” button will be added to allow leveling all skills to the target level at once.
An “Claim All” feature will be added for Bonds Rewards, allowing all rewards to be obtained easily.
To make Artifact management more comfortable, the following features will be added.
After Artifact enhancement, a “Salvage” button will be added to salvage immediately.
When using “Select All,” a filter button will be added to select only desired Artifacts.
When equipping Artifacts automatically, recommended stats will be prioritized.
Recommended Artifact set information will be added to ease the difficulty of setting up.
Gold rewards from Gate missions will be increased, allowing more Gold to be obtained.
Voices will be added to Dossiers, allowing the hidden stories to be enjoyed more vividly.

 

On the day of the update, there will likely be even more news waiting that we cannot yet reveal as it is still under preparation.

 

Additionally, we are preparing for the journey beyond August.

For us, it is about creating abundant content that Hunters can enjoy even more, and for you, Hunters, to join us in that journey.

 

We would like to give you a small preview of some of those plans.

 

Response to the Voices of Hunters – Opening of the [Training Room]

This is the very content that many of our Hunters have been requesting for a long time.

In the Training Room, we hope you will research your own skill combos, experiment with optimal damage settings, and complete the ultimate build.

 

A New Threat: The Appearance of the Commander of Steel Army [Valtair]

A new hidden story is coming to our Hunters.

 

Preparing the Ultimate Test – PvP Content

We are finally beginning preparations for developing PvP content.

However, we believe that such an important feature should not be introduced hastily, and we are currently in the early stages of development, keeping various possibilities open to find the most enjoyable and fair rules.

Many aspects may change during the development process, but please understand that this is all part of creating a better final product, and we hope you will continue to watch with interest.

 

 

This concludes what we have prepared to share with you today.

We will continue to listen to the voices of our Hunters and work tirelessly to repay you with the best possible results.

 

We promise to maintain communication with our Hunters not only through Developer Notes, but also via CM Notes, live broadcasts, and surveys.

Please look forward to next week’s Power of Destruction Hard Mode event, where weapon costumes will be awarded to the top 3,000 Hunters in the weekly world rankings.

 

As a token of our gratitude to all the Hunters who stayed with us until the end of this story, we have prepared a small gift.

Until the day we meet again, we wish you happy leveling, always.

Thank you.

Developer Notes

8/26 (Tue) Developer Livestream Summary

Hunters Association
|
Aug 27, 2025, 10:00

9,137

 

📢 8/26 (Tue) Developer Livestream Summary

* Please note that the content below is excerpted and translated from the inven article "i-dle 2nd Collaboration! Giant Statue Boss etc. 8/26 Developer Livestream."

[View Original Text]

* The content written below mainly addresses the Q&A details, excluding the 828 (Thu) update related details.

Check out the update details through our official forum in the future.

 

 * To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

 

 

Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream

Code

Reward

Expiration Date (UTC+0)

AUG28THUD

Abyssal Crystal x5

Traces of Shadow x100

Low-tier Mana Crystal x1,000

2NDIDLECOLLAB

Custom Draw Ticket x10

Weapon Enhancement Gear III x50

HAPPY500TH

Rune Fragment x1,000

Powder of Blessing x500

Gold x1,000,000

 

 

📌 Q&A

 

Q. Will there be a new Dark-element Hunter?

- According to tier lists from partner streamers and the community, Dark-element is often rated Tier 3–4.

We’ve been preparing extensively, and a new Dark-element Hunter will be released the day after tomorrow.

Of course, simply adding a new Hunter has its limits, so existing Hunters will also receive buffs.

 

Q. Rewards for obtaining a Hunter beyond 10 advancements feel lacking.

- If you obtain a Hunter that has already reached 10 advancements, you will now receive an additional item called the Hunters Association Special Certificate.

A new shop will be added where this certificate can be used to purchase SSR Hunters.

More exchange items will be added over time.

If all current Hunters are maxed, you can save these certificates and use them on future Hunters.

 

Weapons already have a separate system, so we’re not yet ready for additional rewards, but we’ll discuss alternatives.

 

Q. Gold income feels insufficient. (13th Q&A request)

- Gold is consumed in many places, especially Fusions and Artifact enhancement, making it scarce for some Hunters.

In this update, Gate rewards will be greatly increased to provide more Gold.

We will continue to add more content that grants Gold and steadily increase overall supply.

 

Q. The Red Dot bug needs fixing.

- We found lingering Red Dot bugs in Guild Boss and Hunter Preview. These have been fixed in this update. Please check again after patching. If the Red Dot bug reappears, we promise to provide a reward redemption code in the next Developer Livestream as compensation.

 

Q. Will new bosses be added to Battlefield of Time?

- Since the same bosses have been repeating, new bosses will be added starting with the next update. A new monster, Allon, who appeared in the story, will join as a boss. We’re also preparing gimmicks to shorten the normal monster phases.

 

Q. The “Power of Destruction” arm related bug is severe.

- There was an issue with how the arm’s movement position was set. A partial fix has been applied and will be live in the day-after-tomorrow update. We sincerely apologize for recurring issues. If the problem persists, we will once again provide a reward redemption code.

 

Q. Hacks/cheats are causing problems.

- We have real-time detection, but there were some issues. Fixes are included in this update, and we will continue strict monitoring.

 

In the early days, hacking was rampant, but after implementing the Shield Formation system, it decreased significantly. With new content, hacks resurfaced, but we have past experience in handling them and will continue blocking them. For those pushed out of the in3000 missions due to hackers, rankings will be recalculated excluding those users, so you don’t need to worry.

 

Q. Will there be another Artifact Modification Event?

- Yes, it’s ready. Please check the upcoming event schedule.

 

Q. Can Hunters using account-boosting (“proxy play”) in Battlefield of Time be punished?

- In the past, we sanctioned cases where multiple accounts were used on the same IP. However, some Hunters adapt by changing environments, making it difficult without concrete evidence. We’re continuing to explore solutions. For the Power of Destruction in3000 event, we will try our best to filter out proxy participants before rewards are distributed.

 

Q. Will Championships return?

- Hosting tournaments requires proper groundwork. Once we finalize how they’ll be structured, we’ll provide details.

 

Q. Any new Shadows planned?

- A new Shadow, “Naga”, is scheduled for the September update.

 

Q. More resources for returning Hunters?

- We recognize shortages of items like Mana Power Extract. We’re preparing events with generous rewards for returning Hunters.

 

Q. Can you add a cart/bulk purchase option in the web shop?

- We understand the inconvenience of buying items one by one. We’ll discuss implementing a bulk purchase feature.

 

Q. It’s hard to control Hunter ultimate skills in Guild Boss battles.

- We understand ultimate timing greatly affects Rage stack counts. We’ll discuss adding a feature to make ultimate usage easier to manage.

 

Q. We are in need of Sung Jinwoo's new ultimate skill.

- We are preparing something new regarding ultimates internally.

 

Q. Heavy users who rank high in Power of Destruction want better rewards.

- Ranking rewards need stronger anti-abuse measures before expansion. Once we resolve abuse issues, we’ll gradually enhance rewards.

 

Q. Content updates feel too F2P-oriented.

- Our goal is to satisfy both free-to-play and top-tier Hunters. This is challenging, but we plan to provide content for F2P players while also ensuring meaningful perks for Hunters buying packages.

 

Internally, we’re discussing compensation systems and are preparing honor-based rewards with real value.

 

Q. When will level caps be expanded?

- With the new story update in September, levels will also be expanded.

 

Q. Will higher-level Artifacts be released?

- A full Artifact reset must be timed carefully. Many newer Hunters still struggle to complete current Artifacts. We expect a reset to be considered around the time a new Monarch is introduced.

 

📌 Closing Remarks

 

Jin Sung Gun, Executive Producer:  Thank you for your unwavering love over the past 500 days.

Thanks to all of you, I’ve truly enjoyed communicating with you throughout our live service.

Both the business and development teams are working hard to create a more enjoyable game.

With this new content and beyond, we will continue to bring you fresh experiences, so I kindly ask for your continued support.

 

Lee Da Haeng Head of the Business Department: It has truly been an eventful journey during these 500 days of service.

With the feedback you’ve shared, our service has also leveled up alongside the game.

I hope we can keep growing together as a game that levels up with our players.

Thank you for leaving us so many opinions in the chat, and I look forward to your ongoing interest and support.

 

 

Thank you.

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

Here are the details scheduled to be added and changed through the update on 8/28 (Thu).

 

Please see below for more details about the update.

 

 

📢 8/28 (Thu) Update Details

 

 

📌 Story Expert & Reverse Story New Chapter

- Chapter 12-15 will be newly added to the expert difficulty.

- Chapters 26–29, added in the July 31 update, will now be available in Reverse Mode on Normal and Hard difficulty.

* With the addition of new story content, cumulative achievement rewards for Battle Missions in Expert difficulty, Reverse Mode Normal, and Reverse Mode Hard will also be added.

 

📌 [Cartenon Temple: Co-op Battle] Event Open

- A new PvE event, [Cartenon Temple: Co-op Battle], will be held where Hunters work together to clear stages.

- During the event, three types of dungeons will be available, Guild Boss, Solo Dungeon, and 2-Player Multiplayer Dungeon.

- Among the three, [Proof: The Architect Co-op Battle] is a dungeon that requires two players to cooperate in real time.

You can challenge the Proof: The Architect Co-op Battle via random matchmaking, or by creating a room and teaming up with Guild members or friends.

 

Join forces with other Hunters to conquer the Cartenon Temple and earn a variety of rewards!

 

For details on the event schedule and participation, please refer to the notice below.

[Cartenon Temple: Co-op Battle Event]

 

📌 New Guild Boss [Giant Statue]

- A new guild boss, the "Giant Statue," will be added.

- The Giant Statue has Darkness as its fixed recommended attribute, and during the August 28 update period, both of its variable attributes will be fixed as Fire/Wind.

When it reappears later, the original variable attribute rules will apply.

* The Giant Statue will join the regular Guild Boss rotation along with Fachtna and the Ant Queen, and can be challenged periodically.

 

📌 New Content [Shadow Enforcer]

- A new system where you can dispatch Shadows on various missions to earn rewards will be added.

This feature is available after advancing to Monarch of Shadows, via [Quick Menu] - [Shadow Enforcer] in the lobby.

 

▶ How to Participate

- Choose a mission from the list, select the reward and the Shadows to carry it out, set the duration, and start the mission.

- Missions are categorized into four types, Stop Crimes / Protect Allies / Special Tasks / General. Available Shadows and obtainable rewards vary by category.

* Even if you don’t have suitable Shadows, you can still dispatch regular Shadow soldiers.

However, in this case, the mission duration will be fixed and cannot be changed.

- Once the mission time elapses, the mission will be completed and you’ll receive the chosen reward along with Mission Proficiency.

- Accumulating enough Mission Proficiency will increase your proficiency level.

As proficiency increases, you’ll gain Mission Points to unlock additional mission types or increase the number of missions you can run simultaneously.

 

📌 New Blessing Stones

- New Empowerment Blessing Stones, [Acrobat] and [Finisher Touch] will be added.

- New Survival Blessing Stones, [Weapon Resonance] and [Life in Motion] will be added.

* New Blessing Stones are available in Rare, Heroic, Legendary, and Transcendent grades.

Please check in-game for more details.

* These new Blessing Stones will be added to the Fusion lineup, and item acquisition rates will be adjusted.

However, the overall drop rates by grade (Rare/Heroic/Legendary) remain unchanged.

* With their addition, items such as the Blessing Stone Chest and Transcendent Blessing Stone Chest will be updated to include the new stones.

 

📌 i-dle Collaboration: New SSR Hunters & Exclusive Weapons

- SSR Dark attribute Hunter [MINNIE] and exclusive weapon [Purple Butterfly's Dream] will be added.

- SSR Wind attribute Hunter [SOYEON] and exclusive weapon [Blazing Flash] will be added.

- SSR Fire attribute Hunter [YUQI] and exclusive weapon [Righteous Sun] will be added.

- The Hunter can be obtained through Rate Up Draw, and you can experience the power of the Hunter in advance through Hunter Preview.

- The exclusive weapon can be obtained through crafting or events.

- The new Hunters’ Profile Icon, Dossier, Codex, Bonds will also be added.

- The original story and Secret Library for MINNIE / SOYEON . YUQI will be added.

* Collaboration Hunters will not be included in the Custom Draw lineup after the Rate Up Draw period ends.

* Rate Up Draw and weapon crafting (2 existing + 3 new) for the Collaboration Hunters will only be available during the collaboration event period, and will no longer be craftable after the next regular update.
