- Sung Jinwoo’s weapon [Allon’s Orb] event crafting will be held during the update period.

* The corresponding weapon can be crafted up to 2 times per account by consuming Special Player's Weapon Design.

 

 

📌 Balance Adjustment [LINK]

- Balance for certain Hunters will be adjusted.

- Balance for certain Artifacts will be adjusted.

* Please see the details through a separate notice.

 

📌 New Feature: [Hunters Association Support Check-In/Mission] for New Hunters

- A new feature, [Hunters Association Support Check-In/Mission], will be added to help new Hunters grow by providing various rewards and missions over a set period of time.

* This check-in and mission system will be available to all Hunters after the 8/28 update.

- You can access the Hunters Association Support Check-In/Mission feature through the [Quick Menu] in the Hunters Association lobby.

- After completing a set period of [Hunters Association Support Check-In], the [Hunters Association Support Mission] tab will be unlocked.

In Hunters Association Support Missions, you can participate in various in-game content to earn Mission loyalty points, and claim rewards based on the accumulated loyalties.

- For more details on Hunters Association Support Missions, please refer to the link below.

[Hunters Association Support Event]

 

📌 New Feature: Level Up All Skills & Skill Management Improvements

- A [Batch Skill Level-Up] function has been added to the skill page under Hunter, Weapon, and Shadow management menus.

By selecting the desired skills and target levels, you can level them up all at once with this feature.

* If the required materials (Skill Scrolls, Gold, Mana Power Extract), Hunter level, or Shadow grade conditions are insufficient, Batch Level-Up cannot be performed.

- For Hunter skills, a recommended skill leveling order toggle button has been added to both the skill screen and the Batch Skill Level-Up screen.

When enabled, it will display the suggested order for leveling Hunter's skills.

- For Hunters and Weapons with all skills leveled to the maximum, a “skill level max” icon will now be displayed in the management screen for easier confirmation.

 

📌 New Hunter & Weapon Growth Reset Feature

- Growth reset functions previously available only during special events, such as Hunter upgrade and skill resets, are now permanent features. You can use the reset tickets to perform them anytime.

- For Hunters, the same upgrade/skill reset functions from past events will be available.

For Weapons, you can reset Sung Jinwoo’s/Hunter weapon levels and Sung Jinwoo’s weapon skill levels.

* Weapon level reset will only reset the weapon’s level. Weapon limit break status will not be reset.

- To use these reset features, you will need specific reset tickets (Hunter Upgrade Reset / Hunter Skill Reset / Weapon Level Reset / Weapon Skill Reset Tickets).

These tickets can be obtained as in-game rewards or purchased from the Shop/Subscription Shop.

* After the 8/28 update, Growth Reset Tickets will be added to story stage rewards. Hunters who have already cleared the relevant stages will be compensated accordingly.

 

📌 Artifact Quality of Life Improvements

▶ Artifact Equipment Convenience

- A new “recommended stat count” indicator will be added to the Hunter/Sung Jinwoo Artifact information and Artifact equipment screens.

This count increases when the Artifact’s main/sub options and enhancement bonus include any of the Hunter’s three recommended stats.

- When equipping Artifacts individually to a Hunter, a “recommended stat display” icon will be added next to the criteria section.

Tapping this icon will display the recommended stat count for each Artifact.

- When using Auto Equip for Artifacts, the system will now prioritize the Hunter’s recommended stat count over enhancement level.

- For Sung Jinwoo, the recommended stat feature will be applied to Artifacts. Auto Equip will now prioritize the recommended stats (ATK / Crit DMG / Crit Rate).

 

▶ Artifact Enhancement Screen Improvements

- A “Salvage” button has been added to the Artifact Enhancement screen, allowing you to salvage unnecessary Artifacts immediately after enhancement.

- When an Artifact Modification Event is active, a direct shortcut button to the event screen will be available from the Artifact Enhancement screen.

- When enchanting Artifacts equipped by a Hunter, options matching that Hunter’s recommended stats will now be highlighted in brighter colors.

 

▶ Artifact Crafting Convenience

- From the [Artifact] menu, when selecting an individual Artifact, or when choosing [recommended set] under [Hunter] > [Artifact] management,

a button will be added to move directly to the crafting screen for the selected Artifact.

 

▶ Artifact Management Convenience

- In the [Artifact] > [Artifact Management] screen, when selecting multiple Artifacts, a new filter adjustment button has been added.

In addition to grade, level, and enhancement state, you can now specify desired options before bulk-selecting Artifacts.

 

📌 Other Content Improvements & Adjustments

▶ Architect’s Test: New Season

A new season of Architect’s Test will begin, featuring updated rules as well as new strength/weakness attributes.

* Please check in-game for detailed content rules and rewards.

 

▶ Battle Tier Expansion

- The Battle Tier cap will be increased from 80 to 90.

Rewards will be granted upon reaching each newly added tier.

 

▶ Instance Dungeon & Encore Missions Difficulty Adjustments

- The boss elemental weaknesses introduced in the July 31 update are now extended from Stage 10 to Stage 20.

* From Stage 21 onward, bosses will have the same strengths/weaknesses as before.

* Rules applied to each boss in Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions remain unchanged.

- Unlock requirements have been streamlined, instead of unlocking 30 stages at once, stages are now unlocked in sets of 10 (1–10 / 11–20 / 21–30 / 31+).

* To unlock the next set, you must clear the final stage of the current set (10, 20, 30, etc.).

 

▶ Gate Mission Gold Rewards & Red Gate Frequency Increased

- Gold rewards from Gate Missions, which are earned by clearing Gates a set number of times, will be increased.

- The appearance rate of Red Gates during Gate exploration and Gate clearing will be raised.

 

 

📌 Update New Packages

- The packages below will be added after the update.

Please see the details on the new packages through the new packages notice below.

 [8/28 (Thu) New Packages]

 

📌 System Shop New Packages

- After the maintenance on 8/28, packages below will be added to the system shop.

Package

Legendary Skill Rune Selection Chance Pack

Legendary Blessing Stone Selection Chance Pack

Army of Shadows Growth Chance Pack

* Chance Pack packages will appear depending on your game progress, such as content clears, weapon growth, or Hunter growth.

Once displayed, they can only be purchased within a limited time.

* Details of the new Chance Packs can be checked in-game when the packages are displayed.

Depending on the package type, Gold, Essence Stones, or direct purchase methods may apply, so please check in-game for specifics.

 

 

📌 Other Improvements

- The Hunter Association lobby and parts of the in-game UI will be updated to match the collaboration event theme.

- A “Claim All” button has been added to the Bonds menu, allowing you to collect all available Bonds rewards at once.

- A shortcut button has been added to the Instance Dungeon and Encore Mission screens, allowing instant navigation between the two integrated dungeon categories.

- In the Shop/Exchange, products with purchase periods other than daily/weekly (e.g., 14-day, 21-day) will now display their exact remaining purchase duration.

- In the Exchange, items that have reached their purchase limit will now display the remaining time until they become available again.

- In the Simulation Gate’s System Check section, collection items already registered in the Codex will now be marked with a separate icon when browsing the collection shop.

- The composition and reward order of certain “Train to Become a Formidable Combatant” missions will be adjusted.

- During World Drop Events, the event page will now display detailed information on the relevant event items and associated events.

- For Hunters with an active Hunters Association Premium Subscription, Subscription Points can now still be earned from Daily/Weekly Missions even if you have already accumulated 3,000 or more points.

- In Hunter Mode, Tawata Kanae’s auto-battle skill usage priority will be improved.

- When drawing Hunters, if you obtain an SSR Hunter beyond your 11th pull, you will now receive not only Commemorative Coins but also a Hunters Association Special Certificate that can be used in the Exchange.

* The Special Certificate can be used in the Commemorative Coin Exchange to purchase [Hunters Association Special Certificate Exchange] products.

* In the Hunters Association Special Certificate Exchange, you can select and obtain one SSR Hunter that you currently own.

However, the rate up Hunters added through the new update will not be included in the Special Certification exchange line up right away and may be added after a certain period of time.

- A new Weapon Costume category will be added to the Costume Codex.

- The condition for converting Shard of Baran → Shard of Yogumunt via Shard conversion will be eased, from “Clear Workshop of Brilliant Light – The Distorted Sanctuary (Hard)” to simply “Unlock Workshop of Brilliant Light – The Distorted Sanctuary.”

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the issue where the screen would turn white after completing the final Train to Become a Formidable Combatant mission with all challenges cleared.

- Fixed the issue where the title item (reward from Power of Destruction ranking) did not display its acquisition method in the item info popup.

- Fixed the intermittent issue where the ranking list would not refresh immediately when switching between World Ranking and Server Ranking tabs in Power of Destruction.

- Fixed the issue where, under certain conditions, Ennio could move to an unreachable location during Power of Destruction – Eternal Condemnation difficulty.

- Fixed the issue where the Fusion and Refinement UI displayed abnormally in certain situations.

- Fixed the intermittent issue where the game would freeze when reforging Artifacts.

- Fixed the issue where the Guild Boss formation screen displayed the wrong number of members in the warning message when attempting to assign more than 6 members.

- Fixed the issue where forcibly canceling while returning from Workshop of Brilliant Light caused errors upon re-entering or retrying return.

- Fixed the intermittent issue in Simulation Gate where the boss in a special battle appeared incorrectly within the same difficulty level.

- Fixed the issue in Story Chapter 26 side story [Ghosts of the Past] where some cutscenes played awkwardly.

- Fixed the issue in Story Chapter 29 side story [The Parting Memory] where, under certain conditions, Hunters could move outside of the battle area.

- Fixed the issue where adding presets in certain languages triggered an error popup and the preset was not added correctly.

- Fixed the issue where the Ultimate Skill “Truth: White Flame Strike” of Hunter Baek Yoonho did not display Power Gauge consumption in the skill description.

- Fixed the issue where the Light Attribute damage increase effect of Gold-tailed Fox’s “Golden Wound” only applied to the first hit.

- Fixed the issue where the additional damage effect of Vulcan's Rage “Concentration” did not apply correctly at 20 stacks.

- Fixed the issue where items in the Growth Tournament Event Shop did not display as purchased even after the purchase limit was reached.

- Fixed the issue where unclaimed returning Hunter check-in rewards were not granted upon re-login if the Hunter had partially collected them previously.

- Fixed the intermittent issue where some Hunters Association Mission rewards were not distributed correctly when all rewards were claimed.

* For Hunters who did not receive certain returning Hunter check-in rewards or Hunters Association Mission rewards, the missing rewards will be distributed separately after maintenance.

- Fixed the intermittent issue where the game did not progress normally during the download phase of initial installation.

- Fixed the issue where the red dot notification in the Hunter Preview did not disappear for some Hunters.

- Fixed the issue where the Activity Funds rewards were not accumulating correctly under certain conditions.

* As the issue is being resolved, the compensations below will be given to all Hunters.

Reward

Reward Claim Period (UTC+0)

Gold x5,000,000

[Hunter] Mana Power Elixir III x30

Traces of Shadow x30

Weapon Enhancement Gear III x20

After the maintenance on 8/28 (Thu) - 9/4 (Thu) 14:59

* The compensations will be sent via mail and please be sure to claim them within the mail storage period.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Note: The Monarch of Steel Valtair [Updated 9/5 (Fri) 11:42 (UTC+0)]

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: The Monarch of Steel Valtair [Updated 9/5 (Fri) 11:42 (UTC+0)]

Hunters Association
|
Sep 5, 2025, 06:30
|
15,263

 

Greetings, Hunters!
This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

Are you enjoying the fun experience of teaming up with fellow Hunters in the first-ever Co-op Battle?
Even at this very moment, our team is carefully observing how you cooperate, what brings you joy, and what you may find disappointing.

 

Every piece of valuable feedback you share with us becomes a guiding light that shows us the way forward. We will continue to do our utmost to provide the best service possible.

 

Today, we would like to share with you the exciting new update coming in September, as well as a glimpse into the stories we are preparing for the future.

 

* Please note that the name of items, packages, and events/content scheduled to be added in the future may be subject to change. (Working Titles) 

 

 

Hidden Story - The Monarch of Steel [Valtair]

 

[Valtair]

[Allon]

 

The arrogant general who leads the army of steel, Valtair, is welcoming our Hunters to the stage.
"My name is Valtair, the general of my army. I know that the power you have shown me is not your full strength. I’m inviting you to my stage. Come up and show me your full strength!"
The main boss of the new hidden story, “Valtair,” is not just a simple destroyer.

 

As the monarch of the steel army, Valtair possesses exceptional commanding ability.
There is a little secret to Valtair’s commanding ability, which is controlling the opponent with its “magic threads.”
Since he can command any being that possesses Mana, regardless of race, Valtair has caused strange and mysterious incidents.
Join Sung Jinwoo upon Valtair’s "stage" and uncover every hidden secret.

 

In response to the passionate voices you shared during our recent livestream, the upcoming story expansion will raise the maximum level cap, and Sung Jinwoo’s new Job Change, designed to confront the hidden story, will also be revealed.

 

Look forward to the grand saga soon to unfold, and to the new realm of power that awaits at its climax.

 

[New Shadow Jima]

A new Shadow, Jima, joins Sung Jinwoo’s army to strengthen its might.
Wielding twin spears, Shadow Jima possesses Leader Effects that increase Attack Power and Shield Gain. The moment you appoint him as Leader, your entire team’s attack power will be elevated beyond its limits.

 

Seize his power and make your Shadow Legion even stronger.

 

[Training Room]

Dear Hunters, the perfect spot to test all your strategy is about to be unveiled.
Freely use both Sung Jinwoo and Hunter modes in the training room to test your builds.
⦁     Combo Guide: Displays recommended skill sequences, allowing you to practice combos.
⦁     Performance Check: Measure your combat power precisely with a "damage meter" and "stopwatch."
⦁     Quality of Life Features: Make repeated testing more convenient with the "reset button" and "saved Preset recall."
⦁     Opponent Settings: Disable Monster AI or create custom enemies with "detailed opponent options."
Complete your own build and challenge for a higher tier!
Additionally, based on our Hunters’ feedback, features below have been improved.

 

[No More Wasted Simulation Gate Tickets]
Hunters, many of you may have experienced the frustration of choosing a high difficulty in the Simulation Gate, only to fail without even getting the chance to test your setup, losing your valuable entry ticket.

 

Based on your feedback, the entry system for the Simulation Gate is being updated.
Upon entry, you will be able to choose between [Practice Mode], which does not consume a ticket, and [Battle Mode] (tentative name), which functions as before and provides rewards.

 

In Practice Mode, feel free to experiment with different team combinations and strategies.
Of course, unexpected variables may arise in real battles, so results may not be 100% identical to your practice runs. However, you can now enter Battle Mode with confidence after sufficient preparation.

Your valuable tickets will no longer go to waste.

 

[Guild Boss & Shop Renewal]

With this update, the Guild Boss content will be revamped to be more convenient and strategic.
Forget about the hassle of manual score submissions, now only the thrill of battle to achieve the highest score remains.

Score submission will change from manual to automatic, and your best score for each attempt will be recorded automatically.

 

One record doesn’t mean it’s the end.
Through “free retries and resets,” you can immediately retry with the same team you just used to aim for a higher score, or if you weren’t satisfied with your team composition, you can reset both the score and attempt record for that round to start over with a completely new team.
 

Now, unleash all your strategies without pressure and aim for the very best score in the Guild Boss battles.

 

In addition, Guild-exclusive Artifacts will be added to the Guild Exchange Shop, and the supply of Guild Coins will be increased, so please look forward to it.

 

And that’s not all. Many more changes are on the way.

 

Gate System Expansion & Reward Upgrades
-     Increased appearance rates of Special Gates.
-     Overall reward upgrades across all Gates, including Gold, EXP, Weapon Enhancement Gear, and Marks of Time.
Preset Improvements
-     New "overwrite" function for preset management.
-     Sung Jinwoo’s Skills and Blessing Stones added to auto-equip targets.
Artifact Improvements
-     Artifact Modification will become a permanent feature.
-     Multiple options can now be selected when applying Enchantments.
Interface Improvements
-     Expandable tabs for Weapon/Hunter lists. Advancement notifications added for weapons.
-     Enhancement levels displayed in the Armory interface.
-     When leveling up via bulk mission collection in the Hunter Pass, you’ll now be taken directly to the reward page.
-     Option to toggle interface and damage display during in-game battles.
Other Quality of Life Enhancements & Fixes
-     Auto-play function added to the early tutorial.
-     New growth guide system based on Battle Tier.
-     Instant mining completion function for subscription users.
-     Enjoy Hunter Origins through the popup interface during additional resource downloads.
-     The issue where bosses occasionally became invisible or invincible in specific chapters will be fixed.

 

Please look forward to the September update.
 

From here, we’d also like to share a preview of some upcoming content and features we are preparing for future updates.
(* Some of these are still in the concept stage and may change upon actual release.)

 

[Core Farming Improvement]
Ultimately, our goal is to introduce a Selective Core Farming System, allowing Hunters to focus on farming the cores they want without being tied to specific content. This will reduce farming fatigue while providing clear growth objectives.

 

[Attribute Enchantments for Sung Jinwoo’s Ultimate Skill]
And as briefly mentioned during the last livestream, the new possibilities for Sung Jinwoo’s Ultimate Skill are finally taking shape.
While preserving its overwhelming impact and core identity, a new Rune will be introduced that allows you to imbue the Ultimate with a desired Attribute. With this, Hunters will be able to freely adjust the Ultimate’s attribute to exploit a boss’s weakness or adapt to the unique traits of a dungeon.

Please look forward to the diverse new actions of Sung Jinwoo.

 

[Preparation for Server Merge]
Through the surveys you’ve shared with us, we have confirmed that many Hunters have requested server merge.
We deeply understand your desire for a more active gameplay environment, and we are also giving this matter serious consideration.

However, since such an undertaking may impact sensitive aspects of gameplay such as rankings, it requires ample preparation time.
Rather than proceeding hastily and causing inconvenience, we will provide guidance as soon as everything is fully prepared.

 

[The Overseer's Forbidden Library]

As first introduced in the July Developer Note, The Overseer's Forbidden Library will be added with the October update.
The Forbidden Library is a new arena of challenge designed for mid-to-high level Hunters.
Here, you will once again face the mighty bosses of the past, great tales recreated by the Overseer.

“To challenge the stories of the Forbidden Library, there are a few special rules to follow.”

 

Rule 1. Every Hunter must play their part.
The chronicle of the Forbidden Library cannot be completed by just one or two Hunters.
You must form an expedition by selecting Hunters with a wide range of abilities suited for each situation. As the difficulty rises, the number of Hunters required by the Overseer will increase accordingly.

 

The further you progress through each chapter (stage) of the story, the more parties will be needed, and once a Hunter has participated in a chapter, they cannot appear again.
Additionally, each Hunter has a limited number of attempts per stage, making it essential to distribute your Dealers, Breakers, and Healers strategically across your expedition.

 

Rule 2. Write your own “Strategy Chronicle.”
“The Overseer wishes for you to experience the story in your own way.”

There is no single correct answer. The moment you step into the Forbidden Library, all outcomes will be decided by the book you choose to open next.

 

Each stage will present you with random bosses that will test everything you’ve got.
Here, you are not bound to specific attributes, you can experiment with unique Hunter combinations you may not have tried before. To overcome the ever-changing contents of the books, you will need to make use of every Hunter you’ve raised and adapt with wisdom.

 

(But beware, at key turning points of the story, a fated enemy personally chosen by the Overseer will be waiting.)

The Overseer awaits your challenge within the mysterious Forbidden Library.
Complete your own grand chronicle.

 

 

We would like to sincerely thank all the Hunters who stayed with us until the very end of the story we’ve prepared.
The updates we shared today represent just a part of the future we envision for Solo Leveling:ARISE, a future we hope to build together with you.

 

Your voices will continue to guide us as we transform these exciting concepts into the best possible content. As long as you are here to light our way, our journey will never stop.

 

Please look forward to the September update just around the corner, and the future that lies beyond.

 

Thank you.

 

[Developer Note Surprise Gift]

Redeem Code

Reward Info

SEP9DEV5NOTE

Key to the Cartenon Temple x3

Powder of Blessing x1,000

Low-tier Mana Crystal x1,000

Gold x1,000,000

* The redeem code can only be used once per account and the rewards will be sent immediately upon usage.
* This redeem code can be used until 9/18 (Thu) 23:59 (UTC+0) and will not be usable after the expiration date.

Hunters who used the redeem code prior to this fix will receive the co-op entry currency - Key to the Cartenon Temple x3 rewards at a later time via mail.

Developer Notes

9/22 (Mon) Developer Livestream Summary

Hunters Association
|
Sep 23, 2025, 09:30
|
10,451

 

📢 9/22 (Mon) Developer Livestream Summary

* Please note that the content below is excerpted and translated from the inven article "Dark Attribute Dealer Sung il-Hwan! MINNIE will preserve her value, 9/22 (Mon) developer livestream.”

[View Original Text]

* The content written below mainly addresses the Q&A details, excluding the 9/25 (Thu) update related details.

Check out the update details through our official forum in the future.

 

 * To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

Code

Reward

Expiration Date (UTC+0)

Gold x10,000,000

2025/10/22 (Wed) 23:59

FALLUPDAT3

* The expiration date for the redeem code revealed during the developer livestream was shown as 10/23 (thu) 23:59 (UTC+0), but please note that the code can be used until 10/22 (Wed) 23:59 (UTC+0).

 

 

📌 Roadmap for the Second Half of the Year

In the October update, the Overseer’s Forbidden Library will be unveiled. It is themed around re-encountering powerful bosses faced in the past. Since there is a limit to the number of times Hunters can participate per stage, strategic deployment is crucial. In the Workshop of Brilliant Light, the arrogant commander Bhaltair will appear. Based on feedback that Core acquisition felt inconvenient, Hunters will now be able to choose Core rewards when challenging the Workshop. In addition, new bosses will be added to Instance Dungeons.

 

In November, the 1.5 Year Anniversary Festival is planned. The formidable Monarch of Steel, Rockpasa,who also appeared in the original story, will make his debut. Laura, the tsundere beauty and personal secretary of Thomas Andre, will be introduced as an IF Hunter.

 

In December, alongside the year-end seasonal event, the Kamish Co-op Raid and a special story will be released. While Kamish held an overwhelming presence in the original story but was not detailed extensively, the game will present a unique story and cooperative battle experience. Another National Level Hunter, Christopher Reed, will also make an appearance.

 

In January, a New Year’s event will bring forth a confidential IF Hunter currently in development. The team has poured significant effort into crafting this Hunter, so we ask for your great anticipation. Additionally, a new boss will be added to the Encore Missions and Instance Dungeon.

 

In February, the Monarch of Steel, Rockpasa, will return as a new boss in the Workshop of Brilliant Light, alongside the City Recapture Storyline. This story revisits the colossal Gate incident in Japan from the original work, where even with Russian Hunters summoned, the Gate could not be resolved, until Sung Jinwoo steps in to solve the crisis.

 

▲ Content Roadmap scheduled from October, 2025 until February, 2026.

 

📌 Q&A

Q. Are there plans for new weapon costumes?
- The previous ranking reward costume received very positive feedback.

This time, we have prepared the Demon King’s Longword costume, which will be available to all Hunters through an event.

When equipped, not only the weapon’s appearance but also the color of its effects will change.

We will continue to add new costumes for various weapons in the future.

 

▲ Demon King’s Longsword weapon costume that can be acquired through an event.

 

Q. Please make it possible to play in Practice Mode during Battlefield of Time calculation periods.
- We have reviewed the request and plan to make practice available even during calculation.

Q. I’d like the Architect Conquest Raid to become permanent content.
- As our first real-time multiplayer content, it seems to have been very well received. We will continue to prepare more real-time content, and on 10/2 (Thu), we will rerun the Co-op Event.

Q. Subscription benefits need to be improved.
- Solo Leveling:ARISE already offers fairly rich subscription benefits. Since it is a paid product, we must be cautious in what we say. However, to reward those who show great affection for the game by subscribing, we plan to add a new convenience feature that instantly completes all mining. Since Gate Keys can also be purchased from the subscription shop, combining these will allow you to earn even greater rewards.

Q. I just started, and I don’t know what I should be doing.
- As Solo Leveling:ARISE has now passed its first anniversary, the growing amount of content can make it difficult for newcomers. We are working on improving the guides so that new Hunters can learn more easily, and we also plan to temporarily provide combat power boosting. In addition, the “Monarch of Strategy” event is being held on the forums, where veteran Hunters can participate together. Our development team is also working hard to help new Hunters settle in smoothly.

Q. The Giant Statue Guild Boss Battle was fun, please extend it.
The Giant Statue’s powerful strikes seem to have been very popular. We plan to keep the Giant Statue in this boss battle.

Q. Hunter Archive Keys are piling up.
- We are considering ways to provide additional rewards when they are used repeatedly. However, since too much mandatory content can lead to stress, we will carefully discuss internally to find the best way to utilize them.

Q. Please add a favorites feature so that frequently used Artifacts or Hunters are prioritized.
- We can consider a feature where the most recently used Hunter is moved to the top. For Artifacts, deciding on a sorting standard requires more thought. Since we are continuing to enhance the Preset feature, we recommend making use of that. We are also considering a filter system with heart style tags for easier access.

Q. Guild mini games are boring.
- With only two types of mini games currently available, it’s understandable that they can feel repetitive. We will work on adding more of the mini games we have previously introduced.

Q. Please let us zoom the top-view camera further out.
- Unfortunately, extending the camera distance further is difficult. While a more distant view may be advantageous for gameplay, it reduces the sense of action. On mobile devices, a wider view also increases rendering load. Please understand that the current view is already maximized as much as possible.

Q. It’s difficult to upgrade Shadows.
- We previously distributed generous rewards for Shadows. We will continue to provide Shadow upgrade materials through upcoming events, such as the 500th day event.

Q. Will Gem levels be increased in the future?
- At present, there are no plans to raise Gem levels. For new Hunter, the current Gem level is already very challenging. If needed, we may consider introducing new growth systems instead.

Q. The rhythm game is too hard.
- We anticipated this might be an issue, and indeed, we received feedback like “I don’t know how to do it” and “It’s too difficult.” We acknowledge that some Hunters may find it impossible to earn all rewards. Going forward, we will ensure that mini game difficulty is adjusted to be more accessible.

Q. Shadow Enforcer rewards feel too low compared to the time invested.
- We have reviewed this feedback and plan to improve the rewards for Shadow Enforcer content.

Q. Will the i-dle Hunters be added to Custom Draw in the future?
- For external IP characters, there are contractual usage periods. Therefore, it is not possible to make collaboration characters permanently available. We ask for your understanding, as this is a practical limitation.

Q. Are there plans for future character releases or collaborations?
- We are developing new characters to fill gaps in attributes and data, focusing on those from the original story that Hunters most want to see. Exciting collaborations are also being prepared, but it is still too early to share details.

Q. Please remove the Gold cost for stat redistribution.
- This feedback seems to have come from Hunters experimenting to make the game more enjoyable. We will discuss removing the Gold consumption requirement.

Q. There’s a Rage bug in Guild Boss Battles.
- We’ve seen comments mentioning a skill-related bug. We will investigate internally and fix it as quickly as possible.

Q. About Artifact options.
- We’ve noted requests for guaranteed Artifact options, and even for selling fully fixed options. However, Artifacts are designed to be obtained through gameplay and farming. If fixed-option Artifacts were sold, it would undermine the core fun of farming. That said, we understand the difficulty of creating “perfect” Artifacts. We will continue to provide systems such as Artifact crafting and option resetting, and we aim to offer these opportunities more frequently.

Q. Are there plans to change the Power of Destruction?
- We will hold additional internal discussions to explore ways to make the competition more fun.

Q. The Red Dot bug has appeared again.
- In our last livestream, we promised it would be patched permanently, and even pledged a redeem code reward if it reappeared. We sincerely apologize that it has returned. As promised, we will provide an apology redeem code. (First redeem code: SORRYFORBUG)

Q. Why was Sung Il-Hwan released as a Dark attribute damage dealer right after MINNIE's rate up?
- i-dle collaboration characters cannot be recruited after their rate up period ends. Since the Dark attribute deck was underperforming, MINNIE was meant to address this. However, once the collaboration ended, Hunters who missed MINNIE would have been stuck with a weak Dark deck. That is why we released Sung Il-Hwan as a Dark attribute dealer comparable in tier to MINNIE, but with different mechanics, ensuring ongoing accessibility.

 

We do understand that Hunters who invested heavily in MINNIE may feel disappointed. We kindly ask for your understanding that Sung Il-Hwan’s release timing was necessary to resolve the Dark attribute issue. We will take greater care in managing future updates.

 

📌 Closing Remarks

 

Jin Sung Gun, Executive Producer: We had prepared various story-related content and improvement plans, but it seems we have disappointed Hunters with matters regarding MINNIE. Until now, we have consistently worked to ensure that Hunters can remain relevant and useful within the game. We will continue to make steady efforts and take action moving forward, so we ask for your continued trust and support.

 

Lee Da Haeng Head of the Business Department: Regardless of our circumstances, we recognize that there may be aspects that Hunters are dissatisfied with. It is not our intent to deny such feedback, rather, in this space of communication, we believe it is right to speak openly and explain how we will address concerns. After Sung Il-Hwan’s release, we will closely monitor the situation to ensure MINNIE's value and standing are not diminished, and we will continue with patches to preserve her importance. We kindly ask for your understanding.

 

 

Thank you.

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

Here are the details scheduled to be added and changed through the update on 9/25 (Thu).

 

Please see below for more details about the update.

 

 

📢 9/25 (Thu) Update Details

 

 

📌 Main Story New Chapter

- A new hidden chapter will be added to the main story Normal and Hard.

* You can enjoy Solo Leveling:ARISE’s original story through the hidden chapters.

- As a new chapter is added to the Normal and Hard stories, recommended combat power for certain stages will be reduced.

However, only Clear rewards will be provided when clearing chapters that only consist of “Story.”

* As new stories are added, new Battle Mission Achievement Rewards for Normal and Hard mode will be added accordingly.

 

📌 New Sung Jinwoo Job Change

- New Sung Jinwoo Job Change the [Monarch of Shadows: Liberator] will be added.

The Job Change conditions and rewards are as below.

Job Change Condition

- Reach Sung Jinwoo combat power 350,000

- New costume [Daily Stroll]

- Increase in combat power

- Bonus stat points

- Additional Sung Jinwoo sweep points

 

📌 Maximum Level & Activity Funds Expansion

- The maximum level for the Player will be expanded, and the maximum level for Hunters will also be expanded.

- Sung Jinwoo level achievement rewards, maximum tier for Activity Funds, and the highest difficulty for Gates will also be expanded.

- As the Hunters max level is expanded, level achievement rewards in the Bonds content will be newly added.

📌 New SSR Hunter & Exclusive Weapon

- A new SSR Dark attribute Hunter [Sung Il-Hwan] and exclusive weapon [Unbreakable Will] will be added.

- The Hunter can be obtained through Rate Up Draw, and you can experience the power of the Hunter in advance through Hunter Preview.

- The exclusive weapon can be obtained through crafting or events.

- The new Hunters’ Profile Icon, Dossier, Codex, Bonds will also be added.

- New Sung Jinwoo exclusive weapons SSR Fire attribute [Ennio's Roar] and SSR Fire attribute [Radiru Clan's Double-edged Spear] will be added.

- The corresponding weapons can be acquired through Custom Draw, Weapon Custom Draw, and Special Summons.

* 2 new weapons will be released after 10/9 (Thu).

▶ Shadow Max Level Expansion

- Along with the addition of a new Shadow, the maximum level of Army of Shadows will be expanded to 156.

- When leveling up Army of Shadows Lv. 150 or higher, a new material “Shadow Wave” is required

The Shadow Wave can be acquired in Shop & Battlefield of Time exchange shop and Shadow Enforcer “Secret Missions.”

 

📌 New Costume & Weapon Costume

- New costumes for Hunters and weapons will be added.

- The new costumes can be purchased from the shop.

* Costumes can be equipped by entering through the hanger-shaped button on the Sung Jinwoo and Hunters information screen.

- 3 types of chromas will be added for Sung Il-Hwan.

* The [Vulcan’s Rage - Soul Bear] and [Skadi - Refreshing Beam] can be purchased in the subscription shop with subscription points.

 

📌 New Strategy Training & [ Training Room] Feature

- A new [Strategy Training] option will be added to the Hunters Association lobby’s quick menu and the original [Hunter Preview] feature will move to the corresponding menu.

 

▶ Training Room

- In the [Strategy Training] content a new [Training Room] content is also available other than [Hunter Preview].

- Load the Sung Jinwoo/Hunters formation saved in your preset and test the performance in the Training Room.

 

The features below are available in the Training Room content.

1. Skill Usage Guide for Each Hunter

- A recommended skill rotation will be displayed for each Hunter, allowing you to practice combos.

* You can toggle this option on or off via [Other Settings] → [Recommended Skill Use Order].

* While this option is enabled, both the Power Gauge and Mana will remain full.

 

2. Preset Loading

- You can load saved presets of player and Hunter formations for practice.

* Please note that presets cannot be modified (such as changing equipment) within the Training Room, they can only be loaded.

 

3. Cumulative Damage Measurement

- You can check the total damage dealt to the monster. Press the button to the left of the damage indicator to reset the count.

* If the timer function is enabled, the timer must be running for damage to be measured.

 

4. Monster State, Weakness, Break Gauge, and Position Reset Settings

- You can adjust various states of the dummy monster used for training.

* Monster attack/idle switching and position reset can be done on the stage screen.

Weakness attribute and Break Gauge adjustments can be made in [enemy settings] under options.

* Currently, only one type of monster, the [Training Room Icebear], is available.

 

5. Stage Timer Settings

- Press the button to activate a 1-minute timer. Use this when you want to measure damage dealt within a set time limit.

* You can toggle the timer function on or off in options under [timer settings].

 

 

📌 Ongoing Events

- After the 9/25 (Thu) update, various events will be held in-game.

Please refer to the event links below for more details on the event.

 

[Full Moon Celebration 3 Events]

[Weapon Costume [Crimson Throne] Crafting Event]

[Sung Il-Hwan Debut Celebration! Rate Up Draw & 2 Events]

 

📌 Event Weapon Crafting

- Sung Jinwoo’s weapon [Allon’s Orb] crafting event will be held during the update period.

* The corresponding weapon can be crafted maximum 2 per account by using Special Player Weapon Design.

 

📌 [Cartenon Temple: Co-Op Battle] 2nd Event

- The [Cartenon Temple: Co-Op Battle] event held during the 8/28 (Thu) update period will be held again after 10/2 (Thu) 00:00 (UTC+0).

The recommended attribute for the Architect co-op battle will be adjusted during the period.

 The details regarding the Cartenon Temple: Co-Op battle 2nd event will be announced through a separate notice.

* As the Cartenon Temple: Co-Op Battle 2nd event is held, the Guild Boss for this update will remain the same as the previous (Giant Statue).

Please note that the two non-fixed attributes of the Giant Statue change every week.

 

 

📌 New Addition to the Custom Draw Rate Up List & Special Summons

▶ Addition to the Custom Draw Rate Up List

- SSR Sung Jinah will be added to the Custom Draw and can be selected in the Rate Up List.

* New rate up Hunters can be added to the Custom Draw Rate Up list in the future.

* As for Special Summons, the Special Summons list that opens after 10/1 (Wed) 00:00 (UTC+0) will be renewed.

 

📌 Artifact Enhancement Convenience Improvement

▶ Artifact Enhancement Reset Feature Added

- The Artifact Recomposition Event, which was previously available only during limited-time events, is now a permanent feature. You can now access it by selecting reset enhancement on the Artifact Enhancement screen.

- To use this feature, an [Artifact Enhancement Reset] ticket is required. Tickets can be obtained through in-game rewards, the Weapon Material Exchange Shop, or purchased via the Shop/Subscription Shop.

 

▶ Artifact Magic Enchantment Convenience Added

- When enchanting an Artifact, you can now multi-select sub-options to apply enchantments simultaneously.

Simply check the sub-options you wish to enchant, and enchant them all at once.

* During continuous enchantment, sub-options that have already reached their maximum value will automatically be excluded from the target list.

 

📌 Battle Tier UI Improvements

- The UI of the Battle Tier in the quick menu will be improved as below.

 

▶ Battle Tier Info UI Adjustment

- The UI has been redesigned to allow you to view combat power details and growth progress of Sung Jinwoo, three Hunters, Shadows, Armory, and Remnant Power all at a glance.

 

▶ New Menu for Hunter Growth Information by Battle Tier

- A new menu has been added that allows you to check the combat power and growth progress of your Hunters based on your Battle Tier.

In this menu, you can view the selected Hunter’s Level, Upgrades, Skills, Weapons, Artifacts, and Cores in detail.

 

📌 Improvements to Formation and Preset Features

- In the Preset Management screen, you can now modify and save weapons, Skills, Blessing Stones, Artifacts, Hunters, Shadows, and Remnant Power directly without navigating to a separate editing screen.

* For Artifacts, only the equipped slots can be changed here. To swap Artifacts in each slot, you must go to the Sung Jinwoo/Hunter Management screen.

* The existing Preset edit mode remains unchanged and can still be used to copy, delete, or reorder the currently selected preset.

- In the formation screen before entering a stage, a [Overwrite] button will be added to the Preset menu, allowing you to overwrite an existing preset with your current formation in addition to the existing load preset option.

- In Sung Jinwoo Mode, when using Auto-Formation before entering a stage, Skill Runes and Blessing Stones will now be automatically equipped.

 

📌 Gate Content Improvements

▶ Gate Rewards & Special Gate Appearance Frequency Improvement

- Exp and Gold rewards from clearing Gates will be increased.

- The amount of Weapon Enhancement Gears obtained from clearing normal Gates will be increased, including the quantities in Weapon Enhancement Gear loot chests.

- The drop rate for Marks of Time I & II will be greatly increased in all A- and S-Rank Gates.

- In Dungeon Break, both the drop rate and quantity of Marks of Time from loot chests will be increased.

- The drop rates for Design/Precision Design/Special Design items in Dungeon Break will be slightly increased.

- The chance to obtain Shadow Energy in Gates under level 40 will be increased.

- Special Gates now appear more frequently when re-exploring Gates.

 

▶ Daily Gate Key Recharge Limit Increased

- The daily recharge limit for Gate Keys will be increased from 10 times to 30 times.

- Recharge costs will increase for the 11–20 and 21–30 recharges.

 

▶ Mining Team Level Expansion & Convenience Improvements

- The maximum Mining Team Level will be expanded from 40 to 50.

* Please check in-game to see the effects of the expanded Mining Team Level.

- The Mining Team dispatch list will be increased from 40 slots to 100 slots.

- The duration for Gate mining will be increased from 24 hours to 168 hours.

 

📌 Guild Content Improvements

▶ Guild Boss Score Registration Method Updated

- The Rage Score registration for Guild Bosses will be updated to match the Power of Destruction scoring system, where only the highest score per attempt will be recorded.

* Once a team has been set for a retry, it will not be changeable until the record is reset.

When resetting, team members can be changed, but note that scores, rage, and attempt counts will also be reset.

* Hunters already registered in another team cannot be assigned to multiple teams.

- The Guild Boss main screen UI will be updated to reflect the new scoring system.

 

▶ Guild Mini Game Mission Improvements

- The scoring system for the Anxious Tank Stacking mini game will be adjusted.

- Weekly Guild co-op mission mini game score requirements will be merged into a single mission, allowing any mini game played to count toward the mission.

 

▶ Guild Boss Reward Improvements

- Personal rewards based on Guild Boss rage counts will be increased, allowing Hunters to earn up to 630 Guild Coins.

- Co-op rewards based on rage counts will be expanded up to 7000 times, with a maximum of 300 Guild Coins obtainable.

 

📌 Simulation Gate Improvements & Balance Adjustments

▶ Entry Mode Selection Added

- Previously, entering a Gate required using an entry code automatically. Now, Hunters will be able to choose between:Test Mode: Enter without using a code.Normal Mode: Use a code to enter as usual.

 

▶ Other Improvements

- When entering the Effect Amplification screen, Hunters will be directed to the section with lower progress for easier activation.

- In the Collection Info screen, the UI will highlight when a selected Hunter is applicable to the collection target class.

 

▶ Balance Adjustments

- Damage for “Multithread” Protocol [Single Core/Dual Core/Quad Core] will be reduced.

- Some effects from codes obtained during stages will be adjusted.

* For details on each code’s performance changes, please refer to in-game information.

- Adjustments will be made to allow all codes to appear in the first stage.

 

📌 Shadow Enforcer Improvements

▶ New Secret Missions for Shadow Enforcer

- After completing a mission, there will be a chance for a secret mission to appear when a new mission is generated.

Secret missions will not occupy mission slots during progress, and all Shadows can be deployed regardless of the mission series.

- Secret missions, like regular missions, will allow durations between 12 to 48 hours.

The longer the mission duration, the more reward options will be available. For 48-hour missions, Hunters will be able to select rewards such as Condensed Energy, Gold, Abyss Crystals, and a new material “Shadow Waves” used for Army of Shadows level-ups.

 

▶ Shadow Enforcer UI Improvements

- Mission slots will be highlighted for easier tracking of ongoing missions.

- If a reward is selected first, it will remain even when Auto-Select is used.

- Completed missions will appear at the top of the mission list.

- A mission filter will be added at the bottom of the mission list to help Hunters find missions more easily.

- Animations will be added when selecting Shadows and starting missions.

 

📌 Other Content Improvements & Changes

▶ New Season of the Architect's Test

- A new season of the Architect's Test will begin, featuring updated rules and new strengths/weakness attributes..

* Please check in-game for detailed rules and rewards.

 

▶ Combat Power Advantage Adjustments for Certain Content

- For some content excluding Battlefield of Time, Power of Destruction, and Guild Boss, if a Hunter’s combat power is higher than the recommended level, the damage bonus from combat power advantage will be slightly increased.

- Conversely, if combat power is lower than recommended, the penalty will be slightly reduced.

 

▶ Activity Funds Reward Expansion

- The amount of Gold obtained from Activity Funds based on cumulative time will be increased by about 1.5×.

* Rewards such as Sung Jinwoo Exp and growth materials will remain unchanged.

 

▶ Instance Dungeon / Encore Missions Some Conquest Mission Repeated Reward Adjustment

- For Hunters with Battle Tier 17 or higher, Instance Dungeon / Encore Missions conquest mission repeated reward will be adjusted as below.

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Next Episode

Hunters Association
|
Oct 1, 2025, 09:00
|
26,757

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

We sincerely thank you for always showing deep affection and interest in our game.

 

Today, we would first like to share the improvements we are preparing in response to the valuable feedback you have sent us through various channels.

 

Following that, we would also like to share the direction we are preparing for the future as we approach the important milestone of our 1.5-year anniversary.

 

 

[Operation Plan for the Guild Boss]

 

First of all, we would like to sincerely thank you for enjoying the new Guild Boss, “Giant Statue.”

In response to the enthusiasm Hunters have shown, the next Guild Boss will also feature the Giant Statue.

 

The positive reception of the Giant Statue has given our team the opportunity to reflect deeply on other Guild Bosses as well.

 

As some of you may have already expected, this particularly concerns the battle patterns of “Fachtna.”

We have received multiple valuable opinions that certain patterns of Fachtna are excessively difficult, creating a heavy burden for Hunters.

 

In addition, we have confirmed feedback that some patterns, while added for fun, may actually reduce the overall enjoyment of the battle.

In light of this, we intend to actively embrace your feedback and are preparing a comprehensive pattern renewal so that Fachtna may be reborn as a more enjoyable challenge.

 

The renewed Fachtna will arrive this December, alongside the Kamish Co-op Raid that we previously introduced during our Developer Livestream.

Until then, the Queen Ant and Giant Statue will appear alternately, awaiting your challenge.

 

We promise to continue listening to your voices and to reward you with even more enjoyable Guild Boss content.

 

[Workshop of Brilliant Light Difficulty Adjustment]

 

Hunters, this October a new boss will appear in the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

The Commander of Steel and arrogant general, Bhaltair, awaits the challenge of top Hunters.

 

Before introducing this new boss, our team aims to ensure that more Hunters can enjoy the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

To achieve this, we are planning a broad rework of the existing bosses.

 

First, we will relax or remove certain pattern elements that forced the use of specific Hunters or strategies, allowing you to enjoy battles with more freedom instead of following a rigid approach.

 

Additionally, we will adjust some patterns and reduce excessively high attack power, thereby lowering the overall difficulty so that you can better experience the core fun of boss strategies.

 

With the arrival of the new boss, entry barriers to the Workshop of Brilliant Light will also be lowered, making the content more accessible to a wider range of Hunters.

We hope you will look forward to this updated Workshop of Brilliant Light, and we promise to continue improving to deliver an even better gameplay experience.

 

[Workshop of Brilliant Light New Rules]

 

This October, Bhaltair will make his appearance in the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

 

The battle against Bhaltair will proceed in a different way than before.

Hunters will first need to adapt to the new set of rules and discover strategies to overcome Bhaltair’s unique patterns.

Once it is determined that Hunters have grown familiar enough with this new battlefield, a Hard Difficulty will be added in a future update.

 

The First Clear Event will grant the highest honor to those who conquer this Hard Difficulty before anyone else.

Hunters, become the ruler of the new rules, break Bhaltair’s arrogance with your strength, and claim the greatest honor and rewards.

 

“Hunters, history will remember the name of the one who arrives first.”

 

[Guild Boss Rage System Improvement]

 

We would like to address the experience some Hunters had where powerful skills such as Firestorm Kick did not contribute to Rage Points during the lower Rage phases of Guild Boss battles, which at times felt like an in-game error.

 

First, please note that this was originally intended behavior under the current system design.

However, through your feedback, we deeply recognized that this design actually disrupted the natural flow of combat.

 

Acknowledging this misalignment between intent and gameplay, our team will fundamentally improve the Rage system.

Instead of complex rules, Rage Points will now be directly and proportionally tied to the total damage inflicted on the boss, making the system clearer and more intuitive.

 

Because this change involves a major overhaul, we are targeting an update in November to December after thorough internal review.

We are committed to ensuring your strength is fully reflected in the score.

 

[Balance Adjustment Preview]

 

Hunters, first, we would like to inform you that the combat logic error for Sung Il-Hwan will be fixed soon through a patch.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and will reinforce our internal processes to prevent recurrence.

 

As many Hunters anticipated, this logic fix will result in a performance buff for Sung Il-Hwan.

We see this as an opportunity to spotlight Dark-attribute Hunters, and in line with Sung Il-Hwan’s adjustments, MINNIE will also receive enhancements.

 

Additionally, our team had already been preparing balance updates for Dark-attribute Hunters (Lee Bora, Lim Tae-Gyu, Isla Wright) in October.

Among them, Isla Wright’s improvements have been completed ahead of schedule and will be applied in the upcoming patch, accelerating this wave of change.

 

The attribute meta shift will not stop here.

Further balance adjustments are planned for November, which will reveal new potential for existing Hunters.

 

Starting with these adjustments, we aim to bring new vitality to your deck compositions and expand your strategic options.

Please look forward to the renewed brilliance of Dark-attribute Hunters!

 

[Survey Feedback]

Here is our response to the feedback you provided through the recent survey.

We received valuable input regarding certain Hunters, Weapons, and Artifacts whose usability was significantly lacking.

 

Based on your feedback, we will gradually apply buffs to these elements according to their usage levels.

The goal of this balance adjustment is to secure greater deck diversity and provide Hunters with broader strategic choices.

 

Please note, however, that these updates will not all be rolled out at once in October, but will instead be implemented progressively depending on the situation.

 

[Improvements]

 

Our team is preparing improvements for all our Hunters.

     - The maximum level of Cores will be expanded.
     - Additionally, categories will be assigned to Sung Jinwoo’s skills, allowing you to conveniently view their performance at a glance.

(Sample Image)

     - When salvaging an Artifact, you will now receive Artifact Modification Ticket Fragments (working title).
     - Guild Achievements will be expanded.
     - We are also introducing selectable Artifact Modification.
        ⦁ An improved event system based on the existing Artifact Modification feature.
        ⦁ With this change, the [Artifact Modification] event will allow you to choose between before and after options.
     - In addition, the stats of certain monsters with excessively high HP will be adjusted.

 

Beyond these, we are preparing many more updates, which we will explain in greater detail through upcoming CM Notes and Developer Livestreams.

 

 

Lastly, the time we have shared with all Hunters is soon approaching the precious milestone of our 1.5-year anniversary.

To turn this special day into a festival that all Hunters can enjoy together, we are preparing a variety of gifts and events, so please look forward to it!

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

Developer Notes

10/21 (Tue) Developer Livestream Summary

Hunters Association
|
Oct 22, 2025, 07:51
|
12,769

 

 

📢 10/21 (Tue) Developer Livestream Summary

* Please note that the content below is excerpted and translated from the inven article "Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End Collaboration Announcement, 10/21 (Tue) Developer Livestream."

[View Original Text]

* The content written below mainly addresses the Q&A details, excluding the 10/23 (Thu) update related details.

Check out the update details through our official forum in the future.

 

 * To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

 

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

Code

Reward

Expiration Date (UTC+0)

23OCTUD

Skill Rune Transcendent Stone Chest x15

Amplification Agent x250

Until 11/19/2025 23:59

FRIERENCODE

Traces of Shadow x100

Shadow Energy x3,000

Shadow Waves x5

COLLABUD

Custom Draw Ticket x10

Gold x3,000,000

 

 

📌 Q&A

Q. How will the bug with Ennio’s Roar weapon be addressed?

- First of all, we sincerely apologize. There was a discrepancy between the skill description and the actual in-game performance of Ennio’s Roar. This issue will be fixed in the 10/23 (Thu) update. We apologize for any difference in feel or performance this change may bring, and we will work to provide a more stable service moving forward.

 

Since Hunters draw based on the stated skill descriptions and weapon performance, we will ensure that the weapon is fixed to match the listed specifications.

 

Q. Some of Sung Jinah's skills do not function as described, can you explain?

- We’ve identified an issue where Sung Jinah’s advancement tier 5 effect is not being properly applied. In Team Fight mode, we also confirmed that her Ultimate could not be used due to cooldown problems.

 

This occurred because the skill description did not sufficiently explain the cooldown mechanic. Rather than adjusting the description, we plan to buff the character’s performance in a future update.

 

Q. The Guild Mini-Game needs improvement.

- It’s been quite some time since the mini-game was released, and we’ve continued to receive feedback on it. We plan to update Guild content as soon as possible and will share specific details in the next livestream.

 

Q. Please release more challenging content.

- We understand the fun and importance of seeking out and attempting high-difficulty content. However, when preparing updates, we must also consider the various situations of all Hunters, making it difficult to focus solely on challenge content.

 

With this update, a new Workshop of Brilliant Light stage will open, and in the next update, a Hard Mode and a limited-time ranking event will follow, providing a true challenge for top-tier Hunters. Additionally, as mentioned in the update notes, new content called “The Overseer's Forbidden Library” will be added. Since many of you have requested more challenging content, we plan to gradually introduce it, so please stay tuned.

 

Q. Please release a new version of the Miner costume.

- We recognize the desire for costumes that capture the spirit of the original work. The Miner costume was based on Sung Jinwoo’s outfit when he infiltrated in disguise in the original story, and we will review ways to release new variations of the Miner costume in the future.

 

Q. Was there a reason you kept the Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End collaboration a secret?

- It wasn’t intentionally hidden. Because there are multiple parties involved, including the IP holder, we are not always free to mention collaborations. If that IP is engaged in other projects or collaborations elsewhere, there are restrictions that prevent us from publicly stating “we are also collaborating.” We understand that many Hunters brought up Frieren, and we wanted to agree openly, but we ask for your understanding regarding this situation.

 

Q. The collaboration intervals feel too short.

- The Frieren: Beyond Journey’s End collaboration had been in preparation for a long time, but collaboration schedules need to be adjusted to match each company’s circumstances. As a result, it may have seemed that collaboration events were arriving too close together. We’ll take this feedback into account and try to plan future collaborations with better pacing.

 

We’ve also heard concerns about the frequency of collaborations. Since Solo Leveling is a completed webtoon, we felt the need to introduce new sources of excitement for the game. In the future, before proceeding with new collaborations, we will consider steps such as conducting Hunter votes to gather your opinions beforehand.

 

Q. There’s a bug with Guild Boss Rage.

- When a large amount of damage is dealt as the Guild Boss’ Rage gauge is about to fill, the gauge may fail to increase. This behavior was actually intentional, to emphasize the feeling of progressing through Rage phases, while also distinguishing it from the Power of Destruction content, which uses total DPS calculations.

 

However, we understand that it can be frustrating when your recorded damage doesn’t contribute to the Rage gauge. The development team is exploring ways to reflect total damage more accurately, and improvements are planned for an upcoming update.

Q. Characters like Silver Mane Baek Yoonho deal different damage depending on frame rate.

- Damage discrepancies related to frame rate can occur due to various factors like hit-stun and action timing. If frame rates drop, certain hit detections may fail to register, causing inconsistencies in damage output.

 

One fundamental fix would be to simplify multi-hit attacks into single, high-damage strikes, but since Solo Leveling:ARISE is an action game, oversimplifying skills would reduce gameplay depth and enjoyment.

 

Because performance differs between mobile and PC, frame-based damage loss can occur. We plan to add a compensation system to minimize this difference, though a complete simplification is not the right approach. For competitive content where records matter, we recommend adjusting settings to maximize frame rate.

 

Separately, we also agree that AI-controlled characters in Team Fight should perform at least to their expected standard. We will prepare additional solutions for this issue.

 

Q. Can collaboration weapons be crafted?

- Since collaboration content can only be provided during its contract period, weapons cannot be obtained after the collaboration ends. However, for Hunters who have already acquired collaboration weapons but couldn’t fully upgrade them, we plan to introduce common evolution materials to allow continued progression.

 

Q. Will there be another SLC tournament?

- We are currently preparing plans for SLC, and once it is finalized, we will make an official announcement. We expect to share details in the next livestream.

 

We’ve also received requests for a separate player meeting. While past SLC tournaments have included community interaction aspects, we are considering additional opportunities to communicate more directly with players.

 

Q. The Custom Draw’s four-choice list feels too many.

We’ve heard this feedback since the game’s launch and completely understand. We are preparing related improvements and will share details in the next livestream.

 

Q. Please extend the Guild Boss – Giant Statue event period.

- We recognize the popularity of the Giant Statue battle and will extend its duration.

 

Q. Will there be an expansion to the Battlefield of Trials?

- Yes. It’s scheduled for the next update and is currently in its final stages of development. You’ll be able to experience it soon.

 

📌 Closing Remarks

 

Jin Sung Gun, Executive Producer: We sincerely apologize for the increased burden caused by the consecutive collaboration events. We will continue to update engaging content to deliver a better service experience, while also putting greater effort into ensuring stability so that similar issues do not occur again.

 

Lee Da Haeng Head of the Business Department: I came here today with a very heavy heart. Beyond simply providing compensation, I deeply regret that trust has been shaken due to concerns about in-game weapon performance and related issues. Moving forward, we will strengthen our verification processes to ensure that everything functions exactly as described, so that players will no longer experience confusion or uncertainty.

 

 

Thank you.

📌 New Content “The Overseer's Forbidden Library”

▶ The Overseer’s Forbidden Library

- Select several Hunters and clear stories selected by the Overseer to claim rewards.

- You can access [The Overseer’s Forbidden Library] from the content screen or quick menu in the lobby.

* The Overseer’s Forbidden Library becomes available after clearing Story Normal Chapter 23: “The True King.”

* The Overseer’s Forbidden Library will be open from 11/6 (Thu) 00:00 (UTC+0) until the next update.

 

▶ How to Play

- On the entry screen for the Overseer’s Forbidden Library, you can view the current library rules, the available Hunter attributes, and reward information.

Additionally, certain Hunters are designated as the Overseer’s bookmarks (special Hunters) each season, which can also be viewed there.

- The stories are divided into three difficulty levels: Normal (Easy, 4 stages), Ancient (Normal, 8 stages), and Forbidden (Hard, 12 stages).

The number of Hunters required and the combat power needed for each Hunter increase with higher difficulty levels.

* If you select more Hunters than the minimum required for each story, you will gain additional effects for each extra Hunter.

* Hunters chosen for the story are considered to possess all attributes, allowing them to receive attribute-specific effects regardless of their original type.

* Hunters designated as the Overseer’s bookmarks can be used in battle even if you do not own them.

- Upon your first entry, you can manually organize a team of three Hunters from your selected roster. After clearing each stage, three Hunters randomly selected from your pre-selected roster will appear, and the Hunter you choose from them will continue to the following stages.

- Each selected Hunter receives two Trust Points, which represent the number of times they can enter a stage. One Trust Points is consumed each time that Hunter clears a stage.

Once a Hunter’s Trust Points are depleted, they can no longer participate in subsequent stages.

- Upon clearing certain stages, a Plot Twist event will occur, allowing you to recover a Hunter’s Trust Points, swap Hunters from your candidate list (available Hunters for team formation), or gain beneficial effects to help with the next stage.

* You must reach Battle Tier 42 to challenge Puppeteer’s Theater.

▶ Simulation Gate Balance Adjustment

- Certain magic beasts’ HP appearing in Simulation Gate will be adjusted.

- The code and collection rewards appearing in certain episodes will be adjusted.

 

▶ Shadow Enforcer Reward Improvement

- The proficiency acquisition rate will slightly increase when completing Shadow Enforcer missions.

 

▶ Artifact Salvaging Reward Improvement

- When salvaging Artifacts you will be able to select and obtain “Artifact Enhancement Reset Ticket Fragment” as salvage reward.

- The “Artifact Enhancement Reset Ticket” will be added to the crafting list and you will be able to craft it with Artifact Enhancement Reset Ticket Fragments.

 

▶ Sung Jinwoo SKill Info UI Improvement

- Tags describing each skill’s characteristics and control method will be added to Sung Jinwoo’s Rune Skill information screen, allowing Hunters to intuitively understand the role and usage of each skill.

 

▶ Training Room Certain UI & Feature Improvement

- Guidance text related to Hunter Preview and the use of the Training Room will be added to the Strategy Training menu.

- A tutorial will be added for first-time access to the Training Room.

- The Training Room settings feature will be relocated to the pause screen for easier access.

- New options will be added to the Training Room’s convenience and timer settings.

- When the timer feature is activated, previously accumulated damage will now reset automatically.

- The Combo Guide will now be accessible through the main in-game buttons.

- When the Combo Guide is enabled, its auxiliary functions can be adjusted via Pause → Other Settings.

 

▶ Guild Boss Schedule Announcement

- The Guild Boss will be set to “Giant Statue” and will remain available until the next regular update.

- The Guild Boss’s variable attributes will be fixed to Fire and Water until the next update.

 

▶ New Addition to the Hunters Association Special Certificate Exchange List

- After 11/1 (Sat) 00:00 (UTC+0), SSR MINNIE, SOYEON, and YUQI will be added to the Hunters Association Special Certificate exchange list.

 

 

📌 Update New Packages

- The packages below will be added after the update.

Please see the details on the new packages through the new packages notice below.

 [10/23 (Thu) New Packages]

 

📌 System Shop New Packages

- After the maintenance on 11/1 (Sat) 00:00 (UTC+0), packages below will be added to the system shop.

Package

Transcendent Skill Rune Chance Pack I

Transcendent Blessing Stone Chance Pack I

* Chance Pack packages will appear depending on your game progress, such as content clears, weapon growth, or Hunter growth.

Once displayed, they can only be purchased within a limited time.

* Details of the new Chance Packs can be checked in-game when the packages are displayed.

Depending on the package type, Gold, Essence Stones, or direct purchase methods may apply, so please check in-game for specifics.

 

 

📌 Other Improvements

- The title screen will be updated.

- The Hunters Association lobby and parts of the in-game UI will be redesigned to match the collaboration event theme.

- The check-in and content guide pop-ups shown upon login will be improved for quicker visibility.

- A magnifier button will be added to the Exchange Shop and other store menus when items have different reset times, allowing Hunters to check the remaining time for each item’s reset individually.

- Acquiring or equipping a weapon costume will now properly count toward costume-related achievements.

- When using “Claim All” in the mailbox, only items that can be received due to sufficient inventory space will be automatically collected.

- When a check-in event is active, the related event icon in the mailbox will now be highlighted.

-Certain rewards for the “Train to Become a Formidable Combatant” missions will be increased.

- The UI for the “Train to Become a Formidable Combatant” missions will be refined.

- The Burn effect buffs applied by Sung Jinwoo and other Hunters will now update consistently across all effects when refreshed.

- After a Guild Boss retry, if the score achieved is higher than the previous one (even if Rage Level remains the same), the score will now update accordingly.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- The issue where the Ennio’s Roar advancement tier 5 effect is being applied to both weapon skill and normal skill will be fixed.

- The issue where the Ennio’s Roar advancement tier 5 effect’s damage is being increased based on the number of Burn instances will be fixed.

- The issue where the Blessing Stone, Finisher Touch’s effect is not being applied when equipping Ennio’s Roar or Radiru Clan's Double-edged Spear.

- The issue where Isla Wright's advancement tier 2 effect, “Increase the Attack of [Dark Attribute] team members by 5% of basic Defense,” increased more than the described value will be fixed.

- The issue where the Break Time Increase effect was not properly applied when a Hunter with Break Time Increase was deployed will be fixed.

- The issue where the duration of the shield gained after using "Extreme Attack: Beast Form" from Silver Mane Baek Yoonho's advancement tier 1 was not displayed will be fixed.

- The issue where the debuff icon did not appear when Shimizu Akari’s Ultimate Skill “Ring of Fire” hit the target will be fixed.

- The intermittent issue where Sung Jinah’s advancement tier 5 effect, “After using [Stormwind Serenade] in [Team Fight] mode, Serenade: Aero Disruption can be used again,” did not activate will be fixed.

- The issue where Burn debuffs were not properly refreshed when another Burn effect was applied simultaneously will be fixed.

- Missing Burn effect information in the description of Sung Jinwoo’s Rune Skill "Vertical Arts – Crosshairs" will be fixed.

- The issue in Workshop of Brilliant Light – “Demons' Castle Upper Floors” where “White Flames Baran” sometimes did not fire energy orbs under certain conditions will be fixed.

- Unnatural start and defeat animations for Deimos, the Commander of Transfiguration in Workshop of Brilliant Light – Spire of Transfiguration will be fixed.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.
