Developer Notes

Developer Note: November and Beyond

Hunters Association
|
Oct 28, 2025, 08:00
|
13,569

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

Today, we would like to quickly share some of the improvements we are preparing based on the feedback you, our Hunters, have provided.

 

Please note that some of the points we will discuss today are still in the early stages of development or are being explored for better approaches.

 

We decided to share our thought process with transparency first, and as a result, some specifications may change when the actual update is released. We kindly ask for your understanding.

 

* Please note that the name of items, packages, and events/content scheduled to be added in the future may be subject to change. (Working Titles)

 

 

[Adjustment of Fern’s Joining Schedule]

 

We have exciting news for Hunters eagerly awaiting Fern’s arrival.

The Fern rate up draw, originally scheduled for 11/6 (Thu), will now be available earlier on 10/30 (Thu).

 

This decision was made in response to the voices of Hunters who wanted to complete the combination of Frieren, Fern, and Stark as soon as possible following the collaboration update, as well as to feedbacks from new or returning Hunters who had selected Fern first but felt limited in their progress.

 

We believe that shortening the wait time is the best way to show our appreciation.

Please give a warm welcome to Fern, who will be joining soon!

 

[Balance Adjustment Per-Announcement]

 

We have been carefully reviewing feedback from Hunters regarding the recent collaboration Hunters, as well as some other Hunters whose “feel” or usability may not have fully met your expectations.

 

For the collaboration Hunters, we believe that you should be able to experience their true appeal within the period when they are obtainable (rate up draw period). Implementing buffs in November, after the opportunity to acquire them has mostly ended, could cause a greater sense of loss for Hunters.

 

Therefore, balance adjustments for the collaboration Hunters will not wait until the November update. Instead, they will be applied as soon as preparations are complete, aligned with Fern’s arrival. The Hunters expected to receive balance adjustments alongside Fern’s debut are likely to be Frieren, Fern, Seorin, and Cha Haein, Pure Sword Princess.

 

Beyond this, balance adjustments for other Hunters remain our top priority in upcoming updates. It is anticipated that the next set of adjustments may focus on Light-attribute Hunters.

 

We will continue to review balance updates to ensure that a diverse range of Hunters can thrive, rather than having a uniform meta.

 

Moving forward, any confirmed balance adjustments will be shared first through channels such as Developer Livestream and CM Notes to keep Hunters informed as quickly as possible.

 

[Revision of Certain In-Game Issues]

 

We have promptly addressed several issues that occurred after the update, however, we are aware that some inconveniences still remain.

Among the unresolved issues, a few required a “build update,” which has caused a slight delay in deployment.

We are currently preparing a fixed build to resolve these problems and will distribute it as soon as possible.

 

The detailed fixes are as follows.

 

● Fixed the issue where Ennio’s Roar skill did not activate under certain conditions.
● Fixed the issue where the “Unable to Claim” popup in the mailbox could not be closed by tapping outside the close button area.
● Fixed the issue where a red dot notification appeared on the banner after achieving a weekly cumulative score in the Magic Beast Conquest mini-game.
● Fixed the issue on the PC build where the mouse cursor disappeared when enhancing Simulation Gate Codes.
● Fixed the issue where it was impossible to change back to a higher difficulty level after lowering the level in the Architect’s Test.

 

We will continue to work diligently to resolve any other issues that may be causing inconvenience to our Hunters as quickly as possible.

 

[Other Scheduled Updates]

 

We would like to share with you in advance some of the content planned for the November update and future updates.

As mentioned earlier, some of these features are still in the early stages of development or may be adjusted for better direction, and thus are subject to change.

 
● Sung Jinwoo’s maximum level will be increased from 120 → 130, along with a new Job Change.
● Workshop of Brilliant Light: Valtair (Hard Mode) will be added, accompanied by a first-clear event.
 
● The Battlefield of Trials will be expanded up to Floor 80.
● Light Attribute SSR Hunter Laura Walker will join the Gate Raids.
● Light Attribute Hunters will undergo balance adjustments.
● A navigation arrow button will be added to the Battlefield of Time Challenge Boss Page, allowing Hunters to move between stages.
● Shadow Waves will be added to the crafting list.
● New Shadow Uros will be joining the scene.

 

In addition, we are preparing various quality-of-life improvements, including an auto limit break feature for weapon enhancement, designed to save Hunters valuable time. And beyond what we’ve shared today, even more exciting updates are on the way.

 

 

We will continue to share further details through CM Notes and Developer Livestreams in the near future.

 

As always, we sincerely thank all our Hunters for your continued support and feedback, and we ask for your ongoing interest and encouragement as we move forward into the next chapter of Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

Notices

Guide to Resolving the PC Version/Web Shop Login Issue [Updated 12/17 (Wed) 01:43 (UTC+0)]

Hunters Association
|
Oct 31, 2025, 10:00
|
46,284

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

We have confirmed an intermittent issue where certain Hunters are unable to log into the game and Web shop on PC.

 

For Hunters who are experiencing the issue, please refer to the following details below and change the Chrome browser and Edge settings.

 

📌 Chrome Measures

1. Go to the menu in the upper right corner of the Chrome browser and select Settings.

2. Navigate to Privacy and Security → Site Settings.

3. Under netmarble.com, click apis.netmarble.com.

4. Set Local Network Access to Allow.

 

📌 Edge Measures [Added 12/17 (Thu)]
1. In the top-right corner of the Edge browser, click the […] menu and go to [Settings].
2. Click [Privacy, search, and services].
3. Select [Site permissions] → [Recent activity].
4.  Click apis.netmarble.com.
5. Set “Allow sites to request permission to connect to all devices on your local network” to Allow.

 

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and will do our best to investigate and resolve the issue as soon as possible.

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Note: New Combat System Attribute Infusion & Overload

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: New Combat System Attribute Infusion & Overload

Hunters Association
|
Nov 11, 2025, 09:40
|
11,265

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

Dear Hunters, today we are excited to share the thrilling news that we are preparing a new combat system that will bring significant changes to Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

* Please note that the name of items, packages, and events/content scheduled to be added in the future may be subject to change. (Working Titles)

 

 

First, we understand that Hunters reading this Developer Note might be wondering why such a sudden change is necessary.

 

You may also be curious why such an important update was not included in the second-half roadmap. We want to address this honestly and ask for your understanding. This system represents a core change that fundamentally alters the foundation of the game.

 

Because of its significance, we felt it would be more appropriate to explain it to you once a concrete ‘blueprint’ had been drawn internally, rather than sharing it prematurely with just a vague note that it was “in preparation.” And now, since the system’s outline has finally taken shape, we are excited to bring you the news quickly.

 

The greatest value the "Solo Leveling:ARISE" team has consistently pursued is "maximizing the fun of combat through diverse actions." This has been emphasized multiple times in previous developer notes as our guiding principle.

 

We consider it extremely important that every Hunter you’ve nurtured with care has the opportunity to showcase unique actions and a wide range of possibilities.

 

To achieve this, we have continued discussions and experiments aimed at not only "breaking the established mold" but also enhancing the fundamental enjoyment of combat.

 

After much consideration, we plan to introduce, alongside the existing Break system, a new strategic approach in the December update for all Hunters to experience.

 

With this new combat system, all monsters with specific elemental weaknesses will now have an “Attribute Infusion” (working title) corresponding to each of their weak attributes.

 

Hunters will be able to attack enemies with attribute skills to accumulate this gauge, and once the gauge reaches its threshold, “Attribute Overload” (working title) will be triggered.

 

Attribute Overload is a new mechanic distinct from the existing Break system. It is a special state that allows Hunters to deal even greater damage for a limited time. Our team expects that this system will significantly expand the strategic choices available to Hunters.

 

All Hunters can contribute to Attribute Infusion with their respective skills, but "the efficiency will vary depending on each Hunter’s position and skill characteristics."

 

Now, hunters can select different strategies depending on the type of enemy.

 

Previously, it was common to build a team composition around Breakers when facing enemies with a Break Gauge. Now, when facing enemies without a Break Gauge, building a team around Attribute Overload will become another core strategic approach. Through the combination of Break and Attribute Overload, we hope Hunters will experience deeper and more engaging combat.

 

Additionally, our team is considering various supporting mechanisms to back up this major change.

 

However, these mechanisms will be introduced only after we determine that the new combat system has been fully established, with prior explanations provided to Hunters in advance.

 

We ask Hunters to look forward to this change, which will provide a fresh and exciting combat experience. The upcoming developer live stream will take place in early December, instead of November, to coincide with various other changes. During the December developer live, we will introduce SLC 2026, seasonal events, and a variety of other updates to keep Hunters informed and engaged.

 

Thank you.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

Here are the details scheduled to be added and changed through the update on 11/20 (Thu).

 

Please see below for more details about the update.

 

 

📢11/20 (Thu) Update Details

 

 

📌 New Story Chapter (Normal/Reverse Normal/Expert)

 

▶ Normal/Reverse Normal New Chapter

- Hidden chapters will be added to the main story Normal, Reverse Normal difficulties.

* You can enjoy Solo Leveling:ARISE’s original story through the hidden chapters.

* Clear and Battle Missions rewards will be granted for each chapter.

However, only Clear rewards will be provided when clearing chapters that only consist of “Story.”

 

▶New Expert Difficulty Chapter

- Chapter 16-18 will be newly added to the Expert difficulty.

* As new stories are added, new Battle Mission Achievement Rewards for Normal, Reverse Normal, and Expert mode will be added accordingly.

 

📌 New Sung Jinwoo Job Change

- New Sung Jinwoo Job Change the [Monarch of Shadows: Unbreakable] will be added.

The Job Change conditions and rewards are as below.

Job Change Condition

Reward

- Clear Hidden Story 10 [A Duel for the Ages]

- Complete Sung Jinwoo job change [Monarch of Shadows: Liberator]

- New Blessing Stone [Ricochet](Rare)

- New Costume [A Cozy Winter Day]

- Increase in combat power

- Bonus stat points

- Additional Sung Jinwoo sweep points

 

📌 Maximum Level & Activity Funds Expansion

- The maximum player level will be increased, and the maximum Bonds level for Hunters will be expanded accordingly.

- Sung Jinwoo’s level achievement rewards, the maximum tier of Activity Funds, and the maximum Gate difficulty will also be expanded.

- With the level cap increase, the Hunter Level Bonus limit for Activity Funds will be expanded up to Level 9000.

- Due to the expansion of the Hunter Bonds level, a new Bonds reward for achieving Hunter Level 130 will be added.

📌 New Blessing Stone

- New Empowerment type Blessing Stone [Power Surge], [Ricochet] and, [Ultimate Judgement] will be added.

- New Survival type Blessing Stones [Mutual Support] and [Dual Guard] will be added.

* New Blessing Stones are available in Rare, Heroic, Legendary, and Transcendent grades.

Please check in-game for more details.

* These new Blessing Stones will be added to the Fusion lineup, and item acquisition rates will be adjusted.

However, the overall drop rates by grade (Rare/Heroic/Legendary) remain unchanged.

* The Blessing Stones Chest and Blessing Stones Transcendent Stone Chest will be updated with a refreshed lineup that includes the newly added runes.

* For the Blessing Stones Selection Chest and the Blessing Stones Transcendent Stone Selection Chest, new types of selection chests reflecting the newly added Blessing Stones will be introduced.

 

📌 Workshop of Brilliant Light - The Puppeteer's Theater Hard Mode  & Difficulty Adjustment

▶ Workshop of Brilliant Light - The Puppeteer’s Theater Hard Mode

- The hard mode for Workshop of Brilliant Light “The Puppeteer’s Theater” will be added and will unlock after clearing “The Puppeteer’s Theater - Normal Difficulty.”

- The Puppeteer’s Theater – Hard Mode will apply the [High-Difficulty Battle] standards based on the update.

* If more Hunters clear the Hard Mode over time, the difficulty may be gradually adjusted and eased.

 

The first 6,000 Hunters to clear the Puppeteer’s Theater – Hard Mode will receive a special reward.

For more details, please refer to the event notice below.

[Event Notice Link]

 

▶ Workshop of Brilliant Light Conquest Mission Reward Adjustment

- [Arrogant Ruler] and [Ferocious Protector] Cores will be added to the Core Selection Chest list.

- For Hunters with Battle Tier 47 or higher, the rewards for Workshop of Brilliant Light Conquest Missions will be changed as follows.

▶ New Material Conversion System when Limit Breaking Cores

- When you limit break a Core from Level 10 → 15, if you lack Condensed Energy I, a “Conversion” feature will be added that allows you to use Condensed Energy II as a substitute material for Condensed Energy I.

* The conversion feature can only be used on the Core Limit Break screen.

* When converting, 1 Condensed Energy II can be exchanged to obtain 3 Condensed Energy I.

 

📌 New SSR Hunter & Exclusive Weapon

- A new SSR Light attribute Hunter [Laura Walker] and exclusive weapon [Night-cleaving Flash] will be added.

- The Hunter can be obtained through Rate Up Draw, and you can experience the power of the Hunter in advance through Hunter Preview.

- The exclusive weapon can be obtained through crafting or events.

- The new Hunters’ Profile Icon, Dossier, Codex, Bonds will also be added.

- The original story and Secret Library for Laura Walker will be added.

- As a new Shadow is added, the level cap for Army of Shadows will increase accordingly.

Uros

📌 New Costume & Weapon Costume

- New costumes for Hunters and weapons will be added.

- The new costumes can be purchased from the shop and through events.

* Costumes can be equipped by entering through the hanger-shaped button on the Sung Jinwoo and Hunters information screen.

- 3 types of chromas will be added for Laura Walker.

* The [Ennio’s Roar – Star-devouring Fury] is a Legendary-grade weapon costume and will be revealed after 12/4 (Thu).

Detailed information will be provided in a separate notice at a later date.

 

 

📌 Ongoing Events

- Here is some information on the scheduled events after the maintenance is completed.

Please refer to the event links below for more details.

 

[Laura Walker Debut Celebration! Rate Up Draw & 2 Events]

[Winter Begins! 3 Events]

[[WANTED] Workshop of Brilliant Light Valtair (Hard) Clear Event]

 

📌 Event Weapon Crafting

- Sung Jinwoo’s weapon [Ennio’s Roar] and [Radiru Clan’s Double-edged Spear] event crafting will be held during the update period.

* The corresponding weapon can be crafted up to 2 times per account by consuming Special Player's Weapon Design.

 

 

📌 Balance Adjustment [LINK]

- The balance for certain Hunters will be adjusted.

* Please refer to a separate announcement for more details.

 

📌 New Addition to the Custom Draw Rate Up List & Special Summons

▶ Addition to the Custom Draw Rate Up List

- SSR Sung Il-Hwan will be added to the Custom Draw and can be selected in the Rate Up List.

* New rate up Hunters can be added to the Custom Draw Rate Up list in the future.

* As for Special Summons, the Special Summons list that opens after 12/1 (Mon) 00:00 (UTC+0) will be renewed.

 

▶ New Addition to the Hunters Association Special Certificate Exchange List

- Starting from 12/1 (Mon) 00:00 (UTC+0), SSR Sung Il-Hwan will be added to the Hunters Association Special Certificate exchanges list.

 

📌 Guild Content Improvement

▶ Guild Name Conversion Feature

- A “Change Guild Name” feature will be added to the Guild Management screen.

When changing the Guild name, the system will first check for duplicate names, and then you can use Essence Stones to apply the change.

* Guild names cannot be changed consecutively and a certain amount of time must pass before you can change the Guild name again.

 

▶ Guild Boss Rage System Improvement

- Previously unaccounted points during the Guild Boss enrage and revival process will now be added to the total score after the battle ends, and the additional Rage counts will be reflected accordingly.

 

▶ Guild Boss Schedule Notice

- Until the next scheduled update, the Guild Boss will be set as the Queen Ant and will be available to encounter.

- Among the two fluctuating attributes of the Guild Boss, one attribute will be fixed as Light until the next update.

 

📌 New Sung Jinwoo and Hunter Weapon Advancement Exclusive Material

▶ New Sung Jinwoo’s Weapon Enhancement Material [Orb of Balance] and Hunter Weapon Advancement Material [Orb of Amplification]

- When advancing Sung Jinwoo or a Hunter’s weapon, attribute-specific advancement materials will be added that can replace the same weapon as a material.

During weapon advancement, you can use advancement materials of the same attribute as the weapon to advance it.

 

▶ Weapon Advancement Material Farming Method

- In the Crafting menu, you can craft advancement materials for Sung Jinwoo’s or Hunter’s weapons according to each attribute.

- Crafting weapon advancement materials requires the new common material, “Weapon Fragment,” for each attribute.

* Weapon Fragment can be obtained through the newly added “Weapon Fragment Selection Chest” in the Weapon Material Exchange Shop.

-  In addition to Weapon Fragment, [Orb of Amplification] for advancing Hunter weapons requires attribute-specific Mana Crystals and Hunter-specific weapon designs. [Orb of Balance] for advancing Sung Jinwoo weapons requires Special Player Weapon Designs.

 

📌 Other Content Improvements & Changes

▶ The Architect’s Test & The Overseer’s Forbidden Library New Season

 - A new season of the Architect’s Test will begin, with updated rules and strength/weakness attributes applied.

 - A new season of The Observer’s Forbidden Library will begin, with changes to the entry attributes, appearing bosses, and Hunter targets for bookmarks.

* For detailed information on the rules and rewards of each content, please check in-game.

 

▶ Battlefield of Trials New Floor 71-80

 - Battlefield of Trial will add Player Mode and Hunter Mode Floors 71–80.

Rewards can be obtained for first-time clearance of each Floor and first-time completion of battle missions.

 

▶ Simulation Gate Balance Adjustment

- The HP of Hunter bosses appearing in Stage 4 and Stage 8 Special Battles will be reduced.

 

▶ New Item Crafting

- [Shadow Waves] will be added to the crafting item list.

 

▶ New Training Room PC Version Hotkey Feature

- On the PC version, four main functions in the Training Room will have hotkeys assigned.

In addition to the four main functions, you can set up to two frequently used features (such as recommended skill usage order, enemy attack & break gauge application, and timer activation) to be accessible via hotkeys.

 

 The default hotkeys for each function are as follows.

Training Room Feature

Default Hotkey

Reset Total Damage

Reset Battle

Load Preset

HOME

END

PAGEDOWN

* The default hotkeys for each function can be viewed and changed in the Training Room by navigating to [Options] → [Control] → [Key Mapping] → [Settings].

 

▶ Weapon Level Up Convenience Improvement

- An auto-limit break feature will be added for weapon level-ups.

When this feature is enabled, you can specify the desired limit break stage and perform bulk level-up and limit break for the weapon.

* However, for limit breaks of Tier 2 or higher, the weapon must reach the required level for that limit break tier.

 

▶ Improvements to the Formation Screen and Equipment UI

- The UI of pop-ups for equipped weapons, skills, and Blessing Stones will be partially updated.

- A ‘close Pop-up after equipment change’ checkbox will be added. When checked, the pop-up will automatically close after changing equipment.

- Buttons will be added in the Weapon and Skill Rune Equipment pop-ups to navigate directly to Weapon advancement and Skill level up.

- When attempting to enter a stage with an incomplete formation, a warning pop-up will now appear.

 

 

📌 Update New Packages

- The packages below will be added after the update.

Please see the details on the new packages through the new packages notice below.

 [11/20 (Thu) New Packages]

 

📌 Removal of Special Summons Ticket Packages & Adjustment

 - As previously announced in the forum, the sale of Special Summons Tickets will end, and they will only be available through Special Summons draw using the Hunters Association Premium Subscription benefits.

 - Regarding the end of Special Summons Ticket sales, the Special Summons draw opportunities will be adjusted to display 30 times, regardless of whether the player is subscribed to the Hunters Association Premium Subscription or not.

 

Please refer to the link below for more details.

[11/20 (Thu) Special Summons Ticket Package End of Sales Pre-Announcement]

 

 

📌 Other Improvements

- The amount of Low-tier Mana Crystal obtained from mining in Gates Level 1–110 will be enhanced.

* The amount obtained from Gates Level 110–120 will remain unchanged.

- Player Exp for Hunters Association Missions point rewards in levels 100–119 will be enhanced.

- A recommended team formation button will be added to the Power of Destruction team formation. Hunters will be able to check and use recommended formations for Sung Jinwoo’s weapons and skills, Blessing Stones, Hunters, and Shadows.

- The returning Hunters benefits guide page will be enhanced to be accessible via the quick menu under “Hunters Association Support.”

- The daily login reward notice screen will be improved to display Hunters Association Support check-in rewards.

- Certain mission achievement conditions in Train to Become a Formidable Combatant will be adjusted.

- Screen transition effects will be improved when moving from the Hunters Association lobby to event pages or Guild screens.

- Conditions for red dot notifications related to event currency exchanges will improve.

- An “Auto Delete” checkbox will be added in the mailbox. When checked, received reward mails will be automatically deleted.

- When bulk leveling up skills, the target skill level will be automatically set to be higher than the minimum skill level.

- A quick stage transition button will be added on the boss challenge screen in Battlefield of Time Challenge.

- In the Codex, if there are Blessing Stones/Skill Runes of Transcendent grade registered but no Legendary grade, they will be improved to be usable as refinement targets.

- The Hunter-specific recommended skill usage order guide in strategy info will be partially improved.

- A boss and stage detail display function will be improved in the formation screen. Hunters can check boss traits, rules, and other content-specific info by tapping the boss icon at the bottom right.

- A “view rate” button will be enhanced in the reward info sections of Gates, Encore Missions, Instance Dungeons, Battlefield of Chaos, Simulation Gates, and Workshop of Brilliant Light.

- Highlighting of available Acts and Chapters in the Story screen will be added.

- On the item info screen, when pressing the selection chest use button, the corresponding item and quantity will be automatically selected.

- When performing Shadow Enforcer missions, the last selected reward for the mission will be automatically selected.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed the issue of partial text display errors in Yoo Soohyun's Hunter Archive story.

- Fixed the issue where some Hunters were not properly affected when the boss monster “Shadow of Trials Leader” used certain skills.

- Fixed the issue of various errors occurring during the new account tutorial.

- Fixed the issue where some Hunters’ skill effects were not properly applied when resuming Simulation Gates.

- Fixed the issue where certain stage rewards for Guild Boss cooperative Rage were abnormally granted.

* For Hunters affected by reduced Guild Coins due to this issue, 150 Guild Coins will be distributed in bulk after the update on November 20.

[Added 12/4 (Thu) 09:33 (UTC+0)]

* 150 Guild Coins have been sent to Hunters who were affected by the issue.
Please be sure to claim them within the mailbox storage period.
 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Note: New Rules of Combat

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: New Rules of Combat

Hunters Association
|
Dec 3, 2025, 09:00
|
14,420

  

 

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

In our previous developer notes, we hinted at a “major change” to the combat system.

 

We would like to share with hunters the details of this refined major change, along with updates we are currently preparing.

 

* Please note that the name of items, packages, and events/content scheduled to be added in the future may be subject to change. (Working Titles)

 

 

New Combat System “Attribute Infusion”

 

Hunters, we know many of you have been curious about the “major overhaul of the combat system” that we hinted at in our previous developer note.

 

Today, we’d like to provide a clearer explanation of the dynamic flow of combat, which text alone couldn’t fully convey, alongside a video for easier understanding.

 

[Previous Developer Note]

 

The core concepts are “Attribute Infusion” and “Overload.”

Step 1: Attack enemies with their weakness attribute to fill the Attribute Infusion Gauge.

Step 2: When the gauge reaches 100%, Overload is triggered with a powerful effect, similar to a Break.

Step 3: Attacking enemies in the “Overload” state allows you to deal enhanced damage compared to normal attacks.

 

This is a combat concept different from Break, and the outcome of battles can depend on how effectively you utilize Attribute Infusion.

 

We hope you look forward to experiencing the newly revamped combat system.

 

The Overseer's Forbidden Library seeks to reclaim the true meaning of "Challenge."

 

Hunters, the Overseer’s Forbidden Library was originally designed as a challenge-type content to test the combinations of multiple Hunters.

 

However, when we first launched the content, we faced a difficult question: should we overwhelm Hunters from the start with a high level of difficulty, or should we gradually adjust the difficulty while observing how Hunters engage with it?

 

Since the last update, we’ve realized that for many Hunters, the current library has become less about the thrill of challenge and more about repeatedly obtaining rewards.

 

This was not the experience we intended for the "Forbidden Library."

 

Therefore, we have decided to restore the library to its original purpose. From now on, the Forbidden Library will no longer be a simple repetitive grind. Depending on the difficulty you choose, it will require deep strategy and careful planning, offering hunters a true “challenge-type” content experience.

 

Custom Draw, for a clearer sense of "choice and focus"

 

During our recent developer livestream, many Hunters shared valuable feedback requesting a reduction in the number of slots in the Custom Draw rate up list.

 

We deeply understand your desire to obtain your preferred Hunters at a higher probability, and we truly empathize with that wish.

 

Internally, we conducted extensive technical reviews. We also wanted to implement this change as soon as possible. However, this feature requires a system structure modification that can only be applied through an "app update," making immediate implementation unfortunately impossible.

 

Therefore, starting with the upcoming December update, the number of slots in the rate up list will be reduced from 4 to 3. Once this update is applied, the previously distributed rates will be concentrated, increasing your chances of obtaining the Hunters you want.

 

💡 A small tip from the Development Team💡

If you are planning to participate in Custom Draw soon, we cautiously recommend saving a few of your current Draw Tickets and trying after the update, when the rates will be more favorable.

 

Boundary of Phantom Dreams: Kamish Raid – Day of Calamity

 

 

Dear Hunters, we are excited to bring you news of a massive raid content, [Kamish Raid], that will once again set your hearts racing.

 

In the past, the breath of a dragon that poured forth from the massive Gates in the western America incinerated countless people, and its overwhelming terror was recorded as “humanity’s greatest calamity.”

 

The legendary battle where those heroes risked their lives to finally stand atop the ashes of that catastrophe.

 

Now, in [Boundary of Phantom Dreams], it is your turn, Hunters, to become the protagonists of that legendary battle.

 

  1. The Kamish Raid is a multiplayer PvE content and will be carried out in Hunter Mode.
  2. From the moment you enter, the stage focuses exclusively on the boss battle with Kamish.
  3. In this raid, the catastrophe must be overcome not by Sung Jinwoo, but solely through the Hunters’ own team composition and cooperation.
  4. In case of a matching delay, the raid will automatically switch to a [single-stage mode] balanced for one player.
  5. The raid is structured with four difficulty tiers, starting with Kamish, and powerful bosses will rotate in future     updates.

 

Within the Boundary of Phantom Dreams, the flames of calamity have been resurrected as a nightmare, Red Dragon Kamish is ready to greet challengers.

 

Hunters, complete this great chronicle and save humanity.

Additionally, we are preparing a variety of other updates to enhance your experience.

 

 

To celebrate the Holiday Season, new Hunter costumes will be added.

 

       ⦁ Rewards will be added to the S1 and S2 groups in All-Out Guild War.
       ⦁ A new SSR weapon for Sung Jinwoo will be introduced.

           - Similar to the existing Truth: Demon Knight’s Spear, fragments can be obtained from the Guild Exchange and Guild        

       ⦁ Boss, and can also be acquired through crafting.

       ⦁ Lim Tae-Gyu will appear in the Hunter Archive and the Secret Library.
       ⦁ In Battlefield of Time, monsters will no longer wander when they have not recognized the player, reducing unexpected variables.
       ⦁ A new Challenge Medals will be added.
       ⦁ During the Battlefield of Time season calculation period, all bosses can be practiced.
       ⦁ Records during this period will not be reflected in the rankings.
       ⦁ Proof of the Strong will be added to Workshop of Brilliant Light: Valtair.
       ⦁ Hidden Story Chapters 9 and 10 (Hard / Reverse Hard) will be added.
       ⦁ The Shadow Enforcer will now allow you to resend completed missions.
       ⦁ A new Hunter Cooperative Training system will be added.
           - This is a growth feature that increases Hunter stats based on their attribute or class.
           - Select the desired attribute or class to train, and the effects will apply to Hunters of that attribute or class.
       ⦁ Holiday Events are coming to all Hunters.

Please look forward to the December update!

 

SLC (Solo Leveling:ARISE CHAMPIONSHIP 2026) Preview

 

Once Again, We Invite You to the Thrilling Stage of Competition

 

The offline tournament that set Hunters’ hearts ablaze is returning once more.

This year’s offline finals, held after intense online qualifiers, will feature a brand-new format that promises a fresh and exciting experience unlike any before.

 

We are also preparing various on-site programs and activities for Hunters attending the event in person, ensuring an enjoyable and memorable time.

 

Details regarding registration and the full schedule will be announced later through a separate notice.

 

Who will be the one to lift the glorious trophy at this year’s offline tournament?

We look forward to your great interest and enthusiasm.

 

National Level Hunter -Christopher Reed

 

Lastly, the National Level Hunter “Christopher Reed” is coming to meet all Hunters.

He is not just another new Hunter.

 

 

In the upcoming December, he stands at the very center of the major overhaul of the combat system in Solo Leveling:Arise.

Christopher Reed will be the first to master the new combat rules and become the protagonist who reshapes the battlefield.

 

The enormous changes he brings, along with detailed information, will be introduced directly to Hunters during the developer livestream scheduled for early December.

 

Strategic Auto-Battle! Preview of the "International Exchange Tournament" Event

 

 

Coming January 2026: A New PvP Experience!

Hunters, a brand-new PvP content is arriving to bring a fresh thrill to battles.

The time has come to test the strength you’ve honed against Hunters from around the world.

 

We have prepared a new event that reduces the fatigue of direct control and lets you compete solely through strategy and growth.

 

The International Exchange Tournament focuses on tactical skill rather than control, and this content is presented as an event so that you can enjoy it like a festival rather than feel the pressure of competition.

We ask for your great anticipation and interest in the champion who will lead the vanguard of this new era.

 

Thank you.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

📢 12/11 (Thu) Developer Livestream Summary

* Please note that the content below is excerpted and translated from the inven article "Christopher Reed Debut Preview! SLC News Etc. December Livestream"

[View Original Text]

* The content written below mainly addresses the Q&A details, excluding the 12/18 (Thu) update related details.

Check out the update details through our official forum in the future.

 

 * To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.

 

 

[Redeem Codes Revealed During Livestream]

📌 Q&A

 

Q. The Core filter system needs improvements.
- Regarding feedback that the Core filter is inconvenient, we fully agree. We plan to improve filtering for Cores and level-up materials.

Q. Please add the Co-op Battle event as permanent content.
- Thank you for the positive feedback on Co-op Battles. As mentioned before, we are developing multiplayer content in a different direction, and we plan to introduce a new cooperative PvE event.

Q. Please fix the mailbox red dot bug.
- This issue will be fixed after the update. As we often say, we will work harder on QA.

Q. All-Out Guild War Rage rewards need to be improved.
- Group-based rewards will be increased in this update. As individual damage output has significantly increased (e.g., reaching 200 Rage), rewards will be adjusted accordingly. The minimum quantity of Guild Contribution Chests will remain unchanged, while the maximum Rage rewards will be increased, allowing Hunters to receive roughly double the previous rewards.

Q. Are there plans to introduce weapon types other than swords?
- We plan to introduce a new weapon type in February. Swords are used frequently because they are well-suited for fast-paced and flashy combat, and they are also the weapon type hunters show the most interest in. Nevertheless, we will continue to consider and add other weapon types.

Q. Balance adjustments are needed for certain hunters such as Alicia and Choi Jong-In.
- Balance updates will continue on an ongoing basis. We will keep monitoring feedback and make adjustments accordingly.

Q. The difficulty of Simulation Gate needs to be expanded.
- We are developing content targeting the first half of next year. Currently, Simulation Gates feature hunters as bosses. We plan to add new hunters, introduce boss monsters, and renew existing bosses.

Q. When will Liu Zhigang be updated?
- As stated in the roadmap, it is scheduled for release in June 2026.

Q. Is there a plan to release a new Dark-attribute Breaker?
- It is currently in preparation, and we expect an update in the first half of next year.

Q. Please add a Gem attach/detach feature.
- The Gem system has been in service for a very long time in its current form, making it difficult to add a detach feature.

Q. Are there plans to add the Kamish Dagger?
- The Kamish Dagger will definitely be added. However, since Kamish appears at a specific point in the story, it will be introduced at an appropriate time.

Q. Is there a plan to release Elena Renault as a hunter?
- Elena, who is Alicia Blanche’s adjutant, is currently in development planning. We expect to introduce her soon.

Q. Please add Sung Jinwoo uniform or suit costumes.
- We will take note of this request as well.
 

📌 Roadmap Unveiled

■ January and afterwards

In January, a New Year event will be held alongside the release of Sian Halat as a What if? Hunter Igris. True to their names, they are being designed with striking appearances, and their attribute will be Dark. In addition, the previously introduced PvP event, the International Exchange Match, will take place.

 

In February, the City Recapture storyline will be added. The story will proceed according to schedule as much as possible and will focus on reclaiming the city from the giants that appeared in Tokyo. The maximum level cap will be expanded as well.

At the Workshop of Brilliant Light, the Monarch of Steel, Rockpasa, will be added, and the SLC qualifiers will begin.

 

In March, we are preparing to release the Hunter Teamfight Mode alongside Spring and April Fool’s events. This mode is currently in the planning stage. Three Hunters will appear on the battlefield simultaneously, and unlike Sung Jinwoo Mode, where swapping was not possible, we are developing it so that Hunters can be switched freely.

Sugimoto, formerly the vice master of the Blade Guild, succeeds the late Goto Ryuji as guild master and joins the roster as a Hunter. Additionally, the giant butcher Hars, who appeared in Japan, will be added as a new Shadow.

We are also planning new content, as Encore Missions and Instance Dungeons have lost much of their challenge over time.

 

In April, another National-Level Hunter, Antoine, will make his debut. He will also appear in the newly added Kamish story cutscenes, offering an additional layer of enjoyment for Hunters who look closely. As befits a National-Level Hunter, he will demonstrate overwhelming power.

Sung Jinwoo will receive a new Wind-attribute weapon, Gale Moon Crescent, in the form of a crescent spear. A full-scale Gate system renewal will also be carried out to address existing inconveniences.

In addition, the SLC 2026 Global Finals will be held in April.

 

In May, to celebrate the 2nd Anniversary, an event featuring the most generous rewards ever will be held. A new story arc titled “The Beginning and the Frost” will be added, depicting the tragic events surrounding the Frost Monarch’s arrival before Sung Jinwoo and the death of Go Gunhee.

Sung Jinwoo Mode will be added to the Simulation Gate, and new guild-related content is also in preparation.

 

One of the most important National-Level Hunters, Liu Zhigang, will be added in June. As such a pivotal character, his release timing was carefully considered before finally being confirmed. He has been designed to be powerful. While his combat scenes are rarely shown in the webtoon, the game will allow Hunters to truly experience his strength.

Additionally, the Monarch of the Beginning, Legia, will be introduced at the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

 

* The monthly update details in the roadmap may be subject to change under certain circumstances.

📌 Closing Remarks

Jin Sung Gun, Executive Development PD: I was very glad to be able to play and develop this game together with all of you again this year. We have been constantly busy, and I want to say that we are happily and passionately creating the game.

As we welcome the New Year, we wanted to prepare generous gifts, so we would truly appreciate it if you returned and continued playing with us. We also have many updates planned for 2026, so please look forward to them. Lastly, we look forward to meeting you all on the big stage known as SLC.

Kim Ryun-gu, Head of Content Planning: I felt a great deal of pressure attending this event for the first time, knowing I had to fill the gap left by Lee Da Haeng, Head of the Business Department, and I hope you were satisfied. I spoke for quite a long time today, and we always review the messages you leave in chat and on the forums once again afterward. Our development staff also checks your feedback every morning, so we ask for your continued interest and support.

We are preparing the content introduced today with great dedication, and we hope you enjoy it. We will continue striving to present fun and exciting content again next year as well.

 

 

Thank you.

Hunters Association

24,319

 

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

Here are the details scheduled to be added and changed through the update on 12/18 (Thu).

 

Please see below for more details about the update.

 

 

📢12/18 (Thu) Update Details

 

 

📌 Story New Chapter (Hard/Reverse Hard)

▶ Story Hard, Reverse Hard Difficulty New Chapter

- THe hidden chapters 9 and 10 added through the 11/20 (Thu) update will be added to the story hard and reverse hard difficulty.

* As new stories are added, new Battle Mission Achievement Rewards for Hard and reverse hard difficulties will be added accordingly.

 

📌 Hunter Class Adjustment & New Battle System

▶ Hunter Class Adjustment & New Class

- The existing six Hunter classes (Fighter, Tank, Mage, Ranger, Assassin, Healer) will be restructured into three classes: Striker, Breaker, and Support. In addition, a new class called “Elemental Stacker”, which utilizes the Elemental Charge system, will be introduced.

* The Elemental Stacker class currently applies only to Christopher Reed.

* The existing classes will be renamed as Roles and can be viewed in places such as the Hunter Dossier.

- Following the Hunter class overhaul, class icons and other elements affected by the previous class system will be updated.

ex) Examples include the Remnant Power traits and Simulation Gate Collection.

 

▶ New Battle System “Elemental Charge” and “Element Overload”

- New combat systems, “Elemental Charge” and “Element Overload,” are being introduced, allowing Hunters to stack elemental attacks to deal greater damage to enemies.

- When an Elemental Stacker-class hunter attacks an enemy with its weakness attribute, the corresponding attribute gauge increases. Once it reaches 100%, the enemy enters the Element Overload state.

While attacking an enemy in the Element Overload state, damage is dealt while ignoring the damage reduction effect of enemies that possess a Break Gauge.

* The Elemental Charge system is exclusive to the Elemental Stacker class.

* Using Elemental Charge may affect the instant Break patterns of certain monsters.

* The Element Overload state is applied for a limited duration, and after it ends, enemies become temporarily immune to Elemental Charge.

 

📌 New Growth Element “Hunter Co-op Training”

- A new progression feature that allows you to increase Hunter stats will be added.

Through [Hunter Co-op Training] in the Quick Menu, you can access the training screen and conduct specialized training by attribute and class.

- Each training category requires the “Hunter Training Handbook” item, which can be obtained as Season Rewards from The Observer’s Forbidden Library or through the Celebration Coin Exchange Shop.

- You can reset your training progress using Essence Stones, and upon reset, the Hunter Training Handbook used will be refunded.

 

📌 New Content “Edge of Illusion and Dreams” unveiled

A new content, Edge of Illusion and Dreams, where Hunters cooperate to defeat powerful bosses, will be added.

* Edge of Illusion and Dreams becomes available after clearing Hidden Chapter 1 “Unknown Power” on Story Normal difficulty.

 

▶ How to Participate

- Edge of Illusion and Dreams is a real-time cooperative mode where two players progress through stages together. During the December update period, it will be held in a seasonal format, with two seasons, each lasting two weeks.

* The season duration may change in future updates.

- During the December update period, the content will be available in Hunter Mode, where players use three hunters to challenge “Kamish, the Flame of Calamity.”

You may enter for free or consume an Edge of Illusion and Dreams Key to challenge the stage.

* The mode (Sung Jinwoo Mode / Player Mode) and the target boss may change with each future season.

- After selecting the stage difficulty, you can either be randomly matched with another hunter or create a room to form a party with guild members or friends.

* Stages consist of four difficulty levels, and as the difficulty increases, the boss’s weakness attributes are reduced.

 

▶ Reward

- If you enter using an Edge of Illusion and Dreams Key, you will receive clear rewards upon completing the stage.

- During the season, the World Nightmare Liberation Progress increases based on the total number of boss defeats by all players, allowing you to earn cooperative rewards.

* World Nightmare Liberation Progress cooperative rewards are granted only if you have cleared the dungeon at least once using an entry key.

 

Team up with other hunters to defeat powerful bosses and earn a variety of rewards!

 

For more details on how to enter and progress through Edge of Illusion and Dreams, please refer to the guide below.

[Edge of Illusion and Dreams Guide]

 

📌 New SSR Hunter & Exclusive Weapon

- A new SSR Fire attribute Hunter [Christopher Reed] and exclusive weapon [Strategy for Victory] will be added.

- The Hunter can be obtained through Rate Up Draw, and you can experience the power of the Hunter in advance through Hunter Preview.

- The exclusive weapon can be obtained through crafting or events.

- The new Hunters’ Profile Icon, Dossier, Codex, Bonds will also be added.

- The original story and Secret Library for Christopher Reed will be added.

* With the rate up selection list reduced to three options, the acquisition rate of the selected rate up SSR will be adjusted accordingly.

However, the drop rates by rarity tier will remain unchanged.

 

📌 Guild Boss & Exchange Shop Improvement

▶ Guild Boss Reward Improvement

- Phantomblade Fragments will be added to the reward list of Guild Conquest Chests for all tiers except Tier I, and can be obtained at a certain probability.

- For S1 and S2-tier All-Out Guild War, the Rage-tier rewards by ranking will be further divided into five categories per rank, and the number of All-Out Guild War Chests granted will be increased.

The Observer’s Forbidden Library, previously available in beta, will officially open as a regular season after maintenance.

With the start of the new season, the entry attributes, Library rules, appearing bosses, and bookmark target Hunters will change.

 

 From the official season onward, the following adjustments and improvements will be applied.

 

▶ Addition of Higher Difficulty & Achievements

- A new difficulty tier, “Forbidden Shelf,” higher than the existing Normal/Ancient Shelves, will be added.

This difficulty consists of 12 stages, and 18–20 required candidates are needed to enter.

 

▶ Partial Changes to Season Rewards

- Among the existing stage rewards, Skill Rune/Gem Refinement Tickets and Artifact Enhancement Reset Tickets will be replaced with Hunter Training Handbook.
- The quantities of other rewards will also be partially adjusted.

* Please refer to the in-game details for more information on the updated rewards.

* Please check the game for detailed information on content rules and rewards.

 

▶ Workshop of Brilliant Light - Proof of the Strong added to Puppeteer’s Theater / Removed from Distorted Sanctuary

- Clearing Proof of the Strong grants [Token of Absolute Strength], which can be used in the Proof of the Strong Exchange Shop.

▶ Battlefield of Time Improvements & Monster Pattern Adjustments

- During the settlement period after a Battlefield of Time season ends, all boss stages will be opened in Practice Mode for free use.

* Stage records will not be updated while Practice Mode is available.

- Monsters that fail to detect players in certain Battlefield of Time stages will no longer move to other locations.

 

▶ Battle Class Tier Cap Expansion

▶ New Hunter Archive & Secret Library

- Hunter Archive and Secret Library for Hunter Lim Tae-Gyu will be added.

- The title screen will be updated.

- The reward acquisition animation when leveling up the Hunter Pass will be improved.

- When applying Recommended Formations, Sung Jinwoo’s Ultimate Skill Rune will now be included.

- UI control using a gamepad will now be supported in the Training Room.

- Some shortcut links in the Train to Become a Formidable Combatant will be improved.

- After completing a Special Summons guarantee, the selected target will no longer reappear until the following month.
- A notification for Shadow Enforcer mission completion will be added to Lobby alerts.

- Upon completing a Shadow Enforcer mission, a mission restart pop-up will be added, allowing Hunters to retry missions of the same category.

* Secret Missions are excluded from mission restart eligibility.

* Due to this improvement, after the update, the previously selected automatic rewards for each mission will be reset once per mission.

After completing a dispatch once, the system will automatically select the rewards you had previously received as usual.

-  Crafting of common weapon advancement materials (Orb of Amplification and Orb of Balance) will now be categorized under Growth → Weapon Growth.

-When equipping the Ennio’s Roar – Star-Devouring Fury skin, its exclusive visual effects will now trigger during Dash and Shadow Step actions even after swapping to an unequipped weapon.

- The Encore Missions boss, Viridescent Mage Fores, will no longer use a Fire-attribute Shield pattern.

- Filters and sorting options for Core equipping and Core leveling will be separated, improving ease of Core management and growth.

- In the Artifact Enhancement pop-up, Hunters can now view their current owned quantity of materials required for the selected enhancement level.

- A magnifying glass icon will be added to the Artifact Enhancement pop-up, allowing Hunters to check material costs, Gold costs, and enhancement success rates by enhancement level.

- The readability of guidance text in Power of Destruction → Boss Information will be partially improved.

- The damage display format applied during Break damage will be partially adjusted.

- The tooltips for Tawata Kanae (advancement tier 0 effect) and Sung Il-hwan (advancement tier1 Evolution effect) will be updated to clearly indicate the elemental damage increase effects that were already being applied.

* Actual combat performance remains unchanged from before the tooltip update.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed certain presentation issues in Laura Walker’s Hunter Archive and Secret Library stages.

- Fixed the issue where Shadow Step could activate regardless of conditions in certain situations when the Ennio’s Roar, Star-Devouring Fury skin was equipped.

- Fixed the issue where some red dot notifications remained visible even after using Claim All in the mailbox.

- Fixed the issue where QTE animations continued to play in Workshop of Brilliant Light, The Puppeteer’s Theater: Puppet Show of Arrogance when a QTE pattern was triggered or when the player died during the stage.

- Fixed presentation and dialogue errors in certain Story chapters.

- Fixed the issue where Fame EXP obtained in Story Dungeons was only applied after completing the final story sequence of the stage.

- Fixed the issue where Sung Jinwoo/Hunter scores were not reflected when updating Guild Boss records.

- Fixed the issue where stage progression could occasionally become unavailable after tagging in the Simulation Gate.

- Fixed the issue where a warning pop-up stating that a Transcendence-grade Gem was already owned appeared during Gem refinement.

- Fixed the issue where Shadow Waves could not be automatically crafted when leveling up Shadows.

- Fixed the issue where the weapon level requirement text appeared when lowering the Auto limit break level of a weapon.

 

 

We will continue our efforts to provide our hunters

with an even more enjoyable gaming experience in Solo Leveling:ARISE.

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Note: Our First Greeting of 2026

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Our First Greeting of 2026

Hunters Association
|
Jan 8, 2026, 05:00
|
18,066

 

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

First, we would like to extend our New Year’s greetings through this message.

We hope you have a wonderful time with Solo Leveling: ARISE in the new year of 2026

Our team will always do our best also.

 

In today’s Developer Note, we would like to share our future development direction.

 

* Please note that the name of items, packages, and events/content scheduled to be added in the future may be subject to change. (Working Titles)

 

 

The Red Knight, “Sian Halat (Igris),” Joins the Gate Raid

Finally, the one many Hunters have been waiting for is here. Igris, the most loyal sword of the Monarch of Shadows, comes to you under the name “Sian Halat.”

 

He will join as a powerful “Dark Element Elemental Stacker.” As previously teased, he will unleash overwhelming destructive power at the center of the new combat meta. Please look forward to his crimson slash that will sweep across the battlefield.

Son Kihoon, the Strike Squad Leader of the Hunters Guild's B-Team, Joins the Gate Raid

This coming January, Son Kihoon, the strike squad leader of the Hunters Guild's B-Team, will officially join the Gate Raid.

Son Kihoon, a “Dark Element Breaker,” will maximize the efficiency of Dark Element parties alongside Sian Halat.

 

In particular, there will be no Limited Rate-Up Draw for Hunter Son Kihoon.

 

Instead, he will be available through events and the subscription system, and will also be obtainable through the Custom Draw. Please look forward to it.

 

Artifact Farming Difficulty Reduced

 

Our team deeply empathizes with the frustration caused by the difficulty of ‘obtaining optimal Artifact stats,’ which has diminished the joy of farming.

 

We believe that farming for growth should be an anticipated and enjoyable experience, rather than endless repetition and failure. Accordingly, with the Level 100 expansion, we are preparing fundamental improvements to the farming system.

 

To make sure your efforts result in genuine enjoyment, we will introduce various “farming mitigation systems.” We are working hard to ensure that Hunters can once again fully experience the thrill of obtaining the ‘desired drop.’

 

Various other updates are being prepared.

   - The Guild Boss will be changed to Giant Statue.
   - Shadow Enforcer’s Proficiency will be increased from tier 10 to 20.
   - The exchange limits for Aether I, Skill Scroll I, and Skill Scroll II in the Celebration Coin Exchange Shop will be increased.
   - Sales of Yogumunt Gold Badge and the Ruler Title will end, and Valtair Gold Badge will be added to the Workshop of Brilliant Light Proof of the Strong Exchange Shop.
   - The issue where the game would occasionally crash during UI operations, such as moving between menus, will be fixed.

 

Please look forward to the information above.

Next, we’d like to share a preview of the upcoming updates currently being planned by the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

New Hunter Joining the Gate Raid in February

Richter Guild’ rising star, “Meri Laine”  joins the Gate Raid.

 

From Germany’s renowned Richter Guild, Meri Laine will soon take part in the Gate raid.

 

Despite her young appearance, she skillfully wields a weapon larger than herself. As a Water Element Hunter, her versatility truly lives up to her nickname, “The Rising Star.”

Please look forward to her unstoppable performance as she sweeps the battlefield with her massive weapon.

 

SLC Preliminaries to Be Held

 

Hunters, are you ready to challenge the world?

At last, SLC preliminaries, where you determine the strongest Hunter, begins.

 

If you are still hesitating or getting ready to participate, make sure to obtain 1,000 points from the “Battlefield of Time 15” to prove your eligibility before this season ends.

We wish good luck to all Hunters who will be challenging the stage of glory.

 

New Boss in the Workshop of Brilliant Light and Sung Jinwoo Growth Expansion

 

A new challenge, “Rockpasa, the Monarch of Steel,” arrives in the Workshop of Brilliant Light. To face a Monarch with a formidable physique, Hunter Sung Jinwoo will also evolve to the next level.

 

Surpass Sung Jinwoo’s limits through the new job advancement, and combine it with the newly added Rune Skills to experience even more diverse and spectacular action.

 

Thoughts on the Direction of Future Development

 

As we continue our service, our team has been giving careful thought to both the present and future of our existing content.

 

Among our current concerns, the “Power of Destruction” stands out the most. Compared to the Guild Boss in a similar position, we believe the Power of Destruction has lost its freshness due to the same boss being maintained for an extended period. In addition, its relatively simple scoring system has limited opportunities for diverse strategies and tactical discussions among Hunters.

 

We are not content with the current state and, in order to provide Hunters with greater enjoyment, are thoroughly reviewing all possibilities, including a full renewal of the content or, if necessary, complete retirement followed by the introduction of entirely new replacement content.

 

As we carefully consider ways to deliver a better experience, we will inform you again once the specific plan is finalized.

 

Endless Challenges, Expanding and Renewing Content

 

The stage of challenges expands to keep pace with your growth.

 

We plan to expand the maximum floor for the Battlefield of Trials and Simulation Gate.

 

In particular, the Simulation Gate will introduce new bosses, including a new Hunter Boss and a new Sung Jinwoo boss. New boss monsters and stages will also be added, so please stay tuned.

 

Lastly, we kindly ask for your continued support as you journey with Solo Leveling: ARISE throughout 2026.

 

We would like to share the schedule for the next Developer Livestream.

The next livestream is planned to take place in February instead of January. To prepare even more abundant and diverse stories for all Hunters, we're taking a moment to catch our breath. Please bear with us a little longer as we'll return in February with substantial news.

 

Thank you.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

 

To show our gratitude, we have prepared a login gift for Hunters eagerly anticipating the upcoming update.

 

Please be sure to claim your login gift, which we hope will be helpful until the update.

📢1/15 (Thu) Update Details

 

📌 Story New Chapter (Expert)

- Hidden Chapters 1 and 2, as well as Chapters 19 and 20, will be newly unlocked in Expert difficulty.

* As new stories are added, new Battle Mission Achievement Rewards for Expert difficulty will be added accordingly.

 

📌 PVP Event “International Clash” Added

- The “International Clash” event, where you can challenge other Hunters, will take place throughout the update period.

- The International Clash is a PvP event where you compete for scores by battling other Hunters’ Defense Teams, forming your own Attack/Defense Teams using up to 5 Hunters and 9 Tactic Cards.

 

▶How to Participate

- The International Clash can be accessed via [Event] → [International Clash].

  You must form a Defense Team upon your first participation to join the event.

- There is no limit to the number of times you can participate. However, Ranking Points can only be earned when challenging using Clash Tickets. A set number of Clash Tickets is provided daily.

 

▶Rewards

- When you attack using a Clash Ticket, you will obtain a score regardless of whether the attack succeeds or fails.

  If the attack is successful, you can earn a higher score based on the conditions met.

  Rankings are determined based on your accumulated score.

- You can obtain mission rewards by participating in the Clash or by completing missions that require earning a certain score.

  Additionally, special title rewards will be granted based on your ranking after the event ends.

 

For more details on the International Clash Event, please refer to the notice below.

- The HP of Elite/Boss monsters in all stages will be increased.

- When entering the Battlefield of Chaos for the first time, all tiers, including the highest tier, will be unlocked.

- When all Battle Mission Trophies in the higher tiers of the Battlefield of Chaos are obtained, trophies from the lower tiers will be automatically granted.

- When resetting training, a “Select All” checkbox will be added to the element/class category.

- On the Co-op Training screen, tapping a Hunter icon will display a Hunter information pop-up, allowing you to view the list of Hunters by element/class.

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Retake the City Update

Hunters Association
|
Jan 27, 2026, 08:00
|
16,630

 

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

In today’s Developer Notes, we would like to share the long-awaited news of our Main Story expansion,

along with various updates currently in development.

 

* Please note that the name of items, packages, and events/content scheduled to be added in the future may be subject to change. (Working Titles)

 

[Main Story - Retake the City]

 

As Japan falls into chaos due to a Dungeon Break, Sung Jinwoo heads to the battlefield to stop the Giants occupying the city.

Amidst the overwhelming advance of the Shadow Army, Jinwoo encounters 'Hars,' 

an entity emitting an eerie magical power.

 

While Japanese Hunters watch in awe, Thomas Andre—watching from the other side of the globe—

remains certain of Jinwoo’s victory.

 

Experience the next chapter of Sung Jinwoo’s journey as he once again transcends his limits on a battlefield the whole world is watching with bated breath.

 

[Workshop of Brilliant Light: Trials for the Peak of Valor]

 

In the newly opened Workshop of Brilliant Light, you will face five trials to prove your worth.

To reach the "Apex," you must demonstrate not just raw power, but honor, might, and precision. 

Strategically utilize the trials and blessings provided at each stage to overcome the Rigid Overseer and emerge victorious.

 

Furthermore, we are introducing the ‘Remnant Power,’ a new system that will serve as a vital key to overcoming these challenges.

 

We look forward to your excitement for this new layer of strategy.

 

[SLC Finals & Offline Event Announcement]

The upcoming SLC Finals will be held once again at the ‘Jamsil DN Colosseum’, 

the site of the incredible passion from our first Korean tournament.

 

This offline event is more than just a competition to find the strongest Hunter; 

it is a meaningful space for us to meet you in person and share the future of the game.

 

At the venue, we will unveil the 2nd Anniversary Update details for the first time.

We are also hard at work preparing special merchandise for our Hunters, so please stay tuned.

 

Additionally, we would like to provide you with some key details regarding the tournament proceedings and your participation in the Finals.

 

The competition will feature only original Solo Leveling:ARISE Hunters. Collaboration Hunters will be restricted from use.
 
Please ensure you are familiar with the tournament regulations to avoid any issues during the competition
To support your journey to the Finals, Netmarble will provide full coverage for travel, lodging, and meals.

 

[Gameplay Improvements & New Features]

We are continuously working to enhance your overall play experience:

 

1. To support your continuous growth, the maximum level cap will be expanded to Lv. 140.
2. We are restructuring the combat in Story Chapters 0–2 and improving the tutorial system to help new Hunters adapt more quickly and experience a deeper sense of immersion.
3. The 'New Hunter Protocol' will be added to expand opportunities for testing out new Hunters and to provide a wider range of combat experiences.
4. To resolve inconveniences during play, we are improving the targeting logic for some of Sung Jinwoo’s skills (Crushing Blow, Cutting Rush), weapons (Kasaka's Venom Fang, Knight Killer), and QTE actions (Collapse, Death).
5. Visual clarity for the in-game 'Elemental Accumulation' and 'Element Overload' statuses will be enhanced so you can better assess the flow of battle.
6. To reduce play fatigue, we are improving the animations and controls for the Dice Event to make it more convenient to use.
7. New Skill Runes will be added.
8. A special Valentine’s event will also be held.

 

[Innovation in Artifact Looting: 'Encore Dungeon' Integration]

To alleviate the stress of collecting Artifacts and help you focus on the joy of growth, 

we are beginning a major overhaul by integrating ‘Encore Missions’ 

and Instance Dungeons into a single content called Encore Dungeons.

 

This change will not happen all at once; instead, 

we plan to roll out sequential updates from March to May to ensure the system stabilizes smoothly.

 

Alongside this restructuring, we are refining the gear progression structure by adding a system that allows you to select specific Artifact sets to obtain as rewards.

 

While you previously had to repeat specific dungeons for certain pieces, 

you can now target the exact Artifact sets you want.

 

Regardless of the dungeon type, rewards will drop according to your selected settings,

significantly increasing both the efficiency and your chances of securing the gear you need.

 

To further enhance convenience, we are also improving Artifact management features.

For instance, specifically for Encore Dungeons, we will introduce a system that automatically locks or salvages gear based on its main and sub-stats, allowing you to focus purely on the hunt without the hassle of inventory management.

 

Furthermore, if you select a Hunter you wish to grow, 

the system will help you easily configure reward settings based on recommended sets and stats.

 

The current entrance structure, divided into ‘Sung Jinwoo Mode’ and ‘Hunter Mode’, will be maintained, 

so you can continue to enjoy the familiar experience of dungeon rotations and battle missions.

 

We will carefully refine the new Enclosed Dungeon system and the upcoming Artifact looting experience so that you can once again explore the true thrill of landing that perfect drop.

 

Lastly, we hope you will continue this journey with Solo Leveling:ARISE throughout 2026.

To keep the conversation going with our Hunters, the February Developer Live Stream is scheduled for February 10th (Tue). 

We will remain dedicated to bringing you more exciting and diverse news in the future.

※ Please note that the following information was written by citing the Inven article, "[Inven] The Stage Moves to Tokyo! Feb Dev Live Recap: March Artifact Improvements & More," which summarized the Developer Live broadcast held on 2/10 [View Original Text]

※ This summary focuses on the Q&A session, excluding the details regarding the 2/12 (Thu) update. Detailed information about the update will be provided through a separate upcoming Update Notice.

 

[Go to Live video]

※ To enable subtitles on YouTube, go to Settings > Subtitles > Auto-Translate, then select your preferred language. You can then watch the video with subtitles in the chosen language.
