📌 Q&A

 

Q. It is too difficult to obtain Son Kihoon through Custom Draw.

- We initially chose this draw method to reduce the burden of continuous new Rate-Up character releases, knowing that many players had accumulated Custom Draw Tickets. However, we observed that the actual experience was inconvenient, with hunters or weapons from the other two slots appearing instead.  Therefore, we plan to add guaranteed acquisition routes for Son Kihoon, such as through Subscription-exclusive rewards, and ensure a steady additional supply of Custom Draw Tickets.

 

Q. Q. How is the revamp for the [Power of Destruction] content, as mentioned in the Dev Notes, progressing?

- While many players participate in the Power of Destruction, we have determined that there is a lack of motivation despite the existence of World Rankings, especially since rewards like Weapon Skins were removed. Therefore, we are aiming for an April update to remove the Beta label and introduce a system that provides regular World Ranking rewards. Even after the Beta ends, we will continue to improve the content to ensure it lives up to its name as competitive content.

 

Q. It is too difficult to obtain Artifacts with effective sub-stats.

- We have been sharing updates through Dev Notes since late January, and we are well aware of the significant stress caused by the process of collecting Artifacts and general convenience issues. I will provide more precise details during the update section at the end of this broadcast.

 

Q. Please increase the amount of Gold obtainable from Exchange Events.

- We are currently monitoring the trends regarding the limited supply of Gold. We will proceed with increasing the amount provided to ensure a smoother experience.

 

Q. Improvements are needed for the Gem content.

- We are not currently considering higher-tier Gems. However, we are preparing a feature to unequip Gems. Additionally, for the second page where only 4 slots are available per Gem type, we plan to expand them by 4 slots each, allowing you to equip 8 Gems per type, just like the first page.

※ The exact direction of these improvements is currently under internal review, and detailed information will be provided through a future update notice.

 

Q. There is a bug where only a black screen appears when launching the game or entering a stage.

- We have identified the causes for both cases. Although they originated from different technical issues, both resulted in the same "black screen" error. These issues are scheduled to be fixed in the upcoming update.

 

Q. It is very stressful to deal with AFK players in [Edge of Illusion].

- We are fully aware of the inconvenience caused by players who stay idle inside the dungeon. Initially, we designed the content to prevent players from leaving midway to stop people from giving up too easily. However, we agree with the feedback that re-matching after someone leaves is less frustrating than dealing with idle players. We plan to apply improvements, including balance adjustments, as soon as possible.

 

Q. There seems to be a bug with the hit detection of [Firestorm Kick] during Guild Boss Battles.

- We have identified the issue and are currently in the process of resolving it internally. We will ensure the fix is applied as soon as possible.

 

Q. The rewards for [International Clash] are too insufficient.

- As International Clash is currently in its Beta version, rewards were set at a lower level since it lacks full-scale rankings or promotions. Furthermore, setting overly high rewards for a testing phase might force participation, potentially causing stress for our players. We plan to strengthen the rewards once the content is officially formalized.

 

International Clash was a feature we deliberated on extensively. We had doubts about whether card-based auto-battles would be enjoyable in an action-focused game like Solo Leveling: Arise. However, the response has been more positive than expected, and many are requesting it become a permanent feature. Therefore, we will finalize the system with improved rewards and mechanics before its official release.

 

Q. Currently, Artifact Presets only allow switching between two setups. Are there any plans for improvement?

- We are currently preparing updates to reduce the hassle and fatigue associated with managing equipment setups. I will provide more detailed information during the upcoming update section of this broadcast.

 

Q. When will the level cap for Sung Jinwoo be expanded?

- A level cap expansion is prepared to coincide with the new story release in the upcoming update.

 

Q. The tutorial is too long, and the story flow feels frequently interrupted.

- As the game approaches its 2nd Anniversary, we still have many new and returning players. However, we have received feedback that the mandatory long tutorials feel tedious for those already familiar with the game. Regarding the story, many players have mentioned that having to click the "Next" button after every scene disrupts the immersion.

 

To address this, an initial improvement to the basic tutorial will be implemented in the February update. We are also preparing additional convenience updates and aim to showcase them before the 2nd Anniversary.

 

Q. It feels like the supply of tickets has decreased compared to before.

- The average number of tickets provided has never decreased. However, as players grow stronger, while basic Evolution used to be enough for a hunter to be battle-ready, now Advancement (Dimensional Evolution) is required for them to be considered an immediate asset. This has led to an increase in actual ticket consumption. Therefore, we are working to supply more tickets through various events, so please stay tuned for these updates.

 

Q. Is mobile optimization no longer being improved?

- To get straight to the point, we are still continuously working on mobile optimization. However, since optimization is a task that often feels insufficient no matter how much we do, it seems we have not yet fully met your expectations. We are also well aware of the feedback requesting that damage from unselected hunters in Guild Raids be applied correctly. We are currently working on this for a swift improvement, so please bear with us a little longer.

 

 

📌 March Update Details

 

■ Direction of Artifact Improvements & Encore Mission Revamp Preview

 

Currently, dungeons are divided into Encore Missions and Instance Dungeons, but starting in March, you will only need to run Encore Missions. Additionally, the farming method will shift from targeting specific equipment slots to selecting desired sets. You will be able to select two sets each for Armor and Jewelry, allowing you to obtain a total of 16 different parts.

 

On the reward selection screen, you will be able to check sets suitable for each Hunter along with their stat information. We also plan to introduce Auto-Lock and Auto-Salvage features based on specific options. This will allow you to instantly lock Artifacts with your "Wish" stats and salvage unnecessary ones on the spot. We expect this to significantly reduce the hassle of having to manually salvage a massive pile of accumulated Artifacts once your inventory reaches its limit.

 

The burden of choosing which Artifact to use will also be reduced. In practice, it is often difficult to know exactly which Artifact set or sub-stats are best for a specific character. To address this, new Artifacts tailored to each class will be introduced. These will go up to Level 120 and will come with the essential stats required for that specific class, allowing you to equip them without further hesitation.

 

Of course, the Artifacts you have already built will not become obsolete immediately. While they will no longer drop in dungeons starting in May, we plan to maintain features that allow you to grow them up to Level 120 through Crafting and Refinement, enabling you to use your existing sets for a longer period.

 

There are also changes to the enhancement options. Currently, additional stats are granted at enhancement levels 5, 10, 15, and 20, with higher levels providing larger stat increases. This meant that a "+2" increase at a higher enhancement level resulted in higher total stats than the same "+2" at a lower level. Moving forward, we will unify this so that the same value is always granted regardless of the enhancement level. Additionally, the "Increase Mana Consumption Reduction" (Mana Recovery) option will no longer appear on Level 120 Artifacts.

 

▲ Encore Missions and Instance Dungeons will be merged into a single category.

 

▲ The system will change to allow selecting 2 sets each of Armor and Accessory to obtain as rewards.

 

▲ You can check recommended options for each Hunter and pre-set Artifacts for Auto-Lock or Salvage.

 

The reason we are simplifying Artifact sets and unifying enhancement values is that the current system is too confusing. Even when looking up guides, recommended gear varies wildly; players might find one setup works well one day, only to hear the next day that another setup is better. It has become far too difficult to find the "right" answer.

 

Our goal is to create the simplest structure possible. For sets, we want players to focus on the core of Artifact farming—"how many good options were rolled"—rather than stressing over which set to use. The unification of enhancement values follows the same logic. Previously, even after successfully landing enhancements on desired options, players suffered significant stress because some would end up with maximum values while others received near-minimum stats for the same number of rolls.

 

These factors have led to a cycle of accumulating Artifacts, overflowing inventories, and the inability to easily clear them out. Furthermore, having to prepare so many different sets has led to an ever-increasing dependency on Presets. Our ultimate goal is to reduce the time spent worrying about gear and instead allow you to spend that time actually playing and enjoying the game. We hope our players can resonate with this direction.

 

Additionally, regarding Equipment Refinement: currently, we have planned that Level 75 items refined to Level 100 cannot be further refined to Level 120. However, this is not yet finalized. We fully understand the potential frustration for those who have carefully enhanced Level 75 gear with excellent options, so we will continue to look for the best possible solution.

 

Along with the release of the new Artifacts, we will also hold an Enhancement Re-roll event. To ease the burden of gearing up from scratch, we plan to provide a generous amount of additional enhancement materials. As there is still some time left before the update, we will continue to listen closely to your feedback on the community even after this broadcast ends and will do our best to reflect your opinions in the game.

 

■ New Guild Boss: Manticore

 

A new Guild Boss, Manticore, is coming. Before we dive into the details, I’d like to address the issues regarding Fachtna’s wings. In our previous broadcast, I mentioned that if the wings continued to cause frustration during combat, we would remove them entirely. Since many of you still find them inconvenient, I have officially requested the Art Team to create a version with damaged wings. However, as this weakened version of Fachtna doesn't quite fit the prestige of a Guild Boss, you will instead encounter it in our April Fools' Event Dungeon. For your information, the April Fools' Event Dungeon will be presented in a comical format incorporating the Hunter Team Fight mode.

To describe the Manticore, it is a legendary creature with a bizarre appearance—combining the head of a lion with sharp horns, the wings of a bat, and the tail of a scorpion. We plan to showcase various attack patterns utilizing these features. However, keeping the nature of a Guild Boss in mind, we are preparing the encounter while specifically excluding elements that might cause player frustration.

 

▲ Fachtna will step down as a Guild Boss, and the new boss, Manticore, will make its debut.

 

 

📌 Preview: 2nd Anniversary Eve Offline Event

 

The 2nd Anniversary Eve will be held alongside the SLC 2026 Preliminaries. Both the anniversary celebration and the tournament qualifiers will take place on the same day, and we are hard at work preparing a variety of activities for those visiting the venue. For those unable to attend in person, the entire event will also be broadcast live online.

 

We are preparing this event on a very large scale. As we have consistently done through various sponsorships in our past tournaments, we have secured a wide range of prizes this time as well, including gaming mice, headsets, monitors, and tablet PCs.

 

Furthermore, as Solo Leveling: Arise approaches its 2nd Anniversary, we plan to host a session to share our 2nd Anniversary update details, the roadmap for the second half of the year, and our future vision while communicating directly with our players. The event will take place on April 25th at the DN Colosseum in Jamsil. We look forward to your enthusiastic interest and participation!

 

📌 Closing Remarks

 

Jae-hyun Kim, System Design Team Lead : We covered a lot of topics today. I deeply resonate with your concerns regarding various issues, such as those related to Refinement and Rate Up fatigue. While it is difficult for me to provide definitive answers right here and now, I will ensure everything is well-organized and prepared so that PD Seong-geon Jin can share more positive news with you during his next visit.

 

Da-haeng Lee, Head of Business Division : We fully expected that the Artifact improvement plans presented today would spark a wide variety of opinions. The reason we shared these plans now is that we believe communicating our current direction early is the best way to gather diverse feedback from our players.

 

As there is still time until the update, we will continue to incorporate your feedback, adopting what we can and mitigating any problematic areas through ongoing adjustments. Please don’t worry too much; share your thoughts on the community, and we will gather them for further discussion.

 

Additionally, we have various events in the works where you can receive a total of 180 tickets. This includes the 50 Custom Weapon Draw Tickets from the login event starting right after this broadcast, plus another 100 Custom Draw Tickets and 30 Custom Weapon Draw Tickets through upcoming events. We hope you don't miss out on these rewards! More details will be provided in a future announcement.

 

Ryeon-gu Kim, Content Design Team Lead : We carefully gather all the concerns and opinions shared by our players, and they lead to intense discussions within the company after each broadcast. We are constantly debating the best direction for the game, so please do not worry too much.

 

Our team members are working tirelessly to prepare a wealth of new content. We hope you enjoy it. I personally watch your videos and read your posts, and they are incredibly helpful to us. Please continue to provide us with both constructive criticism and support. We will repay your interest by making Solo Leveling: Arise an even better game.

 

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Note: Back to the Action Essence

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Back to the Action Essence

Hunters Association
|
Feb 27, 2026, 06:00
|
14,733

 

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

In today’s Dev Note, we’re excited to share a variety of updates our team has been working on, starting with the Artifact overhaul scheduled for March, followed by highlights of upcoming major updates.

 

[Seasonal Event - Spring Bloom]

 

In our previous roadmap, we announced that Sugimoto would be joining the Gate Raids.

For this update's seasonal event, we’ve prepared an intriguing story centered around the 'Blade Guild,' which Sugimoto is a member of.

 

Before we dive into the details, here’s a quick sneak peek at the new story unfolding soon.

 

『The Blade Guild heads into a dungeon to investigate a mysterious rumor about a "Gate where the Undying Flower that grants wishes blooms.”

There, they face a suspicious old man named 'Mr. Hyun,' who is obsessed with 'lost ideals' and 'absolute power,' summoning hallucinatory magic beasts. Driven back by the guild members, Mr. Hyun eventually flees into another Gate.

After the commotion settles, Sugimoto, an executive of the Blade Guild, reflects on the word "wish" left by the dungeon. He falls into a bittersweet longing as he remembers Kayo, the lover who left him on their wedding day.

Soon, however, the boisterous yet dependable voices of his comrades bring him back to reality. Beneath the cherry blossoms in full bloom, he decides to treat his guild members to a meal, stepping back into the warmth of a peaceful spring day..』

 

We hope you look forward to the emotional journey and the heartwarming stories awaiting you in this seasonal event.

 

[Pahtna, the Damaged Wing]

 

Additionally, "Pahtna, the Damaged Wing"—which we teased in our last Dev Live—will officially make its debut through this Event Dungeon.

While the main boss of the Event Dungeon is 'Mr. Hyun,' the long-awaited 'Pahtna, the Damaged Wing' will be summoned directly by him during the battle, adding an extra layer of intensity to the fight.

 

[Hunter Team Fight mode]

 

The newly added 'Hunter Team Fight' mode allows you to form a team of Hunters only without Sung Jinwoo and take direct control of them in battle.

 

Unlike existing modes, you can freely switch between Hunters during combat, and they can use their skills immediately upon being tagged in.

 

The core fun of this mode lies in constantly tagging Hunters to suit the flow of battle and chaining their skills together for seamless combos.

 

 

[Monarch of Steel Event Protocol & Speed Race Clearing Event]

 

Through this update, the Monarch of Steel Event Protocol will be newly added to the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

 

Similar to the New Hunter Protocol introduced in the February update, this event is designed to help Hunters who struggle with high difficulty content. It allows players to experience and learn the boss's core mechanics and combat flow in advance.

This content will be provided in Sung Jinwoo Mode. To ensure Hunters can focus entirely on understanding the patterns and mechanics, the battle will be conducted with a fixed system lineup.

 

[Workshop of Brilliant Light First-Come Costume]

 

 

The Workshop of Brilliant Light Rockpasa First-Come Clear Event is also set to begin.

We are eager to see who will be the first to defeat the overwhelming power of Rockpasa.

 

 

[Artifact & Farming System Overhaul]

 

Our team deeply recognizes that the variety of Artifacts added over the past two years has become excessively vast. We have observed that even for expert Hunters who have mastered the game, opinions often differ on which Artifacts offer the best efficiency.

 

Above all, we felt that this complexity has become a significant barrier to entry for new and returning Hunters. Furthermore, due to the sheer number of Artifact types, the fatigue of farming for specific gear and the stress of enhancing options have been exhausting for all of you.

We are committed to addressing these issues and returning to the essence of action.

 

Before we dive into the details, we would like to address the Lv. 78 Artifact Refinement, a topic that has seen a lot of discussion following our last Dev Live.

 

Our team has been closely monitoring your feedback, and we are positively considering an increase to the current one-time refinement limit to better support your progression.

However, as this requires both technical implementation and rigorous balance testing, it will take some time to finalize.

 

We ask for your patience as this change will not be part of the March update. We plan to complete our final review based on player data and further feedback following the upcoming patch.

 

- Four new Artifact sets with specialized stats will be added to maximize the unique appeal of each Hunter class.
 
- New Artifact tier levels (115, 120) will be introduced.
 
- The "Increases MP Recovery Rate" sub-stat will no longer appear on newly dropped or crafted Artifacts.
*However, you will still be able to select this stat when crafting.
 
- The differential scaling of sub-stats during creation and enhancement has been removed, ensuring consistent value increments across all stages.
 
- While stat variations during enhancement won't be completely fixed, we are significantly narrowing the range to reduce uncertainty and minimize RNG stress.
 
- The existing Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions will be integrated into a new unified mode: “Unstable Dungeons."
 

 
- Rewards will shift from individual pieces to "Set-based" drops. To streamline progression, Gold drops will be removed, replaced by new Artifacts, Refinement Stones, and a newly added Mileage Reward system.
 
The maximum floor limit will be extended by 5 floors. Upon completing Battle Missions on these new floors, 15 Essence Stones will be awarded, consistent with previous rewards.
 
- To centralize the farming experience, Artifacts will no longer drop from Gates.
*To compensate for the loss of salvage rewards, Hunters Association Missions have been improved to provide items such as Artifact Enhancement Reset Tickets based on your level.
 
- To assist with the newly revamped Unstable Dungeons, we are reducing the number of boss elemental weaknesses from two to one. This change is designed to simplify team compositions and offer greater flexibility when forming your Hunter squads.
 

(The final elemental weaknesses for major bosses, including Lycan, Kargalgan, and Cerberus, will be announced as soon as they are confirmed.)

 

- To suit the updated gameplay environment, lower-level entries (Tier 1 Lv. 20–35, Common Grade Lv. 40/60/85) will be removed from the Codex to improve menu readability
 
- New "Auto-Lock" and "Auto-Salvage" systems for Artifacts—exclusive to Unstable Dungeons—will be added to streamline your gear management.

 

Our team sincerely hopes that the upcoming March update will alleviate the fatigue of farming and enhancing Artifacts. We look forward to seeing you fully immerse yourselves in the thrilling combat and the core essence of action that Solo Leveling: ARISE is built upon.

 

[New Shadow: Colossus]

 

The new Shadow, "Colossus," joins the Shadow Army.

 

As a powerful ally, Colossus increases the Water Damage of all allies through its Team Leader Effect. Its "Armament Effects" also provide a significant boost to both Critical Hit Rate and Critical Hit Damage.

Along with the arrival of Colossus, the maximum level of the Shadow Army will be expanded from 169 to 182.

 

We hope the addition of this reliable new ally, Colossus, brings even more diverse strategies and excitement to your battles.

 

[Simulation Gate Expansion]

 

To support the endless challenges of our Hunters, the maximum floor of the Simulation Gate will be significantly expanded from floor 40 to 50.

 

Deeper within the Simulation Gate, new Hunter Bosses await you. The powerful opponents standing guard on these new floors are none other than Goto Ryuji and Thomas Andre.

 

Our team is committed to providing continuous updates to this content through June, ensuring a fresh and thrilling combat experience for all Hunters.

 

[Sugimoto Reiji Joins & Hunter Balance Adjustments]

 

A new Hunter from the Sword Guild, Sugimoto Reiji, joins the fray as a Wind-element Stacker.

 

Sugimoto utilizes "HP Scaling," where his combat effectiveness increases in proportion to his maximum HP. Depending on your build, he offers a compelling playstyle that simultaneously maximizes both survivability and offensive power.

 

For optimal growth, we recommend focusing on HP, Critical Hit Rate, and Critical Hit Damage.

We look forward to seeing how Sugimoto Reiji shines in Gate Subjugation through your diverse Artifact builds and strategic setups.

 

Furthermore, our team remains committed to the promise we made: the buff updates for existing Hunters will continue without pause.

 

Just as the recent Alicia buff breathed new life into the Water-element meta, we have prepared another round of balance adjustments to shake up the battlefield.

 

The following Hunters are set to lead the new combat meta through this overhaul:

 

[Hunter Balance Adjustment Targets]

Fire: Kanae,Esil Radiru

Wind: Amamiya Mirei, Lennart Niermann

 

We will continue to conduct meticulous and consistent balance adjustments to ensure a diverse and strategic combat environment, preventing any single Hunter or element from dominating the meta.

 

Beyond the major updates mentioned above, we are developing a wide range of additional content and improvements to further enhance your gameplay experience.

 

- Main Story Chapters 30 and 31: Hard and Reverse Hard modes will be added.
- The new Guild Boss, "Manticore," is coming to challenge all Hunters.
- "Groctar" will now appear as a boss in the Battlefield of Time.
- An issue where the second hit of "Phantom Strike" would occasionally fail to land under certain conditions will be fixed.
*Please understand that this fix requires a client-side update, which prevents an immediate patch.
- A new setting will be added to the Options menu, allowing you to toggle the AutoPlay HUD ON/OFF during cinematic sequences.

 

Although not included in the upcoming update, we are currently preparing the following:

- Battlefield of Trials: Max floor expansion to Floor 90.
- Notifications: Improved UI for Sung Jinwoo’s Job Change and Weapon Skill Levelups.
- New Hunter: Elena Renault to join the Gate.

 

Hunters, there are now only two weeks left until the end of the SLC 2026 Qualifiers.

 

We remain committed to listening to your feedback and will continue to communicate closely with our community.

We hope you continue to enjoy the signature action of Solo Leveling: ARISE with the same passion you’ve shown us.

 

Additionally, excitement is building for our "2nd Anniversary Eve Offline Event" held in Jamsil, Korea, on April 25th.

For those unable to attend in person, we are preparing special events to bring the energy of the venue to you through various channels. We look forward to your continued interest and support.

 

Thank you.

 

[Dev Note Surprise Gift]

Redeem Code

Code Details

DEVN0TE_SPR1NG

- Weapon Custom Draw Ticket x20

- Gold x2,000,000

- Low-tier Mana Crystal x1,000

* Redeem codes can be used once per account, and rewards are distributed immediately upon use.

* Redeem codes are valid until March 11, 2026, 23:59 (UTC+0) and will expire after this time.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

Hunters Association

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

Here are the details scheduled to be added and changed through the update on 3/12 (Thu).

 

Please see below for more details about the update.

 

 

📢3/12 (Thu) Update Details

 

📌 New Story Chapter

 

▶New Story Chapters: Hard/Reverse Hard)

 - Chapters 31 and 32, which were added in the February 12 update, are now available in Hard and Reverse Hard.

※Following the addition of the story chapters, cumulative Battle Mission achievement rewards for Hard and Reverse Hard have been added.

 

📌 Workshop of Brilliant Light: Arena of Madness Hard Difficulty Addition and Adjustments

▶Workshop of Brilliant Light: Arena of Madness Hard Difficulty Added

- Hard difficulty for Workshop of Brilliant Light: Arena of Madness has been added.

  It is unlocked upon clearing Arena of Madness on Normal difficulty.

- [High-difficulty battle] based on the current update standards will be applied to Arena of Madness Hard difficulty.

※ The difficulty may be sequentially adjusted as the number of Hunters who clear Hard difficulty increases.

- Special rewards will be given to the first 6,000 Hunters who clear Arena of Madness on Hard difficulty.

For more details, please refer to the event notice below.

[WANTED] Workshop of Brilliant Light: Rockpasa(Hard) Clear Event Notice]

 

▶Other Workshop of Brilliant Light Difficulty Adjustments

- Five-element weaknesses will now be applied to all difficulties in Workshop of Brilliant Light: Demons' Castle Lower and Upper Floor.

- The elemental damage absorption patterns of some bosses on the 25th floor of Workshop of Brilliant Light: Demons' Castle Lower Floor have been removed.

 

📌 Artifact Level Expansion and Improvements

▶Artifact Level Expansion

 - Higher artifact levels have been expanded, adding Lv.115 (Heroic) and Lv.120 (Legendary) artifacts.

 - Non-reforged Lv.100 artifacts can be reforged and enhanced into Lv.120 artifacts.

※ Lv.120 Refinement Stones required for reforging Lv.100 artifacts can be obtained through Unstable Dungeons.

 

▶Artifact Enhancement Improvements

- Enhancing artifacts to +5, +10, +15, and +20 has been improved so that the added sub-option values increase within the same range.

※ Sub-option values of previously enhanced artifacts will remain unchanged.

※ When attempting to reforge existing artifacts, some sub-option values may appear lower than before reforging; however, if the original sub-option value is higher, that value will be maintained after reforging.

 

▶Removal of Certain Artifact Options

- After the update, 'Increases MP Recovery Rate' will no longer appear among the sub-options for newly acquired artifacts.

※ If you manually select 'Increases MP Recovery Rate' as a sub-option during artifact crafting, you can still obtain an artifact with that option.

 

📌 Consolidation and Difficulty Expansion for Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions

▶Consolidation of Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions - ‘Unstable Dungeon’ Added

- Existing Instance Dungeons and Encore Missions will be consolidated into Unstable Dungeon, and the existing Dungeon Mission Unity Key will be changed to the Unstable Dungeon Key.

- In Unstable Dungeon, a total of 4 types of bosses will appear each week, with 2 types each in Sung Jinwoo Mode and Hunter Mode.
  Starting from difficulty level 21, each boss will be changed to have one type of elemental weakness.

※Bosses that previously had two elemental weaknesses will be changed to have one, and the gimmick balance of some bosses will be further adjusted accordingly.

 

▶’Unstable Dungeon’ Reward Setting System Added

- On the reward setting screen before entering Unstable Dungeon, you can select 2 sets each of desired armor and accessories. Upon clearing, you will only obtain the 2 types of artifact sets you selected.

- In the lock/salvage settings on the reward setting screen, you can set automatic locking and dismantling based on the selected options and the number of included options when obtaining artifacts.

- By pressing the Target Hunter setting on the Unstable Dungeon reward setting screen, you can check and set recommended options and artifact sets.

 

▶’Unstable Dungeon’ Difficulty Expansion

- The difficulty levels, previously consisting of up to step 30 (Proof of Strong step 31), will be expanded, allowing you to challenge up to step 35 (Proof of Strong step 36).

- Starting from Unstable Dungeon step 31, you can obtain Lv.115-120 artifacts, Lv.120 artifact recipes, and Lv.120 Reforge Stones.

※ When crafting using the Lv.120 artifact recipe, only new artifact sets can be crafted.

 

▶Unstable Dungeon Reward Adjustments

- Conquest Mission reward stages have been expanded, allowing you to obtain Lv.120 artifact recipes and Lv.120 artifact selection boxes from Battle Class 42.

- Lv.20-35 artifacts will be changed so they can no longer be obtained in-game.

- Lv.95 Reforge Stones will no longer be dropped.

※ Lv.95 Reforge Stones in possession will be converted into Gold and distributed during the April update.

- Gold rewards will be excluded from Unstable Dungeon clear rewards.

※You can check the changed acquisition probabilities for each reward resulting from the adjustment by pressing View Rate on the in-game stage screen.

 

📌 New Artifacts Added

▶New Artifacts

- New artifacts that can be obtained through crafting or as rewards from Unstable Dungeon difficulty step 11 or higher have been added.

※In addition to Unstable Dungeon rewards, you can also obtain new Lv.78, Lv.100, and Lv.120 artifacts through artifact crafting.

📌 New Guild Boss ‘Manticore’ Added

- New Guild Boss Manticore has been added

- Manticore has Water as its fixed recommended element.

※ Manticore will be added to the Guild Boss rotation along with Giant Statue and Queen Ant, allowing you to challenge it regularly.

 

 

📌 New SSR Hunter and Exclusive Weapon Added

 - SSR Wind Hunter [Sugimoto Reiji] and his exclusive weapon [Etched to the Bone] have been added.

 - The new Hunter can be obtained through Rate-Up Draw and can be experienced in advance through the Hunter Preview.

 - The exclusive weapon can be obtained through crafting or events.

▶Custom Draw/Special Scout Lineup Added

※New Rate-up Hunters may be added to the Custom Draw list in the future.

-  Episode labels for each stage have been added to make it easier to check chapter progress within the story.

- The symbol icons for Elemental Infusion skills have been improved to display in colors matching each element.

- A feature to hide the HUD during story cutscenes while on Auto-play has been added.

  This feature can be toggled on or off in the Auto-play options.

- The maximum number of artifacts for bulk reforging has been increased from 100 to 500.

- A filter to check time-limited items has been added to the inventory.

- In Workshop of Brilliant Light - Brutrock stage, an effect has been added to make button inputs easier to confirm during Power Struggle QTEs.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the elemental infusion was occasionally not applied upon hitting with Sung Jinwoo’s Phantom Strike - Silent Strike skill.

- Fixed an issue where Christopher Reed’s Advancement 5 effect did not trigger correctly on the first attempt under certain circumstances.

- Fixed an issue where pressing the back button during Story Auto-Play pause or cutscenes would close the sub-menus entirely.

- Fixed an issue where Hunter Tags would not trigger automatically during Auto-Battle in the New Hunter Protocol.

- Fixed an issue where the Rune Amplification status was displayed on the team formation screen in the New Hunter Protocol.

- Fixed an issue where the motion animation did not play when entering the Sung Jinwoo settings page.

- Fixed an issue where the effect of a previously equipped weapon remained after wearing the Monarch of the Heaven-Annihilating Dragons skin and entering the formation screen.

- Fixed an issue where the craft button in the Codex remained highlighted even after reaching the maximum crafting limit in the Weapon Crafting Event.

- Fixed an issue where the overwrite function was unavailable when entering the Preset screen for the first time after team formation.

- Fixed an issue where the Red Dot notification was displayed on already cleared Hunter Previews under certain circumstances.

- Fixed an issue where the stage termination was occasionally delayed after reaching the stage time limit.

- Fixed an issue where some product names were not displayed correctly in the Epic Store.

- Fixed an issue where Sung Il-Hwan would face an unnatural direction in certain areas.

- Fixed an issue where players could enter other areas while battling the boss in Chapter 31, A Pillar of Strength.

 

We will continue to do our best to provide you with the best service possible.

Thank you.

As the Finals will be held as an on-site offline event, we will be conducting a survey to confirm your availability and participation.

 

Access to the survey will be provided through the Official Forum and in-game notices. Please make sure to check the path and complete the survey within the designated period.

※ Dedicated practice spaces can be provided upon the participant’s request.

 

📌 Tournament Format & Official Rules

 - You can find the detailed tournament format and official rules at the link below.

👉 [Go to Solo Leveling:ARISE Championship 2026 Official Rules]

※ Finalists must familiarize themselves with all tournament rules. Please note that we cannot provide separate assistance or exemptions for any issues arising from a failure to comply with or understand these regulations.

 

📌 Survey Information

Target Participants

Top-ranked Hunters from each league (International/Asia) based on the final Qualifier results as of March 12(Thu) 00:00 (UTC+0).

Survey Period

March 13(Fri) 00:00 – March 15(Sun) 00:00 (UTC+0)

How to Participate

 - Access the survey via the link in the Official Forum notice or check your in-game mailbox.

👉 [Go to Survey]

 

✅Survey Notices✅

 

- Expressing your intent to participate through the survey does not finalize your participation in the Finals. Individual contact will be made to confirmed on-site participants in order of their final ranking.

- Please note that the final participants for the Finals will be selected from those who have expressed intent, in accordance with the tournament regulations.

- For hunters selected to participate in the Finals, we will contact you individually via in-game mail by  the account information provided in the survey.

- Even if you receive an invitation to the Finals, you will be disqualified from the list of finalists if any violations of tournament rules, such as account sharing or abusing, are confirmed.

- The top rankings for each league can be checked at the link below.

👉 [Go to Qualifier Rankings]

 

📌 Notes

- This survey is conducted for top-ranked Hunters based on the Solo Leveling: ARISE Championship 2026 Qualifier results.

- If you do not participate in the survey within the period, you will be considered unable to participate in the on-site Finals.

- If you have provided incorrect information in the survey, you may re-access it to participate again.

- If you participate in the survey multiple times, the final entry will be considered based on your most recent submission.

- Prize money will be distributed after tax deductions in accordance with the laws and regulations of each region, and physical prizes will be delivered later after the payment of taxes and public charges by the recipient.

- In accordance with the tournament rules, we highly recommend changing to and using an English nickname.

 

 

Thank you.

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Notice on Artifact Farming

Hunters Association
|
Mar 17, 2026, 09:14
|
10,585

 

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

Our team is deeply aware of the diverse feedback and concerns regarding the recently added Artifacts.

In response, we would like to promptly share our deep considerations regarding the current situation and our upcoming direction for improvements.

 

[ New Artifact Upward Adjustments]

 

Our team previously promised to reduce farming fatigue and create an environment where you could fully focus on setting up your new Artifacts.

 

However, after closely analyzing actual player data, we have identified issues where some new Artifacts underperform compared to existing ones in certain situations.

 

To address this, we are preparing an upward balance patch. Our goal is to provide a seamless and satisfying combat experience by not only increasing effect values but also optimizing cooldowns and diversifying trigger conditions.

 

However, since a fundamental improvement of Artifact efficiency requires a comprehensive overhaul of their functional aspects, this upward patch is scheduled for the upcoming April update.

 

We kindly ask for your understanding regarding the time required to ensure perfect balance and high quality.

 

[Artifact Crafting Support Event]

 

We are fully aware of the frustration our Hunters feel regarding the excessive difficulty of obtaining effective stats during the new Artifact farming process.

 

Originally, we planned to gradually ease the farming difficulty through future operational events. However, we have concluded that a gradual approach is insufficient to satisfy the current needs of our Hunters.

 

Therefore, to quickly lower the farming hurdles and provide the immediate joy of growth, we have completely revised our original plans and will soon introduce an Artifact Farming Support Event.

 

We will finalize the specific details and schedule for the new Artifact buffs and farming ease-of-access events quickly, and provide a detailed announcement as soon as possible.

 

As promised in our previous Developer Notes, we will continue to communicate and strive to ensure that our Hunters can immerse themselves in the joy of combat itself—returning to the 'Essence of Action'—without unnecessary stress.

 

Thank you.

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: 2nd Anniversary Eve

Hunters Association
|
Apr 2, 2026, 10:20
|
16,977

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Hunters Association TEAM.

 

It has been nearly two years since Solo Leveling: Arise began its journey with all of you.

 

We would like to express our deepest gratitude for the unwavering love and support you have shown us throughout this time. To honor your dedication, we are thrilled to kick off the 2nd Anniversary Eve celebration with our upcoming April update.

 

[Draw Support Overhaul]

In preparation for the 2nd Anniversary, our team has engaged in deep internal discussions to identify the most fundamental way to ensure Hunters can truly feel that obtaining Hunters and Sung Jinwoo's weapons has become more accessible through the Draw system.

 

As a result, we have reached a collective internal decision to completely revamp the Draw system, driven by our commitment to providing a superior gameplay environment as quickly as possible.

 

Starting from the upcoming April update, the required number of Draw Support counts for a guaranteed SSR rank will be lowered from 80 to 70.

 

As a result, the interval where the rate of an SSR appearance begins to increase for each draw will also be shifted forward.

 

By maintaining the basic structure while reducing the threshold for a guaranteed appearance, the pace of acquiring the SSR Hunters and weapons you desire will become much faster and more pleasant than before.

 

For more details, please check the announcement [Go to Link]

 

[New Hunter Check-in Overhaul]

Our team has carefully listened to various opinions that new Hunters starting the game or returning Hunters after a long break are experiencing difficulties in managing and growing their Hunters.

 

In particular, we deeply empathize with your feedback that it is difficult to find a clear direction on which Hunters to draw and develop first in the early stages of the game.

 

To help Hunters adapt more smoothly, we plan to completely overhaul the New Hunter Check-in system. We are providing this advance notice, and as the application date will not be immediately after the April update, we will provide a separate announcement regarding the specific timing.

 

The following items will be provided through the overhauled Check-in:

● 10 SSR Sung Jinwoo Weapons
● 12 SSR Hunters and 12 Exclusive Weapons
● 30 Weapon Custom Draw Tickets
● 30 Custom Draw Tickets
 

The primary goal of this Check-in overhaul is to provide a wide variety of Hunters directly so that you can experience and verify their gameplay feel for yourself.

 

As you personally experience the controls and skill chains of various Hunters, we hope you find the combat direction that best suits your own playstyle.

 

Furthermore, these overhauled rewards will be available not only to new and returning Hunters but also to all existing Hunters currently playing Solo Leveling:Arise.

 

[Elena Renault]

 

Have you ever met Elena Renault of the Foreign Hunters guild in the lobby?

 

Elena Renault is scheduled to join the roster as a new Water-element Supporter. Characterized by using Defense as her primary stat, her skill set focuses on providing buffs to Water-element teammates.

 

She will be arriving soon through the Rate-Up Draw, so please look forward to the new synergy Elena Renault will bring to your Water-element parties.

 

Additionally, Antoine Martinez, whose arrival was previously announced through the roadmap, will officially meet you in the upcoming May update. 

We kindly ask for your generous understanding regarding the fact that his arrival is slightly later than the previously announced schedule.

 

[Improvements for a Better Gameplay Experience]

 

Regarding improvements, our team is continuously refining the system to ensure that Hunters can always enjoy a smooth gameplay experience.

 

● An Exit function will be added during Boundary of Illusions and Dreams play.
- We have identified the inconvenience where Hunters were forced to continue fighting for the remaining duration or quit the game entirely, even when defeating the boss within the time limit was impossible. To resolve this, we will add a function to exit the dungeon at any time through the pause screen during combat to enhance play convenience.
● Battlefield of Time Temporary Closure and Challenge Mode Removal
- To reduce the fatigue of repetitive daily play, the Battlefield of Time Challenge Mode will be removed starting from the upcoming May update. Along with this, the operation of Battlefield of Time will take a temporary break as we revamp the progression cycle and reward system to present it in a better form.
● We aim to assist in a smoother story progression by moving the unlock timing for the Auto Story Progression feature to the Normal 3-1 stage.
● The maximum floors for Battlefield of Trials will be expanded to Floor 90.
● A convenience feature will be added to allow consecutive Auto Progression for the Architect's Test stages.
● Tawata Kanae, Sung Il-Hwan, and Sung Jinwoo will newly appear as bosses in the Simulation Gate.
● An event will be held to reset the Reforge count of already refined Artifacts.
● Artifacts that have undergone a Reforge reset can be refined once more.
 

We will continue to listen to the voices of our Hunters to create an even more enjoyable environment, so please stay tuned.

 

[Balance Adjustments]

 

Our team is constantly monitoring the performance of Hunters to ensure you can create diverse party combinations and experience the core fun of action. As a result, we have decided to proceed with balance adjustments and system optimizations for certain Hunters, Artifacts, and weapons through the upcoming April update.

 

First, to improve combat efficiency and usability, the overall balance of the following Hunters will be adjusted:

● Esil Radiru
● Meilin Fisher
● Pure Sword Princess Cha Hae-In
● Tawata Kanae
 

Additionally, regarding the Artifacts promised in the previous Developer Note, we will move beyond simple numerical buffs and proceed with a full-scale overhaul focused on improving the combat mechanics themselves for a smoother experience.

 

Furthermore, we plan to refine certain combat calculation mechanisms to allow Hunters to utilize element-based party combinations more strategically.

 

Currently, the 'Increase Elemental Damage Taken' effect possessed by some Hunters and weapons has been applied as part of the overall skill damage calculation formula. 

We will optimize the calculation method so that it creates clearer synergy within the elemental damage category, aligning with the original meaning of the in-game text.

 

This optimization is part of our groundwork to emphasize the unique characteristics of Hunters specialized in specific elements in the long term and to further enhance the fun of various elemental strategies. 

The targets for this calculation system optimization are as follows, and their performance will be improved through the optimization of combat rules:

 

● SSR Hunter (9 types) : Yoo Soohyun, Meilin Fisher, Harper, Gina, Shimizu Akari, Esil Radiru, Seorin, Sung Il-Hwan, Fern

● SSR Sung Jinwoo Exclusive Weapon (2 types) : Moonshadow, Stormbringer

● SSR Hunter Exclusive Weapon (2 types) : Go Gunhee's Exclusive Weapon, Hwang Dongsuk's Exclusive Weapon

 

Our team will continue to research and strive to ensure that Hunters can always enjoy a wide variety of actions.

 

[SLC 2026 and 2nd Anniversary Showcase]

SLC 2026, which will be held at the Jamsil DN Colosseum on April 25th, is being prepared with a variety of programs for our Hunters.

 

This event will feature a point-based league system, the first of its kind since SLC KOREA Season 1 in October 2024, and will also serve as a showcase where detailed information about the 2nd Anniversary update will be revealed for the first time.

 

Our team is currently focusing all our resources on preparing the presentation for the showcase and the upcoming updates, and we are eagerly looking forward to meeting you all in person.

 

Below is a small gift prepared by our team.

As we count down the days until then—less than a month away—we look forward to greeting you again at the venue on April 25th.

 

Thank you.

- Fixed an issue where Proof of the Strong achievements in Unstable Dungeon could not be completed.

- Fixed an issue where crafting an Artifact through ‘Craft’ after selecting a specific Hunter’s Exclusive Artifact resulted in the creation of that Hunter’s Exclusive Artifact.

- Fixed an issue where the Special Commission count was not applied upon defeating bosses in certain Unstable Dungeons.

- Fixed an issue where an app security error popup intermittently appeared, preventing access to the game.

- Fixed an issue where the Overload duration and the Overload UI were displayed differently when battling Rakphasa, Lord of the Rigid Body, in Workshop of Brilliant Light - Arena of Madness.

- Fixed an issue where the modeling of Sugimoto Reiji’s weapon and Hunter appearance differed in certain content.

- Fixed an issue where Hunters without skin parts were displayed in the Archive.

 

We will continue to do our best to provide you with the best service possible.

Thank you.

Developer Note: 2nd Anniversary D-15

Hunters Association
|
Apr 23, 2026, 02:00
|
11,099

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Hunters Association TEAM.

 

April brings with it the vibrant energy of a new season, and it has already been nearly two years since <Solo Leveling:ARISE> began its journey with our Hunters.
We would like to express our deepest gratitude to all of you for the unwavering affection and warm interest you have shown us.

In today's Developer Note, we would like to provide a preliminary guide regarding the key directions for the upcoming 2nd Anniversary Update, the 2nd SLC Global Tournament, the 2nd Anniversary Showcase, and the upcoming balance adjustments that many of you have been looking forward to.

 

---

 

[The 2nd Anniversary: Evolution of Everything and Structural Improvements]

Along with the 2nd SLC Global Tournament, our team is hard at work preparing for the offline showcase and live broadcast, where we will reveal the detailed contents of the 2nd Anniversary Update.

 

After the teaser video for "Norma Selner" was released in early April through YouTube and other community channels, many Hunters shared various theories and curious opinions. As briefly hinted in the video, the core theme of this 2nd Anniversary Update is『EVOLUTION of Everything』.

 

Throughout our two years of service, our team has consistently listened to your valuable voices. Among them, the feedback we empathized with most deeply was that "the growth process for new or returning Hunters to enjoy the latest content is too long and difficult." As the depth of our content has increased through continuous updates, we poignantly realize that the fatigue required to reach that content has also intensified.

 

We plan to significantly boost early to mid game growth speeds to ensure everyone can smoothly enter high level content. At the same time, we will recalibrate the system to greatly enhance the value and sense of achievement found in the process of acquiring and developing Hunters.
Of course, we have not forgotten new goals for our top tier Hunters who enjoy the game consistently. We are also preparing challenging content designed to push you to your limits at the peak of your growth, stimulating your competitive spirit. The results of our deep considerations to fully restore the joy of growth will be shared in detail during the upcoming 2nd Anniversary Showcase and Developer Live Stream, so please stay tuned.

 

[The 2nd SLC Global Tournament & Showcase Notice ]

On Saturday, April 25, the "SLC 2026 Global Tournament" to determine the best in the world will be held alongside the 2nd Anniversary EVOLUTION Showcase.

 

We expect to see the overwhelming strength of Korean Hunters once again, as proven in the previous tournament, challenged by the formidable skills of our global Hunters. As this is a clash between the worlds top Hunters, our team is doing our absolute best to prepare. Please show your support for the Hunters who will battle for the title of Global Champion.

 

Furthermore, the 2nd Anniversary Showcase held at this passionate festival will be where the core theme,『EVOLUTION of Everything),』 is revealed as a clear blueprint before your eyes. From the new main story arcs following the City Reclamation—the "Beginning" and "Bitter Cold" (the narrative of Go Gunhee’s passing)—to the Gate renewal, revamped content and guides, and the appearance of a new National Level Hunter. We will show you the results of our intense deliberations on how these bold, fundamental changes will take your gameplay experience to a whole new level of comfort.

 

In addition to the update roadmap covering our journey to the 2nd Anniversary, we plan to generously unveil an unprecedented 2nd Anniversary gift bundle prepared with deep gratitude for our Hunters who have loved <Solo Leveling:ARISE> for so long. Beyond a simple update announcement, we intend to share the future of <Solo Leveling:ARISE> as envisioned by our team, so please look forward to it. Even if you cannot attend in person, we will bring the heat of the festival to you through our live online broadcast, so please tune in.

 

[Preliminary Notice on Hunter and Weapon Balance Adjustments ]

 

Our team has been continuously monitoring the performance of our Hunters to ensure that you can form diverse party compositions and experience the true excitement of action gameplay.

 

In this process, we felt that the combat efficiency and usability of existing Light elemental Hunters were somewhat lacking. Therefore, to breathe new life into the Light element and lead a shift in the meta, we have decided to buff the overall balance of five Light elemental Hunters in this update.

 

 ■ Target Hunters: Cha Hae-In, Thomas Andre, Shimizu Akari, Laura Walker, Go Gunhee

 

Additionally, through the April update, we optimized certain combat calculation mechanisms to allow attribute based party compositions to create clearer synergies.

 

However, since this improvement, we discovered that due to changes in the calculation method, the damage increase effect was either more marginal than expected or, in some cases, efficiency actually decreased. To rectify these issues and once again provide our Hunters with overwhelming fun and undeniable power, we intend to further refine the combat calculation mechanism for the "Increase Elemental Damage Taken" option found on certain Hunters and weapons. The targets for this recalibration of the calculation structure are as follows:

 

■ Combat Calculation Recalibration Targets

 - SSR Hunters (9 types) : Yoo Soohyun, Esil Radiru, Fern, Gina, Shimizu Akari, Meilin Fisher, Harper, Sung Il-Hwan, Seorin

 - SSR Sung Jinwoo Exclusive Weapons (2 types): Stormbringer, Moonshadow

 - SSR Hunter Exclusive Weapons (2 types): Go Gunhee’s Exclusive Weapon, Hwang Dongsoo’s Exclusive Weapon

※ We are normalizing the issue where damage was unintentionally lower than expected in certain situations following the April update.

 

■ Targets for Unification of Similar Calculation Structures

 - SSR Hunters (10 types): YUQI, Marie Laine, Elena Renault, Shuhua, Sung Jin-ah, SOYEON, Laura Walker, Sian Halat, Son Ki-hoon, MINNIE

 - SSR Sung Jinwoo Exclusive Weapons (2 types) : Allon's Orb, Thetis' Grimoire

 - SR Sung Jinwoo Exclusive Weapon (1 type): Frostbite Falchion

※ Targets with differently implemented mechanisms will be unified under the same standard, and a practical performance increase is expected.

 

We will do our absolute best to optimize the balance so that each Hunters unique party combination can truly shine and you can experience the full joy of diverse action.

 

---

 

We will do our absolute best to prepare so that the adventures we create together in the future shine even brighter than the two year story we have written with our Hunters so far. We look forward to seeing you at the upcoming Showcase and Developer Live Stream.

Below is a small gift prepared by our team.

Thank you.

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: 2nd Anniversary Developer Live PV

Hunters Association
|
Apr 29, 2026, 05:30
|
10,027

  

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

We would like to express our deepest gratitude for the incredible interest and support you showed during the SLC 2026 and the 2nd Anniversary Showcase, held at the Jamsil DN Colosseum on 4/25.

 

Thanks to the passion of those who attended in person and everyone who joined us via the online broadcast, our team was able to experience a truly meaningful and rewarding time.

 

In the last showcase, we shared several exciting updates currently in preparation for our 2nd Anniversary. Moving forward, we are committed to maintaining continuous communication with our Hunters until the actual update goes live, ensuring we welcome this upcoming milestone together.

 

 

[SLC 2026]

 

This offline event featured both the SLC 2026 and the 2nd Anniversary Update Showcase.

 

As this was our first tournament in a year, our team was deeply committed to recreating the same thrill and emotion that we all shared last year.

 

We would like to extend our deepest respect and gratitude to the players who gave their all to show us such incredible matches, and to all the Hunters who sent their passionate cheers with one heart.

 

[2nd Anniversary Update Introduction  & Direction ]

 

Due to the limited time at the live event, some explanations regarding the 2nd Anniversary update were not as detailed as we had hoped.

 

Through this note, we would like to clarify the points that many Hunters have been curious about.

 

First, regarding the role of Norma Selner.

Following the showcase, we noticed concerns from the community about the potential addition of a new rarity grade.

 

We would like to state clearly: This is not the addition of a new grade.

 

The upcoming Value Adjustment System is being designed to naturally add value to your growth without requiring extra costs, additional currency, or special effort.

 

Beyond simple level-ups, this system will enhance the very value of Hunter growth itself.

You will be able to experience a much stronger sense of progression, along with a significant increase in Total Power.

 

 

Next, we would like to introduce Myro, Successor of White Flames.

 

The upcoming combat featuring Myro is designed as a tag-team battle with Sung Jinwoo.

 

This content was built on the imaginative premise: "What if there were other 'Successors' who inherited the powers of Great Ones, just as the protagonist Sung Jinwoo inherited the power of the Shadow Monarch?"

 

The story of the Successor Myro has undergone meticulous supervision by the original author to ensure lore consistency within the world of Solo Leveling.

 

Our development team is extremely cautious and approaches the project with great care to ensure we do not overstep the unique domain of Sung Jinwoo, who remains the heart of Solo Leveling.

 

As such, we have established clear guidelines to preserve the essence of Sung Jinwoo-centric combat by strictly limiting Myro’s active time on the battlefield compared to Sung Jinwoo.

 

Furthermore, when Myro enters the fray, the combat is designed to unfold after deploying a [Unique Realm: White Flame Succession], adding cinematic synergy to the experience.

 

In Sung Jinwoo Mode, Myro will engage in combat by tagging in with Sung Jinwoo. In the existing Hunter Mode, Myro will act as a support, briefly aiding in battle with a powerful Ultimate Attack—similar to the power of a Remnant.

 

We invite you to experience Myro’s upcoming story and a brand-new style of action that seamlessly transitions between Ground and Aerial modes in the future update.

 

Lastly, we would like to share our direction for reducing the burden of repetitive play. Whenever we add new action dungeons, our team remains vigilant about the possibility that these may become just another daily chore, inadvertently increasing the fatigue of our Hunters.

 

At the same time, we have been cautious about abruptly reducing existing daily content where essential growth rewards are placed, as this could destabilize the very foundation of character progression.

 

Therefore, our primary goal for this mitigation is to reduce the pressure of having to clear the same dungeons repeatedly every day. As the burden of routine repetitive play decreases, we plan to progressively increase challenging content that allows you to fully enjoy the core action the game has to offer.

 

[Expansion of Challenging Content]

 

As part of this direction, the May update will feature the event boss, Unyielding White Flame Baran.

 

Hunters who have enjoyed the game for a long time will likely remember the intense battles with Baran in the Workshop of Brilliant Light, and the thrill of action where every single move mattered.

 

The newly introduced Unyielding White Flame Baran is designed to allow you to experience the fun of challenging him once again using the latest Hunters and Sung Jinwoo Weapons you have grown. We are also preparing honorable rewards befitting such a challenge.

 

Starting with this, the new Workshop of Brilliant Light: Legia and a new Power of Destruction boss (Cthulli) are scheduled for June. In August, a new challenging content called Deep Isolation Zone (Working Title) is planned for release.

 

Our team plans to continuously deploy new challenging content and will provide detailed information through future Developer’s Notes or Developer Lives.

 

We will continue to shape our updates so that Hunters can achieve growth through accessible dungeons and experience the thrill of heavy-hitting action whenever they desire.

 

Detailed information regarding the May update, along with actual gameplay footage, will be shared during next week's Live Stream, where we will demonstrate and explain the build play.

 

We look forward to seeing you at the Developer Live on May 6th.

Thank you.

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

Developer Notes

5/6 (Wed) Developer Live Summary

Hunters Association

4,464

 

 

📢 5/6 (Wed) Developer Live Video Summary

※ Please note that the following is a brief summary of the Developer Live broadcast held on May 6, citing the Inven article '[Inven] Successor Joins the Fray, "DPS" Jinwoo Returns in June! Solo Leveling 2nd Anniversary Developer Live.'  [View Original Article]

※ This summary focuses on the Q&A sessions and excludes details regarding the May 7 (Thu) update. Detailed update information can be found in the official Update Notice.

 

※ You can watch the video with subtitles in your preferred language by enabling the YouTube CC function > Settings > Subtitles > Auto-translate > Select Language.

📌 Q&A

Q. What happened to “Moonlit Gale” that was revealed in the roadmap ?

- We are currently working on internal polishing, including skill effects and the feel of impact. To ensure the highest quality, it needs a bit more refinement. We aim to provide visuals that will satisfy all Hunters in the June update.

 

Q. When will the new boss for Power of Destruction be released?

- A new boss named "Cthulli" will be added in June. Since the name "Power of Destruction" is closely tied to the "Monarch of Destruction," it was difficult to introduce a diverse range of bosses. Therefore, the name will be changed to "Power of Calamity" to allow for more variety.

 

The reward system will also be changed. A "Power of Calamity Exchange" will be provided, where you can use coins awarded based on your score to exchange for various items, including weapon skins. At the end of each season, a special honorary reward named after the top-ranked player will also be distributed.

 

Regarding illegal programs such as hacks, verification will be conducted beforehand during the process of distributing the 1st place rewards. The issue of hacking is like a battle between a spear and a shield, where breaching and blocking repeat, but we will ensure that a thorough check is performed at the very least when distributing ranking rewards.

 

The existing boss, Ennio, will not disappear completely. As Power of Calamity changes to a seasonal system, Cthulli and Ennio will take turns appearing. We felt that facing only one boss continuously might not be an enjoyable experience, so we hope this seasonal system will help improve that.

 

Q. Is there a way to re-watch story cinematics?

- We are aware of the feedback requesting a story replay feature. We are preparing to introduce this in June.

 

Q. Improvements to Auto Play are needed.

- We understand the feedback that Auto Play performance falls short compared to manual control. Issues such as skill usage priority have persisted. We are working on reinforcing the feature to automatically adjust skill order based on team and skill compositions, but unfortunately, we won't be able to showcase it in this update. We expect to show you an improved Auto Play system in June.

 

Q. When will Gem slot expansion be applied?

- We originally planned to expand Gem slots gradually. However, as Gems continue to stack up for many Hunters, we plan to update this in June. Additionally, regarding Gem equipping/unequipping improvements, it is difficult to implement in June, so we aim to update that by July.

 

Q. When will the roadmap for the second half of the year be released?

- We plan to reveal it through a Developer Note after the May update. We are preparing it separately because we believe providing a more definitive timeline for the long period of the second half of the year will be more helpful for Hunters. Since the 2nd Anniversary update is currently the main event, we focused on preparing for that first, and will provide the roadmap for the second half of the year shortly after.

 

Q. Please retroactively apply rewards for content that is being removed.

- There are contents being integrated through this update. For missions like the Guide Missions and "Train to Become a Formidable Combatant" that are currently in progress, any rewards that could not be fully obtained will be considered cleared for the remaining progress and will be sent to your mailbox.

 

Although it was a very challenging task due to the differing progress of each Hunter, we believed that retroactive application was the right way to go.

 

Q. When will the PVP event be held again?

- We previously showcased it as an event match. We have since worked on improvements based on the feedback from the surveys. As some expressed discomfort with manual controls, a version with automation features will be introduced in this update.

 

Q. The reorganizations following the update are difficult to understand.

- Artifacts underwent a major reorganization in the last update. We made improvements because the sheer variety of sets made it difficult to decide which character should use what, but as it was a transition period, some old sets continued to drop alongside the new ones.

 

From now on, Artifact farming will be changed so that only new Artifacts are dropped. This will eliminate confusion, and we plan to adjust the performance of new equipment through buffs to ensure they become the primary choice, addressing feedback that new gear felt weaker than existing ones.

 

As for Gates, the changes are aimed at enhancing convenience by removing the repetitive task of re-scanning to find specific ranks or Red Gates.

 

Q. Please provide more details about the previously revealed 27 SSR Hunters, 22 SSR Weapons, and 500 Selection Draws.

- This is one of the main reasons we are holding this live broadcast. From the perspective of new and returning Hunters, it is currently very difficult to build a full roster for each element. Our goal is to allow everyone to complete one deck per element so they can quickly settle in, challenge Guild Raids, and enjoy simulations. The 500 Selection Draws are designed to help build this roster, allowing you to select two specific targets with a structure that guarantees no "off-banner" pulls.

 

We have also noted feedback from existing Hunters who already have most characters and are concerned about what to do with duplicates. As mentioned in the Developer Note, we provide a feature to exchange fully transcended Hunters for other Hunters in the Exchange Shop. Following this event, the limit will be increased from two to three exchanges per month.

 

We understand that some of you may still have nothing left to exchange. For those who have dedicated so much time to the game, we will provide one "Premium Hunter Selection Ticket" each at Sung Jinwoo levels 120 and 140. These tickets will include the latest "Stacker" Hunters, excluding Antoine, who is being added in this update.

 

Q. Improvements for mobile optimization are needed.

- Recent issues have gone beyond frame drops, with the game completely crashing for some. We plan to implement a primary fix for the crashing issue during the 2nd Anniversary update and will continue to work on further improvements.

 

Q. Will new Artifacts be released alongside the new Elemental Buster class?

- Since we improved Artifacts to be used according to class, new Artifacts will indeed be released when the Elemental Buster class launches. However, as it may be difficult to complete a new Artifact set immediately, we plan to hold a crafting event at the time of release. This will help you gear up Liu Zhigang more easily.

 

We plan to set the number of crafting attempts much more generously compared to previous events, so we will ensure you don't have to worry too much about crafting Liu Zhigang’s Artifacts.

 

Additionally, we have received feedback regarding Artifact inventory expansion. There are technical difficulties in implementing this. We are also considering an event where you can salvage lower-tier or older set equipment to obtain new gear. Since we have reorganized the Artifact system, we are looking for a way to let you quickly consume old Artifacts without making those who have already salvaged theirs feel like they lost out.

 

We will put more thought into this and aim to provide a solution by the next broadcast.

 

Q. Are there any plans to hold Skin Events again?

We plan to continue holding Skin Events consistently. We will return with fresh and exciting events for you to enjoy.

 

Q. How do you plan to address the issue where damage output differs based on frame rate?

Development is currently underway to change skill structures into a form that ensures a consistent expected value regardless of frame rate differences.

 

Q. More Artifact Presets are needed.

We have noted this and will look into adding more presets for your convenience.

 

📌 Closing Remarks

Da-haeng Lee, Head of Business Division  : Today, we’ve shared various details ranging from the 2nd Anniversary to what's coming in the June update. It’s difficult to address everything within a limited time. Nevertheless, we aim to disclose as much information as possible through broadcasts and Developer Notes because we want our Hunters to empathize, prepare, and communicate their opinions with us. While some may be satisfied and others may not, please continue to leave your feedback in the community. We will keep communicating and improving our service to welcome the 3rd anniversary together. We ask for your continued anticipation, love, and feedback.

 

Seong-keon Jin, Executive Producer  : The development team has worked incredibly hard on the new story and characters for this 2nd Anniversary. We hope you enjoy playing through the story and challenging the new content. Additionally, we will prepare balance adjustments to return the "Sung Jinwoo" that truly lives up to the original work.

 

Dong-hyun Shin, Balance Lead  : This is my first time greeting you through a live broadcast. You’ve given us many opinions on areas that need improvement, and I will make sure to collect that feedback to achieve the best possible balance. We will strive to provide you with the thrill and joy of manual control and great gameplay.

 

 

 

Thank you.

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

Here are the details scheduled to be added and changed through the update on 5/7 (Thu).

 

Please see below for more details about the update.

 

 

 

📢5/7 (Thu) Update Details

 

 

▶Main Story Renewal

- To allow for deeper immersion in the story, some repetitive battle stages in Chapter 3 - Chapter 20 will be removed.

- The [Story Bonus] Trophies, which were separated during the February update, will be changed back to [Story] Trophies for each difficulty level.

※ Trophies and stage clear rewards from the removed stages will be added to the Chapter Clear rewards of the corresponding story.

※ Hunters who were progressing through the excluded story stages will be provided with any unpaid rewards separately after verification.

- Some Battle Mission rewards will be changed from existing Artifact sets to new Artifact sets.

- Conversation methods in some stages will be improved, and certain bosses will be changed. 

 

▶Special Stages Added

- Special Stages will be added to specific chapters in the Normal story difficulty.

- A Combat Power Cap will be applied to Special Stages so that you can focus on the boss's original patterns and the combat experience.

- Special Stages do not consume separate entrance currency and can be challenged multiple times.

- Special rewards will be provided upon the first clear of each Special Stage.

 

▶New Normal/Reverse Normal Chapters Added

 - New story chapters covering Sung Jinwoo’s experiences in the United States after meeting the King of Giants, the Monarch of Beginning 'Legia', and the events surrounding Go Gunhee’s death will be added to the Normal and Reverse Normal difficulties.

- Sung Jinwoo’s level achievement rewards and the maximum stage for Activity Funds will be expanded.

- The amount of EXP and Gold rewards for all stages of Activity Funds will be significantly increased compared to before.

- As the EXP rewards from Activity Funds have been significantly increased, Player EXP—which was previously included in the Association Mission weekly point rewards for specific level ranges—will be excluded.
