※ Along with the max level expansion, new intervals for Sung Jinwoo’s level achievement rewards will be added.

 

 

📌 Gate, Unstable Dungeon, Battlefield of Chaos Renewal & Entrance Key Integration  [Go to Prior Notice]

▶ Entrance Key Integration

- Gate, Unstable Dungeon, and Battlefield of Chaos keys will be integrated into "Dungeon Entry Keys."

- Keys currently held in your Inventory or Mailbox will be converted and sent to your Mailbox according to the following rules:

※ Gate Key: Converted to 1 Dungeon Entry Key each

※ Unstable Dungeon Key: Converted to 2 Dungeon Entry Keys each

※ Battlefield of Chaos Key: Converted to 2 Dungeon Entry Keys each

※ Hunter Archive Key: Converted to 1 Dungeon Entry Key each

※ Exchange Ticket items (e.g., Gate Key Exchange Ticket) will be converted and provided in the corresponding amount upon use.

- Dungeon Entry Keys will be recharged to 100 every day upon reset, and you can hold a maximum of 200.

※ Free recharge keys will only be charged up to the maximum capacity and will not recharge if the maximum limit has already been reached.

- You can purchase Dungeon Entry Keys with Essence Stones by clicking the [+] button next to the Dungeon Entry Key.

- Following the integration of entrance keys, Gate, Unstable Dungeon, and Battlefield of Chaos keys sold in certain existing Exchange Shops will be removed or changed to Dungeon Entry Keys.

 

▶ Sweep Point Overhaul

- The [Additional Sweep Points] item has been removed from Sung Jinwoo’s job change rewards; instead, 100 Sweep Points will be provided daily as a fixed amount.

- Sweep Points reset every day, and 1 Sweep Point is consumed per Dungeon Entry Key used when sweeping content.

 

▶ Gate Renewal

- Gate difficulty tiers have been consolidated, and difficulty will now automatically adjust based on Sung Jinwoo’s level.

- Gate ranks and types have been unified, and the Rescan feature has been removed.

- Using renewed Gates consumes a minimum of 1 Dungeon Entry Key. .

- Gates have been reorganized into 3 types based on reward categories (all Hunter Mode), allowing you to choose your preferred reward before entering.

※ You can check the adjusted reward rates by clicking 'View Reward Rates' on the Gate screen in-game.

- Renewed Gates support both Sweeps and Multi-play (up to x25), with 1 Sweep Point consumed per Sweep. 

- Experience points have been removed from Gate Mission rewards (earned every 2 clears), but Gold rewards have been significantly increased instead.

 

- Following the Gate Renewal, Mining Gate types and ranks will be removed.

※ All rewards for currently held Mining Gates (Completed / In Progress / Not Started) will be sent to your Mailbox in bulk upon the update.

- When clearing a Gate with Multi-play applied, the same multiplier will be applied to the Mining Gate.

※ Mining time varies depending on the number of keys used for the Gate.

- Mining Gate rewards have been overhauled; you are now guaranteed to obtain Essence Stones upon completing mining. While the amount of Essence Stones may be slightly adjusted, Gold and Low-tier Mana Crystal rewards will be slightly increased.

- Achievements related to clearing Red Gates, Dungeon Breaks, and Special Gates will be removed.

 

▶ Battlefield of Chaos

- Following the integration of entrance keys, Gold, EXP, and Reputation rewards will be added to the Battlefield of Chaos clear rewards.

- Using the Battlefield of Chaos consumes a minimum of 5 Dungeon Entry Keys.

- A Sweep feature has been added for stages where all Battle Missions have been cleared; 5 Sweep Points are consumed per Sweep.

- The maximum Multi-play limit for the Battlefield of Chaos has been increased to x10.

 

▶ Unstable Dungeon 

- Following the integration of entrance keys, Gold, EXP, and Reputation rewards will be added to the Unstable Dungeon clear rewards.

- Using the Unstable Dungeon consumes a minimum of 5 Dungeon Entry Keys; Artifact reward quantities and Subjugation Mission conditions have also been adjusted.

※ You can check the adjusted reward rates by clicking 'View Reward Rates' on the Unstable Dungeon screen in-game.

- A Sweep feature has been added for stages where all Battle Missions have been cleared; 5 Sweep Points are consumed per Sweep.

- The maximum Multi-play limit for the Unstable Dungeon has been increased to x10.

 

- Only the 4 new types of Artifacts can be selected as rewards across all stages of the Unstable Dungeon.

※ Existing Artifact sets can be obtained through Crafting.

- The 'Proof of the Strong' feature and related item exchanges in the Unstable Dungeon will end; held Mark of the Strong / Mark of the Ultimate Strong will be converted to Gold and sent to you.

※ Floor 35 of the Unstable Dungeon will be changed to provide rewards at the same level as the previous Proof of the Strong stages.

※ Achievements related to Proof of the Strong will be hidden and may be provided again later after the completion conditions are updated.

 

▶ New Dungeon: Mind Rift Added

- A new content, "Mind Rift," where you can select and obtain your desired Cores, will be added.

※ Mind Rift is accessible after clearing Story Chapter 18 on Normal difficulty.

- In Mind Rift, "Hunter's Echoes"—manifestations of residual magical power within the Gates—appear as enemies. You can challenge them in either Sung Jinwoo Mode or Hunter Mode depending on the boss.

※ Bosses from Mind Rift will be added to the Special Commission list.

- Using Mind Rift consumes a minimum of 5 Dungeon Entry Keys, and you can set your desired Core rewards before entering.

- Upon clearing, you will receive the selected Core rewards along with Core growth materials, Gold, EXP, and Reputation.

※ You can check the reward rates by clicking 'View Reward Rates' on the Mind Rift screen in-game.

 

- Upon your first entry into Mind Rift, you can challenge higher stages within a certain range. If you obtain all Battle Mission Trophies for a higher stage, all Trophies for the lower stages will be automatically acquired in bulk.

- The existing Workshop of Brilliant Light Conquest Mission rewards have been moved to Mind Rift.

- A Sweep feature is available for stages where all Battle Missions have been cleared; 5 Sweep Points are consumed per Sweep.

- Multi-play is supported for Mind Rift, up to a maximum of x10.

 

📌 Workshop of Brilliant Light Reward Renewal & Sweep Feature Added

- Core rewards and Subjugation Mission rewards from the existing Workshop of Brilliant Light have been moved to Mind Rift.

Rewards have been renewed to include Amplification Agent, Hunter Exclusive Weapon Designs, Essence Stones, Weapon Fragment, and more.

※ You can check the renewed reward details and rates for each stage of the Workshop of Brilliant Light on the in-game screen.

- A Sweep feature has been added to the entry screen of the Workshop of Brilliant Light, allowing you to complete battles instantly.

※ Sweeping is only available for stages that have been cleared 20 or more times.

※ No Sweep Points are consumed when sweeping the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

※ When sweeping, you will receive "Mark of the Absolute Strong" at a level 5 stages lower than your highest cleared level in Proof of the Strong for each Sung Jinwoo/Hunter mode.

ex) If your highest clear in Proof of the Strong is Level 6, sweeping will grant Level 1 "Mark of the Absolute Strong" rewards.

 

📌 Power of Destruction Regularization

- Power of Destruction will transition to regular content, operating on a 4-week seasonal basis, and its name will be changed to "Power of Calamity."

- The existing Easy and Normal difficulties remain available, while the high-difficulty [Eternal Condemnation] has been newly overhauled.

 

▶Introduction of Seasonal System for Power of Calamity [Eternal Condemnation]

- Existing Server Rankings will be removed, and only World Rankings will remain.

- Power of Calamity will operate on a 4-week seasonal cycle.

- "Season Points" will be awarded as weekly ranking rewards. Similar to the "Battlefield of Time," final season rankings will be calculated based on the accumulated points earned during the season.

- Season Ranking rewards have been added, and reward animations have been improved. 

 

▶Conquest Proficiency System Added

- The [Conquest Proficiency] system, which will be the core of seasonal strategies for Power of Calamity, is introduced.

- Proficiency Points are earned based on the advancement stages of Sung Jinwoo’s weapons and the Hunters included in your team. Stat increase effects are applied cumulatively based on the accumulated point brackets.

※ The number of points varies depending on the advancement stages of the weapons and Hunters; details can be checked on the team setup screen.

- You can check the stat increase effects applied via Conquest Proficiency by clicking the [Conquest Loadout] button on the team setup screen.

 

▶Conquest Support System Added

- A "Conquest Support" system, providing new weekly buff effects in the Power of Calamity, will be added.

- Rare, Heroic, and Legendary grade Conquest Support buffs will be unlocked each week .

- You can apply a total of 3 effects by selecting one of the three options provided for each grade via the [Conquest Loadout] → [Change] button on the team setup screen

- Choosing buffs that synergize with your team composition will help you achieve higher scores.

※ Conquest Support buffs can be changed for re-challenges.

※ The same buff can be used across Team 1 and Team 2.

 

▶Reward Renewal & Power of Calamity Exchange Shop Added

- "Chest of Destruction" will be removed from the existing Power of Calamity rewards, and "Resilience Coin" will be provided instead.

  "Resilience Coin" can be used in the newly established exclusive Exchange Shop. You can exchange them for various items, including growth materials, titles, profile icons, and weapon skins.

※ Please check in-game for detailed reward information and exchange items.

 

📌 Monarch's Milestone System Added

- The existing [Challenges] and [Preparation to Become Stronger] will be integrated into the new "Monarch's Milestone" system.

- You can obtain various rewards for growth by clearing missions at each stage. Support is provided for core content growth, including SSR weapons and Hunters, as well as the Armory, Shadows, and Gems.

- You can access Monarch's Milestone via the Quick Menu or the button located on the right side of the Lobby.

※ Any rewards from Challenges or Preparation to Become Stronger missions not completed before the update will be sent in bulk to your Mailbox after the update.

 

📌 Successor System Added

- A "Successor" system will be added, allowing you to receive combat assistance from Successors who inherit the Monarch's power.

- The Successor system is located in the same position as the existing Power of Reminiscence. You can access it by selecting Quick Menu [Succession] → [Successor] sub-menu.

- On the team setup screen, you can choose to equip either Remnant Power or a Successor in the designated slot.

- Successors can be used in most content except for the Battlefield of Trials and International Clash. Their combat style changes depending on the play mode.

- Sung Jinwoo Mode (Includes Power of Calamity and Guild Boss): After using a special skill, the Successor replaces Sung Jinwoo on the battlefield, allowing you to engage in combat via manual control.

※ In cases such as HP depletion or re-entering the "Successor" button, the Successor will exit, and Sung Jinwoo will reappear using "Shadow Step."

- Hunter Mode: Successors provide powerful support skills, similar to the existing Remnant Power.

- With the addition of the Successor system, some existing content has been updated to allow the placement and use of Remnant Power.

※ The cooldown for using Remnant Power after entering a stage has also been adjusted.

 

▶Successor Growth: [Succession] System

- Access the Successor's exclusive growth system, [Succession], via the Successor screen.

- The Succession system is divided into 5 categories: [Exclusive Weapon], [Artifact], [Skill Growth I], [Skill Growth II], and [Upgrade].

- Activating each Succession category requires Successor Data. Once activated, they can be leveled up to Level 5 using the [Succession Crown].

※ Successor Data and [Succession Crown] can be obtained through Successor Recruitment events.

- New combat abilities are unlocked as each Succession item is activated or leveled up. You can choose which category to activate first.

- Successors do not equip separate Artifacts or Weapons; they gain those effects through the Succession system. Stats automatically sync with Sung Jinwoo's level and are influenced by Gem stats.

- Special illustrations of the Successor will be unlocked based on the Succession activation stage. \

 

 

📌 Successor of the White Flames: “Myro” Added

- The Successor of the White Flames [Myro] has been added.

- Profile icons, Secret Files, and Codex entries for Successor Myro have been added.

- The Successor Archive has been added, where you can check the Successor's original story.

- The Successor can only be obtained through the Limited Event Draw [Successor of the White Flames: Myro Special Draw Event].

- The original story for the Successor of the White Flames, "Myro," has been added.

📌Seasonal Content Rotation & Improvements  [Go]

- With the overhaul of the seasonal content rotation, "Hunters Association Honor Tokens" will be added to the rewards for each content.

- Earned "Hunters Association Honor Tokens" can be exchanged for various items in the exclusive Exchange Shop.

- he rotation schedules and improvements for each content are as follows:

 

▶ Battlefield of Time

- The Battlefield of Time will transition to a 4-week season system where 1 of 4 different bosses appears each week. After the 4-week season, there will be a 1-week calculation period.

- Achievement rewards have been restructured; some growth materials will be removed, while "Hunters Association Honor Tokens" and Low-tier Mana Crystals will be added. Essence Stone and Gold rewards will be increased.

- Essence Stone rewards based on Season Ranking will be increased.

- Overall Ranking rewards for each boss will now grant "Hunters Association Honor Tokens" instead of Rune Fragments.

- Gold and Essence Stone rewards for Group Rankings will be significantly increased, and Low-tier Mana Crystal rewards will be newly added.

- As "Medal of Time" rewards are replaced by "Association Medal of Honor," the existing Medal of Time Exchange Shop will close.

※ Detailed Battlefield of Time reward information can be found in-game.

- Battlefield of Time Challenge Mode will be removed.

 

▶ The Overseer's Forbidden Library

※ Detailed rewards for The Overseer's Forbidden Library can be checked via the [Reward Info] button once the season starts.

 

▶ Architect's Test

- Clear rewards for each difficulty will be changed to "Hunters Association Honor Tokens," with quantities varying by difficulty level.

- The Architect's Test will not be held during this update; a new season is scheduled to open with the June update.

※ Detailed rewards for the Architect's Test can be checked via the [Set Trial Level] button once the season starts.

 

▶ Edge of Illusion

- The key distribution for Edge of Illusion will change from 1 per day to a bulk distribution of 5 keys every Thursday during the weekly reset. The maximum storage limit for Edge of Illusion keys is 5.

※ Free recharge keys will only fill up to the maximum storage limit and will not recharge beyond that cap.

- Clear rewards for each difficulty will be overhauled. Previously, reward items differed by difficulty, but following the change, "Hunters Association Honor Tokens," "Essence Stones," and "Low-tier Mana Crystals" will be provided as common rewards, with quantities varying by difficulty.

- Edge of Illusion will not be held during this update; a new season is scheduled to open with the June update.

name.en: Developer Note: Improvements to Artifact Option Efficiency and Sung Jinwoo's Combat Contribution

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Improvements to Artifact Option Efficiency and Sung Jinwoo's Combat Contribution

Hunters Association
|
May 8, 2026, 11:39
|
8,697

 

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

In celebration of our 2nd Anniversary, we would like to express our deepest gratitude to all the Hunters who have shown so much love for Solo Leveling:ARISE.

It is thanks to your unwavering support that we were able to reach this meaningful 2nd Anniversary milestone.

 

In today's Developer Note, we would like to share our direction for improving Artifact Option Efficiency, which has been the subject of many opinions following the update.

We will also provide specific updates on the progress of improving Sung Jinwoo's Combat Contribution, which was mentioned during the recent live broadcast.

 

 

[Information on Artifact Option Efficiency Improvements]

 

The 2nd Anniversary Evolution update included overall stat adjustments to further highlight the unique characteristics of each Hunter. 

 

As the base stats for Sung Jinwoo and other Hunters evolved during this process, an efficiency gap emerged between the percentage (%) increase options and the flat value increase options, such as Additional Attack, on Artifacts.

As a result, we have identified an issue where the value of certain options—which Hunters worked hard to grow—has relatively decreased compared to before.

 

We sincerely apologize for not providing sufficient prior notice regarding the fluctuations in Artifact option values during the systematic stat adjustment process.

 

Accordingly, our team plans to make adjustments so that the efficiency difference of each option can be felt at a level similar to before the update. 

However, since the number of Artifacts in the game is vast and each possesses different values, meticulous verification and inspection are essential for a proper and safe fix.

 

We intend to apply these adjustments collectively through the upcoming June update once sufficient stability is ensured. We ask for your kind understanding.

 

[Improving Sung Jinwoo's Combat Contribution ]

 

As pre-announced during our last live broadcast, the work to improve Sung Jinwoo's combat contribution is progressing smoothly, with the goal of being included in the upcoming June update.

 

To ensure that Sung Jinwoo, who has traversed countless battlefields as the Shadow Monarch, can play a more dependable leading role across various contents, we plan to proceed with improvements in the following three directions.

 

■ Expanding Influence in the Power of Calamity

We will further expand Sung Jinwoo's influence on the battlefield in the Power of Calamity, where he fights alongside other Hunters. To emphasize his presence as the Shadow Monarch, adjustments will be made to increase the damage contribution he provides.

Through this update, the central axis of the party will be strengthened, and the synergy with other Hunters will be deepened to the next level.

 

■ 2nd. Improvements in Sung Jinwoo's Skills

We will increase the overall base coefficients of the skills used by Sung Jinwoo, allowing you to experience even more powerful force under the same conditions.

This improvement will ensure that Sung Jinwoo's weapons and Rune skill builds deliver a wider variety of actions across all types of content.

 

■ 3rd. Applying Party Buffs from the Entire Guild Boss Lineup

In the current Guild Boss content, the structure only allowed Sung Jinwoo to receive buffs from the Hunters assigned to the same party. Through this improvement, the system will be changed so that Sung Jinwoo can fully receive buffs from every party assigned in the Guild Boss battle.

 

Since the synergies from Hunters across both parties will now apply to Sung Jinwoo, you will be able to research more diverse Hunter combinations and enjoy the deep strategic fun of conquering the Guild Boss.

We will implement the initial combat improvements for Sung Jinwoo in the June update and will continue to make further enhancements based on the diverse feedback from our Hunters.

 

Specific figures and schedules for the two changes mentioned above will be provided in detail through subsequent update patch notes.

 

Thank you.

 

[Go to Developer Note Celebration Check-in Event]

 

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

name.en: Developer Notes: The Expanding Battlefield (Edited on 5/28 09:27 UTC+0)

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Notes: The Expanding Battlefield (Edited on 5/28 09:27 UTC+0)

Hunters Association
|
May 28, 2026, 08:30
|
11,174

  

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Hunters Association TEAM.

 

To all our Hunters who have shown unwavering love and support for Solo Leveling:ARISE throughout our 2nd Anniversary update, we would like to express our deepest gratitude.
It is solely thanks to your continued passion that we are able to celebrate this meaningful milestone together.
 

Our team’s top priority is to create an environment where Hunters can constantly challenge new content and enjoy the journey with greater ease. The results of our efforts have been poured into the upcoming June update.
From the arrival of a new class to content expansions and various quality-of-life improvements, here is a detailed look at what we have prepared for you.

 

[The First 7-Star Hunter ‘Liu Zhigang’ Arrives as a New ‘Buster’ Class ]

 

 

Liu Zhigang, the 7-Star Hunter who masterfully wields dual swords, joins Solo Leveling: ARISE as the new ‘Buster’ class.

 

Liu Zhigang’s story follows the journey of China's 7-Star Hunter—a leader driven by firm convictions and bold actions—as he picks up his blades once again, overcoming the crushing guilt of the sacrifices made during the Kamish Raid. As a National-Level Hunter representing China, he is now ready to step onto a new battlefield alongside you.

 

※ This screen is currently under development and is subject to change.

 

As revealed during the April Showcase, Liu Zhigang arrives as the inaugural member of the Buster class, centered around the Overload cycle. While previous classes focused on dealing concentrated damage during the Overload state and pulling back during elemental immunity phases, the Buster transcends these limitations.
 

Busters accumulate a portion of the damage dealt during a target's Overload state as Burst Damage. Once the accumulation period ends, players can activate Burst Skills to unleash this stored damage, effectively turning the Overload immunity phase into a powerful damage-dealing window.

 

In short, the Buster is designed to work in close synergy with the Stacker class, creating a perfect loop from elemental infusion to Overload. You will be able to experience the true potential of this class through a strategic combination with the Fire-element Stacker, Christopher Reed.

 

To ensure you can fully explore the depth of the new Buster class, we have prepared various supporting content. A new dedicated Artifact set, Surtur’s Flame, designed to maximize the Buster's combat potential, will be added. Furthermore, new collectibles exclusively for the Buster class will be introduced to the Simulation Gate, and a Fire-element Buster category will be added to the Hunter Joint Training. We hope you enjoy this new journey of growth with the Buster class.

 

[New Challenge Content]

Our team believes it is crucial to create an environment where Hunters can continuously grow and pursue clear goals. Accordingly, in this June update, we have expanded the difficulty of seasonal content and added new bosses, allowing everyone to experience the thrill of challenge and achievement at their own stage of growth.

First, the Architect's Test will expand up to Trial Level 7 along with the new season. Depending on the level, the Architect's Rules and specific strength/weakness attributes will be newly applied, offering a more strategic party composition experience.

 

Edge of Illusion and Dreams will also begin a new season featuring the seasonal boss, Flames of Calamity Kamish. The difficulty structure and rewards for each level have been completely revamped to provide a more challenging combat experience.

 

The Simulation Gate will expand its challenge range up to Stage 55. Along with the new collectibles for the Buster class, we have prepared this update to help you take another step toward a new peak. We look forward to your participation.

 

 

We have news regarding new bosses as well. A new dungeon, The Land of Beginning, will be added to the Workshop of Brilliant Light, where you can challenge the powerful new boss, The Monarch of the Beginning Legia. Defeating Legia will also unlock the new Remnant Power, allowing you to harness his strength.

 

 

In addition, a new season for Power of Calamity will begin. For this season, Cthulli, the Madness of the Deep Sea, who previously appeared in Chapter 31 of the main story's Giant arc, will feature as the new boss. Please look forward to the new patterns and mechanics that this boss will bring to the battlefield.

 

 

Lastly, in this June update, we will be hosting a defeat event featuring Vulcan of Eternal Greed, who returns more powerful than ever. We prepared this event so that all Hunters can relive the intense fun of the early days of Solo Leveling: ARISE—the thrill of refining builds and mastering strategies to take down Vulcan. Hunters who defeat Vulcan in either Sung Jinwoo Mode or Hunter Mode will be rewarded with the new weapon skin, ‘Vulcan’s Rage’, as a mark of their victory. We look forward to seeing you on the battlefield.

 

※ Detailed rules and rewards for each content can be found in-game. Additionally, further details regarding the two new bosses and the Vulcan defeat event will be shared during the upcoming Developer Live Stream, so please stay tuned.

 

[Balance Adjustments ]

Our team continuously monitors the combat environment to ensure that Hunters can create diverse party compositions and experience the core fun of action gameplay. In addition to the improvements regarding Artifact Option Efficiency and Sung Jinwoo's Contribution announced in the May 8th Dev Note, the June update will introduce extensive balance adjustments covering Sung Jinwoo’s stat structure, Skill Runes, Hunters, weapons, and Artifact set effects.

 

1) Sung Jinwoo Basic Stat Balancing

We have recognized that many Hunters feel as though investing stat points solely into Strength is the only viable option. Believing that narrow growth options diminish the fun of character progression, we have decided to significantly buff the efficiency of the Agility and Vitality stats.

 

Through this adjustment, various point distribution methods will be improved to a level where they can fully compete with Strength-focused builds. This change is designed to make your strategic choices in developing Sung Jinwoo more meaningful.

 

● Significant increase in Defense and HP per 1 Vitality point
● Significant increase in Critical Damage per 1 Agility point
 

2) Sung Jinwoo Skill Rune Balance Adjustments

We are overall buffing the balance of certain Skill Runes that have been overlooked or underutilized. Beyond simple numerical increases, we have selected and adjusted specific Skill Runes to bring actual changes to the damage cycle. We hope these buffs bring back the joy of researching and utilizing a wider variety of Skill Rune combinations.

 

■ Target Rune Skills for Buffs: Death's Dance [High-speed Rotation, Eruption, Wildfire], Vertical Arts [Gale], Phantom Strike [Quickstrike], Dagger Rush [Explosion], Vital Strike [On Point]

※ Detailed figures can be found in the separate Balance Adjustment Notice.

 

3) Other Balance Adjustments

A [Team Fight] mode buff will be newly added to the 8-set effects of the 4 new Artifacts. This added buff will apply not only to the team the equipped Hunter belongs to but to all allies, including Sung Jinwoo. Furthermore, the improvements to the Guild Boss, as previously announced in the last Dev Note, will be implemented with this update. Previously, only the team buffs from Team 1, where Sung Jinwoo belongs, were applied. 

 

With this improvement, team buffs generated by Hunters in Team 2 will also fully apply to Sung Jinwoo. These changes are all part of our effort to create an environment where Sung Jinwoo can perform even more powerfully within various Hunter combinations. Please look forward to Sung Jinwoo’s enhanced performance.

 

In addition, the balance of the following Hunters and Sung Jinwoo-exclusive weapons will be buffed to improve combat efficiency and usability.

 

■ Balance Adjustment Target Hunters:

● Christopher Reed, Meri Laine, Sian Halat, Sugimoto Reiji
● Fire Hunters: Yoo Soohyun, Tawata Kanae, Gina, Esil Radiru
 

■ Balance Adjustment Target Weapons: 

● The Huntsman

 

This balance adjustment is the first step toward expanding the growth potential and combat variety of Sung Jinwoo. We hope you can deeply enjoy the fun of strategic combat and more diverse party compositions. Our team will continue to listen to the voices of our Hunters and consistently refine the combat environment.

 

[Improvements for a Better Gameplay Experience ]

Our team is also preparing system improvements to ensure that Hunters can play in a more comfortable environment.

 

■ Auto Mode Improvements

● The combat behavior trees for each Hunter and their evolution stages have been improved to more accurately replicate their damage cycles during Auto Mode.
● Auto Mode action during the Overload state has been improved for the Stacker class.
● New conditions for detecting boss attack telegraph effects during Auto Combat have been applied, improving the Auto-Dodge function. This ensures that Auto-Dodge triggers more efficiently at the correct timing, reducing damage loss caused by unnecessary dodging.
● An option to disable Auto-Dodge during Auto Combat will be added under [Options] - [Controls].
 

■  Gem Node Expansion

A total of 20 new slots (4 slots for each color) will be added to the second page of Gem slots.

※ New slots are unlocked when Gems of Tier 4 or higher are equipped in all color slots of the previous stage.

 

■  The exchange ratios for certain items will be adjusted, and the item lineup in the Exchange Shop will be expanded.

● The cost for recharging Dungeon Entry Keys will be reduced.
● Artifact Enhancement Reset Tickets and Hair Part Selection Boxes will be added to the Association Special Certificate Exchange.
● The purchase quantity, monthly purchase limits, and Diamond costs for certain items in the Subscription Exchange will be adjusted.

※ Detailed figures and the full list of changes can be found in a separate notice.

 

■  SLC 2026 Special Titles .

● ‘National Level  : NightFall’ : Title awarded to the Championship winner.
● ‘Monarchs of SLC 2026’ : Title awarded to all finalists.
 

■ The existing Shadow Soldier supply and consumption system will be removed. Summoning Shadows will no longer consume any currency.

 

 

The main highlights of this June update will be showcased through a live stream featuring actual build gameplay, and further details will be provided through a separate notice. Additionally, we will be sharing our roadmap for the second half of the year during the live stream, so please look forward to it.

 

We will continue to strive to ensure that Hunters can always experience the joy of new challenges and growth in Solo Leveling: ARISE.

 

Thank you.

*Each redemption code can be used only once per account, and rewards will be issued immediately upon use.

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

Here are the details scheduled to be added and changed through the update on 6/4 (Thu).

 

Please see below for more details about the update.

 

 

📢6/4 (Thu) Update Details

 

📌 New Story Chapters (Hard/Reverse Hard)

▶New Story Chapters Added (Hard/Reverse Hard)

- Hard and Reverse Hard difficulties will be added for Chapters 32, 33, and 34, which were introduced in the May 7 update.

※ Along with the new story chapters, cumulative Battle Mission completion rewards for Hard and Reverse Hard difficulties will also be added.

 

▶ Story Codex Added

- A new "Story Codex" feature will be added, allowing you to rewatch webtoons and illustrations from previously cleared main stories all in one place.

※ Cinematic Replay feature is scheduled to be updated in the future.

- You can access this feature via [Quick Menu] → [Collection] → [Story Codex] sub-menu.

- Completed stories will be registered in the Story Codex, and you can claim collection rewards.

 

📌 Workshop of Brilliant Light: New Dungeon Added & Reward Adjustments

▶New Dungeon: "The First Land" Added

 - "Workshop of Brilliant Light - The First Land" (Easy/Normal difficulty), where you can challenge The Monarch of the Beginning Legia, will be added. "The First Land" will unlock upon clearing "Arena of Madness - Easy difficulty."

- With the addition of the new Workshop of Brilliant Light dungeon, "The Monarch of the Beginning" category will be added to the dungeon selection screen.

※ You must reach Battle Class 85 to challenge The First Land.

※ Normal difficulty will unlock upon clearing The First Land on Easy difficulty.

※ The boss appearing in The First Land will be added to the Special Commission list.

※ Please check in-game for more specific details regarding rewards.

 

▶Workshop of Brilliant Light Secret Chest Reward List Changed

 - The reward list for all Secret Chests in the Workshop of Brilliant Light has been changed.

※ The reward lists and rates for Secret Chests can be checked by tapping "Main Rewards" on the Workshop of Brilliant Light screen in-game.

 

📌 New Remnant Power Added

- A new Remnant Power that allows you to utilize the power of The Monarch of the Beginning Legia will be added. You can check the information and upgrade the new power via [Quick Menu] → [Succession] → [Remnant Power]

▶"Convert Shard" Feature Added

- You can also use “Shard of Yogumunt" and "Shard of Rockpasa" to convert them into Shard of Legia.

※ The Convert Shard feature will not be available for Monarchs whose Remnant Power has already reached the maximum level.

 

📌 2 New Sung Jinwoo Weapons Added

▶New Custom Draw / Weapon Custom Draw Weapons

- Sung Jinwoo's exclusive weapons, SSR Wind-attribute [Soma & Asura] and SSR Wind-attribute [Moonlit Gale], will be added.

📌 Balance Adjustments  [Go]

 - Sung Jinwoo's base stat efficiency has been buffed, and balance adjustments have been applied to some of Sung Jinwoo's Rune Skills, weapons, hunters, and Artifact set effects.

※ Detailed information can be found in a separate notice.

 

📌 Artifact Stats Buffed

- Among the main/sub options and enhancement increase values of Artifacts, the stats for Additional Attack, Additional Defense, and Additional HP have been slightly increased.

- As the Artifact stat values have changed, May's Artifact Tuning Event will be held simultaneously to preserve the performance of existing Artifacts.

- After the update, tapping the [Artifact Tuning] button on the "May's Artifact Tuning" event page in-game will increase the stat values of your owned Artifacts all at once. The Power of Sung Jinwoo and Hunters equipping those Artifacts will also increase accordingly.

※ The event page will not be displayed if you do not own any Artifacts eligible for the buff.

※ Please note that actions such as Artifact enhancement, salvaging, and participating in the Artifact Modification Event will be unavailable until you proceed with May's Artifact Tuning.

 

📌 Max Reputation Level Expanded

 - The maximum Reputation level has been expanded from 100 to 150, and rewards can be obtained upon leveling up.

※ For Hunters who reached Reputation Lv. 100 before the June 4 update, any excess Reputation EXP earned will be retroactively distributed to the in-game Mail during the July update after data verification.

 

📌 New Gem Slots Added

- New slots have been added to Page 2, where Gems can be equipped.

※ The new Gem slots will unlock when Gems of Tier 4 or higher are equipped in all color slots of the previous stage.

※ The new Gem slots allow for additional Gems to be equipped in a total of 20 slots, with 4 slots available per color.

 

📌 Successor Succession Reset System Improved

 - A feature to reset Successor Succession growth by consuming currency has been added.

 - Upon resetting Succession, all material items used for Succession growth will be returned.

 

📌 Draw & Exchange Lineup Added

▶New Custom Draw / Special Scout / Association Special Certification Exchange Lineups

- SSR Elena Renault has been added to the Custom Draw, Special Scout, and Association Special Certification Exchange lineups, and can now be selected from the Rate Up list.

※ New Rate Up Hunters may be added to the Custom Draw list in the future.

※ For Special Scout, the new lineup will be applied starting from the Special Scout that opens after 6/16 (Tue) 00:00 (UTC).

 

📌 Other Content Improvements & Changes

▶ Power of Calamity Season 2 New Boss Added & Improvements

- A new season of Power of Calamity will begin, and the boss will change to Cthulli, the Madness of the Deep Sea.

- Until the next season, the recommended attributes will be fixed to Fire and Wind, and Extermination Support will be newly applied.

- The lobby screen for Power of Calamity has been improved to display ranking information based on the points earned.

- The system has been improved to display the exact rank achieved even if it is below the top 100 in the seasonal rankings.

 

▶ The Architect's Test Difficulty Expanded

- A new season of The Architect's Test will begin, and the Trial Level will be expanded up to a maximum of Tier 7.

- The Architect's Rules and strong/weak attributes based on the Trial Level of The Architect's Test will be newly applied.

※ Please check in-game for more specific details regarding detailed rules and rewards.

 

▶ The Boundary of Illusions and Dreams

- A new season of The Boundary of Illusions and Dreams will begin, and the boss will change to Resist Kamish. Resist Kamish will be played in Hunter Mode, and its weakness attribute will change.

- 5 keys for The Boundary of Illusions and Dreams will be distributed all at once during the weekly reset every Thursday.

- The difficulty and rewards for The Boundary of Illusions and Dream and dreams have been revamped. The changed rewards for each difficulty can be checked by tapping the [Rewards] button on the in-game screen.

 

▶ Simulation Gate Higher Difficulties & New Collections Added

- A new season of Simulation Gate will begin, and weakness attributes and algorithms will be newly applied.

- The difficulty structure, previously consisting of up to Stage 50, has been expanded, allowing you to challenge up to Stage 55.

※ You may also skip lower stages to challenge higher difficulties directly.

- If you skip lower stages and clear a higher stage, it will be treated as if you have cleared all challenges for the lower stages.

- New collectibles for the Stacker and Buster classes will be added.

 

▶ Guild Boss Schedule Notice & Improvements

- Until the next regular update, the Guild Boss will appear as the Giant Statue.

- Until the next season, the recommended attributes will be fixed to Fire and Wind.

- In Guild Boss battles, Sung Jinwoo has been improved to receive buff effects from teams other than Team 1 as well.

※ However, the effects that Sung Jinwoo grants to team members will still only apply to Team 1, same as before.

 

▶ Unstable Dungeon

- The achievement condition for clearing Proof of the Strong Stage 20 in the existing Unstable Dungeon has been changed to clearing Unstable Dungeon Stage 35 and will be provided again.

 

 

📌 New Shop Items Notice

- New items have been added to the shops below after the update. Please check the shop notice link below for more details regarding the items sold in the new shop.

 [6/4 (Thu) New Package Items Notice ]

 

📌 New System Shop Items Added

 - Following the June 4 update, the items below have been added to the System Shop.

※ Chance Pack items appear based on your game progress, such as clearing content or growing weapons and Hunters. They can be purchased within a specified time from the moment they appear.

※ Detailed information about the new Chance Packs can be checked when the item appears in-game. Depending on the item type, payment methods may vary (Gold, Essence Stones, or Direct Purchase), so please check in-game for details.

 

📌 Dungeon Entry Key Purchase Cost Adjustment & Subscription Exchange Shop Revamp Notice [Go to Prior Notice]

 - Following the June 4 update, the purchase cost for Dungeon Entry Keys has been adjusted. Additionally, the quantities, monthly purchase limits, and costs for certain items in the Subscription Exchange Shop have been adjusted.

※ The changes to the Exchange Shop will be applied immediately after the maintenance is complete, and the purchase counts will be reset.

 

📌 Celebration Coin Exchange Items Added

 - Two new exchange items using Association Special Certificates have been added to the Celebration Coin Exchange Shop.

📌Other Improvements

- The button exposure (maintenance) time for QTE skills triggered by Sung Jinwoo's actions has been extended compared to before.

- During Auto Combat, including Team Fight mode, Hunters have been improved to utilize optimized combat AI tailored to their respective roles.

- The conditions for using Evasion during Auto Combat have been improved.

- A setting to disable Auto Evasion during Auto Combat has been added under the [Options] - [Controls] tab.

- The unlock condition for The Architect's Test content has been changed to match that of the Overseer's Forbidden Library.

- The unlock condition for The Boundary of Illusions and Dreams content has been changed to match that of the Battlefield of Time.

- Certain bosses from the Mind Rift have been added to the Special Commission.

- The Low-tier, Mid-tier, High-tier, and Lv. 120 Artifact Selection Chests have been changed to allow the selection of only the 5 types of Class Artifacts.

- Certain Artifacts that cannot be obtained in-game have been excluded from the Codex.

- The UI and convenience of the Gate Reward Settings screen have been improved.

- The UI and convenience of the Battlefield of Trials Stage Selection screen have been improved.

- Convenience features such as stopping progress, pausing, and auto-deployment have been added during Story Auto-Play.

- An icon has been added to the Fund Support and Power of Calamity screens to check whether Guild Buffs are applied.

- Shadow Army Soldiers have been removed, and the system has been improved so that currency is no longer consumed when summoning Shadows.

- The Association Mission to register a record in the Battlefield of Time has been changed to a Trial of the Strong Challenge Mission.

- For content other than Gates, the multiplier information will now be saved after completing a Multi-Sweep.

- Certain skill names for the Shadow "Butcher Brute" have been changed.

- The controls for certain Hunters have been improved.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where expired Gates would display in the list under certain circumstances, causing an error when attempting to mine.

- Fixed an issue where characters would not enter Stealth during the Deimos Orb destruction pattern in the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

- Fixed an issue where a black screen would temporarily display when the "Upgrader's Touch" event page pop-up appeared in mobile environments.

- Fixed an issue where an error pop-up would occasionally display when exiting during Power of Calamity gameplay.

- Fixed an issue in certain languages where a different language than the configured one would display upon entering the Trial of the Strong page for the first time.

- Fixed an issue where the purchase completion pop-up would not display upon purchasing the Successor of White Flames Authority Pack.

- Fixed an issue where notifications would not display when leveling up the Battle Class through Successor Succession Enhancement.

- Fixed an issue where an error message would display and Sweeps could not be performed when attempting to Sweep beyond the allowed Multi-Sweep limit.

- Fixed an issue where the Power displayed in certain Hunter Artifact details screens appeared higher than the actual Power.

- Fixed an issue in Hunter Mode where using Amamiya Mirei's Ultimate Skill followed immediately by Myro skill would cancel Mirei's Ultimate state.

- Fixed an issue where Story Auto-Play would occasionally stop during progress.

- Fixed an issue where a charging skill in use would be forcibly canceled due to the slow-motion effect triggered upon breaking a boss.

- Fixed an issue where the Returning User Hot Time Buff was distributed as an item and could not be used.

※ For Hunters who experienced inconvenience due to this issue, the buff will be redistributed to the in-game Mail after the update and will apply normally upon claiming.

 

 

We will continue to do our best to provide you with the best possible service.

 

Thank you.

text_en:
Developer Notes

6/2 (Tue) Developer Live Stream Summary Notice

Hunters Association
|
Jun 5, 2026, 02:00
|
2,391

  

 

📢6/2 (Tue) Developer Live Stream Summary

※ Please be advised that the following is a brief summary of the Developer Live Stream held on 6/2, quoted from the Inven article "[Inven] From 7-STAR Hunter Liu Zhigang to the Q3 Roadmap! June Developer Live."  [View Original Article]

※ This summary focuses on the Q&A sessions and excludes details regarding the 6/4 (Thu) update. Detailed information about the update will be provided through a separate Update Notice.

 

※ You can watch the video with subtitles in your preferred language by enabling the YouTube subtitle feature > Settings > Subtitles > Auto-translate, and then selecting the language.

 

[Dev Live Redeem Code]

Code

Reward

Valid Date

THX_2ND_5LA

Advanced Mana Crystal x1000

Lv. 120 Artifact Recipes x5

Dungeon Entry Key x100

Until July 1, 23:59 (UTC+0)

L1U_Zh1G4NG

Hunter Exclusive Weapon Design x2

Skill Scroll III x20

[Hunter] Mana Power Elixir III x30

0604_UPD4TE

Artifact Enhancement Reset Ticket x5

Artifact Enhancement Chip I x500

Artifact Enhancement Chip II x200

 

 

📌 Q&A

Q. Will new Artifacts be added this time?
 - As Liu Zhigang is released as a member of the new Class, Buster, his exclusive Artifact "Surtur's Flame" will also be released. Additionally, to help you farm new Artifacts more easily, Crafting and Modification events will be held together this time.

 Q. Please improve the efficiency of Artifact stats.
 - There have been many complaints as the efficiency between % stats and Additional Stats changed due to the increase in base stats. We apologize for not providing sufficient pre-notice regarding this matter. In the June update, Artifact stats will be adjusted upward, which includes a buff to Additional Stat options, and the performance of existing Artifacts will also be enhanced.

 Q. I have leftovers from the Hunters Association Special Certificate. We need more places to use them.
 - This is an issue we are aware of and mentioned once during the last live stream. In this June update, we plan to significantly update the exchangeable items, allowing you to purchase Artifact Enhancement Reset Tickets and past Hair Parts using the certificates.

 Q. We are running too short on Dungeon Entry Keys.
 - Following the Sweep update, the consumption of Dungeon Entry Keys has become significantly higher than expected. We plan to provide more keys, and alongside running events, we will also reduce the key recharge cost itself to be cheaper than before. Furthermore, although the keys have been unified, the daily missions are still separated, causing inconvenience. To address this, a change is planned for the July update where the consumption of keys itself becomes the mission goal, allowing for smoother progress.

 Q. Please raise the maximum Reputation level.
 - We are continuously monitoring the community and have confirmed that there are requests for a level cap raise among long-time players. The level cap will be raised to Lv. 150. For users who have already achieved the current max level, the changes will be applied retroactively in the July update. Even if you have already received Gold in exchange, your EXP will be returned, so please do not worry.

 Q. It would be great if Sung Jinwoo's Monarch form was released.
 - There was a lot of talk about Sung Jinwoo's Monarch form not being released when Myro came out. We determined that we need to develop it to meet your high expectations, and we are preparing to showcase it within Q3. It is currently being prepared under the tentative name "Shadow Monarch," and we will provide more details in the Q3 roadmap section.

 Q. When will the new Shadow "Greed" be released?
 - It is currently in the final stages of development. It will likely be released around the time of the next update.

 Q. Will the new weapon be released in two weeks this time as well?
 - "Moonlit Gale" will be released immediately with this June update.

 Q. There is a bug where mining keeps failing.
 - There is an issue where expired or deleted data remains in the system. This will be resolved with this update.

 Q. Will swimsuit costumes be released this time too?
 - Since it's summer, we are naturally preparing them. Even if we couldn't cover for the World Cup, we will definitely prepare for a summer event. We are getting a wide variety of swimsuit costumes ready this time.

 Q. When will the Sung Jinwoo Simulation be released ?
 - The release timing for the Sung Jinwoo Mode has been adjusted to further polish its quality. It will likely be released within the second half of the year.

 Q. When will the Shadow "Bellion" be released ?
 - Since the story has not progressed that far yet, it will take some more time before Bellion can be released.

 Q. Will new Classes keep being released?
 - Since the Buster class is newly introduced, there are no plans to add any more new classes for the time being.

 Q. Collaboration Hunters are unobtainable now, yet they still dominate the balance.
 - Along with Liu Zhigang's release, the overall balance of Fire-attribute Hunters will be adjusted. In the next update, we plan to adjust the balance of regular, non-collaboration Hunters to align with the newly releasing Hunters.

Since collaboration characters hold unique value as limited-edition units, you can expect the buffs for existing regular characters to bring them up to a similar performance level as the collaboration Hunters.

 Q. Are Breakers becoming obsolete? It feels like Hunters from non-meta classes are being completely sidelined.
 - While the introduction of Stackers and Buster might make it look like existing classes are being abandoned, we are aiming to design content in a way that clearly distinguishes between stages where Breakers have the advantage and stages where Stackers shine.

 Q. Will new attribute-infusing weapons, like the Transfiguration Key, be released?
 - A new one will be added this time. Please check the update details for more information.

 Q. Are there any plans to hold another Costume Design Contest?
 - We will look into preparing a new contest.

 Q. When will the weapon level cap be expanded?
 - We are preparing an update for this within July.

 Q. What should we do with leftover Myro Seals?
 - We plan to provide a conversion feature when the next Successor is released. Once the next Successor arrives, you will be able to exchange them at a 1:1 ratio and use them immediately. However, since Successors are not released constantly, we kindly ask for your patience until the next one arrives.

 Q. Do you have any plans for future collaborations?
 - There are currently no collaborations scheduled.

 Q. The method for obtaining Successors is too inconvenient.
 - The use of a separate ticket for Successors plays a part in this. However, as this is content we put immense effort into preparing, we are running various events to help ease the financial burden, so we ask for your kind understanding.

 Q. Who is the next Guild Boss?
 - The boss for the next season is the Giant Statue.

 Q. What is the status of the Gem equipping/unequipping feature?
 - Development is being prepared. To be frank, there are mixed opinions internally regarding whether this feature is truly necessary. The process of repeatedly equipping and unequipping can be tedious, and adding an unequip feature would also necessitate a preset system. However, since we have confirmed how strongly you want this, the development team will review it once again.

 

📌 Closing Remarks

Jin Seong-geon, Head of Development / Executive Producer:
It was truly great to host the live stream together with our development leaders. We will continue to do our best to provide even more exciting action for all our Hunters.

Kim Ryeon-gu, Content Design Team Leader:

I believe we shared a lot of different stories today. The biggest consideration for the staffs while preparing updates is how satisfying and enjoyable it will be for our Hunters. We are putting in a tremendous amount of effort to deliver fun content, including the June update, so please look forward to it. Furthermore, your feedback via the community and strategy videos is incredibly helpful to our staffs, so please continue to share your thoughts with us.

Shin Dong-hyun, Balance Lead:
Starting from today's demonstration, we introduced various upcoming updates. Once you experience Liu Zhigang, the new weapon, and the new boss in actual gameplay, you will find them far more enjoyable than just hearing about them. We will keep striving to provide you with fun experiences moving forward beyond this update.

 

 

Thank you.

name.en: Developer Notes: The Beginning of the 3rd Summer

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Notes: The Beginning of the 3rd Summer

Hunters Association
|
Jun 11, 2026, 08:00
|
15,670

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

This is the Hunters Association TEAM.

 

We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for the incredible interest and valuable feedback you have shared regarding this June update, which featured the 7-Star Hunter, Liu Zhigang.

 

Before we know it, the third summer is already approaching in Solo Leveling:ARISE. In today’s Developer’s Note, we would like to share what our team has been preparing, starting with a new Hunter who will kick off our third summer together, alongside more powerful challenge-oriented content and system improvements that will expand Sung Jinwoo's growth potential.

 

 

Before we dive in, we would like to share some special news that will kick off this summer with our Hunters. In July, the swimsuit costumes for Hunter Yoo Soohyun and the new Hunter 'Agnes Rivera' will be revealed first, followed by the second release featuring swimsuit costumes for Isla Wright and Meri Laine. Please look forward to the stunning new looks of these four Hunters, who will make our third summer together even more unforgettable.

 

 

[Original Hunter ‘Agnes Rivera’ Arrives as a Dark Elemental Buster]

 

 

 

The new Original Hunter, 'Agnes Rivera,' features a compelling narrative of a syndicate boss raised from birth to rule, who is then betrayed by the person she cherished most and sets out to hunt down the mastermind behind it. In combat, she truly embodies the presence of a mob boss. She will showcase a unique combat style, calling in fire support from her subordinates while freely maneuvering across the battlefield to rack up damage with continuous, targeted gunfire.

 

The Dark Elemental Buster, 'Agnes Rivera,' will join the roster as an ATK-based Hunter. We hope you look forward to the new story she will unfold with the kickoff of this summer.

 

[Addition of The Monarch of the Beginning Legia Hard Mode & Clear Event ]

Have you been enjoying your encounters with The Monarch of the Beginning Legia, who arrived with our recent update?

 

From executing plunging attacks using the tornado mechanics to the satisfying thrill of binding Legia with the Chain Mana Crystals, Legia will return with an even more formidable Hard Mode in our July update.

 

As Legia prepares to pressure you with overwhelming physical might and unique boss mechanics, we will also host a First-Come, First-Served Clear Event. Hunters who successfully clear the challenge within the Top 1,000 / Top 3,000 / Top 6,000 will be rewarded with corresponding special rewards during the following maintenance.

 

[Workshop of Brilliant Light First-Come, First-Served Clear Costumes ]

(Left) Top 1,000 Special Costume / (Center) Top 3,000 Special Costume / (Right) Top 6,000 Special Costume

 

As these rewards serve as an honorable testament to the Hunters who truly prove their skills, we highly encourage everyone to take on the challenge. We look forward to watching with great excitement to see who will be the first to bind the King of the Giants with the chains and defeat him.

 

[New Shadow: Greed]

 

The long-awaited Shadow of Hwang Dongsoo, "Greed," is finally joining the Shadow Army.

As a powerful new Shadow, Greed possesses a Team Leader Effect that increases the Wind Damage of all allies. Furthermore, when utilizing skills, Greed grants a formidable buff that simultaneously boosts both Critical Hit Rate and Critical Hit Damage for the entire team.

 

Along with the arrival of Greed, the maximum level of the Shadow Army will be expanded from the current level 182 to 195.

 

We hope that the S-Rank Hunter from the American Scavenger Guild, reborn as a Shadow, will bring an even more dynamic and thrilling combat experience to all our Hunters.

 

[Improvements for a Better Gameplay Experience ]

Our team has also prepared various improvements to ensure our Hunters can focus on the game in a more seamless and comfortable environment.

 

■ Guild Boss Element Schedule Adjustment

Starting in July, the element schedule for the Guild Boss will be adjusted. To ensure Hunters can continue to take on fresh challenges every week, we are restructuring the system to feature one fixed element and one weekly rotating element. We will continue to listen to your feedback and make adjustments to create an enjoyable gameplay environment, so please look forward to the challenges and keep sharing your thoughts.

 

■ Successor-Related Notice

The Successor Myro will no longer be obtainable 3 months after its release, and any remaining 'Legacy Seals' will be exchangeable on a 1:1 basis for the new Successor's 'Legacy Seals' when the next Successor launches.

 

The next Successor will be the Shadow Monarch, who was first teased during the June Developer Live Stream. However, as the 'Shadow Monarch' is Sung Jinwoo's identity, it will be prepared specially, unlike other Successors. Detailed information will be provided separately in the future, so please stay tuned.

 

The next Monarch will be the Shadow Monarch who was first revealed during the June Developer Live Stream. The Shadow Monarch will be released as a Dark element Monarch in late July. We are planning to make this Monarch obtainable through gameplay as well so please look forward to it. Detailed information will be provided in a future notice.

 

■ Addition of Blessing Stone Possession Effects

Previously, the 'Amplified Bonus Stats and Power' were only increased when a Blessing Stone was actively equipped. With this improvement, these effects will now apply simply by owning the Blessing Stones.

※ Please note that the applied effects will be partially adjusted in the Battlefield of Time content.

 

■ Addition of New Skill Runes

To further expand Sung Jinwoo's combat options, new Skill Runes with different elements will be added to 4 of his existing skills. We encourage you to explore and research your own unique combat style for Sung Jinwoo with these new Skill Rune combinations.

 

● Piercing Thrust(Shadowfall Kick)
● Sonic Stream(Frostbite Stream)
● Death's Dance(Vortex Cleave)
● Armor Break(Void Strike)
 

■ Addition of Gem Equipping/Unequipping Feature

The Gem equipping/unequipping feature, which many Hunters have requested through their feedback, is scheduled to be added in July. Along with the ability to equip and unequip Gems, the existing option to overwrite Gems will remain available. We hope you enjoy the process of reshaping your Gem tree and redesigning Sung Jinwoo’s growth direction.

※ Detailed information regarding the upcoming Gem equipping/unequipping feature will be provided in a future patch notice.

 

■ Amplification System Improvements 

To add further depth to Sung Jinwoo’s leveling progression, we are preparing to expand the current 3-tier limit of the Amplification System up to a maximum of 5 tiers. Please note that 5 tiers will be the final cap for the system, and it will not be expanded further. Detailed information will be provided through a patch notice once the preparations are complete.

 

■ Balance Adjustment

To improve combat efficiency and usability, the balance for the following Hunters, Sung Jinwoo Exclusive Weapons, and Blessing Stones will be buffed.

 

Target Hunters & Sung Jinwoo Exclusive Weapons for Balance Adjustments

Sian Halat

Sung Il-hwan

Isla Wright

Harper

Vulcan’s Rage

 

Target Blessing Stones for Balance Adjustments

■ Added an effect that grants additional MP in Teamfight Mode

■ Added an effect that increases Sung Jinwoo's stats in Teamfight Mode when there are 3 Supporters of the same element

※ Detailed information regarding the balance adjustments will be provided in a separate patch notice in the future.

※ The content and resources featured in this Developer's Note are currently under development and are subject to change upon the actual update.

 

 

Following the excitement of our recent 2nd Anniversary and the arrival of the 7-STAR Hunter, Liu Zhigang, we hope to continue this momentum into the summer, allowing you to write new stories across an even broader battlefield. Our team will remain dedicated to meticulously refining the game so that our Hunters can experience the true joy of new challenges, growth, and immersive combat. We ask for your continued interest and support for our upcoming July update.

 

Thank you.

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

Here are the details scheduled to be added and changed through the update on 7/2 (Thu).

 

Please see below for more details about the update.

 

 

📢7/2 (Thu) Update Details

 

📌 Story Expert Difficulty New Chapters Added

▶ Story Expert Difficulty New Chapters Added

- Hidden Chapters 5 and 6, and Chapters 24 and 25 will be newly opened in Expert Difficulty.

※ Along with the new story additions, cumulative Battle Mission achievement rewards for Expert Difficulty will be added.

 

▶ Story Codex Cinematic Replay Feature Added

- A Cinematic Replay feature will be added to the Story Codex, allowing you to rewatch cinematics from already cleared Main and Sub Stories.

- Story Cinematic Codex collection rewards will be added.

 

📌 Workshop of Brilliant Light: The First Land Hard Difficulty Added

▶ Workshop of Brilliant Light: The First Land Hard Difficulty Added

- Hard difficulty will be added to the Workshop of Brilliant Light: The First Land.

It unlocks upon clearing 'The First Land - Normal Difficulty'.

- The First Land Hard Difficulty will feature [High-Difficulty Battle] as of the update.

※ The difficulty may be sequentially adjusted in the future as more Hunters successfully clear Hard difficulty.

- Special rewards will be given to the first 6,000 Hunters who clear The First Land Hard Difficulty on a first-come, first-served basis. Please refer to the event notice below for more details.

[Go to [WANTED] Workshop of Brilliant Light: Legia(Hard) Clear Event]

 

📌 New Skill Runes Added

- New Skill Runes [Darkness Obliteration Kick], [Frozen Flow], [Torrent Cleave], and [Void Punch] will be added.

※ The new Skill Runes are available in Rare, Heroic, Legendary, and Transcendent ranks. Please check in-game for more details.

※ The new Skill Runes will be added to the fusion lineup, and the acquisition rates for individual items will be adjusted. However, the total acquisition rates for each rank (Rare/Heroic/Legendary) remain the same as before.

※ Skill Rune Chests and Skill Rune Transcendent Stone Chests will be updated to include the new runes in their lineups.

※ For Skill Rune Selection Chests and Skill Rune Transcendent Stone Selection Chests, a new type of selection chest that includes the new Skill Runes will be added.

 

📌 Hunter Archive Added

 - A Hunter Archive for Choi Jong-In will be added.

 

📌 New SSR Hunter & Exclusive Weapon Added

- The new SSR Dark attribute Buster Hunter [Agnes Rivera] and her exclusive weapon [La Famiglia] will be added.

- The new Hunter can be acquired through the Rate Up Draw, and you can experience her beforehand through the Hunter Preview.

- The exclusive weapon can be obtained via crafting or through events.

- The new Hunter’s profile icon, Secret Files, Hunter Archive, and Bonds entries will be added.

- An original story for Agnes Rivera will be added.

Greed

▶ Shadow Level Cap Expanded

- Along with the addition of the new Shadow, the maximum level cap for the Shadow Army will be expanded to 195.

 

📌 New Costumes Added

 - New Costumes for Hunters and Skins for Weapons will be added.

 - New costumes can be obtained through shop purchases, events, and more.

※Costumes can be equipped by accessing the hanger-shaped button on the Hunter Information screen.

 -3 types of color dyeing options will be added for Agnes Rivera's costume.

Agnes Rivera

📌 On-going Events

- Various in-game events will take place after the 7/2 update.

Please refer to the event notice links below for more details.

[Agnes Rivera Debut Celebration! Rate Up Draw & 2 Events]

[Sun-Kissed Summer Kicks Off! Event]

[The Monarch of the Beginning Clear Event]

 

📌 Event Weapon Crafting Notice

- During the update period, event crafting for Sung Jinwoo Weapons [Soma & Asura] and [Moonlit Gale] will be available.

※ Each weapon can be crafted up to a maximum of 2 times per account by consuming Special Player’s Weapon Designs.

 

 

 

📌 Balance Adjustments [Go]

 - The balance of certain Sung Jinwoo Blessing Stones, Weapons, and Hunters will be adjusted.

※ Detailed information can be found in a separate notice.

 

📌 Skill Rune & Blessing Stone Amplification Tiers Expanded & Improved

▶Skill Rune & Blessing Stone Amplification Tiers Expanded

- The maximum Amplification Tier for Transcendent-rank Skill Runes and Blessing Stones will be expanded from the current Tier 3 to Tier 5.

 

▶Blessing Stone Amplification Effects Improved

- The Combat Power increased upon amplifying Blessing Stones, as well as the additional Attack, Defense, and HP increases from amplification, will be improved to apply upon possession, regardless of whether they are equipped.

 

📌 Weapon Level Cap Expanded

 - The maximum level cap for Sung Jinwoo and Hunter Weapons will be expanded from the current level 120 to level 130.

 

📌 Gems Improved

▶ Gem Unequip and Replace Functions Added

- Gem unequip and replace functions will be added.

- If a Gem is already equipped in a slot, you can use the [Unequip] or [Replace] button to safely move the currently equipped Gem to your Inventory.

- Unequipping or replacing Gems consumes Essence Stones or Gem Unequip Tickets. You can select the currency you wish to use via the [Change] button on the screen.

- The existing method of equipping a different Gem without consuming costs remains available. However, please note that in this case, the previously equipped Gem will be destroyed as before.

 

▶ Gem Fusion Color Designation Function Added

- A function will be added where fusing Gems of the same color guarantees the resulting Gem will be of the exact same color used in the fusion.

- You can freely toggle this function on or off via the [Color Selection ON/OFF] button at the bottom left of the Gem Fusion screen.

※ While the Color Selection function is active, Gems of different colors cannot be registered as materials for fusion.

※ Fusing with a designated color will not share the existing Fusion Mileage, but will use a separate Mileage system instead.

 

📌 Draw & Exchange Lineup Added

▶ Custom Draw / Special Scout Draw / Association Special Certification Exchange Lineup Added

 - SSR Antoine Martinez will be added to the Custom Draw, Special Scout Draw, and Association Special Certification Exchange Lineup, and can now be selected from the Rate Up list.

※ New Rate Up Hunters may be added to the Custom Draw list in the future.

※ For Special Scout Draws, this will apply to Special Scouts that open after 7/16, 00:00 (UTC+0).

 

📌 Trials of the Strong Content Improvements & Changes

▶ Battlefield of Time Reorganization

- The default level of allies and monsters appearing in the Battlefield of Time will be changed to 150.

- The default Critical Hit Damage stat of allies will be increased.

- The activation timing of the [Fighting Spirit] effect will be changed to 40 seconds after the battle starts, and its efficiency will be increased compared to before.

- Bosses will be changed to take significantly increased damage when in a Break state.

- The timer will be improved to temporarily pause during the cinematic presentation when the next boss appears after defeating a mid-boss.

- An issue in the Battlefield of Time where the Combat Power correction for Shadows and Remnant Power skills was not applied correctly will be fixed.

- An issue where 99% Precision was not applying correctly to the damage of Remnant Power skills will be fixed.

 

▶ The Overseer's Forbidden Library Difficulty Reorganization

- To enhance the fun of challenging content according to our Hunters' growth specs, the difficulty and required Combat Power for The Overseer's Forbidden Library [Ancient Shelf] and [Forbidden Shelf] will be increased.

- The changed required Combat Power for each difficulty can be checked via the [Select Difficulty] button on The Overseer's Forbidden Library screen in-game.

 

📌 Hunters Association Weekly Missions Content Improvements & Changes

 

▶ Power of Calamity

- A new season of the Power of Calamity will begin, and the boss will be changed to 'Ennio'.

- Until the next season, the recommended attributes will be fixed as Wind and Dark, and Extermination Support will be newly applied.

- Weekly Ranking and Season Ranking will be added to the Power of Calamity ranking information.

- The ranking calculation method will be improved so that when tied scores occur for Power of Calamity Season Points, the ranking priority from the previous week will be applied first.

- A weapon classification filter will be added to the Sung Jinwoo Weapon Equipping tab in the Power of Calamity.

 

▶ Simulation Gate

- Skill errors for certain bosses in the Simulation Gate will be fixed.

- To help you more easily check the stages currently available for Sweeping, a 'Sweep Available' label will be added to those stages within the Simulation Gate to improve information visibility.

 

▶ Guild Boss Schedule Notice

- Until the next regular update, the Guild Boss will be applied as 'Manticore'.

- Until the next season, the recommended attribute will be fixed as the Dark attribute, and additional recommended attributes will apply in the order of Wind, Water, Fire, and Light depending on the week.

 

📌 Retroactive Distribution Notice

 - Please claim your rewards from the Mailbox within the storage expiration period.

 

▶ Reputation EXP Retroactive Distribution(Edited on 7/2(Thu) 05:20 (UTC+0))

- Hunters who reached Reputation Level 100 before the 6/4 update will receive their excessively earned Reputation EXP retroactively via the In-Game Mailbox. are directly applied to your Reputation Level, and the Reputation Level Up rewards are sent to your inventory.

 

▶ Workshop of Brilliant Light Essence Stones Distribution

- Compensation for the difference regarding the issue where the number of Essence Stone rewards in the Workshop of Brilliant Light was incorrectly applied will be distributed via the In-Game Mailbox.

 

 

 

📌 New In-Game Shop Item Sales Notice

- New items will be added to the shops below after the update. For details regarding the items sold in the new shop, please check the item sales notice below.

 [Go to 7/2(Thu) New Packages]

 

📌 System Shop New Items Added

 - The following items will be added to the System Shop after the 7/2 update.

Item Name

Special Artifact Crafting Bundle

Artifact Enhancement Reset Bundle

Special Core Bundle

※ Chance Pack items are displayed based on game progression, such as clearing content or growing weapons and Hunters, and can be purchased within a set period from the time they appear.

※ Details of the new Chance Packs can be checked when the items are displayed in-game. Depending on the type of item, Gold, Essence Stones, or direct purchase methods will apply, so please check in-game.

 

📌 Dungeon Entry Key Purchase Limit Expanded

 - After the 7/2 update, the purchase limit for Dungeon Entry Keys will be expanded to a maximum of 50 times, and the Essence Stone consumption cost from the 31st purchase onwards will be applied identically.

 

📌 Sweep Point Expansion System Added

 - A convenient new function will be added that allows you to proceed with a Sweep by substituting 5 Essence Stones for every 1 missing Sweep Point when you lack the required points.

 

📌[Shop] > [Monthly Bundle] Item Reorganization

- The '[New] Daily Essence Stone Boost' item will be reorganized into the '[New] Daily Essence Stone & Key Boost'.
  For details regarding the reorganized monthly bundle item, please check the [7/2 (Thu) New Packages] announcement.

※ For the benefits of the previous monthly bundle item '[New] Daily Essence Stone Boost', rewards for the remaining number of days will be distributed in bulk via the In-Game Mailbox after the maintenance.

※ Please claim your rewards from the Mailbox within the storage expiration period.

 

 

 

📌 Other Improvements

- Upon clearing Unstable Dungeon, Battlefield of Chaos, and Mind Rift contents, rewards have been improved to additionally grant 'Low-tier Mana Stones' in addition to the basic rewards.

- A ‘Train All' function will be added in Hunter Co-op Training, allowing you to grow training items for a designated class all at once.

- A [Skip] button will be added when playing certain cinematic presentations, improving the experience so you can skip during playback.

- [Thoughtform] Alicia Blanche, [Thoughtform] Kang Taeshik, [Thoughtform] Baek Yoonho, and [Thoughtform] Isla Wright bosses from the Mind Rift will be added to Special Commissions.

- An issue where certain UI elements overlapped and were displayed under specific resolution environments on some devices will be improved.

- The Artifact Recommended Gear Info UI will be improved.

- A growth-available exclusive notification indicator will be added so you can intuitively check when Hunters and weapons are available for Advancement.

- The existing scroll position will be improved to be maintained even after purchasing items in the Shop.

- After proceeding with an Artifact Enhancement Reset, it will be improved to automatically move to the Enhancement tab.

- Even if the conditions for Reforgement are not met, the [Reforge] button will be changed to always be displayed on the Artifact Enhancement screen.

- Some mission items among Daily Missions, Guild Daily/Weekly Missions, and Hunter Pass Missions will be removed and simplified, making them easier to achieve than before.

※ Although the mission difficulty will be adjusted to be easier, the final rewards and total points will remain exactly the same as before.

- In the Workshop of Brilliant Light Blessing Stage, the number of available Blessing Resets will be increased from the current 2 times to 10 times.

※ The amount of Gold consumed upon a Blessing Reset increases according to the number of resets performed.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue causing forced termination when entering Story Hidden Stages 9-6 and 9-10, as well as the Workshop of Brilliant Light Legia: 'Sealed Primordial Lungs' stage on certain devices.

- Fixed an issue where the Battlefield of Time Season 18 of Challenge Medal Tokens were not distributed.

- Fixed an issue where Overload damage was excessively applied in The Overseer's Forbidden Library.

- Fixed an issue where multiple multiplier plays were unavailable in the Workshop of Brilliant Light Demons' Castle Lower Floors Normal difficulty.

- Fixed an issue where the Monarch icon was intermittently not displayed when proceeding with a Re-battle in the Simulation Gate.

- Fixed an issue where the bullet count in Hunter Soyeon's Magnum UI was intermittently not updating in real-time.

- Fixed an issue where Power of Calamity weekly rewards were not distributed under specific situations.

※ Rewards that were not distributed will be sent via the In-Game Mailbox after the update.

 

 

We will continue to do our best to provide you with the best possible service.

 

Thank you.
