name.en: Developer Notes: The Monarch of Shadows, is finally here

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Notes: The Monarch of Shadows, is finally here

Hunters Association
|
Jul 15, 2026, 06:00
|
10,653

 

 

Greetings, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE Team.

 

The moment you have all been waiting for is finally happening. The Shadow Monarch will officially awaken and make his grand entrance at the end of July.

 

 

As the protagonist driving the entire narrative of Solo Leveling, the Shadow Monarch holds the most profound impact in the original story. Our team has poured months of hard work and passion into capturing that exact raw emotion and recreating it perfectly within ARISE.

In today's Developer Note, we are thrilled to give you a sneak peek at what is coming. Starting with the Shadow Monarch who will arrive as a Dark element successor, we will also cover the upcoming Workshop of Brilliant Light revamp, all new Hidden Stories, our latest Hunter Jung Yerim, and a massive lineup of summer events.

 

 

[Dark Element Successor - The Monarch of Shadows, Sung Jinwoo]

『Arise! 』

 

The long-awaited Monarch of Shadows Successor is set to arrive as a Dark element character in our upcoming update. To truly capture the unique and iconic significance of the Monarch of Shadows, we are introducing a brand new acquisition structure that differs from our previous systems.

Lowering the Difficulty to Acquire the Monarch of Shadows Successor

First, we have lowered the barrier to entry so that Hunters can recruit the Successor more easily. The Monarch of Shadows Successor content will unlock once you clear Chapter 11. After unlocking it, you can guarantee his acquisition simply through casual gameplay and completing missions, without any complicated processes.

Permanent Opening of ‘the Monarch of Shadows Special Draw’

Alongside the release, the Monarch of Shadows Special Draw will open permanently with no time limit. Hunters can play at their own pace without any time pressure, collecting tickets through regular gameplay to continuously grow him to his maximum stage.

 

Combat will maintain the distinct style of the existing Sung Jinwoo action while showcasing an even more spectacular and differentiated experience. A new combat concept will be added where Sung Jinwoo transforms into the Monarch of Shadows and performs combo attacks in perfect synergy with his shadows, allowing you to truly feel the overwhelming presence and awe of the Monarch of Shadows.

Please look forward to the arrival of the Monarch of Shadows and the countless battlefields you will conquer together.

※ After the update, your current Myro’s Legacy Seals can be exchanged for Monarch of Shadows Legacy Seals at a 1 to 1 ratio.

※ More specific details will be provided during the Developer Live Stream scheduled for  7/28.

 

[Workshop of Brilliant Light Revamp]

Have you ever wanted to face the Workshop of Brilliant Light bosses again after clearing them?

Our team is planning a step by step revamp of the Workshop of Brilliant Light to bring Hunters fresher and more challenging content. You will experience brand new combat encounters as you face the same bosses but with different elemental weaknesses. With the goal of bringing back the thrilling sensation of fighting Vulcan down to the wire, we will introduce these updates sequentially throughout late July and August.

 

■ Stage 1: Boss Rotation (Late July Update )

The Workshop of Brilliant Light will be revamped into a boss rotation based system. Monarchs you have faced before, such as Baran, Yogumunt, and Rockpasa, will periodically rotate along with Commanders and other bosses. The revamped Workshop of Brilliant Light will operate on a 2 week season system with different boss lineups each season, while the elemental weaknesses will rotate on a 4 week update cycle. Even when facing the same boss, you will need to prepare new strategies based on their changing elemental weaknesses over time.

 

For our very first season, you will be able to face "Baran, the Monarch of White Flames" before anyone else. We will also be streamlining the difficulty structure so that you can challenge your desired difficulty level right away without any separate unlock requirements.

※ Baran in the first season will appear alongside "(Commander) Vulcan" and "(Boss) Esil Radiru." Starting from certain difficulty levels, Fire and Dark will be the weakness elements.

※When a new Monarch debuts in the Workshop of Brilliant Light, that specific season will run for 4 weeks. The next Monarch to arrive in the Workshop of Brilliant Light this September will be the Monarch of Fangs Adan.

※ Future first clear race events will be prepared as a separate piece of content so you can challenge them much more conveniently.

 

■ Stage 2: Corridor of Monarchs (Temporary Name / August Update)

Once you clear the highest difficulty of the newly rotated Workshop of Brilliant Light, a new challenging content utilizing the workshop called Corridor of Monarchs (Temporary Name) will unlock.

 

Corridor of Monarchs (Temporary Name) is a content where Hunters can manually adjust the difficulty by selecting advantageous or disadvantageous conditions, earning scores, rankings, and rewards accordingly. Our team expects this content to be a feature that allows Hunters to immerse themselves even deeper into the raw action of Sung Jinwoo and the Hunters. Detailed information will be provided through a separate notice in the future.

 

[New Hunter, Jung Yerim]

 

The cheerful healer of the Knights Guild, Jung Yerim, is joining the fight.

Having overcome poverty and hardships during her childhood, she learned how to survive on her own. 

 

She is a resilient character who always makes sure to repay any kindness she receives with her own abilities. Joining as a Fire element Supporter, Jung Yerim is an all-around supporter who boosts the team's firepower by providing healing and shields, as well as increasing Fire element Overload damage, Burst damage, Attack Power, and Ultimate Move damage. Please look forward to her exceptional synergy, especially with the Fire element Buster, Liu Zhigang.

Jung Yerim will join as a Hunter whose skills scale with HP.

 

[New Hidden Chapter - The Monarch of Fangs ‘Adan’]

A new chapter unfolds along the path Sung Jinwoo has walked.

The story follows the investigation of a bizarre Hunter Berserk Incident that occurred within the White Tiger Guild. Tracking the clues leads to a jungle island, where alongside Agnes Rivera and Diana Lopez, they confront an entity hidden within the island's darkness. Please look forward to the journey of Sung Jinwoo and his companions as they hunt down the source of the berserk madness.

 

[Third Summer of 2026, Event Story]

 

A mysterious Gate appears over the sea, bringing with it rumors of a mermaid that tempts Hunters. Discover the truth behind these rumors in this summer's event story, featuring Yoo Soohyun, Lennart Niermann, Meri Laine, and Agnes Rivera. We are also preparing a variety of events to help you cool off and enjoy the scorching summer.

 

[Artifact Information and Future Improvements]

First, we sincerely apologize to our Hunters regarding the situation where artifacts that do not match a Hunter's class had to be used in certain content. Although we previously stated our goal to reduce the fatigue of farming and create an environment where you could focus strictly on setting up artifacts that match each class, a close investigation revealed an issue that deviated from our original intention. To improve upon this, we plan to make the following adjustments in the next update.

 

■ Buffs to Class-Exclusive Effects for Striker and Buster Artifact Sets

Furthermore, in this update, we will be streamlining the Ultimate Skills for Buster and Stacker Hunters exclusively for Guild Boss and Power of Calamity contents, allowing you to deal damage more effectively by utilizing Buster Hunters. This adjustment will be gradually implemented for all Hunters in the future. We will continue to monitor this closely to provide a better combat experience for all Hunters, and detailed adjustment details will be provided in a separate notice.

 

[Improvements for a Better Gameplay Experience]

Our team has also prepared various improvements so that Hunters can focus on playing in a much more comfortable environment.

 

■ Sung Jinwoo Level Cap Expansion

Sung Jinwoo's maximum level will be expanded to level 160.

 

■ Guild Boss Exclusive Buff and Balance Adjustments

To ensure Sung Jinwoo performs sufficiently against the Guild Boss, we are adding a brand new Sung Jinwoo exclusive buff that applies only within Guild Boss content. Additionally, to improve the current situation where players are overly dependent on Defense Penetration, the Defense of the Guild Boss will be lowered compared to before.

 

Specific details will be provided through the update notice. Furthermore, our team will continue to make improvements so that you can experiment with diverse Hunter combinations, experience the strategic fun of defeating the Guild Boss, and truly see Sung Jinwoo shine.

 

■ Other Balance Adjustments

The balance for Hunters Choi Jong-in and Christopher Reed will be buffed.

※ Specific values and schedules will be provided through a future patch notice.

※ The content and resources covered in this Developer Note are currently under development and may be subject to change upon the actual update.

 

 

Until the moment Sung Jinwoo is reborn as the Monarch of Shadows, our team will meticulously polish every detail until the very end to ensure that the time you have spent waiting is truly rewarded. 

We will do our absolute best to make the next chapter of this long journey an unforgettable moment for all Hunters.

We look forward to seeing you again on the new battlefield with the Monarch of Shadows in late July.

Thank you.

name.en: Temporary Workaround for Launcher Screen Display Issue After Netmarble Launcher Update

text_en:
Notices

Temporary Workaround for Launcher Screen Display Issue After Netmarble Launcher Update

Hunters Association
|
Jul 15, 2026, 10:08
|
691

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

We would like to inform you that following the recommended Netmarble Launcher update on 7/14 (Tue),

an intermittent issue has been identified where the launcher screen does not display properly.

 

We are currently investigating the root cause to resolve this issue as quickly as possible.

In the meantime, please refer to the temporary workaround detailed below to restore access.

 

 

📌 Temporary Workaround (Option 1)

 

1. Completely close the Netmarble Launcher from the system tray icon in the bottom right corner of your screen.

 

2. Press the [Win + R] shortcut keys on your keyboard to open the "Run" window. Copy and paste the path below, then click "OK."

- Path  : %UserProfile%\AppData\Roaming\Netmarble Launcher

 

3. Right-click the config.json file, select and select “Edit in Notepad”

or Right-click the config.json file, select "Open with," and choose "Notepad."

 

4.Find the line containing ["sandbox": true,] delete the entire line, and save the file.

※ Please make sure to delete the entire line, including the comma ( , ).

 

5. Restart the Netmarble Launcher.

※ If the issue persists even after applying this temporary workaround, please completely uninstall the Netmarble Launcher and reinstall it.

 

 

📌 Temporary Workaround (Option 2) 

 

1. Close the Netmarble Launcher.

 

2. Install the previous version of the Netmarble Launcher.

- Previous Netmarble Launcher Version: v.1.6.0

[Download Link for Previous Netmarble Launcher Version ]

 

3. Run the [netmarble_launcher_restore_installer] file to restore the Netmarble Launcher to its pre-update state.

※  Please note: If the issue is temporarily resolved using this method, do not update the Netmarble Launcher until an official fix is released to prevent the issue from recurring.

 

 

 

We will continue to do our absolute best to ensure that Hunters can always enjoy the game in a smooth and stable environment.

 

Thank you.

7/28 (Tue) Developer Live Stream Summary Notice

Hunters Association
|
Jul 29, 2026, 02:53
|
2,204

 

 

📢7/28 (Tue) Developer Live Stream Summary

※ Please note that the contents below were summarized with reference to Inven's article '[Inven] The Monarch of Shadows Descends! Solo Leveling:ARISE July Developer Live' covering the Developer Live Stream held on 7/28  [View Original Article]

※ Contents related to the 7/30 (Thu) update have been excluded to focus on a summary of the Q&A session. Detailed information regarding the update will be provided through a separate update notice.

 

※ You can watch the video with subtitles in your preferred language by enabling the YouTube subtitle feature > Settings > Subtitles > Auto-translate, and then selecting the language.

 

[Dev Live Redeem Code]

Code

Reward

Valid Date

SHAD0W_M0NARC

[Transcendent] Skill Rune Selection Chest x1

Amplification Agent x500

Until August 26, 23:59 (UTC+0)

0730_UPD473

Mana Power Extract x3

Core Growth Selection Chest II x5

Gold x10,000,000

5UMM3R_EV3NT

Dungeon Entry Key x300

Custom Draw Ticket x10

Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitation x1

 

 

📌 Q&A

Q. When resetting Artifact Enhancement, non-limited (permanent) tickets are selected first, which is inconvenient.
 - There was an issue in the logic where non-limited tickets were being prioritized. It will be updated so that time-limited tickets are selected first.

 Q. Auto Mode controls for Busters need improvement.
 - We have tracked the trends and reviewed the Buster Auto Mode issue internally. It will be adjusted so that when Burst Damage has accumulated, the Buster uses their Burst Skill before swapping out.

 Q. You mentioned simplifying Artifacts, so why do Busters like Liu Zhigang or Agnes Rivera deal more damage with The Architect set?

- We conducted an internal investigation. As mentioned in the Developer Note, we plan to strengthen class-exclusive effects so that equipping Artifacts suited for each class delivers better performance. We will also apply changes to simplify ultimate skill animations, allowing both Busters and Strikers to output more damage.

In addition to equipment for Strikers and Busters, we are also improving Team Fight effects for other items, including Rock Crusher. This is scheduled to be updated in August.

 Q. The difficulty of the Overseer’s Forbidden Library has become too high.
 - As growth stats increased, we adjusted the difficulty, but we received feedback that it became excessively hard. We plan to readjust the balance in the next update. As it is seasonal content, please look forward to the next season.

 Q. Please ease the guild level growth process.
 - We believe this is definitely an area we can improve. We will discuss this internally.

 Q. Please double-check if the Successor Sung Jinwoo 'Monarch of Shadows' is permanent.
 - Yes, it is permanent. We felt that since it is the 'Monarch of Shadows', making it unavailable after a certain period wouldn't fit Solo Leveling.

 Q. When will Kamish's Rage be released?
 - It is currently in development. The concept art has already been approved, and we plan to release it in line with the story, so please hold on a bit longer. Timeframe-wise, it will be released within this year.

 Q. Severe frame drops are occurring.
 - Regarding frame rates, we are currently discussing with the development team ways to optimize graphics settings to ensure smoother frame rates moving forward.

 Q. Hackers keep appearing on the rankings.
 - It really is an endless cat-and-mouse game. Whenever hackers bypass our system after an update, we actively take follow-up measures to handle them. Also, if your rank was pushed down due to a hacker at the moment rewards are distributed, we issue supplementary rewards once sanctions are applied, so please rest assured.

As for the slow response time, we are manually reviewing hundreds of reports one by one. This is to minimize the risk of accidentally penalizing highly skilled players by mistake.

 Q. When will Myro return?
 - As Myro was released as the first Successor, she is currently unavailable since her period ended, and a rerun schedule has not been set yet. For now, please enjoy the newly released Monarch of Shadows, and we will prepare a rerun based on player demand in the future.

 Q. When will Shadow Bellion be released?
 - As the grand marshal of the shadows, Bellion holds a very iconic and crucial role in the story. Since it isn't time for him to appear in the storyline just yet, please wait a little longer.

 Q. We need Artifact Presets.
 - This is something the dev team also finds inconvenient. In this upcoming update, Sung Jinwoo's presets will be expanded from 2 to 4.

 Q. Agnes Rivera feels clunky to play.
 - Many players have mentioned Super Armor. She was designed so that having her damage cycle interrupted causes a lot of frustration, and we understand that current monster attack patterns make it difficult to deal uninterrupted damage.

However, rather than simply fixing this by adding Super Armor, we are considering solutions that create various possibilities depending on team compositions and setups. We are looking into adjustments where pairing her with specific Hunters covers her drawbacks and increases overall damage output, and we will update you on this once finalized.

 Q. Wind and Dark elemental infusion weapons were released. When will the next weapon come out?
 - Next month, a Water elemental infusion weapon will be released first. Overload weapons will be released separately, and we are designing them to be used alongside existing weapons, led by Skadi and Winter Fang.
 

Also, we’ve heard feedback that Winchester Roke and Transfiguration Key feel less usable compared to recently released Wind element weapons. These weapons will also receive buffs in the August update.

 Q. Off-rate pulls (pity breaks) feel terrible.
 - We cannot revamp the draw system immediately. While we sympathize with the stress it causes, many players have already drawn under the current system, so a sudden change could lead to reactions like "I shouldn't have drawn and just waited." Please understand that instead, we will increase the supply of draw tickets and provide more rewards through events and coupons.

 Q. Are there any plans for more collaborations?

 - Over our service past the 2nd anniversary, we held a few collaborations, but what we realized afterward was that "Solo Leveling shines brightest when it stays true to Solo Leveling." Currently, there are no plans for additional collaborations.

 Q. We need content where we can spend Gold.
 - Until recently, there was a severe shortage of Gold, so we made many changes to increase Gold income. As a result, many players now have accumulated a lot of Gold, so we will prepare an event where you can spend Gold and receive rewards.

 

📌 Closing Remarks

Executive Producer Seong-Keun Jin: The Monarch of Shadows will be added in this update. The development team is putting in a great deal of effort to present distinctively spectacular combat, so please look forward to it. We will strive to offer an enjoyable experience through various events and abundant rewards.

Head of Business Operations Da-Haeng Lee: This live stream was a great opportunity to showcase the Monarch of Shadows. To welcome this update and help players get started more smoothly, we would like to distribute Rate Up Draw Tickets—10 tickets per day for 3 days, making a total of 30 tickets. You can claim these rewards by logging in for 3 days starting on the day of the update. Additionally, Artifact Enhancement Reset Tickets will also be provided separately.
 

Seeing the upcoming Monarch of Shadows and Workshop of Brilliant Light, I can feel how deeply the Solo Leveling dev team deliberated on how to make the gameplay as fun as possible for Hunters. We have prepared a jam-packed update, so please enjoy it! Also, someone mentioned they are returning to the game after 8 months—with the Monarch of Shadows available for free, now is definitely the perfect time to come back.

Balance Lead Dong-Hyun Shin: Although today's demonstration fell a bit short, I am confident Hunters will find it extremely fun once they play it themselves. We have prepared thoroughly so you can enjoy the reworked Workshop of Brilliant Light as well, and if you leave plenty of feedback, we will do our best to actively incorporate it.

 

 

Thank you.

Hunters Association

21,008

 

 

Greetings Hunters,

The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

 

Here are the details scheduled to be added and changed through the update on 7/30 (Thu).

 

Please see below for more details about the update.

 

 

📢7/30 (Thu) Update Details

 

📌 New Main Story Chapters Added

 - Hidden Chapters have been added to the Normal and Reverse Normal difficulties of the Main Story.

 * Hidden Chapters welcome you to experience the original story of Solo Leveling:ARISE.

Category

Hidden 11

※ Clear achievement rewards and battle mission rewards exist for each chapter. However, chapters consisting solely of story content will only provide clear achievement rewards.

※ With the addition of new story chapters, cumulative battle mission achievement rewards for Reverse Normal difficulty will be added.

 

📌 Workshop of Brilliant Light Rework

▶ Difficulty & Entry Method Rework

- The Workshop of Brilliant Light will transition to a 2-week seasonal system, with the boss lineup changing each season.

- Difficulty is composed of a total of 10 stages, and starting from Stage 6, the recommended element will change with each update cycle.

※ Upon entering the Workshop of Brilliant Light for the first time, 'Workshop of Brilliant Light Invitations' will not be consumed regardless of the difficulty, and invitations will be consumed for subsequent entries.

- The 'Proof of the Strong' feature in the Workshop of Brilliant Light will end.

※ The Proof of the Strong Exchange Shop will remain available until the update on 8/27 (Thu), and any unused 'Token of Absolute Strength' will be converted into Gold and distributed at a later date .

 

▶ Remnant Power Unlock Condition Eased & Shard of the Monarch Integration

- Clearing Stage 1 of the Workshop of Brilliant Light now allows you to unlock all Monarchs' Remnant Power at once.

- Clearing a stage will now drop 'Shard of the Monarch' regardless of the boss type. This allows you to freely level up your desired Remnant Power without being restricted to a specific Monarch.

※ Any existing Monarch-specific shards will be converted to 'Shard of the Monarch' at a 1:1 ratio, regardless of type.

 

▶ Sweep Condition Improvements

- The Sweep feature, which previously required clearing the final stage at least 20 times, has been improved so that it can now be used after clearing it just once.

※ Clearing a higher difficulty stage will simultaneously unlock the Sweep feature for lower difficulty stages.

※ Sweep conditions are applied individually to each boss.

 

▶ Reward Rework

- Following the Workshop of Brilliant Light rework, the reward lineup for each challenge difficulty has been renewed.

※ Detailed reward lists and drop rates for each renewed stage can be checked on the Workshop of Brilliant Light screen in-game.

 

📌 Sung Jinwoo New Job Change Added

- Sung Jinwoo’s new Job Change, [The Monarch of Shadows: Vanquisher], has been added. The conditions and rewards for the new Job Change are as follows:

Job Change Conditions

Job Change Rewards

- Clear Story Chapter 34 [Frost Army]

- Achieve Sung Jinwoo Job Change

 [The Monarch of Shadows: Executioner]

- Reach Sung Jinwoo Level 150

- Reach 1,200,000 Total Power with Sung Jinwoo

- New Costume 

[Shadow of the White Night]

- Combat Power Increase

- Stat Points

 

📌 Max Level & Activity Funds Expansion

 - The Player max level has been expanded, and the Hunter's maximum Resonance level has been expanded alongside it.

 - Sung Jinwoo level milestone rewards, maximum Activity Fund tiers, and maximum Gate difficulties have been expanded.

 - Following the Hunter Resonance level expansion, Hunter level milestone rewards (Lv. 160) under the Bonds section have been newly added.

📌 Max Reputation Level Expansion

-The maximum Reputation level has been expanded from Lv. 150 to Lv. 200, and rewards can be obtained upon leveling up.

 

📌 New Successor 'Monarch of Shadows' Added

- The Successor 'Monarch of Shadows' has been added.

- The profile icon, Secret Files, Codex entry, and Original Story for the Successor 'Monarch of Shadows' have been added.

- The Successor 'Monarch of Shadows' can be obtained through the [Monarch of Shadows Crafting Event], and growth materials for Successor advancement can be obtained through the permanent event draw [Monarch of Shadows: Special Draw].

📌 New SSR Hunter & Exclusive Weapon Added

- The SSR Fire-element Supporter Hunter [Yerim Jung] and her exclusive weapon [Radiant Seal] have been added.

- The new Hunter can be obtained through Rate Up Draw and tested beforehand in Hunter Preview.

- The exclusive weapon can be obtained through crafting or events.

- Profile icons, Secret Files, Codex entries, and Bonds for the new Hunter have been added.

- Yerim Jung's Original Story has been added.

📌 New Costumes & Skins Added

 - New costumes for Hunters and Weapons have been added.

 - New costumes can be obtained through product purchases, events, and other methods.

※ Costumes can be equipped by tapping the hanger icon on the Hunter Info screen.

 - 3 color chromas have been added for Yerim Jung and Meri Laine's costumes.

※ The 'Unbreakable Steel & Silver Moon' skin for Soma & Asura can be viewed and purchased after purchasing the prerequisite item, the 'Golden Wolf's Roar' skin for Winchester Roke.

 

 

 

📌 On-going Events

- Various in-game events will take place after the 7/30 update. Please refer to the event notice links below for more details.

[Jung Yerim Debut Celebration! Rate Up Draw & 2 Events]

[The Monarch of Shadows Special Draw Event]

[Monarch of Shadows Crafting Event]

[Midsummer Mermaid Mayhem! Event]

[Summer! Treasure Hunt Event]

 

📌 Event Weapon Crafting Notice

- During the update period, event crafting for Sung Jinwoo Weapons [Soma & Asura] and [Moonlit Gale] will be available.

※ Each weapon can be crafted up to a maximum of 2 times per account by consuming Special Player’s Weapon Designs.

 

 

 

📌 Balance Adjustments [Go]

 - Balance adjustments will be applied to the set effects of certain Hunters and Artifacts.

※ Detailed information can be found in a separate notice.

 

📌 Draw & Exchange Lineup Additions

▶ Custom Draw / Special Scout Draw / Association Special Certification Exchange Lineup Additions

 - SSR Liu Zhigang has been added to the Custom Draw, Special Scout Draw, and Association Special Certification Exchange lineups, and can now be selected in the Rate Up list.

※ New Rate Up Hunters may be added to the Custom Draw list in the future.

※ For Special Scout Draw, the new addition will apply to Special Scout draws opened after August 1, 00:00 (UTC+0).

 

📌 Trial of the Strong New Season Notice

▶ Edge of Illusion and Dreams

- A new season of Edge of Illusion and Dreams will begin, and the boss will change to 'The Architect, Master of the System'.

  'The Architect, Master of the System' will be played in Sung Jinwoo Mode, and its elemental weakness will be updated.

 

▶ Architect's Test

- A new season of Architect's Test will begin, featuring newly applied Architect Rules and elemental strengths/weaknesses based on the Trial Level.

※ Please check in-game for detailed rules.

 

📌 Hunters Association Weekly Missions Improvements & Changes

- To offer a smoother combat experience in Team Fight Mode, ultimate skill animations for Buster and Striker classes in Power of Calamity and Guild Boss content will be simplified.

 

▶ Power of Calamity

- A new season of Power of Calamity will begin, with the boss changing to 'Cthulli'.

- Until the next season, the recommended elements will be fixed to Dark and Fire, and Conquest Support will be newly applied.

- The entry flow will be improved to allow for a smoother selection and progression of Conquest Support.

- In the event of a tie in Power of Calamity season points, ranking calculations will be improved so that Hunters with a higher total score during the season receive the higher rank.

- The amount of Conquest Coins distributed based on weekly Power of Calamity rankings will be adjusted, and additional Conquest Coins will be awarded in proportion to the total score obtained.

 

▶ Guild Boss

- Until the next regular update, the Guild Boss will be set to 'Ant Queen'.

- Until the next season, the recommended element will be fixed to Dark, with Fire, Water, Wind, and Light elements additionally added in sequential order depending on the week.

- The Guild Boss's level and certain stats will be adjusted, and required score thresholds per Rage count will be changed.

- Guild Boss Rage rewards will be increased in accordance with the revised score thresholds per Enrage count.

※ Even if your score is higher than before, the displayed Rage count may appear lower; however, the actual rewards received have been increased compared to before.

- Required Enrage count thresholds for Guild Boss Total War ranking rewards will be lowered.

- Through the Guild Skill revamp, previous elemental damage boost skills will be consolidated into an 'All Elemental Damage Increase' buff, and new Guild Boss-related skills will be added.

 

 

 

📌 New In-Game Shop Item Sales Notice

- New items will be added to the shops below after the update. For details regarding the items sold in the new shop, please check the item sales notice below.

 [Go to 7/30(Thu) New Packages]

 

 

 

📌 Other Improvements

- An expansion feature for Sung Jinwoo's Artifact Preset slots has been added, allowing you to expand up to 4 preset slots using Essence Stones.

- A new boss and special commission have been added to the Mind Rift.

- Screen animations when there is no data to display on the ranking page have been smoothly improved.

- System mail notifications have been added to inform you when guild join requests are approved or when Guild Master permissions are transferred.

- A Bulk Weapon Level Up feature has been added, allowing you to conveniently level up multiple owned weapons at once.

- Improvements have been made so that time-limited tickets are prioritized when performing an Artifact Enhancement Reset.

- The Auto-Combat AI for the Buster class has been improved.

- The QTE skill icon in Successor of the White Flames Myro’s skill info screen has been changed to an orange color palette.

(Updated on 7/31 (Fri) 06:18(UTC+0))

- The Low Graphics Optimization setting has been excluded from the July update due to identified issues. It will be applied in a future update following thorough verification.

- To provide a smoother and more comfortable gameplay experience on mobile environments, a new graphics optimization option has been added exclusively for the mobile version.

You can manually toggle the 'Apply Low-Spec Resources' setting based on your device specifications via the [Options] - [Graphics] menu.

※ Upon a fresh installation, low-spec devices will have low-spec resources applied by default.

※ For existing Hunters, a pop-up notice upon logging into the game will allow you to switch to low-spec resources.

However, please note that once switched, the option to revert back to standard resources will not be provided.

※ When low-spec resources are applied, the appearance of certain characters and costumes may look different.

 

📌 Bug Fixes

- Fixed an issue where the [Intrusive] debuff effect intermittently failed to stack when using Lee Bora's Basic Skill 1 consecutively.

- Fixed an issue where rewards were intermittently not displayed on the stage clear result screen when network latency occurred in the Workshop of Brilliant Light.

※ This was a visual display error only; actual rewards were distributed normally.

- Fixed an issue where weekly mission rewards intermittently could not be claimed after completing the missions.

- Fixed an issue where the advancement notification effect was incorrectly displayed on the Quick Menu when owning a 10-Advancement weapon alongside two or more duplicate weapons.

- Fixed an issue in the Workshop of Brilliant Light (Legia Easy) 'Sealed Primordial Lungs (Sung Jinwoo Mode)' where pattern resolution was intermittently delayed when using the tornado mechanic.

 

 

We will continue to do our best to provide you with the best possible service.

 

Thank you.

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Notes: A Preview of New Challenges & Metas (Edited on 8/14 06:56 (UTC+0))

Hunters Association
|
Aug 7, 2026, 06:00
|
21,919

 

Hello, Hunters!

This is the Solo Leveling:ARISE team.

 

Are you enjoying playing as the Monarch of Shadows, who joined as the Dark-attribute Successor on July 30th? Today, we would like to share news about the upcoming August update following the Monarch of Shadows, as well as content to be revealed afterward.

 

From the newly joining Hunter and Sung Jinwoo's weapon to upcoming content and the ranking system revamp—we will now guide you through the news we have prepared so that Hunters can enjoy playing even more this summer.

 

 

[A New Challenge Beyond the Workshop of Brilliant Light, Hall of the Monarchs]

 

Until now, the content that welcomed Hunters focused on strategizing by changing the attributes and combinations of Hunters and weapons against different bosses and monsters.

 

As variations continued within the same framework, we believe some of you may have felt disappointed by the repetitive flow at some point.

 

Accordingly, our team pondered content that could design the challenge itself anew, going beyond mere changes in combinations, and we would like to reveal it through this update.

 

 

 

The 'Hall of the Monarchs', unlocked for Hunters who have cleared Tier 10 of the Workshop of Brilliant Light, is content where you do not follow a fixed strategy, but rather select restriction effects yourself to combine your own difficulty and strategy methods.

 

For example, you can challenge yourself to an extreme speed clear by selecting 'increased enemy attack power/HP' and 'time limit applied' restrictions together, or conversely, aim for extreme evasion by selecting the 'reduced recovery' restriction. The categories of restrictions consist of common restrictions, boss-specific restrictions, and seasonal restrictions, so you will be able to feel a different tension and thrill every time, even when facing the same boss.

 

Additionally, bosses will be randomly matched each season in the 'Hall of the Monarchs,' and in the first season, you can challenge Surtur, Vulcan, and Yogumunt. As the Hall of the Monarchs establishes itself as a new challenge-type content, the balance of the Workshop of Brilliant Light will also be adjusted so that many Hunters can enjoy it. The first season of the 'Hall of the Monarchs' will run for two weeks starting September 3, and the weakness attributes will be Water and Light.

 

We plan to prepare special honorary rewards for top-performing Hunters in the 'Hall of the Monarchs,' and detailed information will be provided through a separate notice in the future. We ask for your interest in this newly added challenge-type content, and we hope you enjoy playing with new strategies.

 

 

 [4-Hunter Team Fight Mode]

 

Meanwhile, while the 'Hall of the Monarchs' is content designed with a completely new way of challenging players, our team believes that the fun of team composition is also an indispensable element of 'Solo Leveling:ARISE.' However, there were limitations with the current compositions, which led our team to ask one question.

'Why can we only form teams of three?'

 

We put a lot of thought into this question and decided to break away from the long-standing framework of 3-Hunter compositions to design content featuring 4-Hunter compositions.

 

The 4-Hunter Team Fight Mode is content where you research and tackle challenges with the optimal 4-Hunter composition tailored to your deck, choosing from Striker, Supporter, Breaker, Stacker, and Buster class Hunters. 

 

Since it basically takes the form of a team fight, four Hunters fight simultaneously, and when you switch Hunters, you join the battle as the selected Hunter. In line with this mode, we also plan to introduce a new combat system featuring joint attacks created by the four Hunters together.

 

We will do our best to showcase this content as soon as it is ready, and detailed information, including our 4Q update direction, will be provided during the Developer Live Stream in August.

 

※ Please note that some update details may be subject to change upon the actual release.

 

 

[Ranking System Revamp Notice]

 

Recently, along with issues regarding story progression, we have reviewed the various feedback you have sent us about the Trophy Ranking system.

 

Although the current Trophy Ranking is not tied to direct rewards, we are aware that many Hunters consider it important. However, while story progression has previously been one of the elements symbolizing a Hunter's strength, our adjustments to the progression system to allow players to enjoy the story without stress have turned the Trophy Ranking at the time of a story update into an indicator closer to "who logged in first and played quickly," causing it to function differently from its original intent.

 

Therefore, our team intends to gradually improve the ranking system into a format that more clearly showcases the strength Hunters have built up over time and allows for comebacks.

 

1)    The existing Trophy Ranking will end with the August update. However, the weekly Essence Stone rewards based on the number of trophies held will remain unchanged.

2)    A new ranking system based on Power will be added within the year so that Hunters' growth can be fully reflected.

 

We will provide detailed information on the rewards for the new ranking system once they are ready, and we will continue to listen to your feedback to refine the ranking system.

 

※ Due to the revamp of the ranking system, "Edge of Illusion and Dreams" will run as the seasonal content instead of "Battlefield of Time" for the August update. Detailed information regarding "Battlefield of Time" will be provided in the October update.

 

 

[The 2nd Memorial Hunter: Light-Attribute Buster, Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth]

 

 

 

 

Within the time wound back by the Rulers using the 'Cup of Reincarnation,' there exists a world of Hunters living lives similar to, yet slightly different from, the present.

 

Through social media, we previously revealed the colors of the Memorial and Original versions of the Hunter arriving in August. Did anyone guess which Hunter would appear in what form just by looking at the colors?

 

'Lee Joohee,' who was greatly loved in the original work, is coming to visit Hunters in the form of another world. ‘Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth' is a Hunter who, driven by regret over failing to protect her loved ones, fights at the very front as if burning herself out just to save people.

 

In battle, her Basic Skills and Core Attacks trigger additional attacks, and as this effect stacks, the power of her Buster Skill increases. We expect her to show particularly great synergy when paired with Laura Walker and Shimizu Akari, whose balance is being adjusted this time.

 

The Light-attribute Buster ' Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth' will debut as an Attack-scaling Hunter.

 

 

[New Sung Jinwoo Weapon, 'Spirit Blade: Blizzard']

 

 

Introducing the Water-attribute stacking weapon, 'Spirit Blade: Blizzard'.

 

'Spirit Blade: Blizzard' is a blade infused with the soul of an ice fox that guarded a snowfield where winter has not ended for hundreds of years. By swinging the scabbard and sword in a cross motion, it freezes a wide area in front. 

 

It enhances the damage of all of Sung Jinwoo's skills that can trigger a freeze effect, and significantly strengthens the weapon's skills when those skills are used a certain number of times.

 

It is expected to become a new option for Water-attribute Sung Jinwoo weapon combinations by showing particularly good synergy with Sung Jinwoo's weapon 'Skadi', which is also undergoing balance adjustments this time.

 

 

[Balance Adjustment]

 

Through this update, we will broadly adjust the balance of Hunters, Sung Jinwoo's weapons, and Artifact effects. The adjustments will focus on buffs so that neglected Hunters and weapons can shine again, and so that players can equip class-appropriate Artifacts in team fight modes. Some changes will go beyond simple numerical adjustments and include near-rework level transformations.

 

In particular, through this adjustment, Shimizu Akari will be revamped to synergize well with Light-attribute busters, and Skadi will play a meaningful role as a weapon specialized in Water-attribute Overload damage.

 

Target Hunter

Key Adjustment Details

Shimizu Akari

● Newly applied Unhealable effect to [Ring of Fire] [Divine Flame] newly applies Recovery Block effect, and the restriction preventing [Divine Flame] from being applied to [Ring of Fire] has been removed. (※ Edited on 8/14 06:56 (UTC+0))

● Added effects to increase Burst damage and Burst damage accumulation rate

● Increased values for HP, shields received by [Light-attribute] team members, damage dealt, and other effects

Antoine Martinez

● Extended the duration of key buffs such as [Blessed Light], [Harmony], and [Karma]

● Adjusted the exclusive weapon's Light damage increase to apply as a team-wide buff and increased its value

Laura Walker

● Added an effect that increases damage dealt for each Light-attribute ally

● Increased HP, Power Gauge recovery efficiency, and damage dealt values

 

Target Sung Jinwoo Weapon

Key Adjustment Details

Skadi

● Changed the damage of [Last Hunt] to be classified as Normal Skill damage

● Significantly increased the values of key effects, including [Skadi's Domain] damage

● Applied an effect to [Skadi's Curse] that increases Water-attribute Overload damage taken

Winterfang

● Increased the value of the [Isolation] effect upon reaching Tier 5

Demonic Plum Flower Sword

● Added a skill enhancement effect for [Plum Flower: Swift Flight] to the [Full Bloom] effect

(Added 8/14 06:56) * The balance adjustment plan for the Demonic Plum Flower Sword has changed, and further details will be provided once the timing is finalized.

Transfiguration Key

● Increased the attribute infusion amount for Basic Attacks and Core Attacks

Winchester Roke

● Instantly activates Core Attack when performing a Basic Attack while equipping two Dark-attribute weapons

Moonlit Gale

● Added a Core Gauge recovery effect when using [Lunar Wind]

● Increased elemental infusion amount for Basic Attacks and Core Attacks

 

In addition, the Team Fight mode-exclusive effects of Artifacts will also be buffed. To ensure that equipping Artifacts matching one's class in Team Fight mode provides greater benefits, the class-exclusive effects of all sets will be enhanced.

 

Target Artifact Set

Team Fight Mode-Exclusive Effect Buffs

The Architect's Blue Poison

● When equipped by Sung Jinwoo or a Striker class, the ally damage increase effect is greatly buffed

Glorious Arrogance

● When equipped by a Breaker class, the ally Critical Damage increase effect is greatly buffed

Noble Flesh

● When equipped by a Supporter class, the ally Attack, Defense, and HP increase effects are greatly buffed

Kamish's Obsession

● When equipped by a Stacker class, the ally Overload damage increase effect is greatly buffed

Surtur's Flame

● When equipped by a Buster class, the ally elemental weakness damage increase effect is slightly buffed

Furthermore, for the Surtur's Flame set, the basic effect of 'increased Burst damage stacking effect upon successful Overload' will be split into '1) increased Burst damage, and 2) increased Burst damage stacking effect upon successful Overload' to improve usability and secure a higher damage floor for Busters.

 

※ Detailed adjustment values will be provided in a future patch note.

 

 

[Laura Walker’s New Costume]

Unveiling Laura Walker's new look, ready to spend a sweet summer night with you, Hunters!

 

 

 

[Other Improvements]

 

Our team has also prepared various improvements so that Hunters can focus on playing in a more comfortable environment.

 

■ Workshop of Brilliant Light New Season Operation

This Workshop of Brilliant Light will run in the order of Season 3: Rockpasa, followed by Season 4: Legia. Season 4: Legia is scheduled to run for only one week due to the update schedule. Additionally, all elements will be weakness elements for Stages 1–5, and Water/Light will be the weakness elements starting from Stage 6.

 

■ Successor Auto Mode Improvements

We have improved the Successor Auto-Play system so skills are now used based on the recommended combo sequence.

 

■ Additional Hunters for Ultimate Skill Simplification

Through this update, we plan to simplify the Ultimate Skills of the following Hunters in Guild Boss and Power of Calamity.

 

- Yoo Soo-Hyun, Esil Radiru, Gina, Jeong Yerim, Pure Sword Princess Cha Hae-In, Seorin, Elena Renault, Alicia Blanche, Meilin Fisher, Niermann, Mirei, Goto Ryuji, Sung Jin-Ah, Han Se-Mi, Thomas Andre, Cha Hae-In, Go Gun-Hee, Laura Walker, Shimizu Akari, Min Byung-Gu, Sung Il-Hwan, Song Ki-Hoon, Lee Bora, Isla Wright, Silver Mane Baek Yoon-Ho

 

※ Please note that newly added Hunters will arrive with ultimate skill animation simplification already applied for Guild Boss and Power of Calamity content.

 

■ Simulation Gate Floor Expansion

The Simulation Gate will be expanded from Floor 55 to Floor 60.

 

※ The details and numbers covered in the Developer's Note are currently under development and may be partially changed during the actual update.

 

 

Starting with Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth and Spirit Blade: Blizzard, all the way to Hall of the Monarchs and the 4-Player Team Fight Mode—we will continue preparing a wide variety of content so that all of our Hunters can fully enjoy their time this summer.

 

We are deeply grateful for the incredible love and support you’ve been sending us, and our team is currently hard at work preparing for our 2.5-Year Anniversary.

 

We are working on various updates to deliver a unique kind of fun and challenging experience that only Solo Leveling:ARISE can offer. We are actively listening to your feedback through various channels and making continuous improvements based on what you share with us, so please stay tuned!

 

During the upcoming live stream in August, we’ll be able to give you a sneak peek into some of these exciting plans. We will always do our best to repay your support with an even more enjoyable game and spectacular action.

 

Thank you.

 

 

[Developer's Note Surprise Gift]

Redeem Code

- Solo Leveling:ARISE Team -

8/27 (Thu) Update Details (Updated on 9/1(Tue) 08:00 (UTC+0))

Hunters Association

Aug 27, 2026, 02:00

18,330

 

Greetings Hunters,
The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

Here are the details scheduled to be added and changed through the update on 8/27 (Thu).

Please see below for more details about the update.
 

📢8/27 (Thu) Update Details

📌 New Main Story Chapters
▶ Hidden Chapters 11 & 12 Hard / Reverse Hard Difficulty Added
- Hard and Reverse Hard difficulties have been added for Hidden Chapters 11 and 12, which were introduced in the July 30 update.
※ Cumulative Battle Mission completion rewards for Reverse Hard difficulties have been added alongside the new story content.

📌 New Content: Hall of Monarchs
- The new challenge mode 'Hall of Monarchs' has been added.
- Hall of Monarchs unlocks upon clearing Stage 10 of the Workshop of Brilliant Light (Sung Jinwoo Mode). It can be accessed via the 'Trial of the Strong' tab in the Content Menu.
- Entering Hall of Monarchs requires no currency, allowing you to challenge it repeatedly at any time.
- Hall of Monarchs operates on a 2-week seasonal system and consists of 3 Gates in total. Clearing the first Gate unlocks the next, allowing you to clear them sequentially and earn scores.
※First BETA Season 1 of Hall of Monarchs begins on 9/3, 00:00 (UTC+0).
 - Each Gate features one of the bosses previously encountered in the Workshop of Brilliant Light, with bosses rotating randomly each season.

▶ Proof of Mastery System
- A feature that allows you to adjust the difficulty by selecting constraints when attempting a Gate. Choosing constraints yields higher scores, while attempting a Gate without selecting any constraints grants the baseline score.

▶ Ranking Rewards

- You can obtain special Frames and Titles based on your achieved rank when the Hall of Monarchs season ends.
- Rewards are available up to Rank D. Please check in-game for more details.
※Hall of Monarchs rewards are subject to change each season.

📌 New Sung Jinwoo Weapon Added
▶ New Custom Draw / Weapon Custom Draw Weapon
- Sung Jinwoo's exclusive SSR Water weapon, [Spirit Blade: Snowstorm], has been added.
- This weapon can be obtained through Custom Draw, Weapon Custom Draw, and Special Scout.

Spirit Blade: Snowstorm

 

 

📌 New SSR Hunter & Exclusive Weapon
- SSR Light Buster [Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth] and her exclusive weapon, [Guide of the Blessed Light], have been added.
- The new Hunter can be obtained via Rate-Up Draw and can be trialed in advance through Hunter Preview.
- Her exclusive weapon can be obtained through crafting or events.
- Profile Icon, Secret Files, Codex, and Bond entries for the new Hunter have been added.
- Original Story content for Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth has been added.
 

Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth

📌 New Costumes Added
 - New skins/costumes for Hunters and weapons have been added.
 - New costumes can be obtained through shop purchases and events.
※ Costumes can be equipped by tapping the hanger icon on the Hunter Information screen.
 - 3 color chroma options have been added for Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth's costume.

📌 On-going Events
- Various in-game events will take place after the 8/27 update. Please refer to the event notice links below for more details.
[Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth Debut Celebration! Rate Up Draw & Advancement Event]
[At the Seasonal Crossroads! 2 Events]

 

📌 Balance Adjustments [Go]
 - Balance adjustments will be applied to the set effects of certain Hunters and Artifacts.
※ Detailed information can be found in a separate notice.

📌 Draw & Exchange Lineup Additions
▶ Custom Draw / Special Scout Draw / Association Special Certification Exchange Lineup Additions
 - SSR Agnes Rivera has been added to the Custom Draw, Special Scout Draw, and Association Special Certification Exchange lineups, and can now be selected in the Rate Up list.
※ New Rate Up Hunters may be added to the Custom Draw list in the future.
※ For Special Scout Draw, the new addition will apply to Special Scout draws opened after 9/1, 00:00 (UTC+0).

📌 Server Ranking System Retired
- To provide a better gaming experience, server ranking features—including the Battle Mission Trophy Ranking, which was primarily driven by content completion speed—have been removed.
- Weekly rewards based on total Battle Mission Trophies will remain intact and can be checked and claimed on the Sung Jinwoo Level Achievement Rewards page.

📌 Trial of the Strong New Season Notice
- For this update season, Battlefield of Time will not open due to content overhaul work, and a new season of Battlefield of Trials will continue in its place.

▶ Edge of Illusion and Dreams
- A new season begins, and the featured boss changes to 'Resist Kamish'.
  This boss battle is played in Hunter Mode, and its elemental weakness has been updated.

▶ The Overseer's Forbidden Library
-  A new season of The Overseer's Forbidden Library begins, with updates to allowed entry attributes, featured bosses, and Bookmark Hunters.
※ Please check in-game for detailed rules and further information.

📌 Hunters Association Weekly Missions Improvements & Changes
- Ultimate skill animations for select Striker, Breaker, and Supporter Hunters have been simplified to ensure smoother combat in content where Team Fight mode applies (Power of Calamity, Guild Boss).

▶ Simulation Gate Higher Difficulty Added
- A new season of Simulation Gate begins, featuring updated elemental weaknesses and algorithms.
- The maximum difficulty for Simulation Gate has been expanded from Stage 55 to Stage 60.
※ You can skip lower stages to challenge higher difficulties directly. Clearing a higher stage will automatically mark all lower-stage challenges as completed.

▶ Power of Calamity
- A new season begins, and the boss changes to 'Kamish'‘Ennio’. (※Edited on 8/27 02:46(UTC+0))
- Until the next season, recommended elements change to Light and Water, and Conquest Support will be freshly applied.

▶ Guild Boss
- Until the next regular update, the Guild Boss will be set to the 'Giant Statue'.
- Until the next season, the primary recommended element is fixed to Light, with Water, Dark, and Fire attributes applied sequentially as additional recommendations.

▶ Workshop of Brilliant Light
- The new August update season will run in 2-week and 1-week intervals, with updates to bosses and elemental weaknesses.
- The difficulty of Workshop of Brilliant Light has been lowered: monster levels per stage are slightly reduced, and combat stat adjustments based on Combat Power differences have been improved in your favor.
- The damage dealt by certain boss monsters has been reduced.

 

📌 Update New Product Sales
- New products will be available for purchase following the update. For detailed information regarding the new products on sale, please check the notice link below:
[Go to 8/27(Thu) New Packages]

📌 System Shop New Products Added
- Following the 8/27 update, the following new product will be added to the System Shop:

Name

Dungeon Entry Key Support Pack

※ Chance Packs appear based on your gameplay progress, such as clearing content or upgrading weapons and Hunters, and can be purchased within a limited time once triggered.
※ Specific details for new Chance Packs can be checked in-game when the offer appears.
Payment methods vary by item type (Gold, Essence Stones, or direct purchase), so please double-check in-game before purchasing.

 

📌 Other Improvements
- The conditions for auto-equipping Hunter Cores have been improved to automatically equip recommended Cores first.
- The auto-battle AI for Successors and Buster-class Hunters has been improved.
- The combo guide will now be displayed when controlling a Successor in the Training Room.
- Entrance effects for certain Hunters when using Supporter Skills have been fixed to display correctly.
- The Guild EXP required to level up a Guild has been reduced.
- The duration of Sian Halat's [Scarlet Domination] effect has been increased to 40 seconds so it can be maintained in Team Fight mode. [Go to In-Game Balance Adjustments Notice]
- For certain devices, the default in-game UI settings have been adjusted to match the screen resolution. (※Added on  9/1(Tue) 08:00 (UTC+0))
- The default option checkbox settings for selecting multiple weapons at once have been updated.  (※Added on  9/1(Tue) 08:00 (UTC+0))
※To prevent unintended weapons from being selected during bulk weapon level-up or salvage, the system has been improved so that bulk selection is only activated when you manually check the Weapon Enhancement and Level options.

📌 Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where unpurchasable products were displayed in the Recommended Shop.
- Fixed an issue where the tag-out motion for 'Pure Sword Princess Cha Hae-In' was incorrectly linked.
- Fixed an issue where the Rumblefoot Ogre Boss would disappear when using certain skills.
- Fixed an issue where the clear mission count did not properly increase when sweeping the Workshop of Brilliant Light.
- Fixed an issue where the meta information display for boss Yogumunt differed from its actual effects.
- Fixed an issue on certain low-spec devices where damage dealt by 'Remnant Power' in the Training Room was not added to cumulative damage.
- Fixed an issue in the Sung Jinwoo Artifact Preset popup where Artifact information—such as tier, enchantment, and level—was not displayed.
- Fixed an issue where sound would intermittently loop when skipping videos in the Story Codex.

We will continue to do our best to provide you with the best possible service.

Thank you.

📢8/25 (Tue) Developer Live Stream Summary
※ Details regarding the 8/27 (Thu) update, in addition to the content covered in the live stream, will be provided through the update notice.
 

※ You can watch the video with subtitles in your preferred language by enabling the YouTube subtitle feature > Settings > Subtitles > Auto-translate, and then selecting the language.

[Dev Live Redeem Code]

N3W_W3AP

Weapon Custom Draw Ticket x20
Artifact Enhancement Reset Ticket x10
Hunter Exclusive Weapon Design x2
 

 

📌Developer Live Stream Key Highlights

▶ New Hunter - Light Buster 'Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth'
- Following 'Pure Sword Princess Cha Hae-In', the original 'Lee Joohee' arrives as a Memorial Hunter, presenting her appearance from another world.
 

- She is a Light Buster Hunter who scales with Attack. Using a prism as her weapon, her battle style features flashy action, including firing beam magic. Her combat mechanism works by inflicting extra hits and debuffs on enemies when Basic Skill 1 and Core Attack hit, while stacking buffs on herself to enhance Basic Skill 1 into a boosted skill for even greater damage.

- She synergizes well when paired with Shimizu Akari—whose balance is being buffed in this update—and Antoine Martinez, who fills the Stacker role among Light Hunters.

- Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth also retains the "Team MP Recovery Effect" possessed by her original SR counterpart, Lee Joohee.

▶ New Challenge Content - ‘Hall of Monarchs’
- A new challenge content for Hunters who have cleared the highest stage of the Workshop of Brilliant Light is added.
Unlike the Workshop of Brilliant Light, this challenge content allows Hunters to set their own difficulty by directly selecting constraints applied within the stage, combining various strategy styles.
 

Constraints & Difficulty
- Constraint categories are divided into Common Constraints, Boss-specific Constraints, and Season-specific Constraints. Utilizing these requires different strategic approaches even when facing the same boss, depending on the selected constraints.
For example, you can attempt a speed clear by selecting constraints such as "Increased Enemy ATK" or "Time Limit," or focus on dodging enemy attacks using the "Reduced Healing" constraint to build diverse clearing strategies.

-The default difficulty of Hall of Monarchs is set to the level of Stage 10 of the Workshop of Brilliant Light (renewed in the July 30 update), but the difficulty adjusts based on your constraint settings.
The existing Workshop of Brilliant Light difficulty is lowered in this update, allowing for easier gameplay.

- Applying fewer constraints adjusts the difficulty to a manageable level for players who've previously cleared the Workshop of Brilliant Light. Conversely, selecting more constraints increases your clear score, but significantly raises the difficulty.
The balance is not designed around selecting every single constraint. We recommend choosing constraints that fit your combat style to defeat bosses and achieve a suitable score.

Rewards & Season Schedule
- Your total score across all 3 stages determines your rank on the leaderboards, with special honor rewards like frames and titles awarded based on your ranking tier.

- Hall of Monarchs Season 1 kicks off on September 3 and runs for 2 weeks, featuring Water and Light as the first weak elements.
Please note that you must clear the highest stage of the Workshop of Brilliant Light to enter. Whenever higher stages are added to the Workshop in future updates, you'll need to clear the new highest stage to refresh your entry eligibility.

▶ New Sung Jinwoo Weapon - 'Spirit Blade: Snowstorm'
- A new Water weapon with a Water stacking effect for Sung Jinwoo.
 

- Using its scabbard and blade, it applies a Freeze effect to a wide area in front of you, and its core mechanics center on synergy that boosts the damage of Freeze-inflicting skills.
Even if enemies are immune to Freeze, skills that inflict Freeze will still benefit from the damage boost, allowing you to deal heavy damage even against bosses with Freeze Immunity.

- Unlike other attribute-infusing weapons, its weapon skill changes to an enhanced version during Overload, enabling even more powerful strikes and offering a distinct playstyle, such as utilizing weapon skills while in Overload.

- It pairs exceptionally well with Skadi, which is being rebalanced in the August update, making it a strong new choice for Water weapon builds.

▶ Hunter & Weapon Balance Adjustments

Hunters
- Shimizu Akari's main buffs, Divine Flame and Ring of Fire, have been reworked for better clarity. Unhealable and Overload Stacking effects have also been added, solidifying her role as a Light Buster-Supporter when paired with Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth.
- Additionally, Light Hunters: Antoine Martinez and Laura Walker are getting buffed.

Weapons
- Skadi gets the biggest overhaul, updated to synergize with Sung Jinwoo Weapon, Spirit Blade: Snowstorm:
 1. Last Hunt now counts as a Basic Skill instead of a Special Skill, allowing it to benefit from Basic Skill damage boosts.
 2. Skadi's Blessing now stacks up to 4 times when equipping two Water weapons.
 3. Skadi's Curse, which previously had no additional effect, now increases Water Overload damage.
- Additionally, Winterfang, Transfiguration Key, Winchester Roke, and Moonlit Gale are all getting buffed.

Artifacts
- Equipping 5 core artifact types for a specific class on a matching Hunter will grant additional enhanced effects in Team Fight Mode.

▶ Other Improvements & New Costume
Successor Auto-Battle Improvements
- Auto-battle for Successors has been updated to mirror the optimized skill rotations commonly used by Hunters, ensuring skills are executed in the recommended sequence.
 

New Laura Walker Costume
- Laura Walker's new costume, "Sweet Night," has been added. This costume is available with the Hunter Pass Deluxe.
 

▶ Future Update Direction
- Feedback like "I still care about the game, but I no longer have a reason to play hard" was a heavy wake-up call for us.

The fact that long-time players feel this way highlights a core issue: a lack of engaging content. We firmly believe that your effort should yield clear rewards, that the variety of challenging content should expand, and that growing stronger should feel genuinely meaningful.

To address these concerns, we plan to take the following direction.
 

1. Total Power Centered Rework & Restoring the Joy of Farming

Combat Power Advantage Rework
- Combat Power will no longer be a meaningless metric where clearing remains difficult even after exceeding the recommended requirements. We are fully reworking it to make TP a truly impactful stat.

Reaching or exceeding recommended TP will grant clear combat advantages, while under-geared attempts will feel noticeably challenging. We will also refine the TP difference display so players can clearly gauge their advantage or disadvantage in combat.

Ranking System Rework
- The current Trophy Ranking will transition into a TP and content-focused ranking system, giving Hunters a prestigious way to showcase their strength, supported by exclusive honor-based ranking rewards.

While Trophy Rankings are being retired, the Essence Stone rewards previously tied to them will still be distributed based on your total accumulated trophies as before. .

Farming Content Improvements
- We agree with your feedback that routine daily and weekly dungeons currently lack a sense of meaningful progression. We are restructuring these systems so that farmed materials directly contribute to your growth.

We will continue our efforts to reduce tedious grinding, while ensuring that end-game challenge content retains its thrilling, engaging nature.

Additionally, we are developing new growth systems to ensure both Sung Jinwoo and Hunters feel a continuous sense of progression. By providing more avenues to boost Combat Power, we aim to make the farming experience genuinely rewarding again.

2. Diverse Action Experiences
- Since most current content centers on solo clears with either Sung Jinwoo or a single Hunter focusing on raw damage, we are preparing new regular and event modes for our 2.5 Anniversary update, including 4-Hunter Team Fights and Infinite Relay Boss Challenges.

4-Hunter Team Fight - Deep Isolation Zone
- Similar to the 3-Hunter Team Fight introduced during the April Fools event, this mode features 4 Hunters fighting simultaneously on the field.
It introduces new combat mechanics, such as swapping Hunters dynamically to adjust to fight conditions, or triggering a joint combo attack once a specific gauge fills to temporarily neutralize enemies.

- Meeting certain conditions triggers special mechanics like mutant monsters or anomalous events that shift your tactical priorities. Designed so various party roles carry weight, this mode will offer rich strategic variety based on your team composition.

Infinite Relay Boss Challenge - Infinite Battlefield
- A challenge stage where players face waves of past elite monsters and bosses in sequence. Built to make you strongly feel the impact of your Combat Power, this mode serves as a benchmark for your growth while offering rewards to match your progress.

3. Guild Rework & QoL Improvements

Guild Rework
- Since current guild activities are limited to Guild Bosses, daily Check-Ins, and shop purchases, we are planning a comprehensive rework of the guild system following the 2.5 Anniversary update:

1. Joining a guild will directly increase your Total Power.
2. Guild buffs will be updated so individual members can select the specific buffs they want.
3. Discord integration will be added to facilitate better communication among guild members.
4  New cooperative content will be introduced alongside Guild Bosses.

- We are designing this so simply playing regular in-game content will naturally contribute to Guild Co-op progress.

QoL Improvements
- To streamline long story cutscenes, a cutscene speed-up option will be added (scheduled for September).
Simulation Gate auto-play features will be further refined to reduce required playtimes.
Detailed updates on these improvements will be shared in upcoming Developer Notes and future live streams.

📌 Q&A
Q. When will Diana Lopez, who appeared in the Story Hidden Chapter, be released?
 - We are currently preparing to release Diana Lopez through the upcoming September update.

Q. The difficulty of the newly reworked Workshop of Brilliant Light is too high.
 - As we prepare the new Hall of Monarchs content introduced in this update, we are lowering the difficulty of the Workshop of Brilliant Light, which serves as an entry requirement, so more Hunters can participate.
First, to ensure more Hunters can enjoy the Hall of Monarchs, we are adjusting the baseline difficulty of Workshop Stage 10, which was previously tuned around the top 1,000 to 3,000 players from the Hard Difficulty Clear event.
Second, we are adding bonus stats for Hunters who exceed the recommended Combat Power, making your growth feel more impactful. We also plan to further refine this bonus Combat Power system in the September update.

 Q. Please add Blessing Stones that synergize with specific artifacts so Sung Jinwoo can adapt to different roles.
 - We are actively discussing this internally and are currently brainstorming ideas.
First, we are preparing a Blessing Stone designed to synergize with the Architect Set, along with several other Blessing Stones offering various effects.
At the moment, we are prioritizing around 5 empowerment-type and 2 survival-type Blessing Stones. We will share more details through Developer Notes or a future live stream once development is complete.

 Q. Closing so many popup windows every time I log in is frustrating.
 - We completely agree that the popups upon logging in can be inconvenient.
To improve this, we are looking to tailor these popups to each Hunter's individual progress so that only essential information is displayed. We also plan to optimize the event tab to make checking key information much easier and more intuitive.

Q. What is the update cycle for main story chapters?
- We are doing our absolute best with schedule management to ensure new story content is updated approximately every 3 months.

Q. Some players feel that daily tasks are too short and there isn't enough content to play after logging in.
- For farming-focused dungeons, our goal is to maintain a manageable gameplay burden while providing challenging content for you to enjoy. We will work to regularly introduce engaging difficulty levels alongside suitable rewards to spark your drive for challenge.

Q. The renewal period for Battlefield of Time is taking too long.
- Improvement work is currently in progress. For content that is not functioning as intended, we are taking necessary time to revamp it so we can offer a fully refined version. We kindly ask for your patience a little longer.

Q. Please revert the changes that slowed down Rage buildup during Raids.
- The previous Rage system had a structure where values skyrocketed exponentially past a certain threshold. While our initial goal was to smooth out this sudden spike, we confirmed that Rage is currently building up lower than intended during the Ant Queen boss fight. We will adjust it back so it scales closely to previous levels.
Additionally, we are actively working on a fix to balance out the overall variance in Rage buildup across different bosses.

Q. When will artifact swapping convenience be improved? Equipping and unequipping piece by piece is tedious.
- While we generally recommend utilizing Artifact Presets, please note that the dev team is working to streamline the process as much as possible so Hunters won't have to swap Artifact sets as frequently.

Q. There isn't enough challenging content or meaningful rewards to motivate top-tier and paying players.
- We fully recognize that our diverse player base has different preferences. We are committed to developing a balanced mix of accessible content optimized for mobile devices and high-end endgame challenges that demand high Total Power. Our goal is to establish a solid core gameplay loop where your efforts yield worthy rewards and tangible progression.

- We take the frustration of our endgame Hunters very seriously. To address this, we are preparing high-difficulty content with meaningful rewards for upcoming major beats, such as the 2.5-Year Anniversary update.

Q. Are there any plans to adjust legacy Hunters so they can return to the current meta?
- We are actively exploring ways to bring older Hunters back into the current combat meta, and we will continue fine-tuning balance on a regular basis so a wider variety of Hunters can shine.
Since introducing entirely new classes can place a heavy burden on players, we are currently designing content where existing classes—like Strikers and Breakers—can be utilized effectively.

Q. When will Sung Jinwoo Mode be added to Simulation Gate?
- Although we experienced some delays during development, work is actively ongoing. As previously mentioned, we are preparing to release it within this year.

Q. When will "Kamish's Wrath" be released?
- We are aiming to launch it in November.

Q. Please add Hunters mentioned in the original work (like Jonas and Siddharth Bachchan) and Monarchs who appear as bosses as playable characters.
- If there are specific Hunters from the original work you’d like to see, please keep sharing your suggestions, and we’ll do our best to add them.
- Regarding plans for male Hunters from the original series, we are preparing stylish male characters for future updates. Characters like Siddharth Bachchan are indeed on our roadmap, and their development and release schedules will align with our internal timeline.
- As for making Monarch bosses playable, this is something we are thoroughly evaluating internally. However, building playable characters requires implementing entirely new skill sets and assets, which takes a fair amount of time. We will do our best to consider all possibilities.

Q. There’s a serious imbalance between how resources and Gold are earned vs. spent.
- While we boosted Gold gains to help newer players progress, we recognize this has created a surplus for endgame players and an overall imbalance across resources. We’re currently working on proper resource sinks and adjustments to get the economy back on track.

Q. Can we bring back 3 elements for Guild Bosses?
- We’re open to this and are looking into expanding the elemental line-up for Guild Bosses again.

Q. Sung Jinwoo's Ultimate feels pretty weak right now. Any buffs planned?
- We're working on an upgrade path for it through a new Rune Skill system.

Q. Edge of Illusion and Dreams difficulty is still tuned to combat power standards from launch. Please adjust it to fit the current meta.
- We are planning to retune the difficulty of Edge of Illusion and Dreams. However, if we bump up the difficulty too abruptly, it could lead to frustration for players who might suddenly find content they used to clear impossible. We're carefully finding the right middle ground to make the overall overhaul feel right.

Q. There are too many players abusing game systems. Can you take stricter action?
- Our team is constantly detecting and penalizing accounts showing suspicious behavior, but since abusers keep finding new ways around it, it's an issue we are constantly fighting to address. We will keep tightening our anti-abuse measures to ensure a fair environment.

Q. Any plans for new collaborations?
- Not for this year.

Q. You mentioned a Guild update is coming. Are there any plans to raise or uncapping the Guild EXP limit?
- We are planning to raise the Guild level cap as part of our 2.5-Year Anniversary Guild revamp. To help lower-level Guilds catch up, we'll also make it much faster for them to reach Level 30.

Q. Are there any new Alt (variant) characters in development?
- We're currently working on a new Alt version of a character who showcased incredible action in the original series, aiming for a release around the 2.5-Year Anniversary.

Q. Are there any plans to add dubbing in other languages, like Portuguese, alongside Korean, Japanese, and English?
- Unfortunately, adding more voice-over languages presents significant logistical challenges, so we don't have immediate plans for it. However, we'll make sure to discuss the possibility with our business team.

📌 Closing Remarks
Planning Team Lead Ryong-ku Kim: It's a great opportunity to connect with all of you again directly. We are working hard behind the scenes to deliver exciting new challenges, including the Hall of Monarchs. We hope you look forward to and take on the challenge when Hall of Monarchs Season 1 kicks off on September 3. As outlined today, we will make sure to deliver on these plans step by step through our upcoming updates.

Balance Lead Dong-Hyun Shin: We have shared a lot today, from Pilgrim of the Labyrinth Lee Joohee to the new weapon Spirit Blade: Snowstorm, as well as various Hunter and weapon balance adjustments. After the update, we hope you jump in to try the new Hunter and weapon, and experiment with various team compositions including the updated Shimizu Akari and Skadi for a fresh experience. As you try different playstyles, please feel free to leave us your feedback on any areas for improvement, and we will continuously review them to keep refining the game.

Executive Producer Seong-Keun Jin: Our team is working with a core principle to keep the game healthy over the long term. We deeply recognize where we fell short for our long-time Hunters and sincerely apologize. Moving forward, we will ensure that both long-time players and new Hunters feel supported and valued. We kindly ask for your continued interest and feedback, and we will do our best to reflect your thoughts in future updates.

 

 

Thank you.

Notice on Actions Taken Against Policy-Violating Accounts

Hunters Association
