484

 

Greetings Hunters,
The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

First and foremost, we sincerely apologize to all Hunters for the deep disappointment caused by issues regarding the use of unauthorized programs and proxy play in relation to the recent Hall of the Monarchs rankings.

We also deeply apologize for the confusion and distress caused by our insufficient guidance and lack of transparent disclosures regarding the situation.

We fully empathize with the frustration our Hunters are currently experiencing, and we would like to transparently share the status of our past actions as well as our direction for future measures.

 

📌 Reasons for Delayed Action and Announcement
As mentioned in our previous notice ([Go to Notice on Measures Taken Against Accounts Violating Terms of Service]), sanctions against caught proxy play were previously limited to 'warnings' and 'exclusion from rankings.' These measures were applied based on relaxed standards compared to our Terms of Service and Operational Policy, aiming to minimize any excessive inconvenience that users might experience.

However, while monitoring the current situation, we determined that the severity of the sanctions in the previous notice was too lenient relative to the seriousness of the issue. The announcement was delayed as we thoroughly reviewed and confirmed plans to apply stricter and higher enforcement standards.

We sincerely apologize once again for the delay in delivering timely announcements and swift measures as requested by our Hunters.

📌 Stricter Enforcement Standards

Based on the judgment outlined above, we will apply significantly stricter and stronger measures against proxy play and the use of unauthorized programs, strictly adhering to our Terms of Service and Operational Policy. 

Enhanced enforcement standards will take effect starting with these current measures, and detailed criteria will be clearly outlined in a separate announcement.

📌 Continuous Monitoring and Log Investigation Methods

We have been continuously tracking and penalizing the use of unauthorized programs based on content usage log data. Beyond unauthorized software, we have also identified and verified targets for sanctions through in-depth analysis of proxy play circumstances.

This covers a full-scale investigation including connection environments, combat setups, damage records, and all other play data, alongside reported cases.

As the newly introduced 'Hall of the Monarchs' is a feature where our Hunters' effort and competition are concentrated, we will strictly enforce sanctions for any abnormal gameplay moving forward based on detailed factual investigations, adhering to a zero-tolerance policy under our Terms of Service and Operational Policy.

📌 Disclosure of Sanctioned Accounts

Listening to our Hunters who have requested the disclosure of sanctioned accounts alongside enforcement details, we will transparently publish the list of sanctioned players moving forward. The list of accounts identified regarding the Hall of the Monarchs content since 9/3(Thu), can be reviewed at the bottom of this announcement.

📌 Schedule for Finalized Enforcement Criteria

To establish a fair competitive environment while minimizing potential side effects from stricter enforcement, we are currently developing enhanced criteria applicable across all services. Finalizing these standards requires thorough consideration of consumer protection regulations across various operating regions, which is taking additional time.
The detailed enforcement criteria will be finalized by 9/10 and shared through a follow-up announcement.

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: Back to the Roots of Progression

Hunters Association
|
Sep 15, 2026, 10:11
|
6,921

 

Greetings, Hunters
The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

We are carefully reviewing all of your support and honest feedback sent through various channels.
In particular, your opinions regarding Total Power and Rankings, as well as concerns about unfair gameplay such as using unauthorized programs and account sharing, have weighed heavily on us.

We will build a fair environment where Total Power is more than just a number and holds true meaning, and where rankings can shine through rightful effort.

Today, we have prepared news representing the results of that promise.
We would like to share the changes coming with the September Update and extending all the way to our 2.5th Anniversary.

 

Before diving into the details, we would like to sincerely apologize for adjusting the New Hunter Rate Up Celebration Events without sufficient prior communication.

This adjustment was part of our process to reorganize and revamp events that had overlap regarding new Hunter Rate Ups.

However, after hearing the voices of many Hunters who wished for the Rate Up celebration events to return, we have decided to resume them starting with this September Update. Both the event content and rewards will be provided at the same level as before. We once again apologize for the confusion and inconvenience caused during this process, and we will ensure better communication moving forward.
As a gesture of our apology, we will be delivering the following rewards to all Hunters. Please be sure to check them after the September Update!
 

Reward Details

Mailbox Expiration Date

Hunter Exclusive Weapon Design x12
Rate Up Draw Ticket x20

After maintenance on 9/17 (Thu) - 10/21 (Wed) 23:59 (UTC+0)

* Mailbox rewards can be claimed until 10/21 (Wed) 23:59 (UTC+0). Rewards will no longer be available once expired.

Now, we would like to present the prepared updates in detail.

[New Boss: Adan, the Monarch of Fangs]
 

Adan, the Monarch of Fangs who leads the beastly magical beast horde known as the Army of Fangs, makes his appearance in the Workshop of Brilliant Light and the Hall of Monarchs.

Starting in his black-haired humanoid form, Adan transforms into his white-haired humanoid form and eventually his beastly magical beast form as the battle progresses, drastically shifting the dynamics of combat.
 

Adan, the Monarch of Fangs, First Mechanic
 

Adan, the Monarch of Fangs, Second Mechanic
 

Adan, the Monarch of Fangs, Third Mechanic

In Phase 1 (Humanoid Form), Adan fires a barrage of projectiles before gathering power to charge forward; you must counter his attack with precise timing.

Upon entering Phase 2 (Beast Form), a series of button QTEs and a power struggle will begin. Winning the struggle will temporarily incapacitate him. When his HP drops below a certain threshold in Beast Form, Adan summons lightning strikes while gathering energy. If he fully charges his energy, he will heal and empower himself, so it is crucial to defeat him before the charge is complete.

Each phase features its own unique mechanics, and executing QTEs with precise timing to incapacitate Adan is the key to victory.

Adan, the Monarch of Fangs, will appear in the Workshop of Brilliant Light during Weeks 1–3, followed by Baran in Weeks 4–5.

Alongside the arrival of this new boss, the "Adan, the Monarch of Fangs Smash Event" will run concurrently. This event operates separately from the Workshop of Brilliant Light and can be challenged at any time without consuming Workshop Invitations.

Furthermore, to ease the pressure of previous first-come, first-served clear events that somewhat forced Hunters to rush high-difficulty content, we have improved the event structure. Clear rewards will now be granted to all Hunters who complete the challenge within the event period.

 

(Left) The Monarch of Fangs Smash Event Main Page / (Right) Smash Event Page
 

(Left) Week 1 Clear Reward / (Center) Week 2 Clear Reward / (Right) Week 3 Clear Reward

The difficulty will decrease as the weeks progress, allowing Hunters who join later to participate without feeling overwhelmed. The elemental weaknesses for this season of the Workshop of Brilliant Light are Wind and Dark, while lower difficulty levels can be played using all elements.

※Clearing Week 1 grants all rewards, while clearing Week 2 grants the rewards for Weeks 2 and 3.
※ Special rewards, including a special costume for Hunters who complete the clear, will be distributed following the October update.
※ Adan, the Monarch of Fangs, will also appear in the Hall of Monarchs during Weeks 4 and 5. His elemental weakness in the Hall of Monarchs is Dark.

[New Hunter, Diana Lopez]
 

Diana Lopez, a former Spanish soldier turned mercenary and the first Wind Buster, is joining the roster.

Diana Lopez is a Hunter who handles heavy weaponry. She places a target mark (Lock-On) on enemies struck by her skills and snipes marked targets with supersonic rounds. Upon using her Ultimate or specific skills, her Critical Hit Rate increases significantly, allowing her to finish off targets with a powerful Burst Skill the moment they break out of Wind Elemental Overload.

After losing all her subordinates to the Monarch of Fangs, Diana became a mercenary to hunt him down. She enters the battle as a Defense-scaling Hunter, and we highly recommend pairing her with Han Se-Mi and Sugimoto Reiji.

[Total Power: Making the Numbers Matter ]

We are closely reviewing your frustrations and concerns regarding cases where content remains uncleared despite significantly exceeding the Recommended Total Power, or where increasing Total Power does not result in a noticeable difference.
We strongly believe that Recommended Total Power must serve as a meaningful indicator felt directly in combat, and we would like to share our concrete plans for this direction in our upcoming update.
 

※ The image above is a conceptual example to aid understanding and actual values may differ upon the live update.

Going forward, exceeding the Recommended Total Power in any content will grant progressively stronger damage boosts, while falling short will incur clear damage penalties. 

 

Specifically, exceeding the requirement will be indicated by three shades of blue, and falling below will be shown in three shades of red, with the color intensity deepening based on the difference. This system allows you to instantly gauge your combat advantage in any content simply by checking the color.

 

In the Main Story, Unstable Dungeon, Battlefield of Chaos, and Mind Rift, the perceived difficulty will increase if your Total Power falls significantly below the recommended requirement. This measure is designed to prevent imbalances caused by clearing content at overly low Total Power levels and to establish a healthy gameplay environment where Total Power serves as an objective indicator of progression. (Other content will maintain the existing level of combat experience.)

※ Guild Bosses and Battlefield of Time are excluded from Total Power adjustments.
※ The degree of the 3 tiers above and below the Recommended Total Power will be applied differently for each content.
※ We will continuously monitor the perceived difficulty of select content to ensure smooth gameplay, and any necessary adjustments will be clearly announced in advance.

[Balance Adjustments]
With this update, we are making broad balance adjustments to Hunters and Sung Jinwoo's weapons. Underutilized Hunters and weapons will be buffed so they can shine in battle once again. In particular, this rebalance will revamp Han Se-Mi to create strong synergy with Wind Busters.

 

Target Hunters

Key Adjustment Directions

Han Se-Mi

Addition of Burst Damage and Burst Damage Accumulation Rate Increase effects

Addition of [Wind] Overload Damage, Critical Hit Rate, and Critical Hit Damage Increase effects

Increased duration of [Protection Zone]

Sugimoto Reiji

Additional inflictions of Wind Damage Taken and Wind Overload Damage Taken debuffs

Goto Ryuji

Enhancement of [Arrogance] buff effects

Additional inflictions of Defense Reduction and Damage Taken Increase debuffs upon landing [Devastate Prey]

Lennart Niermann

Addition of Wind Damage Increase effect per Wind Element ally

Defense Penetration stat increase

 

Target Weapons

Key Adjustment Directions

Demonic Plum Flower Sword

Damage increase for [Plum Flower: Swift Flight] skill

Addition of 7 new Blessing Stones (5 Empowerment types, 2 Survival types) to allow Sung Jin-Woo to perform his role with greater flexibility
 

Blessing Stone

Effect Summary

 

Master Marksman

Core Attack and Weapon Skill Damage increase

Core Attack and Weapon Skill Damage increase upon equipping Bow or Gun weapons

 

Do or Die

Attack Power % increase in exchange for receiving damage that ignores [Shield]

 

 

Supercharge

Overload Damage increase in exchange for reduced Element Accumulation effects

 

Iron Stance

Critical Hit Damage increase in exchange for increased Dash cooldown

Addition of 1 Dash charge restoration effect upon successful Extreme Evasion
 

 

Architect's Plan

Damage Increase upon equipping 8 pieces of [The Architect's Blue Poison]

Increase of Sung Jin-Woo's Damage Dealt and HP Recovery when equipping 8 pieces of [The Architect's Blue Poison] on a Striker in Sung Jin-Woo Mode

 

Spring of Life

HP recovery per second

Additional HP recovery per second when Vitality exceeds a certain threshold

 

Devour

HP recovery upon landing attacks

[Smoother Gameplay, Bigger Challenges]
We have prepared several QoL improvements so Hunters can focus on gameplay in a more comfortable environment.

■ Simplified Login Pop-ups
The multiple Check-in pop-ups displayed upon logging in will now be consolidated into one. Additionally, an simplified check option to skip or speed up reward claim animations will be added to streamline the process.    
 

Check-in events merged into a single pop-up / Tap each Check-in Event to view detailed rewards

■ Simulation Gate Improvements
QoL features have been improved to help Hunters focus on the core fun of the Simulation Gate.
 

1) Stage maps for each difficulty will be compressed from 11 stages to 8 stages.
2) A progress indicator will be added to clearly show your current stage location.

Additionally, we are preparing a fix for an issue where Hunters occasionally freeze during auto-combat in the Simulation Gate to make your runs even smoother.

Furthermore, we know many of you have been eagerly awaiting the Simulation Gate Sung Jinwoo Mode, which is currently undergoing further refinement. We sincerely apologize for the delay, as our efforts to deliver a unique and fresh gameplay experience took longer than anticipated. 

We are working to launch Sung Jinwoo Mode within this year, and the improved Sung Jinwoo Auto Mode will be applied alongside this update.

■ Higher Difficulty Tier Expansion for Select Content & Armory Page Expansion
To provide fresh challenges suited to your Total Power for Hunters who have already cleared the highest levels, we are expanding the higher difficulty tiers for select content along with upgraded rewards to match.
 

1) Battlefield of Trials expands from Floor 90 to Floor 100.
2) New Expert Story Chapters will be added.
3) Unstable Dungeon expands from Tier 35 to Tier 40. In these expanded tiers, Artifact Enhancement Reset Tickets will drop at a set rate to help improve your Artifact efficiency.
4) Battlefield of Chaos expands from Tier 20 to Tier 30, with Tier 5 Gems dropping at a set rate in the expanded tiers.
5) Mind Rift expands from Tier 10 to Tier 15, and the Core Level cap increases from Level 20 to Level 25. Materials required for Level 25 upgrades can be obtained in the expanded tiers.
 

(Left)Unstable Dungeon / (Center) Battlefield of Chaos / (Right) Mind Rift

However, simply expanding difficulty tiers and adding content to challenge is not enough. To help you reach the Total Power required for these higher tiers and to make use of benched Sung Jinwoo weapons, the Armory will expand from Page 3 to Page 5. Unlocking Armory slots will allow you to inherit Total Power from even more weapons.
※ The weekly exchange limit for Traces of Time required for slot growth will also be increased, with exact numbers to be detailed in an upcoming patch notice.

[2.5 Anniversary and Our Future Direction]
We have been closely listening to your voices across various communities as well as during our recent Developer Live Stream. We have taken comments such as "Total Power has become a meaningless number" and "I can no longer find a reason to keep playing like before."

These heartfelt messages showed us that even though our long-time Hunters still deeply care for the game, you are finding it difficult to stay motivated. We sincerely apologize for falling short of your expectations and causing concern, and we are truly grateful for your unwavering support. Starting with our 2.5 Anniversary, we would like to present the solutions we have been preparing to address these issues.

■ 2.5 Anniversary: Reframing the Core Gameplay Experience
1) Restoring the Meaning of Growth & Building a Fair Competitive Environment
We have reviewed your feedback that Total Power has gradually lost its meaning as a true reflection of your strength. Even after meeting the Recommended Total Power, clears remained unnecessarily challenging, and the lack of content to showcase your accumulated power left little motivation to compete. Coupled with repetitive farming routines, the core joy of progression itself has diminished.

Therefore, we intend to re-establish Total Power as the core standard for both content and rankings.

Beginning with the September update, we will implement an initial phase of advantages and penalties based on Total Power. Moving forward, we plan to restructure rankings into a comprehensive metric that incorporates Total Power alongside active gameplay, restoring the satisfaction of watching your growth bring meaningful changes.

While ranking rewards will primarily serve as symbols of honor, we plan to adjust the overall reward structure to provide tiered rewards based on actual progression and content clears.

Additionally, to foster an active environment where Hunters can grow and compete together, we are preparing new content, events, and ranking competitions that group Hunters with similar activity levels. We are structuring this to ensure that you can actively engage and compete regardless of the group you are assigned to, and further details will be announced as soon as they are finalized.

However, for these revamps to hold true meaning, trust in the ranking system must come first. We sincerely apologize once again for the concern caused by unfair play, such as the use of unauthorized programs and proxy playing. We do not take this matter lightly. As mentioned in previous notices, we will take strong action against unfair play to maintain a fair environment, and matters directly affecting ranking placements will be addressed promptly upon confirmation. That said, we kindly ask for your understanding, as the verification process may take time to ensure legitimate Hunters are not affected by false positives. We will continue to refine our abnormal play detection and enforcement measures moving forward.

  2) Delivering Thrilling Challenges and High-Octane Action with New Team Compositions
We have received extensive feedback regarding the lack of challenging content and how repetitive gameplay has dampened the fun. We deeply sympathize with your frustration that even after overcoming tough encounters, the rewards did not feel impactful enough, and that pushing your Total Power higher yielded little visible difference in performance.

Therefore, our goal is to introduce new content that captures the pure tension of a real challenge and delivers the exhilarating action of overcoming it. We are preparing content designed to explore the fun of combining Hunters across various classes, as well as modes focused on defeating continuous waves of bosses.
 
● Infinite Relay Boss Challenge (Working Title)
The Infinite Relay Boss Challenge is a new mode where players face a continuous lineup of dozens of iconic bosses from the original work. Defeating each boss extends your remaining time, allowing you to push further and endure longer with every clear.
You will earn rewards as you clear each milestone, with enhanced rewards available at specific threshold stages. This content will be pre-released as a special event mode in the 2.5 Anniversary update, and we hope for your active interest and support.

 

● Deep Containment Zone
Deep Containment Zone is a new team-fight mode where four Hunters battle together. Iconic bosses return as "Subjects," offering fresh combat experiences set within dynamic, evolving stage environments. For its initial update in October, Igris and Kargalgan are scheduled to appear in brand-new forms.

Additionally, a new combat feature tentatively named Union(Working Title) will be introduced, enabling same-element Hunters to join forces and trigger powerful elemental damage, with unique effects activating based on each Hunter's class role. Rather than relying on a single DPS Hunter, this content is designed to truly shine when all four Hunters coordinate their respective roles. We are thoroughly refining this mode so you can experience high-octane action and exhilarating gameplay with new Hunter compositions. Please stay tuned for further updates.

 

Deep Containment Zone: "Union" System Combat Gameplay
※ This content is currently under development and is subject to change upon official release.

 3) Creating Fun Experiences to Enjoy Together with Guild Members
In the original series, guilds were an essential element that provided Hunters with a sense of belonging and shared growth. However, guilds in Arise currently serve little purpose beyond Guild Boss content and the Exchange Shop. Attendance rewards feel largely symbolic due to their lack of impact, and because Guild Buffs are set solely by the Guild Leader, there have been few reasons to feel a strong sense of pride in one's guild.

Moving forward, our goal is to foster an environment where all members can enjoy the game together by gradually implementing improvements that give Hunters clear reasons to join a guild, stay active, and grow alongside their guildmates.

First, the initial phase of the Guild Revamp will arrive in October alongside the start of the 2.5 Anniversary. To foster an environment where daily attendance directly benefits the guild, Check-In rewards will be added based on the number of checked-in guild members.

Additionally, we are preparing a buff system revamp so that simply joining a guild grants a noticeable boost to your Total Power. Rather than being tied directly to the guild itself, the new Guild Buffs will scale with your personal growth and setup, ensuring you retain these benefits as long as you remain a member of any guild.

Alongside these changes, we will introduce QoL updates to streamline guild growth and management, including lower guild leveling requirements and integrated Discord links for each guild.

Following these updates through December, we plan to progressively roll out further improvements, including new co-op guild content, revamped Guild Exchange Shop rewards, and a Tutorial Guild system designed for new Hunters.

 Through this comprehensive guild revamp, we hope Hunters will find guild activities far more engaging, and we will continue refining the system to deliver an even more enjoyable guild experience. Further details will be shared in sequential notices as preparations are finalized.

■ Seasonal Card Collection (Working Title)
We are preparing a Seasonal Card Collection feature to replace the long-standing Special Commission. In this mode, players open card packs each season to collect cards and earn set rewards upon completing designated sets. 

 

To ensure cards obtained during a season do not go to waste, duplicate cards will be refunded as a dedicated currency that can be used to purchase higher-grade card packs. Card packs can be earned through gameplay, and completing sets or achieving collection milestones will grant various rewards, including Rate Up Draw Tickets, Essence Stones, and Dungeon Entry Keys.

The Seasonal Card Collection system focuses on the fun of collecting. We are designing it so that Hunters can earn collection rewards simply by participating consistently every day. As a content feature introduced to replace Special Commission, we will make sure to bring fresh enjoyment through gathering and completing sets. Further details will be announced in a separate notice once preparations are finalized.

■ Power of Calamity Revamp
Moving forward, Power of Calamity will be revamped beyond a mode that merely competes for top records. The new structure will more clearly display your growth and total damage milestones, granting clear rewards based on those achieved stages. The core direction of this revamp is to ensure that your steadily built Total Power translates directly into meaningful rewards.

Additionally, elemental restrictions will be improved, changing to an all-weakness elemental attribute setup. We hope you will enjoy breaking your personal high scores in line with your growth and elemental deck builds. We are also reviewing ways to shorten the time required per attempt so you can jump in for quicker, lighter challenges. Further details will be announced within the year once preparations are finalized.
 

Hunters, that is all the news we have prepared for today. While the September update may seem minor on the surface, we view it as the starting point for a major structural overhaul leading into our 2.5 Anniversary. 

We will fully commit to realizing the directions discussed today so that progression regains its purpose, rankings accurately reflect genuine effort, and playing together brings true enjoyment.

We will continue to actively communicate with you as we build the future of ARISE together, all the way toward our 3rd Anniversary.

Thank you as always for your continued support.

※Eligible Hunters: Seo Jiwoo, Esil Radiru, Lee Bora, Cha Haein, Amamiya Mirei, Emma Laurent, Min Byung-Gu, Baek Yoonho, Woo Jinchul, Lim Tae Gyu, Choi Jong-In, Alicia Blanche
- You can check this feature by tapping the [✂️] icon added below the Costume icon in the Hunter tab.

 

📌 On-going Events
- Various in-game events will take place after the 9/17 update. Please refer to the event notice links below for more details.
[Diana Lopez Debut Celebration! Rate Up Draw & 2 Events]
[Autumn! 3 Events]

📌 Event Weapon Crafting Notice
- During the update period, event crafting for Sung Jinwoo Weapons [Spirit Blade: Snowstorm] and [Moonlit Gale] will be available. (Edited on 9/18 01:21 (UTC+0))
※ Each weapon can be crafted up to a maximum of 2 times per account by consuming Special Player’s Weapon Designs.
 

📌 Recommended Total Power Color Display & System Improvements
- The damage calculation system has been improved so that the gap between your Total Power and the Recommended Total Power directly affects combat efficiency. Accordingly, the color display for each Total Power tier has been divided into 3 tiers for Exceeded and 3 tiers for Insufficient, allowing you to intuitively see combat advantages and disadvantages in battle.

▶ Exceeding Recommended Total Power
- When entering content with a Total Power higher than the Recommended Total Power, an increased damage bonus will be applied based on how much you exceed the requirement.

▶ Insufficient Recommended Total Power
- In Story, Unstable Dungeon, Battlefield of Chaos, and Mind Rift content, if your Power is significantly lower than the Recommended Power, a stronger penalty than before will be applied, increasing the overall perceived difficulty. (Other content will maintain the same penalty level as before.)
※ Damage is not affected by Recommended Power in Guild Boss and Battlefield of Time content.
※ The criteria for exceeding or falling short of Recommended Power varies depending on the content and Recommended Power level.

📌 Battle Class Expansion
- The Battle Class cap has been expanded from the previous maximum of Tier 120 up to Tier 150.
- Achievement rewards can be obtained upon reaching each tier.

📌 Balance Adjustments [Go]
 - Balance adjustments will be applied to the set effects of certain Hunters and Artifacts.
※ Detailed information can be found in a separate notice.

📌 Draw & Exchange Lineup Additions
▶ Custom Draw / Special Scout Draw / Association Special Certification Exchange Lineup Additions
 - SSR Jung Yerim has been added to the Custom Draw, Special Scout Draw, and Association Special Certification Exchange lineups, and can now be selected in the Rate Up list.
※ New Rate Up Hunters may be added to the Custom Draw list in the future.
※ For Special Scout Draw, the new addition will apply to Special Scout draws opened after October 1, 00:00 (UTC+0).

📌 New Armory Slots Added
- New Armory slots [Armory of Dominion 1–6] and [Armory of Dimensions 1–6] have been added.
※ [Armory of Dominion] slots unlock at Battle Class 75 or higher, and [Armory of Dimensions] slots unlock at Battle Class 105 or higher.

📌 Weekly Missions Improvements
- The category name "Hunters Association Weekly Missions" has been changed to "Weekly Missions" for convenience.

▶ Simulation Gate
- The number of Simulation Gate sectors has been reduced from 11 sectors to 8 sectors.
※ Score and stage rewards have been adjusted according to the sector reduction, while overall rewards remain at the same level as before.
- The weekly Memory Chip cap has been increased from 1,500 to 6,000.
- Exchange Shop item changes: LuminousPrism I and Luminous Prism II have been discontinued, and select Growth Reset Tickets have been added.

▶Power of Calamity
- A new season of Power of Calamity begins, and the boss changes to Cthulli.
- Recommended elements will be fixed to Wind and Dark until the next season, and Subjugation Support will be newly applied.

▶ Guild Boss
- The Guild Boss will be set to Manticore until the next regular update.
- The recommended element will be fixed to Wind until the next season, with additional recommended elements applied weekly in the order of Light, Dark, Fire, Water, and Dark.

📌 Season Missions Improvements & Changes
- The category name "Trial of the Strong" has been changed to "Seasonal Missions" for convenience.

▶ Hall of Monarchs
- A new season of Hall of Monarchs begins on October 8 at 00:00 (UTC+0), and season rewards have been updated.
※ Please check in game for detailed information on rewards.

▶ Edge of Illusion and Dreams
- A new season of Edge of Illusion and Dreams begins, and the appearing boss has been changed to “The Architect, Master of the System."
- "The Architect, Master of the System" progresses in Sung Jinwoo Mode, and its elemental weakness has been changed.

▶ Architect's Test
- A new season of Architect's Test begins, and Trial Levels have been expanded up to Level 8.
- Laws of the Architect as well as strength and weakness elements have been newly applied according to the Trial Levels in Architect's Test.
※ Please check in game for detailed information on specific rules and rewards.

 

📌 New In-Game Shop Item Sales Notice
- New items will be added to the shops below after the update. For details regarding the items sold in the new shop, please check the item sales notice below.
 [Go to 9/17(Thu) New Packages]

 

📌 Other Improvements
- Improved the Special Operation List so that featured Hunters now receive additional Total Power.
※ Bonus Total Power from the Special Operation List only applies to the Deployment screen and will not affect Hunter Info or Battle Class.
- Renamed the "Where Destinies Divide" category to "Companion Missions" for better clarity.
- Added obtainable reward preview text to content screens for Gates, Unstable Dungeon, Battlefield of Chaos, and Mind Rift.
- Streamlined Ultimate skill animations for all Hunters in Power of Calamity and Guild Boss content.
- Improved the Gate reward setup screen to display owned item quantities.
- Improved the Unstable Dungeon Artifact reward setup screen to display class icons.
- Updated trait details for select Story Stage bosses.
- Added an animation skip feature for Check In rewards and improved convenience by displaying all Check In and Monthly Subscription rewards in a single popup to reduce overall login popups.
- Added an Unstable Dungeon Clear Event for new Hunters, which unlocks upon clearing Main Story Chapter 5.
- Added a feature to toggle cutscene animations on or off during Auto Run in Main Story Normal difficulty.
- Improved the recommended combo skill order for select Hunters and Successors in the Training Room.
- Improved auto battle behavior so that dashes are automatically used during auto battle when included in select Hunter recommended combos.
- Increased the weekly purchase limit for SR Hunter Exclusive Weapon Designs in the Weapon Material Exchange Shop from 3 to 10 times per week.
- Increased the weekly purchase limit for Time Crystals in the Honor Token Exchange Shop from 5 to 7 times per week.
- Reduced the price of Chroma Costumes that share the same hair as the default costume from 1,500 Mana imbued Fabrics to 1,200 Mana imbued Fabrics.
Hunters who previously purchased these Chroma Costumes will receive a refund for the price difference.
Eligible Costumes: Min Byung-Gu: Nocturnal Grace (1), Cha Haein: Sunshine Spirit (3), Esil Radiru: The Buffet of Everyday Life (2)

📌 Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where specific Hunter models were displayed incorrectly when playing Guild Boss on select low end devices.
- Fixed an issue where the Super Armor buff was removed when a monster used an instant Break skill.
- Fixed an issue where the unlock condition text for Hall of Monarchs in the content guide popup was displayed as clearing Stage 0.
- Fixed an issue where the damage and elemental accumulation of Christopher Reed's Basic Skill 2 at Advancement Tier 0 to 4 were not functioning correctly.
- Fixed an issue where the tag timing to Sung Jinwoo was not applied as intended during SEMI Auto battle in Successor Mode.
- Fixed an issue where the Activity Funds tutorial intermittently could not be progressed.
- Fixed an issue where using select skills immediately after a dash with Lee Joohee, Pilgrim of the Labyrinth cast the skill toward the dash direction instead of the target.

We will continue to do our best to provide you with the best possible service.

Thank you.

918

 

Greetings Hunters,
The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

First and foremost, we sincerely apologize to all Hunters who experienced inconvenience regarding the Guild Boss Rage score issue following the September update.

This issue occurred due to a setting error during the process of converting Guild Boss damage into Rage scores for certain sections.
We have confirmed that abnormal scores were applied only within these specific thresholds, while normal Rage scores were properly reflected for sections beyond them.
※ Sections that should have been applied as 147 Rage were incorrectly displayed as 264.
※ Sections that should have been applied as 187 Rage were incorrectly displayed as 265.

※This issue was resolved via the data patch applied on 9/28 (Mon).
For more details, please refer to the notice below.
[Notice: Guild Boss Rage Score Fix and Normalization]

As previously announced, we are providing the patch schedule to normalize current season scores for the Guild Boss Rage issue, along with the results of our investigation into the full impact of the issue during Week 1 of the September update and the corresponding compensation plan.

Please refer to the details below for more information.

 

📌 Current Guild Boss Season Normalization Schedule & Action Details
[Normalization Schedule]
 - 9/30(Wed)06:50 ~ 07:50 Completed at 07:30 (UTC+0)

[Action Details]
Normalization of Rage records achieved within the issue-affected sections
Normalization of Guild Contribution Points obtained within the issue-affected sections

※Please note that Guild Boss content will be unavailable while the patch is being applied. We kindly ask for your generous understanding.
※The patch schedule is subject to change. Should any changes occur, we will inform you through an update to this announcement.

📌 Previous Season (9/17 - 9/24) Investigation Results & Compensation
▶ Scope of Investigation
- Number of players who achieved Rage within the issue-affected sections during the previous season: 223 Players
- Number of Guilds affected in All-Out Guild War and Group Rankings due to the Rage score issue: 214 Guilds
- Number of Guilds whose rank increased after the season ended due to this issue: 55 Guilds
- Number of Guilds that experienced this issue but saw no change in their rank: 159 Guilds
- Number of Guilds whose rank dropped during the previous season due to this issue: 62 Guilds (Eligible for Compensation)

▶ Compensation Eligibility & Details
Rewards will be sent to the in-game Mailbox for Hunters who meet the eligibility criteria for each category below, including the Guilds whose All-Out Guild War rankings were affected by the Guild Boss Rage score issue.

■ Individual Rewards

Eligibility

Rewards

Hunters who played the Guild Boss during the previous season (9/17 - 9/24) and achieved normal scores past the issue-affected score sections
(30,112 Hunters in total)

Season Gold rewards distributed based on the abnormally applied Rage counts

※As the Rage count of 147 was incorrectly applied as 264, and 187 was incorrectly applied as 265, additional compensation for Hunters who achieved 147 or more Rage counts will be calculated and distributed based on 265 Rage counts.

■ Guild Rewards

text_en:
Developer Notes

Developer Note: BEYOND (Edited on 10/15(Thu) 07:42 (UTC+0))

Hunters Association
|
Oct 12, 2026, 10:50
|
21,198

Greetings Hunters,
The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

It has been two and a half years since we first stood before the Gates alongside all of you, Hunters.
Clearing Gates, defeating Monarchs, and rising to challenge them once more after bitter defeats.
Every single one of those moments has shaped Solo Leveling:ARISE into what it is today.

Recently, Hunters have been engaging in fierce battles against our newest boss, the Monarch of Fangs, Adan.
Seeing even more Hunters step up to defeat Adan than during the First Come, First Served events for the Monarch of Steel, Rockpasa and the Monarch of Beginning Legia, has filled us with deep gratitude and reminded us of your unwavering passion for new challenges.
However, when we reflect on whether we have truly lived up to the intense passion and support you have shown us, we feel a deep sense of responsibility regarding the stern criticisms and voices you have shared recently.
 

We are taking each and every piece of feedback to heart, including painful critiques that while the game has become easier, it is difficult to feel the same sense of achievement as before, and that even after putting in immense effort to grow characters, the corresponding rewards and sense of fulfillment are not fully felt. To all Hunters who must have felt this disappointment more than anyone, we wish to present clear answers and a strong commitment to improvement starting with this 2.5th Anniversary.

 

"BEYOND — The Beginning of a New Battle Exceeding All Limits"
 

 

Moving forward, we will establish a fair environment where the power you have built leads to new challenges and even greater rewards, allowing you to experience growth and achievement well beyond current limits.
The 2.5th Anniversary update on October 22 will mark the next chapter of this promise and the starting point of a new battle.
 
To honor your passionate support and anticipation, we are pleased to present the full details of what we have prepared.
 

Before we begin, we would like to extend our heartfelt gratitude to all Hunters who have been with us over the past two and a half years. Thanks to your continued support, Solo Leveling Arise has reached a meaningful milestone of over 70 million cumulative players on its 2.5th Anniversary.

To express our appreciation, we would like to first introduce the 2.5th Anniversary gifts prepared by our team.
You can claim these right as the 2.5th Anniversary Festival begins, so please log in and enjoy the gifts and content we have prepared. Additionally, a special appreciation gift commemorating 70 million Hunters will be revealed during the live stream on October 19, so please look forward to it.

● Obtain up to 2.5th Anniversary Special Draw Tickets x500 including Stackers
● Earn up to 10,000 Essence Stones through event gameplay

※A maximum of 2.5th Anniversary Special Draw Tickets x300 can be earned through the first update in October, and up to 200 tickets through the second update in November. These will be available through check\-ins and gameplay, with full details to be announced in the upcoming patch notes.

In addition, ahead of the 2.5th Anniversary Festival, the Pre Anniversary Loyalty Event starting October 8 will award Mystery Boxes containing special rewards that can be used after the 2.5th Anniversary. We kindly ask for your enthusiastic participation.

Also, in celebration of Halloween, Seorin and Diana Lopez will visit Hunters in special outfits designed to steal your hearts.

 

Now, let us guide you through the detailed updates our team has prepared.

 

 

[ACT 18. Attack of the Monarchs] (Edited on 10/14(Wed) 02:23 (UTC+0))

 

A massive Gate covering the skies of Seoul, and three Monarchs appearing right before Sung Jinwoo.

Amidst an unprecedented anomaly where Gate spawns have ceased across the entire world, the Monarchs begin to move once more. As Sung Jinwoo clashes with the Monarchs, the situation plunges deeper into catastrophe, forcing Sung Jinwoo to face the greatest crisis he has ever encountered.

"A freezing wind cold enough to freeze even the soul has begun to blow."

We hope you will personally experience this suffocating tension and despair, along with the thrilling moment of rising above it all in your gameplay.
 

※ Development in progress. Final implementation may be subject to change.
 

Furthermore, as he undergoes the greatest crisis on a new battlefield against the Monarchs, Sung Jinwoo awakens to a new power. Sung Jinwoo's max level will be expanded from Lv 160 to Lv 170, accompanied by the new Job Change ‘Requiem’ and the new Ultimate Skill Commander's Authority.

 

[The Chairman of the Hunters Association, Borrowing the Power of the Four Divine Beasts in a Forgotten World: Holy Guardian Barrier Go Gunhee ]
 

 

"Blessed by the Four Divine Beasts."

In the time turned back by the Cup of Reincarnation, there exist Hunters who made choices slightly different from those in our current timeline, though still resembling them. Having played active roles in a world now forgotten, they remain preserved in recorded history to be remembered for a long time. The character arriving this time, Holy Guardian Barrier Go Gunhee, is indeed Go Gunhee from that alternate world.

Though he lost so much amid an irreversible tragedy, instead of crumbling under the weight of his loss, he resolved to build a system that would protect all Hunters. He is a true guardian of the Hunters Association who chose to dedicate his renewed youth solely to protecting even more lives.

 

※ Basic Skills and Skill Core (Left: Four Divine Beasts Skill Combo), Ultimate Skill (Right)
※ Development in progress. Final implementation may be subject to change.

Holy Guardian Barrier Go Gunhee joins the battlefield as a Water element Buster Hunter. Azure Scale, Black Tortoise Shell, White Tiger Fang, and Vermilion Wing. He is a martial artist borrowing the power of the Four Divine Beasts, with every single strike carrying his resolute determination to protect. Hunters that synergize well when paired together include Meiri Laine and Elena Renault.

※ ‘Holy Guardian Barrier Go Gunhee’ will be introduced as a Defense based Hunter.

[Successor Inheriting the Ferocity of the Monarch of Fangs: Velvet]
 

"Did you call for me? Now is your only chance to run."
 

At the scene of the massacre left behind by the Monarch of Fangs, Adan, there was a single person who felt no fear. Finding thrill on the line between life and death, she inherited the ferocity of Adan and became the Successor of Fangs.

Concealing a ruthless love for the game behind an elegant, captivating face, Velvet arrives as a Fire element Successor. She changes stances freely during combat, building up power as her attacks connect, then releasing that accumulated force in transformed empowered strikes unique to each stance. At the moment of her Ultimate, experience the battle of an apex predator that grows stronger as she rides the rhythm of combat.
 

[2.5th Anniversary Update Key Highlights]

■ Challenges Beyond All Limits: Difficulty Expansion for Key Contents

To match the remarkable growth Hunters have demonstrated, we are expanding the difficulty of key content including Unstable Dungeon, Battlefield of Chaos, Mind Rift, Workshop of Brilliant Light, and Simulation Gate, while also increasing the combat difficulty for the seasonal content The Overseer's Forbidden Library, ensuring a clearer sense of progression and higher goals.

Stronger upper difficulty tiers will be added to existing daily and weekly challenges, allowing you to test your limits in even fiercer battles. To further elevate the true value of your efforts, in addition to increased standard clear rewards, exclusive honor rewards will be granted upon first clearing these higher difficulties.

These honor rewards will become available for clears following the November update, with additional honors planned to continually honor your achievements whenever new limits are unlocked in the future.
We invite you to shine your path with honor through these new upper difficulty challenges and achievements.

■ New Strategic 4 Hunter Challenge: Deep Containment Zone

 

※ Development in progress. Final implementation may be subject to change.

A new four Hunter team fight mode begins. Four Hunters form a team to target Experiment (variant bosses) that have exceeded their limits. Each experiment causes abnormal phenomena under specific conditions such as wave impacts, host monster spawns, and random ground hazards, while environmental hazards including zone collapses and gas leaks occur during the battle.
Additionally, the newly added Deep Containment Zone requires strategic skill compositions compared to other three Hunter challenge dungeons. Formulate diverse strategies depending on the season and boss, deciding whether to prioritize raw damage or tailor buff and debuff skill setups to counter abnormal phenomena.

The newly introduced battle system Union can be activated when deploying four Hunters of the same element. Filling the gauge and activating Union unleashes a powerful skill alongside class specific effects for deployed Hunters, granting a decisive advantage in battle. Since it can only be used once per battle, strategic timing will be key to securing victory.

Deep Containment Zone opens upon defeating Igris in Expert Mode and will first be introduced as a Beta. Initially, Experiment Kargalgan with Water element weakness and Experiment Igris with Wind element weakness will each appear for two weeks. We kindly ask for your enthusiasm and participation in this new challenge content.

■ New Growth, Toward Higher Goals Beyond Mighty Enemies - Figure

 

※ Development in progress. Final implementation may be subject to change.
 

The Figure system will be added to further empower Sung Jinwoo, Successors, and Hunters.

Defeating formidable foes such as Igris, Kargalgan, and the 8 Monarchs on Expert difficulty will now leave behind proof of growth in the form of Figures.
These Figures embody the battle experience of Hunters who overcame fierce encounters, and completing them leads to new growth toward even higher goals. Consisting of two branches, one for Sung Jinwoo and Successors and another for Hunters, a total of 5 Figures will be unlockable upon initial release.

Unlocked Figures are completed by refining their stats. Each Figure features 3 stats in total, and you can refine desired stats using materials earned from Activity Funds bonuses, Deep Containment Zone, and events to craft your own unique Figure. Favored stats can be locked in place while aiming for higher tiers, and completing all 3 stats at B grade or higher activates a special buff effect.

■ Endless Boss Waves: Challenge Your Limits: Battlefield of Infinity

 

 ※ Development in progress. Final implementation may be subject to change.
 

The content introduced this past September as Infinite Relay Boss Challenge arrives under the official name ‘Battlefield of Infinity’.

This event content challenges you to defeat as many ceaselessly spawning bosses as possible within a time limit, available in both Sung Jinwoo Mode and Hunter Mode. Achievement points and rankings are calculated based on your initial boss kill count, earning you various achievement and ranking rewards including Essence Stones, Rate Up Draw Tickets, event materials, and Gold at each stage.

■ Relive Iconic Scenes from the Original Series: Seasonal Card
 

※ Seasonal Card Page (Left), Set Composition and Reward Page (Right)
 

※ Collection Book Page to Review Collected Cards
※ Development in progress. Final implementation may be subject to change.

Starting with the 2.5th Anniversary, Seasonal Cards will be added in place of Special Commissions. You can collect Seasonal Cards featuring iconic webtoon cuts, ARISE Hunters, and monsters to complete sets and earn various rewards. Duplicate cards convert into Card Points which can be exchanged for new card packs, while missing cards can be filled using Joker Cards.

Simply participating every day grants collection rewards such as Rate Up Draw Tickets, Essence Stones, and Dungeon Keys. Enjoy the thrill of completing your collection with original scenes and Hunters.

■ Prove the Results of Your Training Against the Monarchs: Hall of the Monarchs (New Season)

Starting in Week 3, a new season of Hall of Monarchs begins. In this season of Hall of Monarchs, bosses appear in the order of Davorka → Tarr → Rockpasa, with Fire and Water as their weak elements.
※ Hall of Monarchs is unlocked upon clearing Workshop of Brilliant Light Tier 10, separate from the Workshop of Brilliant Light difficulty expansion.

[Challenges and Honor Toward the Ultimate Hunter: Ranking System Revamp]
The ranking system is being restructured into a seasonal format focused on Total Ranking, Content Ranking, Total Power Ranking (Battle Class Total Power), and Hunter Total Power Ranking (Hunter Special Operation List 5 Hunters). The newly revamped ranking will serve as a leaderboard that symbolizes honor itself rather than competition solely for rewards.

Additionally, to foster an active environment where you can grow and compete together, Hunters with similar activity levels will be grouped every season. Moving forward, matching across all content and rankings will be based on your assigned group, structured to ensure active participation regardless of which group you belong to.

[Other Improvements]

■ Adjustments Following Guild Buff Overhaul

Following the Guild Buff overhaul, the Guild Buffs previously purchasable in the Guild Exchange Shop will no longer be sold after the reset on October 15. We will share full details on the new buffs arriving alongside the Guild system overhaul in the October update.
▶ Prior Notice: End of Buff Exchange in Guild Exchange Shop

■ Smoother Combat Experience Even on Devices with Limited High Graphics Capabilities (Scheduled for November Update)

Our team has utilized high resolution resources to deliver the best action and visually stunning combat experience to Hunters. However, we have confirmed that some Hunters experienced gameplay issues due to high resolution and heavy memory usage. To allow smooth and comfortable combat even on devices where high resolution settings are difficult to run, we are preparing an option to play with standard resolution.

Once applied in the November update, standard resolution resources will be applied by default for new installations on devices with limited high graphics capabilities, while existing Hunters can switch via a popup notice upon logging into the game. You will also be able to adjust this directly in Settings to suit your play environment.

Additionally, background downloading of resources is being prepared for Android environments, which will significantly lessen the burden of waiting for downloads.

※Please note that returning to previous high resolution resources will not be supported after switching to standard resolution resources.
※ Certain characters and costumes may appear differently when standard resolution resources are applied.

 

In addition to the new Hunter, Successor, the story depicting the clash between Sung Jinwoo and the Monarchs, along with new growth and challenges beyond all limits introduced today, many more changes will arrive with this 2.5th Anniversary update.

The major Guild overhaul previewed in the September Dev Note will introduce newly revamped Guild Attendance Rewards and Guild Buffs, alongside balance buffs for leader skills of select Hunters and Shadows, as well as difficulty expansions for Workshop of Brilliant Light, Simulation Gate, Unstable Dungeon, Battlefield of Chaos, and Mind Rift. Additional detailed information including 2.5th Anniversary events will be announced through patch notes aligned with the update timing.

The fact that ARISE has been able to stand here for two and a half years is entirely thanks to Hunters who played together and shared diverse feedback at every moment. This 2.5th Anniversary update marks the very first step embodying the feedback you have provided, and in upcoming updates as well, we will continuously shape Arise into a game offering a smoother play environment, more enjoyable content, and tangible progression matching your growth.

On October 22, we look forward to meeting Hunters at the beginning of a new battle.

We ask for your continued love and support for Solo Leveling: ARISE.

Thank you.

[2.5th Anniversary Festival Dev Note Gift! ]

📌 New Growth System 'Figure' Added
- A new growth system [Figure] that allows additional stat growth for Sung Jinwoo, Successors, and Hunters has been added.
- The Figure system is unlocked upon clearing Story Expert Chapter 8, and new Figures are sequentially unlocked upon clearing specific Expert Chapters thereafter.
- Unlocked Figures can be accessed and checked via [Quick Menu] → [Figure].
- Figures can be distinguished as 'Sung Jinwoo and Successor Applied Figures' and 'Hunter Applied Figures' through icon displays.
- Stats increased through Figure growth are immediately reflected in Stat Info and included in Total Power calculations.
- A 'Recurring Missions' category has been newly added under [Missions], where Figure growth materials can be obtained upon completing missions.

▶Figure Grades and Conversion
- Each Figure consists of 3 stat slots, and the overall grade of the Figure is determined based on the lowest grade among the 3 slots.
- Gold and ‘Polish of Change' can be used to transform Figure options.
- Upon conversion, S / A / B / C / D / E grade options are applied to each slot according to set rates.
- If all options in the 3 slots reach at least B grade or higher, the Figure's unique effect is additionally applied.

▶Stat Lock and Convenience Features
- Stat Lock Feature: Select the lock button next to the Figure option to lock desired options and convert only the remaining slots.
※ Consumes 'Seals of Unity' when converting with locked stats
- Auto Convert: Set target grades and preferred stat types to automatically proceed with convert until the desired conditions are met.
- Save Stats: Activating the Save Stats feature increases the material cost per conversion, but allows you to choose whether to apply the conversion results, enabling you to retain previous stats.
※ The Auto Convert feature cannot be used while the Save Stats feature is active.

📌 New Weekly Mission Content 'Deep Containment Zone' Added
- A new content, 'Deep Containment Zone,' where you face experimental test subject bosses that exceed limits using a combination of 4 Hunters, has been added.
- Deep Containment Zone is unlocked upon clearing Story Expert Chapter 8.
- 'Deep Containment Zone Keys' are required for entry, and 2 keys are automatically distributed every Thursday at 00:00 (UTC+0).
※ Keys are not consumed upon clear failure.
- Figure growth materials can be obtained as rewards upon clearing the dungeon.
※ Deep Containment Zone will first be introduced as a Beta Season, and select features or reward structures may change when transitioning to the official season in the future.
- Special effects are applied to Deep Containment Zone every week, and detailed information can be checked in [Season Info] → [Anomaly Report].
※ Appearing bosses, dungeon elements, and Anomaly Report effects will rotate regularly.

▶New Battle System 'Union'
- A new battle system, 'Union,' which can be used when forming a team with 4 Hunters of the same element in the Deep Containment Zone, has been added.
- The 'Union Gauge' can be charged over time during battle or by using QTE skills.
- Filling the gauge allows you to activate the Union skill, and upon activation, skill effects are triggered according to the classes of the deployed Hunters.
※ The Union skill is a battle system usable exclusively in Deep Containment Zone and can only be used once per battle.

📌 New Card System Added
- A new [Card] system where you can collect various cards and complete sets to obtain rewards has been added.
- The Card system is unlocked upon reaching Sung Jinwoo Level 7.
- You can access it by selecting [Seasonal Card] or [Collection Book] submenus under Quick Menu → [Card].

▶ Seasonal Card & Collection Book
- Seasonal Card: Seasonal Cards operate on a seasonal basis, allowing you to collect cards each season and earn set completion rewards.
- Collection Book: You can check all collected cards at a glance in the Collection Book.
※ Seasonal Card Season 1 Period: 10/22 (Thu) after update – 12/3 (Thu) 00:00 (UTC+0)

▶Card Acquisition and Collection Rewards
- Complete missions in Seasonal Card to obtain 'Card Packs', which grant cards at set rates upon use.
- Cards range from 1 Star to 5 Star grades, and obtaining certain Special Cards grants additional rewards.
- Complete sets by collecting all cards within a set to earn [Set Completion Rewards].
- Earn rewards such as Joker Cards, Card Coins, Essence Stones, and Rate Up Draw Tickets based on overall season collection progress.

▶Duplicate Cards and Currency Usage
- Duplicate cards automatically convert into 'Card Points' based on their Star (★) grade and accumulate over time.
- Card Points / Card Coins: Can be exchanged for new Card Packs in the Exchange Shop.
- Joker Card: Can be exchanged for 1 unowned card from the current active season.
※ Joker Cards have an expiration date. If not used within the time limit, they are automatically consumed to grant an unowned card.
- When the season ends, all owned cards for that season (except in the Collection Book) as well as accumulated Card Points and Coins reset, so please consume them before the season ends.
※ Cards from ended seasons may become restricted or difficult to acquire in the future.

- Card Loyalty: Duplicate card acquisitions accumulate Card Loyalty separately by season and Star grade. Once a set threshold is reached, drawing a card of that Star grade guarantees an unowned card from the opened Card Pack instead of a duplicate.
※ Card Loyalty resets upon acquiring an unowned card of that season and Star grade, or when the season ends.
※ If all cards of that Star grade are already owned, the unowned card guarantee will not apply.
※ Detailed guarantee conditions by season and Star grade can be checked on the [Web Probability Info Page].

📌 Guild System Overhaul
▶ Guild Max Level Expansion
- The Guild max level has been expanded from Level 30 up to Level 50.

▶ Guild Check-In Reward Overhaul
- Guild Check-In rewards have been overhauled so that additional Essence Stones and Guild Coins can be obtained in tiers based on the 'number of Guild members who logged in on the previous day'.
※ Overhauled Guild Check-In rewards are divided into 5 tiers. Detailed rewards for each check-in tier can be checked in game via [Guild Check-In].
※ Following the 10/22 update, Guild Check-In rewards will start at the base tier (Tier 1) due to the system overhaul implementation.

▶ Guild Rank Buff Overhaul
- Existing Guild rank buffs have been overhauled into Guild level effects, automatically applying buffs to all Guild members upon reaching specified Guild levels.
※ Stats increased through Guild rank buffs are immediately reflected in the stats and Total Power of Sung Jinwoo, Hunters, and Successors.

▶ New Guild Mastery Added
- A new system, [Guild Mastery], which allows you to freely increase stats and grow according to personal choice, has been added.
- Accessible by talking to NPC Jian in [Guild] via [Guild Info] → [Guild Mastery].
- You can consume Guild Coins or Essence Stones to directly select desired effects and raise skill levels to enhance abilities.
- The maximum growth limit (Max Level) of Guild Mastery expands in proportion to the level of your current Guild.
※ Stats increased through Guild Mastery are immediately reflected in the stats and Total Power of Sung Jinwoo, Hunters, and Successors.
※ Even if you leave a Guild or move to another Guild, previously unlocked and leveled Mastery ranks will be maintained.
※ However, Mastery buff effects do not apply while not in a Guild and will reactivate upon joining a Guild.
※ Even when transferring to a Guild with a lower level, previously developed Mastery effects remain fully active without restriction.

▶ Guild Discord Link Sharing System Added
- A feature to register and share Discord links in the [Guild Management] → [Guild Notice] menu has been added.

▶ Guild Exchange Shop Buff Exchange Overhaul
- A new [Supplies] tab where you can purchase various content exclusive buff items has been added to the Guild Exchange Shop.
※ Detailed information on sold buff items can be checked in game at the Exchange Shop.

▶ Existing Guild Skill Effect Conversion
- Following the introduction of the new growth system [Guild Mastery], existing [Guild Skills] have been converted and overhauled into [Guild Mastery] buffs.

- Successor of the Fangs [Velvet] has been added.

Score Calculation Method

Overall Rank

Final ranks are determined by combining ranking scores from each category, updated hourly on the hour.

Total Power Rank

Scores calculated based on the highest Total Power in Battle Class.

Special Operation List Rank

Scores awarded based on the combined Total Power of the 5 Hunters registered on the Special Operation List for each update.

Content Rank

Scores awarded according to ranks in content such as Power of Calamity and Hall of the Monarchs.

▶ Previous Season Rewards Distribution Notice Following Ranking System Improvements
- As the Ranking System changes to a group matching method, calculation rewards for previous seasons conducted before the change will be sequentially distributed via Mail after the update.
- Since rewards are sent directly to the Mailbox, in game settlement animations will not play, and sent rewards can be checked and claimed in the Mailbox.
※ Applicable Content: Power of Calamity, Hall of the Monarchs

▶ Other Ranking Improvement Changes
- In connection with ranking improvements, the 'Top % of Server' display shown under Token Collection in Profile → Challenge Medals → Main Token will be removed.
※ Information regarding the overall player acquisition percentage for each token will be retained.

📌 Weekly Mission Improvements and Changes
▶ Workshop of Brilliant Light Max Difficulty Expansion and Balance Adjustments
- The maximum difficulty for Workshop of Brilliant Light has been expanded from Tier 10 up to Tier 14.
※ As before, Hall of the Monarchs unlocks upon clearing Sung Jinwoo Mode Tier 10 in Workshop of Brilliant Light.
- During the October update period, Elemental Accumulation applied to bosses in Sung Jinwoo Mode of Workshop of Brilliant Light will be significantly reduced, while damage received during Break status and gauge recovery times will be significantly increased.
※ This balance adjustment does not apply to Hunter Mode.

▶ Simulation Gate Max Difficulty Expansion
- A new season of Simulation Gate begins, featuring new Weakness Elements and Algorithms.
- The maximum difficulty for Simulation Gate has been expanded from Tier 60 up to Tier 65.
※ When attempting tiers, lower tiers can be skipped to directly challenge higher tiers. Clearing a higher tier will automatically complete all challenges for the lower tiers.

▶ Power of Calamity
- A new season of Power of Calamity begins, and the boss changes to 'Ennio'.
- Recommended Elements will be fixed to Water and Fire until the next season, and Conquest Support will be newly applied.
- Power of Calamity season rankings will aggregate ranks and distribute rewards based on group matched Hunters rather than all Hunters.

▶ Guild Boss
- The Guild Boss will feature 'Giant Statue' until the next regular update.
- Recommended Elements will be fixed to Fire until the next season, with additional Recommended Elements applied in the order of Dark, Water, Wind, and Light depending on the week.

📌 Seasonal Mission Improvements and Changes
▶ Hall of the Monarchs
- A new season of Hall of the Monarchs begins on 11/5 at 00:00 (UTC+0), and season rewards will be changed.
- Score achievement rewards have been newly added, allowing you to earn rewards upon reaching target scores.
※ Please check in game for detailed information on rewards.

▶ Battlefield of Time
- A new season of Battlefield of Time begins, featuring new bosses.
- The competition format has been changed from server wide ranking to group matching, where you compete with Hunters within the same assigned group.

▶ Overseer's Forbidden Library
- With the opening of the new season of Overseer's Forbidden Library, the difficulty and recommended Total Power for [Ancient Shelf] and [Forbidden Shelf] have been adjusted upward.
- Entry Elements, appearing bosses, and Bookmark target Hunters will change according to the new season progression.
※ Please check required Total Power by difficulty and detailed season rules in game via Overseer's Forbidden Library.

 

📌 New In-Game Shop Item Sales Notice
- New items will be added to the shops below after the update. For details regarding the items sold in the new shop, please check the item sales notice below.
 [Go to 10/22 (Thu) New Packages]

📌New System Shop Items Added
 - The following items will be added to the System Shop after the 10/22 update.

Item

New_SSR Cha Hae-In Special Chance Pack
Sung Jinwoo Skill Level Up Chance Pack
Light Element SSR Hunter Chance Pack
Weapon Enhancement Chance Pack
Hunter Upgrade Chance Pack
Shadow Growth Chance Pack
First Gem Equipping Celebration! Gem Special Pack
Monarch of Shadows: Titan of Twilight Awakening Celebration! Transcendent Blessing Stone Pack
Transcendent Blessing Stone Chance Pack

※ Chance Pack items appear based on game progression, such as clearing content or upgrading Weapons and Hunters, and can be purchased within a set time limit after appearing.
※ Detailed information on new Chance Packs can be checked when they appear in game. Gold, Essence Stones, or direct purchase methods may apply depending on the item type, so please check in game for details.

 

📌 Other Improvements
- The title screen, download video, and app icon have been updated.
- Improved so that the instant crafting feature can be used immediately upon unlocking an Armory slot.
- Improved so that the quantity of owned Dungeon Keys can be directly checked on the lobby screen.
- Icon buttons have been added to the lobby screen to allow quick access to Rankings and Check-In.
- A speed up feature has been added to fast forward through cutscenes appearing during Story Normal difficulty.
- [Display Buff Icons] and [Display Buff Duration] options have been added under [Options] → [Controls Layout] menu, enabling easier tracking and management of active buff info during battle.
- Improved so that the scroll position on the research list is retained after completing Skill Synthesis and Amplification.
- Improved so that Element icons for each Skill Rune can be checked when using Skill Transcendent Stone Selection Boxes.
- Select item tabs have been reorganized and merged for Shop structure improvements.
- 2 types of Seals of Unity previously separated by Successor have been merged into a single shared item.

📌 Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where pressing the F key during the QTE phase for Adan in PC version Workshop of Brilliant Light triggered Weapon Skills simultaneously.
- Fixed an issue where control buttons and UI were displayed abnormally small on select 4:3 aspect ratio devices.
- Fixed an issue where skill animations were applied abnormally when using Alicia Blanche's Winter Storm skill.
 

We will continue to do our best to provide you with the best possible service.

Thank you.

Developer Notes

Must ReadDeveloper Note: Kamish's Wrath Arrives

Hunters Association
|
Nov 12, 2026, 07:47
|
5,675

 

Greetings Hunters,
The Hunters Association has a notice for you.

Ever since our 2.5 Year Anniversary kicked off, we’ve been blown away by the creative strategies you’ve brought to both the Battlefield of Infinity and the Deep Containment Zone.

In Battlefield of Infinity, Wind teams are dominating Hunter Mode while Water builds take center stage with Sung Jinwoo. Over in the Deep Containment Zone, we love seeing everyone push the meta with fresh compositions and tactics.

Thank you so much for your relentless passion and support!
We’re keeping a close eye on all the feedback across our community channels, and we will keep refining the game to deliver the best experience possible.

Looking ahead to November, we’ve packed in tons of exciting content, headlined by Sung Jinwoo’s ultimate weapon from the original series: ‘Kamish's Wrath’. You can also look forward to a brand-new original Hunter and a new Guild Boss. On top of that, to celebrate the 2.5 Year Anniversary Part 2, we’re giving away up to 200 2.5 Year Anniversary Special Custom Draw Tickets (including Stackers) just for playing and logging in.

Don’t miss out on grabbing the Hunters you have been eyeing!
Now, let us jump right into the full preview our team has put together.

 

[One of the Ultimate Weapons from the Original: Kamish's Wrath & Kamish's Roar]

 

 

※ Kamish's Wrath Combat Footage (Captured during development and subject to change upon the official update.)

Following a brief preview in October during the battle against Sillad, the Monarch of Frost, One of the Ultimate Weapons from the Original: Kamish's Wrath is finally making its official debut.

Kamish's Wrath is a pair of daggers crafted from the sharpest fangs of Kamish, the dragon known as humanity's greatest calamity. It arrives as a weapon specialized for Fire elemental damage, featuring a fast and relentless combat style with dual blades held in a reverse grip.

Kamish's Roar appears as an original weapon specialized for Fire elemental stacking, delivering powerful thrust attacks that infuse elements across a wide area. As both weapons harness the might of Kamish, they possess formidable Fire elemental power, and we expect them to elevate the firepower of Fire team compositions to an entirely new level.

Please look forward to the explosive firepower that Kamish's Wrath and Kamish's Roar will bring to the battlefield.

[Dark Elemental Overload Supporter, Thalia De Rossi]

Thalia De Rossi, a Dark elemental supporter from the Rivera Guild, joins the fight.

Standing steadfast by Agnes Rivera, she brings a distinctive combat style that commands flowers and thorny briars. Thalia De Rossi boosts team survivability through shields and recovery buffs while empowering your damage dealers with an Overload buff and an increased Critical Damage Taken debuff.

Her true potential shines especially bright alongside the Dark elemental buster Agnes Rivera, and she further excels in her supporter role by increasing Sung Jinwoo's Core Attack damage.

Look forward to the story of Thalia De Rossi, closely entwined with Agnes Rivera, and the incredible synergy these two Hunters will unleash together.

[New Guild Boss: Dargo, the Horn of the Azure Sea]

A colossal beast that serves the King of Beasts and the Beast Army, Dargo, the Horn of the Azure Sea, makes its debut as a new Guild Boss.

Wielding varied attacks driven by the sharp horn on its forehead and the power of water, prepare brand new strategies alongside your guild members to take down Dargo.

※ Dargo possesses strong resistance to elemental accumulation, requiring active elemental accumulation to push it into the Overload state.

[Power of Calamity: Tangible Growth and Real Achievement]

 ※ The screen above is currently under development and may be subject to change upon official release.

Until now, Power of Calamity has leaned heavily toward competitive gameplay focused on competing for maximum damage records. Beginning with this November update, it will be revamped into an experience centered around steadily challenging and achieving milestones tailored to each Hunter's stage of progression.

The system will shift to a stage progression structure where defeating a boss advances you to the next tier, granting both tier clear rewards and damage milestone rewards along the way. Even when a new season begins, you can continue directly from the highest stage you previously reached, ensuring your hard earned progress is never lost.

In addition, previous elemental restrictions will be removed, and all elements will apply as weakness elements, allowing you to freely tackle stages with your own custom team compositions. Playtime will also be shortened so you can jump into challenges with a lighter, more streamlined experience.

Weekly and seasonal ranking rewards based on your current stage and cumulative damage will remain at the same level as before, with first time clear rewards added for each stage milestone. As the content is being revamped to make your steady progression and reached stages far more meaningful, we look forward to your enthusiastic participation

[Guild Revamp Part 2]
In this November update, we would like to share follow-up improvements continuing from the guild revamp announced during the 2.5 Year Anniversary.

First, a "Guild Item Trade-In" event will take place where Hunters can contribute surplus inventory items such as Mana Crystals and Artifact Enhancement Chips, as well as Gold, to their guild. This event will feature individual achievement rewards for each guild member alongside collective rewards achieved by the entire guild, allowing you to earn Guild Coins upon reaching contribution milestones. 

 

The Guild Item Trade-In event will initially run during the 2nd to 3rd week of the update, and we plan to continue hosting this event moving forward while actively incorporating feedback from our Hunters.

Additionally, we are preparing a Tutorial Guild (Ahjin Guild) so that new Hunters can experience basic guild features in advance, such as check ins and Guild Boss Raids, before joining an official guild. We will continue to improve guild activities to ensure they remain meaningful and rewarding.

[Standard Resource Option for Smoother Action]
To provide a smoother action experience even on lower spec devices, resource settings will be separated into High Quality and Standard Quality through this November update. On devices where running high quality resources is difficult, the Standard Quality resource will be downloaded by default upon initial installation, enabling seamless gameplay with smaller file sizes and lower memory usage.

 

※ When applying the Standard Quality resource option, the file size is reduced by approximately 45%, from around 14 GB (based on High Quality resources) to around 8 GB. Actual sizes may vary slightly upon application and download.

Hunters who have already installed and are playing the game can switch down to the Standard Quality option directly in settings, and you can switch back whenever you wish to play in High Quality. However, please note that changing the resource quality requires downloading the entire resource pack again, so we strongly recommend doing so in a Wi-Fi environment.

In addition, a background download feature has been added for Android devices, allowing you to multitask while downloads progress. As shared in our previous developer notes and livestreams, our team remains committed to continuously improving the game to ensure an optimal gameplay environment.

[New Damage Display Option for Cleaner Combat]

*Before (Left), After (Right). The display format for units can be adjusted via settings.

We have noted feedback that as combat grows more intense with rising Total Power, the sheer volume of damage numbers filling the screen can reduce readability. To address this, a new option will be added that allows damage numbers to be displayed in simplified units. You can configure your preferred display style directly through settings, so be sure to check it out following the November update.

[Smarter Auto-Battle for Sung Jinwoo]
To ensure a satisfying combat experience even when playing Sung Jinwoo in Auto-Battle, improvements will be made to Sung Jinwoo Mode Auto-Battle.

Skill rotations, such as transitioning smoothly from elemental accumulation into overload, will now connect much more seamlessly, allowing you to experience true Sung Jinwoo style action even without manual control.

 

The enthusiasm and support our Hunters have sent our way for the 2.5 Year Anniversary have been an immense source of strength for our team. We are thoroughly reviewing all the diverse feedback shared across our various channels, so please continue to let your voices be heard anytime.

As the flames of Kamish ignite the battlefield this November, we will relentlessly improve the game so you can rediscover the joy of progression, experience the excitement of playing together, and dive into thrilling action and satisfying tactical clears.

Thank you once again for your ongoing passion and support for Solo Leveling: ARISE.

[Dev Note Release Celebration! Check-In Event]

Essence Stone x2,600

Seals of Unity x5
Guild Coins, Key materials, etc.
