Mana Power Extract Chance Pack
Abyssal Crystal Chance Pack
Figure Conversion Chance Pack

※ Chance Pack items appear based on game progression, such as clearing content or upgrading Weapons and Hunters, and can be purchased within a set time limit after appearing.
※ Detailed information on new Chance Packs can be checked when they appear in game. Gold, Essence Stones, or direct purchase methods may apply depending on the item type, so please check in game for details.

 

📌 Mobile Environment Improvements
- To reduce storage space and performance load on mobile devices and provide a smoother gameplay experience, resources have been separated into High Quality Resources and Standard Resources.
- On devices where High Quality Resources are difficult to run, Standard Resources will be downloaded by default upon initial installation.
- You can change the resource quality via the 'Apply Standard Resources' option in [Options > Graphics].
- Enabling 'Apply Standard Resources' reduces resource storage size by approximately 40% compared to High Quality Resources.
※ Actual resource size may vary depending on your device and specifications.
※ Changing resource quality requires redownloading all resources, so we recommend proceeding over a Wi-Fi connection.
※ Depending on device specifications, 'Apply Standard Resources' may be enabled automatically, and in such cases, switching back to High Quality Resources may not be available.
- A background resource download feature has been added for Android, allowing you to use other apps while downloading.

📌 Other Improvements
● Combat
- A feature has been added under [Pause Battle > Options > Controls Layout] allowing you to individually toggle Auto Skill usage for each Support Hunter.
- A 'Simplify Damage Numbers' setting has been added under [Options > Graphics] to condense large damage numbers into units for easier visibility during combat.
- Improved so that individual team settings are retained when retrying Guild Boss.
- Improved skill usage AI during Sung Jinwoo Mode Auto Combat when chaining into Elemental Accumulation and Overload.

● Team Formation
- An [Apply All] feature has been added to Recommended Formation, allowing you to configure a suitable lineup all at once based on the selected Element tab.
- A [Prioritize Recommended Formation] option has been added to Auto Formation to prioritize the Element rules from Recommended Formation.
- 'Player Team Fight' and 'Hunter Team Fight' preset modes have been added, and Guild Boss formation presets have been expanded from 10 to 20.
- In ‘Manage Presets', you can now copy preset settings between play modes and selectively copy only desired categories such as Sung Jinwoo, Hunters, or Shadows.

● UI
- The [Relic] button in the Quick Menu has been removed, and [Gems] and [Armory] have been separated into individual tabs.
- Improved so that you can check the Remnant Power used by other Hunters in certain ranking content.
- A [View All] button has been added to the item info popup so you can check all owned chests that grant the item at once, and when using Instant Craft with insufficient materials, you can now also view owned chests that provide the required materials.
- Improved Guild Mastery ‘Enhance All’ so you can enhance up to the maximum level all at once.
- The name of the 'Monarch of Fangs Adan (Beast Form)' card in Seasonal Card content has been changed to 'Monarch of Fangs Adan (Spiritual Body Manifestation)'.

● Others
- The daily purchase limit for Sweep Points has been expanded from 500 to 1,000.
- Improved so that locked Figure options remain locked even when logging in on a different device.
- Accounts with no guild join history after unlocking Guilds will be assigned to the solo-only 'Ahjin Guild', allowing access to individual Guild content such as Check-In and Personal Guild Boss.
※ Joining another Guild or creating a Guild will end access to the Ahjin Guild, and you cannot return to it afterward.
- Before proceeding with Special Summons, you can select 4 SSR Hunters/Weapons in advance, and when a confirmed result occurs, 1 of the 4 selected Hunters/Weapons is guaranteed to be included.
※ This applies starting from Special Summons opening after 12/01 00:00 (UTC+0).

📌 Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where skipping the cutscene upon entering the Deep Containment Zone for the first time caused the wrong BGM to loop repeatedly.
- Fixed an issue where the QTE icon was displayed incorrectly when checking the Recommended Skill Rotation for Successor of Fangs Velvet in the Training Room.
- Fixed an issue where the camera view shifted after entering certain dungeons in the Battlefield of Time.
- Fixed an issue where the camera view would intermittently lock in place when repeatedly tagging during combat on mobile devices.
- Fixed an issue where previously purchased Costume Packs could be purchased again in the Costume Shop.
- Fixed an issue where the cinematic camera view shifted when entering Edge of Illusion and Dreams with other Hunters.
- Fixed an issue where the Break duration extension buff values were applied differently between Successor of White Flames Myro and the Monarch of the Shadows.
- Fixed an issue where only the Successor's entry skill was triggered when sequentially inputting the Ultimate Skills of Successor of White Flames Myro and Sung Jinwoo.
- Fixed an issue where the Total Power of designated Hunters in Sub Stories was applied differently.
- Fixed an issue where information on users who obtained Tokens was not displayed in Challenge Medals.

We will continue to do our best to provide you with the best possible service.

Thank you.

- 11/20 (Fri) 10:15 (UTC+0) (Completed)
 
📌 Patch Details
- An issue where the weapon animation does not display properly when obtaining Kamish's Wrath with Standard Resources applied.
- An issue where the weapon effect does not display on the Draw results screen for Kamish's Wrath.
- An issue where the stage intermittently does not clear even after defeating the boss in the Workshop of Brilliant Light "Slaughterhouse of Remorse" stage.
- An issue where the "Hunters Association Special Certificate" item does not appear in the [Shop] > [Exchange] > [Celebration Coin Exchange] tab.

- An issue where rewards cannot be claimed from Gate Mining slots that had Mining Teams dispatched prior to the 11/19 (Thu) update.

※Hunters playing with Standard Resources can resolve this issue and play normally by switching to High Quality Resources via [Reset Data] at the top right of the title screen or by changing settings in [Options] > [Graphics].

※(Added on 11/24 09:15 (UTC+0)) The missing data that was not properly applied to Standard Resources has been additionally implemented.

📌 Recommended Build Update Details
- An issue where certain images do not display properly with Standard Resources applied.
- An issue where the Burst effect displays incorrectly when switching to an AI controlled Buster class Hunter after they use their Burst Skill in Hunter Team Fight.
- An issue where a different skill from the selected setting is equipped when pressing the Apply All button after selecting a single skill setting in Recommended Formation.
- An issue where the UI intermittently does not display properly when entering Guild Boss content.

- An issue where Kamish's Wrath weapon skills do not hit properly in the Workshop of Brilliant Light "Sealed Primordial Lungs" stage.

※Please proceed with the recommended update via your market or app store to apply the fixes and play with the updated content.
